    realAdjoint A = A.adjoint

name: EulerPacketPiola.coveringPotential_angle_derivative
statement:
theorem coveringPotential_angle_derivative (P : ℝ) (m : Space → Space)
    (A : LiftTangent → Space) (z : LiftTangent)
    (hA : Continuous (fun θ => A (z.1, θ)))
    (hq : DifferentiableAt ℝ (coveringPotential P m A) z) :
    fderiv ℝ (coveringPotential P m A) z (0, 1) =
      potentialMultiplier (m z.1) (A z)

name: EulerPacketPiola.coveringPotential_pair_piola
statement:
theorem coveringPotential_pair_piola (P κ : ℝ) (m₀ : Space) (Ξ : Space → Space)
    (A : LiftTangent → Space) (hΞ : ContDiff ℝ 2 Ξ)
    (F : Space → Space ≃L[ℝ] Space) (z : LiftTangent)
    (hF : fderiv ℝ Ξ z.1 = (F z.1).toContinuousLinearMap)
    (hdet : (operatorMatrix (F z.1).toContinuousLinearMap).det = 1)
    (hm : (F z.1).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint m₀ ≠ 0)
    (htan : ⟪(F z.1).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint m₀, A z⟫_ℝ = 0)
    (hA : Continuous (fun θ => A (z.1, θ)))
    (hq : DifferentiableAt ℝ
      (coveringPotential P (fun y => (F y).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint m₀) A) z) :
    (F z.1).symm (A z + κ • coveringSlowCurl (F z.1).symm.toContinuousLinearMap
      (coveringPotential P (fun y => (F y).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint m₀) A) z) =
      coveringCurl κ m₀ (coveringPullbackCovector Ξ
        (coveringPotential P (fun y => (F y).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint m₀) A)) z

name: EulerPacketPiola.curlMatrix_rankOne
statement:
theorem curlMatrix_rankOne (a b : Space) :
    curlMatrix (rankOne ℝ a b) = cross b a

name: EulerPacketPiola.curl_lifted_split
statement:
theorem curl_lifted_split (κ : ℝ) (m : Space) (L : LiftTangent →L[ℝ] Space)
    (G : Space →L[ℝ] Space) :
    curlMatrix (L.comp ((EulerGraphPullback.liftedDirection κ m).comp G)) =
      κ • curlMatrix (L.comp ((ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ Space ℝ).comp G)) +
        cross (G.adjoint m) (L (0, 1))

name: EulerPacketPiola.lifted_pair_piola
statement:
theorem lifted_pair_piola (κ : ℝ) (m₀ : Space) (Ξ : Space → Space)
    (A Q : LiftDomain period → Space) (hΞ : ContDiff ℝ 2 Ξ)
    (F : Space → Space ≃L[ℝ] Space)
    (hF : ∀ y, fderiv ℝ Ξ y = (F y).toContinuousLinearMap)
    (hdet : ∀ y, (operatorMatrix (F y).toContinuousLinearMap).det = 1)
    (hQ : ∀ x, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (localFieldLift period Q x)) (x : LiftDomain period)
    (hm : (F x.1).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint m₀ ≠ 0)
    (htan : ⟪(F x.1).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint m₀, A x⟫_ℝ = 0)
    (hangle : fieldDerivative period (0, 1) Q x =
      potentialMultiplier ((F x.1).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint m₀) (A x)) :
    (F x.1).symm (A x + κ • liftedSlowCurl period F Q x) =
      liftedCurl period κ m₀ (liftedPullbackCovector period Ξ Q) x

name: EulerPacketPiola.piolaPairLp_ae
statement:
theorem piolaPairLp_ae (κ : ℝ) (m₀ : Space) (Ξ : Space → Space)
    (A Q : LiftDomain period → Space) (hΞ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Ξ)
    (hc : HasCompactSupport Q) (hQ : ∀ x, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (localFieldLift period Q x))
    (F : Space → Space ≃L[ℝ] Space)
    (hF : ∀ y, fderiv ℝ Ξ y = (F y).toContinuousLinearMap)
    (hdet : ∀ y, (operatorMatrix (F y).toContinuousLinearMap).det = 1)
    (hm : ∀ x, (F x).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint m₀ ≠ 0)
    (htan : ∀ x, ⟪(F x.1).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint m₀, A x⟫_ℝ = 0)
    (hangle : ∀ x, fieldDerivative period (0, 1) Q x =
      potentialMultiplier ((F x.1).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint m₀) (A x)) (p : ℕ) :
    (piolaPairLp period κ m₀ Ξ Q hΞ hc hQ p : LiftDomain period → Space) =ᵐ[liftMeasure period]
      fun x => (F x.1).symm (κ ^ p • A x + κ ^ (p + 1) • liftedSlowCurl period F Q x)

name: EulerPacketPiola.piolaPairLp_mem
statement:
theorem piolaPairLp_mem (κ : ℝ) (m₀ : Space) (Ξ : Space → Space)
    (Q : LiftDomain period → Space) (hΞ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Ξ)
    (hc : HasCompactSupport Q) (hQ : ∀ x, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (localFieldLift period Q x)) (p : ℕ) :
    piolaPairLp period κ m₀ Ξ Q hΞ hc hQ p ∈ divergenceFreeSpace period κ m₀

name: EulerPacketPiola.transformedLiftedCurl_split
statement:
theorem transformedLiftedCurl_split (κ : ℝ) (m₀ : Space)
    (F : Space → Space ≃L[ℝ] Space) (Q : LiftDomain period → Space)
    (x : LiftDomain period) :
    transformedLiftedCurl period κ m₀ F Q x =
      κ • liftedSlowCurl period F Q x +
        cross ((F x.1).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint m₀)
          (fieldDerivative period (0, 1) Q x)

name: EulerPacketPiola.weighted_lifted_pair_piola
statement:
theorem weighted_lifted_pair_piola (κ : ℝ) (m₀ : Space) (Ξ : Space → Space)
    (A Q : LiftDomain period → Space) (hΞ : ContDiff ℝ 2 Ξ)
    (F : Space → Space ≃L[ℝ] Space)
    (hF : ∀ y, fderiv ℝ Ξ y = (F y).toContinuousLinearMap)
    (hdet : ∀ y, (operatorMatrix (F y).toContinuousLinearMap).det = 1)
    (hQ : ∀ x, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (localFieldLift period Q x)) (x : LiftDomain period)
    (hm : (F x.1).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint m₀ ≠ 0)
    (htan : ⟪(F x.1).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint m₀, A x⟫_ℝ = 0)
    (hangle : fieldDerivative period (0, 1) Q x =
      potentialMultiplier ((F x.1).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint m₀) (A x)) (p : ℕ) :
    (F x.1).symm (κ ^ p • A x + κ ^ (p + 1) • liftedSlowCurl period F Q x) =
      κ ^ p • liftedCurl period κ m₀ (liftedPullbackCovector period Ξ Q) x

name: EulerPacketPiola.coveringPotential_contDiff

name: EulerPacketPiola.coveringSlowCurl_contDiff
statement:

name: EulerPacketPiola.smooth_coveringPotential_pair_piola

theorem smooth_coveringPotential_pair_piola (P κ : ℝ) (hP : 0 ≤ P)

    (hΞ : ContDiff ℝ 2 Ξ) (F : Space → Space ≃L[ℝ] Space)
    (hNormal : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => (F y).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint m₀))
    (hm : ∀ y, (F y).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint m₀ ≠ 0)
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (z : LiftTangent)

theorem pairLp_ae

name: EulerPacketResidual.packet_residual_eq_tail
statement:
theorem packet_residual_eq_tail (N : ℕ) (κ : ℝ) (hκ : κ ≠ 0)
    (L : V →ₗ[ℝ] W) (G H : Q →ₗ[ℝ] W) (B C : V →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℝ] W)
    (u : ℕ → V) (p : ℕ → Q) (hu : u 0=0) (hp : H (p 0)=0)
    (hcancel : ∀ n ≤ N, coefficient (N+1) L G H B C u p n=0) :
    residual (N+1) κ L G H B C u p =
      ∑ n ∈ Ico (N+1) (2*N+3), κ^n • coefficient (N+1) L G H B C u p n

name: EulerPacketResidual.residual_eq_evaluate
statement:
theorem residual_eq_evaluate (M : ℕ) (κ : ℝ) (hκ : κ ≠ 0)
    (L : V →ₗ[ℝ] W) (G H : Q →ₗ[ℝ] W) (B C : V →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℝ] W)
    (u : ℕ → V) (p : ℕ → Q) (hu : u 0=0) (hp : H (p 0)=0) :
    residual M κ L G H B C u p = evaluate (2*M) κ (coefficient M L G H B C u p)

name: EulerPacketResidual.residual_eq_tail

theorem residual_eq_tail (M K : ℕ) (hK : K ≤ 2*M+1) (κ : ℝ) (hκ : κ ≠ 0)

    (u : ℕ → V) (p : ℕ → Q) (hu : u 0=0) (hp : H (p 0)=0)
    (hcancel : ∀ n < K, coefficient M L G H B C u p n=0) :

      ∑ n ∈ Ico K (2*M+1), κ^n • coefficient M L G H B C u p n

name: EulerPacketPointJets.jet_fieldSum
statement:
theorem jet_fieldSum {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (M : ℕ) (κ : ℝ) (u : ℕ → Domain → E) (z : Domain)
    (hu : ∀ n ≤ M, DifferentiableAt ℝ (u n) z) :
    jet (fieldSum M κ u) z = evaluate M κ (fun n => jet (u n) z)

name: EulerPacketPointJets.momentumResidual_formula
statement:
theorem momentumResidual_formula (κ : ℝ) (FInv M : Space →L[ℝ] Space) (m : Space)
    (u : Domain → Space) (p : Domain → ℝ) (z : Domain) :
    momentumResidual κ FInv M m u p z =
      fderiv ℝ u z timeDirection + M (u z) +
      FInv.adjoint ((toDual ℝ Space).symm ((fderiv ℝ p z).comp spatialInjection)) +
      κ⁻¹ • (fderiv ℝ p z angleDirection • m) +
      fderiv ℝ u z (spatialInjection (FInv (u z))) +
      κ⁻¹ • (⟪m, u z⟫_ℝ • fderiv ℝ u z angleDirection)

name: EulerPacketPointJets.momentum_fieldSum_eq
statement:
theorem momentum_fieldSum_eq (N : ℕ) (κ : ℝ) (hκ : κ ≠ 0)
    (FInv M : Space →L[ℝ] Space) (m : Space)
    (u : ℕ → Domain → Space) (p : ℕ → Domain → ℝ) (z : Domain)
    (hu : ∀ i ≤ N, DifferentiableAt ℝ (u i) z)
    (hp : ∀ i ≤ N, DifferentiableAt ℝ (p i) z)
    (hu0 : jet (u 0) z=0) (hp0 : fastPressure m (jet (p 0) z)=0) :
    momentumResidual κ FInv M m (fieldSum N κ u) (fieldSum N κ p) z =
      evaluate (2*N) κ (momentumGrade N FInv M m u p z)

name: EulerPacketPointJets.momentum_fieldSum_tail
statement:
theorem momentum_fieldSum_tail (N : ℕ) (κ : ℝ) (hκ : κ ≠ 0)
    (FInv M : Space →L[ℝ] Space) (m : Space)
    (u : ℕ → Domain → Space) (p : ℕ → Domain → ℝ) (z : Domain)
    (hu : ∀ i ≤ N+1, DifferentiableAt ℝ (u i) z)
    (hp : ∀ i ≤ N+1, DifferentiableAt ℝ (p i) z)
    (hu0 : jet (u 0) z=0) (hp0 : fastPressure m (jet (p 0) z)=0)
    (hcancel : ∀ n ≤ N, momentumGrade (N+1) FInv M m u p z n=0) :
    momentumResidual κ FInv M m (fieldSum (N+1) κ u) (fieldSum (N+1) κ p) z =
      ∑ n ∈ Ico (N+1) (2*N+3), κ^n • momentumGrade (N+1) FInv M m u p z n

name: EulerPacketPointJets.norm_momentum_fieldSum_le
statement:
theorem norm_momentum_fieldSum_le (N : ℕ) (κ : ℝ) (hκ : κ ≠ 0)
    (FInv M : Space →L[ℝ] Space) (m : Space)
    (u : ℕ → Domain → Space) (p : ℕ → Domain → ℝ) (z : Domain)
    (hu : ∀ i ≤ N+1, DifferentiableAt ℝ (u i) z)
    (hp : ∀ i ≤ N+1, DifferentiableAt ℝ (p i) z)
    (hu0 : jet (u 0) z=0) (hp0 : fastPressure m (jet (p 0) z)=0)
    (hcancel : ∀ n ≤ N, momentumGrade (N+1) FInv M m u p z n=0) :
    ‖momentumResidual κ FInv M m (fieldSum (N+1) κ u) (fieldSum (N+1) κ p) z‖ ≤
      ∑ n ∈ Ico (N+1) (2*N+3), |κ|^n * ‖momentumGrade (N+1) FInv M m u p z n‖

name: EulerPacketTailBound.finite_tail_norm_le
statement:
theorem finite_tail_norm_le (κ B : ℝ) (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hsmall : κ*B ≤ 1/2) (N : ℕ) (c : ℕ → E)
    (hc : ∀ n ∈ Ico (N+1) (2*N+3), ‖c n‖ ≤ B^(n+1)) :

name: EulerPacketTailBound.normalized_tail_norm_le
statement:
theorem normalized_tail_norm_le (k B C : ℝ) (hk : 0 ≤ k) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hsmall : B/k ≤ 1/2) (L : E →L[ℝ] F) (hL : ‖L‖ ≤ C) (N : ℕ) (c : ℕ → E)

    ‖k • L (∑ n ∈ Ico (N+1) (2*N+3), (k⁻¹)^n • c n)‖ ≤
      2*C*k*B*(B/k)^(N+1)

name: EulerPacketMovingFrame.scaledVelocityRhs_first
statement:

name: EulerPacketMovingFrame.scaling_denominator
statement:
theorem scaling_denominator (s₀ ε : ℝ) (R : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    (∑ j : Fin 3, (s₀*rayScale ε j*R j)^2) =
      s₀^2 * rayDenominator ε (R 0) (R 1) (R 2)

name: EulerPacketMovingFrame.scaling_flux
statement:
theorem scaling_flux {a : ℝ} (ha : a ≠ 0) (s₀ ε : ℝ)
    (M : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (R V : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    (∑ i : Fin 3, (s₀*rayScale ε i*R i) *
      (∑ j : Fin 3, M i j*(velocityScale ε j*V j))) =
      s₀*a*velocityNumerator (scaledVelocityEntry a ε M)
        (R 0) (R 1) (R 2) (V 0) (V 1) (V 2)

name: EulerPacketMovingFrame.scaling_pairing
statement:
theorem scaling_pairing (s₀ ε : ℝ) (R V : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    (∑ i : Fin 3, (s₀*rayScale ε i*R i)*(velocityScale ε i*V i)) =
      s₀*ε*(R 0*V 0+R 1*V 1+R 2*V 2)

name: EulerPacketMovingFrame.scaling_velocity_rate
statement:
theorem scaling_velocity_rate {a ε s₀ D : ℝ}
    (ha : a ≠ 0) (hε : ε ≠ 0) (hs₀ : s₀ ≠ 0) (hD : D ≠ 0)
    (M S : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (R V : Fin 3 → ℝ) (J : ℝ) (i : Fin 3) :
    ((-(∑ j : Fin 3, (M i j+S i j)*(velocityScale ε j*V j)) +
      (2*(s₀*a*J)/(s₀^2*D))*(s₀*rayScale ε i*R i))*(ε/a))/velocityScale ε i =
      -(∑ j : Fin 3, scaledVelocityEntry a ε (fun i j => M i j+S i j) i j * V j) +
        2*(rayScale ε i)^2*R i*J/D

name: EulerPacketMovingFrame.thirdVelocity_of_pairing
statement:
theorem thirdVelocity_of_pairing (R V : Fin 3 → ℝ) (hN : R 2 ≠ 0)
    (hRV : R 0*V 0+R 1*V 1+R 2*V 2 = 0) :
    V 2 = velocityThird (R 0) (R 1) (R 2) (V 0) (V 1)

name: EulerPacketMovingFrame.velocityScale_ne_zero

name: EulerPacketMovingFrame.scaling_cross_flux
statement:
theorem scaling_cross_flux {a : ℝ} (ha : a ≠ 0) (s₀ ε : ℝ)
    (M : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (R V : Fin 3 → ℝ) (hV : V 1 ≠ 0) :
    (∑ i : Fin 3,
      (_root_.crossProduct (fun j => s₀*rayScale ε j*R j) (fun j => velocityScale ε j*V j)) i *
        (∑ j : Fin 3, M i j*(velocityScale ε j*V j))) =
      s₀*a*(V 1)^2*frameCrossNumerator ε (R 0) (R 1) (R 2) (V 0/V 1) (V 2/V 1)
        (rowAction (scaledVelocityEntry a ε M) 0 (V 0/V 1) (V 2/V 1))
        (rowAction (scaledVelocityEntry a ε M) 1 (V 0/V 1) (V 2/V 1))
        (rowAction (scaledVelocityEntry a ε M) 2 (V 0/V 1) (V 2/V 1))

name: EulerPacketMovingFrame.scaling_pressure_ratio
statement:
theorem scaling_pressure_ratio {a : ℝ} (ha : a ≠ 0) (s₀ ε : ℝ)
    (M : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (R V : Fin 3 → ℝ) (hV : V 1 ≠ 0) :
    (∑ i : Fin 3, (s₀*rayScale ε i*R i)*(∑ j : Fin 3, M i j*(velocityScale ε j*V j))) =
      s₀*a*(V 1)*velocityNumerator (scaledVelocityEntry a ε M)
        (R 0) (R 1) (R 2) (V 0/V 1) 1 (V 2/V 1)

name: EulerPacketPhysicalTransform.physical_euler_momentum_of_flow
statement:
theorem physical_euler_momentum_of_flow
    (κ k : ℝ) (hκ : k*κ=1) (m : E)
    (F : ℝ × E → E →L[ℝ] E) (z : ℝ × (E × ℝ) → E)
    (u : ℝ × E → E) (p Q : ℝ × E → ℝ) (X Y : ℝ × E → E)
    (t : ℝ) (x : E) (A : E ≃L[ℝ] E)
    (DF : (ℝ × E) →L[ℝ] (E →L[ℝ] E)) (Dz : (ℝ × (E × ℝ)) →L[ℝ] E)
    (Du : (ℝ × E) →L[ℝ] E) (P : E)
    (hleft : ∀ s y, Y (s,X (s,y)) = y)
    (hY : DifferentiableAt ℝ (inverseCoordinates Y) (t,X (t,x)))
    (hX : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 X (t,x))
    (hframe : F =ᶠ[𝓝 (t,x)] fun r => (fderiv ℝ X r).comp (inr ℝ ℝ E))
    (hflow : (fun r => fderiv ℝ X r (1,0)) =ᶠ[𝓝 (t,x)] fun r => u (r.1,X r))
    (hF : HasFDerivAt F DF (t,x)) (hz : HasFDerivAt z Dz (spaceTimeGraph k m (t,x)))
    (hA : F (t,x) = A.toContinuousLinearMap)
    (hu : HasFDerivAt u Du (t,X (t,x)))
    (hp : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => p (t,y)) (X (t,x)))
    (hQ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => Q (t,y)) x)
    (hQgradient : gradient (fun y => Q (t,y)) x = κ • P)
    (hparent : momentumResidual u p (t,X (t,x)) = 0)
    (hlift : Dz (1,(0,0)) +
      (2 : ℝ) • A.symm (DF (1,0) (z (spaceTimeGraph k m (t,x)))) +
      Dz (0,(κ • z (spaceTimeGraph k m (t,x)),⟪m,z (spaceTimeGraph k m (t,x))⟫_ℝ)) +
      κ • A.symm (DF (0,z (spaceTimeGraph k m (t,x))) (z (spaceTimeGraph k m (t,x)))) +
      A.symm (A.symm.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint P) = 0) :
    momentumResidual (fun q => u q+physicalVelocity κ k m F z Y q)
      (fun q => p q+physicalPressure Q Y q) (t,X (t,x)) = 0

theorem slicedMomentum_fieldSum_tail (s : Set ℝ) (N : ℕ) (κ : ℝ) (hκ : κ ≠ 0)
    (FInv M : Space →L[ℝ] Space) (m : Space)
    (u : ℕ → Domain → Space) (p : ℕ → Domain → ℝ) (z : Domain)
    (hs : UniqueDiffWithinAt ℝ s z.1)
    (hut : ∀ i ≤ N+1, DifferentiableWithinAt ℝ (fun t => u i (t,z.2)) s z.1)
    (hux : ∀ i ≤ N+1, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => u i (z.1,y)) z.2)
    (hpx : ∀ i ≤ N+1, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => p i (z.1,y)) z.2)
    (hu0 : slicedJet s (u 0) z=0) (hp0 : fastPressure m (pressureJet (p 0) z)=0)
    (hcancel : ∀ n ≤ N, slicedMomentumGrade s (N+1) FInv M m u p z n=0) :
    slicedMomentumResidual s κ FInv M m (fieldSum (N+1) κ u) (fieldSum (N+1) κ p) z=
      ∑ n ∈ Ico (N+1) (2*N+3), κ^n • slicedMomentumGrade s (N+1) FInv M m u p z n

name: EulerPacketResidual.coefficient_assembled
statement:
theorem coefficient_assembled (N p : ℕ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hpN : p ≤ N)
    (L : V →ₗ[ℝ] W) (G H : Q →ₗ[ℝ] W) (B C : V →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℝ] W)
    (a b c : ℕ → V) (q π : ℕ → Q) (hq : ∀ i ≤ N, H (q i)=0) :
    coefficient (N+1) L G H B C (assemble N (fun i => a i+b i) c) (assemble N q π) p =
      (L (a p)+H (π p)) + (L (b p)+G (q p)) + (L (c (p-1))+G (π (p-1))) +
      convolution (N+1) B (assemble N (fun i => a i+b i) c)
        (assemble N (fun i => a i+b i) c) p +
      convolution (N+1) C (assemble N (fun i => a i+b i) c)
        (assemble N (fun i => a i+b i) c) (p+1)

name: EulerPacketResidual.coefficient_assembled_eq_zero
statement:
theorem coefficient_assembled_eq_zero (N p : ℕ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hpN : p ≤ N)
    (L : V →ₗ[ℝ] W) (G H : Q →ₗ[ℝ] W) (B C : V →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℝ] W)
    (a b c : ℕ → V) (q π : ℕ → Q) (hq : ∀ i ≤ N, H (q i)=0) (fmean : W)
    (hmean : L (b p)+G (q p)=fmean)
    (hhigh : L (a p)+H (π p)=
      -(L (c (p-1))+G (π (p-1))+
        convolution (N+1) B (assemble N (fun i => a i+b i) c)
          (assemble N (fun i => a i+b i) c) p+
        convolution (N+1) C (assemble N (fun i => a i+b i) c)
          (assemble N (fun i => a i+b i) c) (p+1))-fmean) :
    coefficient (N+1) L G H B C (assemble N (fun i => a i+b i) c) (assemble N q π) p=0

theorem equation30_slope_ratio_dominates
    {σ lam s t : ℝ} {F F₁ Z Z₁ : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (hσsmall : σ ≤ 1/4) (hlam : 0 ≤ lam)
    (hF : ∀ x, 0 ≤ x → HasDerivAt F (F₁ x) x)
    (hZ : ∀ x, 0 ≤ x → HasDerivAt Z (Z₁ x) x)
    (hfluxF : ∀ x, 0 ≤ x → HasDerivAt (fun u => (1+(σ^2*u^2)^2)*F₁ u)

    (hfluxZ : ∀ x, 0 ≤ x → HasDerivAt (fun u => (1+(σ^2*u^2)^2)*Z₁ u)
      (2*(1-σ^2*(σ^2*x^2))*Z x) x)
    (hF0 : F 0 = 1) (hF₁0 : F₁ 0 = 0) (hZ0 : Z 0 = 1) (hZ₁0 : Z₁ 0 = lam)

      (if n=N+1 then
        linearPart (O.strain z) (slicedJet O.interval (a N).corrector z)+
        slowPressure (O.inverseFrame z) (pressureJet (a N).highPressure z) else 0) +
      nonlinearGrade (N+1) n (O.inverseFrame z) (O.normal z) (knownJets O (N+1) a z)

    (u c : ℕ → V) (q π : ℕ → Q) :

      (if n=N+1 then L (c N)+G (π N) else 0) +

name: NavierStokes.MomentRepair.correctionIteration_norm_le
statement:
theorem correctionIteration_norm_le
    (B : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (Q : E → E) (d : E) (β K r : ℝ)
    (hβ : 0 ≤ β) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hB : ∀ x, ‖B.symm x‖ ≤ β * ‖x‖)
    (hQ : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ r → ‖Q x‖ ≤ K * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    (hsmall : 4 * β * K * r ≤ 1) (hd : 2 * β * ‖d‖ ≤ r)
    (c : E) (hc : ‖c‖ ≤ r) : ‖correctionIteration B Q d c‖ ≤ r

name: NavierStokes.MomentRepair.correctionIteration_sub_le
statement:
theorem correctionIteration_sub_le
    (B : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (Q : E → E) (d : E) (β K r : ℝ)
    (hβ : 0 ≤ β) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hB : ∀ x, ‖B.symm x‖ ≤ β * ‖x‖)
    (hQ : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ r → ∀ y, ‖y‖ ≤ r →
      ‖Q x - Q y‖ ≤ K * (‖x‖ + ‖y‖) * ‖x - y‖)
    (hsmall : 4 * β * K * r ≤ 1)
    (x y : E) (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ r) (hy : ‖y‖ ≤ r) :
    ‖correctionIteration B Q d x - correctionIteration B Q d y‖ ≤
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖x - y‖

name: NavierStokes.MomentRepair.exists_unique_small_correction
statement:
theorem exists_unique_small_correction [CompleteSpace E]
    (B : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (Q : E → E) (d : E) (β K r : ℝ)
    (hβ : 0 ≤ β) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hB : ∀ x, ‖B.symm x‖ ≤ β * ‖x‖)
    (hQnorm : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ r → ‖Q x‖ ≤ K * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    (hQdiff : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ r → ∀ y, ‖y‖ ≤ r →
      ‖Q x - Q y‖ ≤ K * (‖x‖ + ‖y‖) * ‖x - y‖)
    (hsmall : 4 * β * K * r ≤ 1) (hd : 2 * β * ‖d‖ ≤ r) :
    ∃! c : E, ‖c‖ ≤ r ∧ B c + Q c = d

name: NavierStokes.MomentRepair.repair_idempotent
statement:
theorem repair_idempotent (L : ι → V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (b : ι → V)
    (hB : (momentMatrix L b).det ≠ 0) (u : V) (target : ι → ℝ) :
    repair L b (repair L b u target) target = repair L b u target

name: NavierStokes.MomentRepair.repair_support_subset
statement:
theorem repair_support_subset (L : ι → (X → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (b : ι → X → ℝ)
    (u : X → ℝ) (target : ι → ℝ) (S : Set X)
    (hb : ∀ j, Function.support (b j) ⊆ S) :
    Function.support (repair L b u target - u) ⊆ S

name: NavierStokes.MomentRepair.repair_unchanged_when_exact
statement:
theorem repair_unchanged_when_exact (L : ι → V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (b : ι → V) (u : V) :
    repair L b u (moments L u) = u

name: NavierStokes.MomentRepair.twoPointMatrix_det
statement:
theorem twoPointMatrix_det (x₁ x₂ w₁ w₂ : ℝ) :
    (twoPointMatrix x₁ x₂ w₁ w₂).det = w₁ * w₂ * (x₂ - x₁)

name: NavierStokes.MomentRepair.twoPointMatrix_det_pos
statement:
theorem twoPointMatrix_det_pos (x₁ x₂ w₁ w₂ : ℝ)
    (hx : x₁ < x₂) (hw₁ : 0 < w₁) (hw₂ : 0 < w₂) :
    0 < (twoPointMatrix x₁ x₂ w₁ w₂).det

name: NavierStokes.PowerMomentMatrix.bumpMomentMatrix_det_ne_zero
statement:
theorem bumpMomentMatrix_det_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (a l u : Fin n → ℝ)
    (β : Fin n → ℝ → ℝ) (ha : Function.Injective a)
    (hl : ∀ j, 0 < l j) (hsep : ∀ i j, i < j → u i < l j)
    (hcont : ∀ j, Continuous (β j)) (hnonneg : ∀ j t, 0 ≤ β j t)
    (hnonzero : ∀ j, ∃ t, β j t ≠ 0)
    (hsupp : ∀ j, Function.support (β j) ⊆ Set.Icc (l j) (u j)) :
    (bumpMomentMatrix a β).det ≠ 0

name: NavierStokes.PowerMomentMatrix.continuousOn_powerSum
statement:
theorem continuousOn_powerSum {n : ℕ} (a c : Fin n → ℝ) (l u : ℝ) (hl : 0 < l) :
    ContinuousOn (powerSum a c) (Set.Icc l u)

name: NavierStokes.PowerMomentMatrix.exists_ordered_derivative_zeros
statement:
theorem exists_ordered_derivative_zeros {n : ℕ} (f f' : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ t, HasDerivAt f (f' t) t)
    (x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hx : StrictMono x) (hz : ∀ j, f (x j) = 0) :
    ∃ y : Fin n → ℝ, StrictMono y ∧
      (∀ j, x j.castSucc < y j ∧ y j < x j.succ) ∧ (∀ j, f' (y j) = 0)

name: NavierStokes.PowerMomentMatrix.exists_zero_of_setIntegral_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_zero_of_setIntegral_eq_zero
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (l u : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hmass : μ (Set.Icc l u) ≠ 0) (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc l u))
    (hzero : ∫ t in Set.Icc l u, f t ∂μ = 0) :
    ∃ t ∈ Set.Icc l u, f t = 0

name: NavierStokes.PowerMomentMatrix.expEvaluationMatrix_det_ne_zero
statement:
theorem expEvaluationMatrix_det_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (a x : Fin n → ℝ)
    (ha : Function.Injective a) (hx : StrictMono x) :
    (expEvaluationMatrix a x).det ≠ 0

name: NavierStokes.PowerMomentMatrix.expSum_coefficients_zero
statement:
theorem expSum_coefficients_zero :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (a c x : Fin n → ℝ), Function.Injective a → StrictMono x →
      (∀ j, expSum a c (x j) = 0) → c = 0

name: NavierStokes.PowerMomentMatrix.expSum_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem expSum_hasDerivAt {n : ℕ} (a c : Fin n → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (expSum a c) (expSum a (fun j => c j * a j) t) t

name: NavierStokes.PowerMomentMatrix.expSum_shift
statement:
theorem expSum_shift {n : ℕ} (a c : Fin n → ℝ) (s t : ℝ) :
    expSum (fun j => a j - s) c t = expSum a c t * Real.exp (-s * t)

name: NavierStokes.PowerMomentMatrix.integral_powerSum
statement:
theorem integral_powerSum {n : ℕ} (a c : Fin n → ℝ) (l u : ℝ)
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (hl : 0 < l) :
    (∫ t in Set.Icc l u, powerSum a c t ∂μ) =
      ∑ i, c i * ∫ t in Set.Icc l u, t ^ a i ∂μ

name: NavierStokes.PowerMomentMatrix.intervalMomentMatrix_det_ne_zero
statement:
theorem intervalMomentMatrix_det_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (a l u : Fin n → ℝ)
    (μ : Fin n → Measure ℝ) [∀ j, IsFiniteMeasure (μ j)]
    (ha : Function.Injective a) (hl : ∀ j, 0 < l j)
    (hsep : ∀ i j, i < j → u i < l j)
    (hmass : ∀ j, μ j (Set.Icc (l j) (u j)) ≠ 0) :
    (intervalMomentMatrix a l u μ).det ≠ 0

name: NavierStokes.PowerMomentMatrix.powerEvaluationMatrix_det_ne_zero
statement:
theorem powerEvaluationMatrix_det_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (a x : Fin n → ℝ)

    (powerEvaluationMatrix a x).det ≠ 0

theorem angular_integrand_pulse (c : Parameters) (amp : ℝ → ℝ) (eta : ℝ) {y : ℝ}

        axial c amp (y, eta) =
      (momentScale c 1 * (shape eta)^2) *
        (Real.exp ((c.exponents 1 + 1) * (y - c.pulseStart)) *
          radialPulse c amp eta (Real.exp (y - c.pulseStart)))

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingSchedule.constructed_core
statement:
theorem constructed_core (c : Parameters) {amp : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ amp) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (angular c.P c.dropLength c.lam) ∧
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (axial c amp) ∧
    (∀ p, 0 < angular c.P c.dropLength c.lam p) ∧
    (∀ eta y, c.endpoint ≤ y →
      axial c amp (y, eta) = 0 ∧ massMoment c amp eta y = 0 ∧
        angularMoment c amp eta y = 0) ∧
    (∀ eta y, c.holdStart ≤ y → y ≤ c.pulseStart →
      axial c amp (y, eta) = 0 ∧
      angular c.P c.dropLength c.lam (y, eta) =
        radialAmplitude c.P c.dropLength c.lam c.holdStart * shape eta *
          Real.exp (-(1 / 2 + c.lam) * (y - c.holdStart)))

      (∫ x in (1 : ℝ)..Real.exp c.pulseLength,
        x ^ c.exponents 0 * radialPulse c amp eta x) = 0 ∧
    prefixJ c * eta * shape eta + momentScale c 1 * (shape eta)^2 *
      (∫ x in (1 : ℝ)..Real.exp c.pulseLength,
        x ^ c.exponents 1 * radialPulse c amp eta x) = 0

name: NavierStokes.FlatKernelBounds.iteratedDeriv_kernel
statement:
theorem iteratedDeriv_kernel {b : ℝ → ℝ} (hb : ContDiff ℝ ∞ b)

    iteratedDeriv n (fun x => kernel c j b x t) =

statement:

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitiveFactor.denominator_ratio_eq_rpow
statement:
theorem denominator_ratio_eq_rpow (j : ℕ) (x : ℝ) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    denominator x t ^ j / denominator x t ^ 3 =
      (1 + x ^ 2 * t) ^ (((j : ℝ) - 3) / 2)

theorem denominator_sq (x : ℝ) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :

theorem edge_coordinate (c : ℝ) {x t : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitiveFactor.exists_smooth_factor
statement:
theorem exists_smooth_factor {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (j : ℕ) {b : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hb : ContDiff ℝ ∞ b) :
    ∃ F : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ F ∧ F 0 = b 0 / (2 * c) ∧
      ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → primitive c j b x = scale c j x * F x

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitiveFactor.exists_smooth_factor_original
statement:
theorem exists_smooth_factor_original {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (j : ℕ) {b : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hb : ContDiff ℝ ∞ b) :
    ∃ F : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ F ∧ F 0 = b 0 / (2 * c) ∧
      ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x →
        (∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..x, (Real.exp (-c / u ^ 2) / u ^ j) * b u) =
          Real.exp (-c / x ^ 2) * x ^ (3 - (j : ℝ)) * F x

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitiveFactor.factor_at_zero
statement:
theorem factor_at_zero {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (j : ℕ) (b : ℝ → ℝ) :
    factor c j b 0 = b 0 / (2 * c)

statement:
theorem factor_eq_normalized_primitive (c : ℝ) (j : ℕ) (b : ℝ → ℝ)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitiveFactor.factor_iteratedDeriv
statement:
theorem factor_iteratedDeriv {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (j : ℕ) {b : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hb : ContDiff ℝ ∞ b) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    iteratedDeriv n (factor c j b) x =
      ∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), iteratedDeriv n (fun y => kernel c j b y t) x

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitiveFactor.factor_sqrt_contDiffAt_zero
NavierStokes.FlatPrimitiveFactor.integral_exp_eq_primitive

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitiveFactor.primitive_eq_scale_mul_factor

theorem primitive_eq_scale_mul_factor (c : ℝ) (j : ℕ) (b : ℝ → ℝ)

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitiveFactor.scale_eq_rpow
statement:
theorem scale_eq_rpow (c : ℝ) (j : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitiveFactor.transformed_integrand
statement:
theorem transformed_integrand (c : ℝ) (j : ℕ) (b : ℝ → ℝ)

    (∀ k ≤ n, ∃ C : ℝ, ∃ N : ℕ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ y t,
      ‖y‖ ≤ R → 0 ≤ t → f k y t ≤ C * (1 + t) ^ N) →
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∃ N : ℕ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ k ≤ n, ∀ y t,
      ‖y‖ ≤ R → 0 ≤ t → f k y t ≤ C * (1 + t) ^ N

theorem kernel_eq_raw (c : ℝ) (j : ℕ) (b : E × ℝ → ℝ) (y : E × ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    kernel c j b y t = ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-c * t)) * rawKernel j b y t

name: NavierStokes.ParametricKernelBounds.kernel_iteratedFDeriv_bound_of_jetBounds
statement:
theorem kernel_iteratedFDeriv_bound_of_jetBounds {b : E × ℝ → ℝ}

    {B : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hjets : ∀ k ≤ n, ∀ z : E × ℝ, ‖z‖ ≤ R → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k b z‖ ≤ B) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∃ N : ℕ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ y : E × ℝ, ∀ t : ℝ,
      ‖y‖ ≤ R → 0 ≤ t →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun z => kernel c j b z t) y‖ ≤
        C * (1 + t) ^ N * Real.exp (-c * t)

name: NavierStokes.ParametricKernelBounds.norm_iteratedFDeriv_linear_le
statement:
theorem norm_iteratedFDeriv_linear_le (L : X →L[ℝ] F) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (x : X) :

name: NavierStokes.ParametricKernelBounds.norm_iteratedFDeriv_mul_le_of_bounds

name: NavierStokes.ParametricFlatFactor.exists_joint_smooth_factor
statement:
theorem exists_joint_smooth_factor {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (j : ℕ)
    {b : E × ℝ → ℝ} (hb : ContDiff ℝ ∞ b) :
    ∃ F : E × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ F ∧
      (∀ p : E, F (p, 0) = b (p, 0) / (2 * c)) ∧
      ∀ (p : E) (x : ℝ), 0 < x →
        (∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..x, (Real.exp (-c / u ^ 2) / u ^ j) * b (p, u)) =
          Real.exp (-c / x ^ 2) * x ^ (3 - (j : ℝ)) * F (p, x)

name: NavierStokes.StressAlgebra.angularPrimitive_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem angularPrimitive_hasDerivAt
    (h η x : ℝ) (W H I Iη J Jη : ℝ → ℝ) (Wx Hx U Uη Hη : ℝ)
    (hWderiv : HasDerivAt W Wx x) (hH : HasDerivAt H Hx x)
    (hI : HasDerivAt I (H x) x) (hIη : HasDerivAt Iη Hη x)
    (hJ : HasDerivAt J (U * H x) x)
    (hJη : HasDerivAt Jη (Uη * H x + U * Hη) x)
    (hW : W x + x * Wx =
      1 - 2 * axialExponent h * η * U - coordinateFactor η * Uη) :
    HasDerivAt (angularPrimitive h η W H I Iη J Jη)
      (angularSource h η x (W x) U (H x) Hx Hη) x

name: NavierStokes.StressAlgebra.angular_derivative_algebra
statement:
theorem angular_derivative_algebra
    (h η x W Wx U Uη H Hx Hη : ℝ)
    (hW : W + x * Wx = 1 - 2 * axialExponent h * η * U - coordinateFactor η * Uη) :
    -((W + x * Wx) * H + x * W * Hx) + (1 - h) * H -
      axialExponent h * η * Hη - coordinateFactor η * (Uη * H + U * Hη) +
      2 * (h - axialExponent h) * η * (U * H) =
      angularSource h η x W U H Hx Hη

name: NavierStokes.StressAlgebra.angular_integrated_identity
statement:
theorem angular_integrated_identity
    {h η X : ℝ} (p : AngularMomentData h η X)
    (hint : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun x => angularSource h η x (p.W x) (p.U x) (p.H x) (p.Hx x) (p.Hη x))
      volume 0 X) :
    intervalIntegral
      (fun x => angularSource h η x (p.W x) (p.U x) (p.H x) (p.Hx x) (p.Hη x))
      0 X volume =
      angularPrimitive h η p.W p.H p.I p.Iη p.J p.Jη X

name: NavierStokes.StressAlgebra.angular_integrated_lag
statement:
theorem angular_integrated_lag
    {h η X : ℝ} (p : AngularMomentData h η X) (hX : X ≠ 0) (hH : p.H X ≠ 0)
    (hint : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun x => angularSource h η x (p.W x) (p.U x) (p.H x) (p.Hx x) (p.Hη x))
      volume 0 X) :
    intervalIntegral
      (fun x => angularSource h η x (p.W x) (p.U x) (p.H x) (p.Hx x) (p.Hη x))
      0 X volume / (X * p.H X) =
      -p.W X + ((1 - h) * p.I X - axialExponent h * η * p.Iη X -
        coordinateFactor η * p.Jη X + 2 * (h - axialExponent h) * η * p.J X) /
          (X * p.H X)

name: NavierStokes.StressAlgebra.angular_lag_primitive_iff
statement:
theorem angular_lag_primitive_iff
    (H Q : ℝ → ℝ) (x Hx Qx Sq : ℝ)
    (hH : HasDerivAt H Hx x) (hQ : HasDerivAt Q Qx x) (hHne : H x ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => y * H y * Q y) (H x * Sq) x ↔
      x * Qx + (1 + x * Hx / H x) * Q x = Sq

name: NavierStokes.StressAlgebra.angular_source_logarithmic_form
statement:
theorem angular_source_logarithmic_form
    (h η x W U H Hx Hη : ℝ) (hH : H ≠ 0) :
    H * (-W * (x * Hx / H) - h * (1 - 2 * η * U) -
      (axialExponent h * η + coordinateFactor η * U) * (Hη / H)) =
      angularSource h η x W U H Hx Hη

name: NavierStokes.StressAlgebra.angular_stress_coefficient
statement:
theorem angular_stress_coefficient
    (x R E L Qs Ex : ℝ) (hR : R ≠ 0) (hE : E ≠ 0) (hL : L ≠ 0) :
    (E / R) * (x * Qs / L - (1 - 2 * x * Ex / E)) =
      (E / R) * (x * Qs / L) + (2 * x * Ex - E) / R

name: NavierStokes.StressAlgebra.axialPrimitive_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem axialPrimitive_hasDerivAt
    (h η x : ℝ) (W U M Mη S Sη P Pη : ℝ → ℝ)
    (Wx Ux Uη E Eη Px Pηx : ℝ)
    (hWderiv : HasDerivAt W Wx x) (hU : HasDerivAt U Ux x)
    (hM : HasDerivAt M (U x) x) (hMη : HasDerivAt Mη Uη x)
    (hS : HasDerivAt S ((U x) ^ 2 - E ^ 2 / 2) x)
    (hSη : HasDerivAt Sη (2 * U x * Uη - E * Eη) x)
    (hPderiv : HasDerivAt P Px x) (hPηderiv : HasDerivAt Pη Pηx x)
    (hW : W x + x * Wx =
      1 - 2 * axialExponent h * η * U x - coordinateFactor η * Uη)
    (hP : x * Px = E ^ 2 / 2) (hPη : x * Pηx = E * Eη) :
    HasDerivAt (axialPrimitive h η W U M Mη S Sη P Pη)
      (axialSource h η x (W x) (U x) Ux Uη (P x) Px (Pη x)) x

name: NavierStokes.StressAlgebra.axial_derivative_algebra
statement:
theorem axial_derivative_algebra
    (h η x W Wx U Ux Uη E Eη P Px Pη Pηx : ℝ)
    (hW : W + x * Wx = 1 - 2 * axialExponent h * η * U - coordinateFactor η * Uη)
    (hP : x * Px = E ^ 2 / 2)
    (hPη : x * Pηx = E * Eη) :
    -((W + x * Wx) * U + x * W * Ux) + axialExponent h * (U - η * Uη) +
      4 * h * η * (U ^ 2 - E ^ 2 / 2) -
      coordinateFactor η * (2 * U * Uη - E * Eη) +
      (4 * velocityExponent h * η * P - coordinateFactor η * Pη) +
      x * (4 * velocityExponent h * η * Px - coordinateFactor η * Pηx) =
      axialSource h η x W U Ux Uη P Px Pη

name: NavierStokes.StressAlgebra.axial_integrated_identity
statement:
theorem axial_integrated_identity
    {h η X : ℝ} (p : AxialMomentData h η X)
    (hint : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun x => axialSource h η x (p.W x) (p.U x) (p.Ux x) (p.Uη x)
        (p.P x) (p.Px x) (p.Pη x)) volume 0 X) :
    intervalIntegral
      (fun x => axialSource h η x (p.W x) (p.U x) (p.Ux x) (p.Uη x)
        (p.P x) (p.Px x) (p.Pη x)) 0 X volume =
      axialPrimitive h η p.W p.U p.M p.Mη p.S p.Sη p.P p.Pη X

name: NavierStokes.StressAlgebra.axial_integrated_lag
statement:
theorem axial_integrated_lag
    {h η X : ℝ} (p : AxialMomentData h η X) (hX : X ≠ 0)
    (hint : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun x => axialSource h η x (p.W x) (p.U x) (p.Ux x) (p.Uη x)
        (p.P x) (p.Px x) (p.Pη x)) volume 0 X) :
    intervalIntegral
      (fun x => axialSource h η x (p.W x) (p.U x) (p.Ux x) (p.Uη x)
        (p.P x) (p.Px x) (p.Pη x)) 0 X volume / X =
      -p.W X * p.U X + axialExponent h * (p.M X - η * p.Mη X) / X +
        (4 * h * η * p.S X - coordinateFactor η * p.Sη X) / X +
        4 * velocityExponent h * η * p.P X - coordinateFactor η * p.Pη X

name: NavierStokes.StressAlgebra.axial_lag_primitive_iff
statement:
theorem axial_lag_primitive_iff
    (N : ℝ → ℝ) (x Nx Sn : ℝ) (hN : HasDerivAt N Nx x) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => y * N y) Sn x ↔ x * Nx + N x = Sn

name: NavierStokes.StressAlgebra.axial_stress_coefficient
statement:
theorem axial_stress_coefficient
    (x R E L Ns Ux : ℝ) (hR : R ≠ 0) (hE : E ≠ 0) (hL : L ≠ 0) :
    (E / R) * (x * Ns / (L * E) + 2 * x * Ux / E) =
      (x / R) * (Ns / L + 2 * Ux)

name: NavierStokes.StressAlgebra.stressFree_angular_lag_algebra
statement:
theorem stressFree_angular_lag_algebra
    (x L φ φx φxx : ℝ) (hφ : φ ≠ 0) :
    x * (-2 * L * (φxx * φ - φx ^ 2) / φ ^ 2) +
      (2 + x * φx / φ) * (-2 * L * φx / φ) =
      -2 * L * (x * φxx + 2 * φx) / φ

name: NavierStokes.StressAlgebra.stressFree_axial_lag_algebra
statement:
theorem stressFree_axial_lag_algebra (x L Ux Uxx : ℝ) :
    x * (-2 * L * Uxx) + (-2 * L * Ux) = -2 * L * (x * Uxx + Ux)

theorem W_balance (h : ℝ) {p : Point} (hp : p ∈ D.carrier) :

        coordinateFactor p.2 * parameterPartial P.U p) p.1

name: NavierStokes.ProfileHistories.Profiles.angularLag_equation
statement:
theorem angularLag_equation (h : ℝ) {p : Point} (hp : p ∈ D.carrier)
    (hX : p.1 ≠ 0) (hH : P.H p ≠ 0) :
    p.1 * deriv (fun x => P.angularLag h (x, p.2)) p.1 +
      (1 + p.1 * radialPartial P.H p / P.H p) * P.angularLag h p =
        P.angularSource h p / P.H p

name: NavierStokes.ProfileHistories.Profiles.angularLag_equation_logarithmic
statement:
theorem angularLag_equation_logarithmic (h : ℝ) {p : Point} (hp : p ∈ D.carrier)
    (hX : 0 < p.1) (hf : P.f p ≠ 0) :
    p.1 * deriv (fun x => P.angularLag h (x, p.2)) p.1 +
      (1 + p.1 * deriv (fun x => Real.log (P.H (x, p.2))) p.1) * P.angularLag h p =
        -P.W h p * (p.1 * deriv (fun x => Real.log (P.H (x, p.2))) p.1) -
          h * (1 - 2 * p.2 * P.U p) -
            (axialExponent h * p.2 + coordinateFactor p.2 * P.U p) *
              deriv (fun η => Real.log (P.E (p.1, η))) p.2

name: NavierStokes.ProfileHistories.Profiles.angularLag_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem angularLag_hasDerivAt (h : ℝ) {p : Point} (hp : p ∈ D.carrier)
    (hX : p.1 ≠ 0) (hH : P.H p ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt (fun x => P.angularLag h (x, p.2))
      ((P.angularSource h p * (p.1 * P.H p) -
        primitive (P.angularSource h) p * (P.H p + p.1 * radialPartial P.H p)) /
          (p.1 * P.H p) ^ 2) p.1

name: NavierStokes.ProfileHistories.Profiles.angularLag_integrated
statement:
theorem angularLag_integrated (h : ℝ) {p : Point} (hp : p ∈ D.carrier)
    (hX : p.1 ≠ 0) (hH : P.H p ≠ 0) :
    P.angularLag h p = -P.W h p +
      ((1 - h) * P.I p - axialExponent h * p.2 * parameterPartial P.I p -
        coordinateFactor p.2 * parameterPartial P.J p +
          2 * (h - axialExponent h) * p.2 * P.J p) / (p.1 * P.H p)

name: NavierStokes.ProfileHistories.Profiles.axialLag_equation
statement:
theorem axialLag_equation (h : ℝ) {p : Point} (hp : p ∈ D.carrier) (hX : p.1 ≠ 0) :
    p.1 * deriv (fun x => P.axialLag h (x, p.2)) p.1 + P.axialLag h p =
      P.axialSource h p

name: NavierStokes.ProfileHistories.Profiles.axialLag_equation_explicit
statement:
theorem axialLag_equation_explicit (h : ℝ) {p : Point} (hp : p ∈ D.carrier) (hX : 0 < p.1) :
    p.1 * deriv (fun x => P.axialLag h (x, p.2)) p.1 + P.axialLag h p =
      -P.W h p * (p.1 * radialPartial P.U p) -
        velocityExponent h * (1 - 2 * p.2 * P.U p) * P.U p -
          (axialExponent h * p.2 + coordinateFactor p.2 * P.U p) * parameterPartial P.U p -
            coordinateFactor p.2 * parameterPartial P.pressure p +
              4 * velocityExponent h * p.2 * P.pressure p +
                2 * p.2 * (p.1 * radialPartial P.pressure p)

name: NavierStokes.ProfileHistories.Profiles.axialLag_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem axialLag_hasDerivAt (h : ℝ) {p : Point} (hp : p ∈ D.carrier) (hX : p.1 ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt (fun x => P.axialLag h (x, p.2))
      ((P.axialSource h p * p.1 - primitive (P.axialSource h) p) / p.1 ^ 2) p.1

name: NavierStokes.ProfileHistories.Profiles.axialLag_integrated
statement:
theorem axialLag_integrated (h : ℝ) {p : Point} (hp : p ∈ D.carrier) (hX : 0 < p.1) :
    P.axialLag h p = -P.W h p * P.U p +
      axialExponent h * (P.M p - p.2 * parameterPartial P.M p) / p.1 +
        (4 * h * p.2 * P.S p - coordinateFactor p.2 * parameterPartial P.S p) / p.1 +
          4 * velocityExponent h * p.2 * P.pressure p - coordinateFactor p.2 * parameterPartial P.pressure p

statement: theorem summable_term (k : ℕ) (t : ℝ) : Summable (fun n : ℕ => term k n t)

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.summable_term_tail
statement:
theorem summable_term_tail (k j : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ => term k (n + j) t)

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.term_contiguous
statement:
theorem term_contiguous (k n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    term k (n + 1) t = ((k : ℝ) + 1) * term (k + 1) (n + 1) t -
      t * term (k + 2) n t

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.term_norm_le
statement:
theorem term_norm_le (k n : ℕ) (t R : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (ht : |t| ≤ R) :
    ‖term k n t‖ ≤ R ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ)

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.term_sign
statement:
theorem term_sign (k n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    term k n t = (-1 : ℝ) ^ n * term k n (-t)

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.term_succ_ratio
statement:
theorem term_succ_ratio (k n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    term k (n + 1) t =
      (-t) / (((n : ℝ) + 1) * ((n : ℝ) + k + 1)) * term k n t

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.abs_bilinear_term_le
statement:
theorem abs_bilinear_term_le (a x y wx wy F G : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hF : 0 ≤ F) (_hG : 0 ≤ G) (hwx : 0 ≤ wx) (_hwy : 0 ≤ wy)
    (hx : |x| ≤ F * wx) (hy : |y| ≤ G * wy) :
    |a * x * y| ≤ (F * G) * (a * wx * wy)

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.abs_double_sum_le
statement:
theorem abs_double_sum_le {ι κ : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (t : Finset κ)
    (f M : ι → κ → ℝ) (h : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ k ∈ t, |f i k| ≤ M i k) :
    |∑ i ∈ s, ∑ k ∈ t, f i k| ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ k ∈ t, M i k

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.averageJet_bound
statement:
theorem averageJet_bound {ε F : ℝ} (_hε : 0 < ε) (_hF : 0 ≤ F)
    (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (hf : ∀ n m, |f n m| ≤ F * weight ε n m) (n m : ℕ) :
    |averageJet f n m| ≤ F * weight ε n m

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.choose_factorials
statement:
theorem choose_factorials (k l : ℕ) :
    ((k + l).choose k : ℝ) * (k.factorial : ℝ) * (l.factorial : ℝ) =
      ((k + l).factorial : ℝ)

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.choose_product_le
statement:
theorem choose_product_le (i j k l : ℕ) :
    (i + k).choose k * (j + l).choose l ≤ ((i + j) + (k + l)).choose (k + l)

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.coreWeight_factorial
statement:
theorem coreWeight_factorial (ε : ℝ) (n m : ℕ) :
    coreWeight ε n m =
      (1 / 20 : ℝ) ^ n * (ε⁻¹) ^ m * ((n + m).factorial : ℝ) / (n.factorial : ℝ)

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.coreWeight_parameter_shift
statement:
theorem coreWeight_parameter_shift {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (i k : ℕ) :
    coreWeight ε i (k + 1) =
      (20 / ε) * ((i : ℝ) + 1) * coreWeight ε (i + 1) k

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.coreWeight_pos
statement:
theorem coreWeight_pos {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (n m : ℕ) :
    0 < coreWeight ε n m

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.coreWeight_product_le
statement:
theorem coreWeight_product_le {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (i j k l : ℕ) :
    ((k + l).choose k : ℝ) * coreWeight ε i k * coreWeight ε j l ≤
      coreWeight ε (i + j) (k + l)

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.coreWeight_radial_identity
statement:
theorem coreWeight_radial_identity {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (n m : ℕ) :
    coreWeight ε n m * ((n : ℝ) + m + 1) =
      20 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * coreWeight ε (n + 1) m

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.coreWeight_radial_le
statement:
theorem coreWeight_radial_le {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (n m : ℕ) :
    coreWeight ε n m ≤ 20 * coreWeight ε (n + 1) m

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.inverseMixedJet_bound
statement:
theorem inverseMixedJet_bound {ε F G : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hF : 0 ≤ F) (hG : 0 ≤ G)
    {r : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (f g : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ n m, |f n m| ≤ F * weight ε n m)
    (hg : ∀ n m, |g n m| ≤ G * weight ε n m) (n m : ℕ) :
    |inverseMixedJet r f g n m| ≤ (5120 / ε) * F * G * weight ε (n + 1) m

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.jetProduct_bound
statement:
theorem jetProduct_bound {ε F G : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hF : 0 ≤ F) (hG : 0 ≤ G)
    (f g : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ n m, |f n m| ≤ F * weight ε n m)
    (hg : ∀ n m, |g n m| ≤ G * weight ε n m) (n m : ℕ) :
    |jetProduct f g n m| ≤ 64 * F * G * weight ε n m

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.mixedWeightSum_le
statement:
theorem mixedWeightSum_le {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) {r : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (n m : ℕ) :
    mixedWeightSum ε r n m ≤ (5120 / ε) * weight ε (n + 1) m

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.mixed_factors_le_divisor
statement:
theorem mixed_factors_le_divisor {r n i j : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hij : i + j = n) :
    ((i : ℝ) + 1) * (j : ℝ) ≤ radialDivisor r n

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.mixed_weight_term_le
statement:
theorem mixed_weight_term_le {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) {r n i j : ℕ}
    (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hij : i + j = n) (m k l : ℕ) :
    (((m.choose k : ℝ) * j) / radialDivisor r n) * weight ε i (k + 1) * weight ε j l ≤
      (80 / ε) * ((m.choose k : ℝ) * weight ε (i + 1) k * weight ε j l)

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.parameterPrimitiveJet_bound
statement:
theorem parameterPrimitiveJet_bound {ε F : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hF : 0 ≤ F)
    (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (hf : ∀ n m, |f n m| ≤ F * weight ε n m) (n m : ℕ) :
    |parameterPrimitiveJet f n m| ≤ (80 / ε) * F * weight ε n m

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.primitiveJet_bound
statement:
theorem primitiveJet_bound {ε F : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hF : 0 ≤ F)
    (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (hf : ∀ n m, |f n m| ≤ F * weight ε n m) (n m : ℕ) :
    |primitiveJet f n m| ≤ 80 * F * weight ε n m

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.productWeightSum_le
statement:
theorem productWeightSum_le {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (n m : ℕ) :
    productWeightSum ε n m ≤ 64 * weight ε n m

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.radialDivisor_ge_one
statement: theorem radialDivisor_ge_one {r : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (n : ℕ) : 1 ≤ radialDivisor r n

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.radialDivisor_pos
statement: theorem radialDivisor_pos {r : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (n : ℕ) : 0 < radialDivisor r n

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.reciprocal_square_telescope
statement:
theorem reciprocal_square_telescope (x : ℝ) (hx : 1 ≤ x) :
    1 / x ^ 2 ≤ 2 / x - 2 / (x + 1)

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.regularInverseJet_bound
statement:
theorem regularInverseJet_bound {ε F : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hF : 0 ≤ F)
    {r : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ n m, |f n m| ≤ F * weight ε n m) (n m : ℕ) :
    |regularInverseJet r f n m| ≤ 80 * F * weight ε n m

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.regularInverseMixedJet_bound
statement:
theorem regularInverseMixedJet_bound {ε F G : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hF : 0 ≤ F) (hG : 0 ≤ G) {r : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (f g : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ n m, |f n m| ≤ F * weight ε n m)
    (hg : ∀ n m, |g n m| ≤ G * weight ε n m) (n m : ℕ) :
    |regularInverseMixedJet r f g n m| ≤ (5120 / ε) * F * G * weight ε n m

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.shiftedProductWeightSum_le
statement:
theorem shiftedProductWeightSum_le {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (n m : ℕ) :
    shiftedProductWeightSum ε n m ≤ 64 * weight ε (n + 1) m

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.squareDecay_convolution_le
statement:
theorem squareDecay_convolution_le (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ ij ∈ antidiagonal n, squareDecay ij.1 * squareDecay ij.2) ≤ 8 * squareDecay n

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.squareDecay_le_four_succ
statement: theorem squareDecay_le_four_succ (n : ℕ) : squareDecay n ≤ 4 * squareDecay (n + 1)

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.squareDecay_pos
statement: theorem squareDecay_pos (n : ℕ) : 0 < squareDecay n

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.squareDecay_product_le
statement:
theorem squareDecay_product_le (i j : ℕ) :
    squareDecay i * squareDecay j ≤
      2 * squareDecay (i + j) * (squareDecay i + squareDecay j)

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.squareDecay_succ_le
statement: theorem squareDecay_succ_le (n : ℕ) : squareDecay (n + 1) ≤ squareDecay n

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.sum_squareDecay_le
statement:
theorem sum_squareDecay_le (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), squareDecay i) ≤ 2 - 2 / ((n : ℝ) + 2)

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.sum_squareDecay_le_two
statement:
theorem sum_squareDecay_le_two (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), squareDecay i) ≤ 2

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.weight_eq_core_decay
statement:
theorem weight_eq_core_decay (ε : ℝ) (n m : ℕ) :
    weight ε n m = coreWeight ε n m * squareDecay n * squareDecay m

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.weight_parameter_radial_shift
statement:
theorem weight_parameter_radial_shift {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (i k : ℕ) :
    weight ε i (k + 1) ≤ (80 / ε) * ((i : ℝ) + 1) * weight ε (i + 1) k

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.weight_parameter_radial_shift_ratio
statement:
theorem weight_parameter_radial_shift_ratio {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (i k : ℕ) :
    weight ε i (k + 1) / weight ε (i + 1) k ≤ (80 / ε) * ((i : ℝ) + 1)

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.weight_pos
statement: theorem weight_pos {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (n m : ℕ) : 0 < weight ε n m

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.weight_product_term_le
statement:
theorem weight_product_term_le {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (i j k l : ℕ) :
    ((k + l).choose k : ℝ) * weight ε i k * weight ε j l ≤
      coreWeight ε (i + j) (k + l) * (squareDecay i * squareDecay j) *
        (squareDecay k * squareDecay l)

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.weight_radial_shift
statement:
theorem weight_radial_shift {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (n m : ℕ) :
    weight ε n m ≤ 80 * weight ε (n + 1) m

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.weight_radial_shift_ratio
statement:
theorem weight_radial_shift_ratio {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (n m : ℕ) :
    weight ε n m / weight ε (n + 1) m ≤ 80

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.Window.continuous_project
statement: theorem Window.continuous_project (I : Window) : Continuous I.project

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.Window.project_of_mem

theorem Window.project_of_mem (I : Window) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ I.interval) :

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.abs_iteratedDerivWithin_coefficient_le
statement:
theorem abs_iteratedDerivWithin_coefficient_le (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (A : CoefficientSpace I w) (n m : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ I.interval) :
    |iteratedDerivWithin m (coefficient I w A n) I.interval x| ≤ |w n m| * ‖A‖

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.abs_jet_le
statement:
theorem abs_jet_le (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (A : CoefficientSpace I w)
    (n m : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    |jet I w A.1 n m x| ≤ |w n m| * ‖A‖

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.abs_jet_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_jet_sub_le (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (A B : CoefficientSpace I w)
    (n m : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    |jet I w A.1 n m x - jet I w B.1 n m x| ≤ |w n m| * ‖A - B‖

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.axisSpace_complete
statement: theorem axisSpace_complete (I : Window) (ε : ℝ) : CompleteSpace (AxisSpace I ε)

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.axisSpace_derivative_bound
statement:
theorem axisSpace_derivative_bound (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (A : AxisSpace I ε) (n m : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ I.interval) :
    |iteratedDerivWithin m (coefficient I (AxisWeightEstimates.weight ε) A n) I.interval x| ≤
      AxisWeightEstimates.weight ε n m * ‖A‖

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.axisSpace_norm_le_iff
statement:
theorem axisSpace_norm_le_iff (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (A : AxisSpace I ε) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) :
    ‖A‖ ≤ C ↔ ∀ (n m : ℕ) (x : I.interval),
      |iteratedDerivWithin m (coefficient I (AxisWeightEstimates.weight ε) A n) I.interval x| /
        AxisWeightEstimates.weight ε n m ≤ C

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.axisSpace_smooth
statement:
theorem axisSpace_smooth (I : Window) (ε : ℝ) (A : AxisSpace I ε) (n : ℕ) :

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.coefficient_ext
statement:
theorem coefficient_ext (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ n m, w n m ≠ 0) (A B : CoefficientSpace I w)
    (h : ∀ n x, x ∈ I.interval → coefficient I w A n x = coefficient I w B n x) :
    A = B

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.coefficient_ofJetFamily
statement:
theorem coefficient_ofJetFamily (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (hw : ∀ n m, 0 < w n m)
    (J : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (hcont : ∀ n m, ContinuousOn (J n m) I.interval)
    (hderiv : ∀ n m x, x ∈ I.interval →
      HasDerivWithinAt (J n m) (J n (m + 1) x) I.interval x)
    (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hbound : ∀ n m x, x ∈ I.interval → |J n m x| ≤ C * w n m)
    (n : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ I.interval) :
    coefficient I w (ofJetFamily I w hw J hcont hderiv C hC hbound) n x = J n 0 x

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.coefficient_ofSmoothFamily
statement:
theorem coefficient_ofSmoothFamily (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (hw : ∀ n m, 0 < w n m)
    (F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (hF : ∀ n, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (F n) I.interval)
    (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hbound : ∀ n m x, x ∈ I.interval →
      |iteratedDerivWithin m (F n) I.interval x| ≤ C * w n m)
    (n : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ I.interval) :
    coefficient I w (ofSmoothFamily I w hw F hF C hC hbound) n x = F n x

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.compatible_rawOfJetFamily
statement:
theorem compatible_rawOfJetFamily (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (hw : ∀ n m, 0 < w n m)

    (hderiv : ∀ n m x, x ∈ I.interval →
      HasDerivWithinAt (J n m) (J n (m + 1) x) I.interval x)
    (C : ℝ) (hbound : ∀ n m x, x ∈ I.interval → |J n m x| ≤ C * w n m) :
    Compatible I w (rawOfJetFamily I w hw J hcont C hbound)

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.continuous_jet_parameter

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.derivWithin_jet
statement:
theorem derivWithin_jet (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.jet_ofJetFamily
statement:
theorem jet_ofJetFamily (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (hw : ∀ n m, 0 < w n m)
    (J : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (hcont : ∀ n m, ContinuousOn (J n m) I.interval)
    (hderiv : ∀ n m x, x ∈ I.interval →
      HasDerivWithinAt (J n m) (J n (m + 1) x) I.interval x)
    (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hbound : ∀ n m x, x ∈ I.interval → |J n m x| ≤ C * w n m)
    (n m : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ I.interval) :
    jet I w (ofJetFamily I w hw J hcont hderiv C hC hbound).1 n m x = J n m x

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.jet_ofSmoothFamily
statement:
theorem jet_ofSmoothFamily (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (hw : ∀ n m, 0 < w n m)
    (F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (hF : ∀ n, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (F n) I.interval)
    (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hbound : ∀ n m x, x ∈ I.interval →
      |iteratedDerivWithin m (F n) I.interval x| ≤ C * w n m)
    (n m : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ I.interval) :
    jet I w (ofSmoothFamily I w hw F hF C hC hbound).1 n m x =
      iteratedDerivWithin m (F n) I.interval x

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.jet_rawOfJetFamily
statement:
theorem jet_rawOfJetFamily (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (hw : ∀ n m, 0 < w n m)
    (J : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (hcont : ∀ n m, ContinuousOn (J n m) I.interval)
    (C : ℝ) (hbound : ∀ n m x, x ∈ I.interval → |J n m x| ≤ C * w n m)
    (n m : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ I.interval) :
    jet I w (rawOfJetFamily I w hw J hcont C hbound) n m x = J n m x

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.jet_smul
statement:
@[simp] theorem jet_smul (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (A : RawJets I)
    (n m : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    jet I w (c • A) n m x = c * jet I w A n m x

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.jet_sub
statement:
@[simp] theorem jet_sub (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (A B : RawJets I)
    (n m : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    jet I w (A - B) n m x = jet I w A n m x - jet I w B n m x

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.jet_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem jet_zero (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (n m : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    jet I w 0 n m x = 0

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.norm_le_iff_derivative_bound
statement:
theorem norm_le_iff_derivative_bound (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ n m, 0 < w n m) (A : CoefficientSpace I w) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) :
    ‖A‖ ≤ C ↔ ∀ (n m : ℕ) (x : I.interval),
      |iteratedDerivWithin m (coefficient I w A n) I.interval x| / w n m ≤ C

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.norm_ofJetFamily_le
statement:
theorem norm_ofJetFamily_le (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (hw : ∀ n m, 0 < w n m)
    (J : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (hcont : ∀ n m, ContinuousOn (J n m) I.interval)
    (hderiv : ∀ n m x, x ∈ I.interval →
      HasDerivWithinAt (J n m) (J n (m + 1) x) I.interval x)
    (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hbound : ∀ n m x, x ∈ I.interval → |J n m x| ≤ C * w n m) :
    ‖ofJetFamily I w hw J hcont hderiv C hC hbound‖ ≤ C

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.norm_ofSmoothFamily_le
statement:
theorem norm_ofSmoothFamily_le (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (hw : ∀ n m, 0 < w n m)
    (F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (hF : ∀ n, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (F n) I.interval)
    (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hbound : ∀ n m x, x ∈ I.interval →
      |iteratedDerivWithin m (F n) I.interval x| ≤ C * w n m) :
    ‖ofSmoothFamily I w hw F hF C hC hbound‖ ≤ C

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.normalized_derivative
statement:
theorem normalized_derivative (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ n m, w n m ≠ 0) (A : CoefficientSpace I w)
    (n m : ℕ) (x : I.interval) :
    iteratedDerivWithin m (coefficient I w A n) I.interval x / w n m =
      A.1 ((n, m), x)

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.quotient_abs_derivative
statement:
theorem quotient_abs_derivative (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ n m, 0 < w n m) (A : CoefficientSpace I w)
    (n m : ℕ) (x : I.interval) :
    |iteratedDerivWithin m (coefficient I w A n) I.interval x| / w n m =
      |A.1 ((n, m), x)|

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.coefficient_iteratedDeriv
statement:
theorem coefficient_iteratedDeriv (I : Window) (ε : ℝ) (A : AxisSpace I ε)
    (n m : ℕ) {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ Ioo I.left I.right) :
    iteratedDeriv m (coefficient I (weight ε) A n) η = jet I (weight ε) A.1 n m η

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.evaluationCLM_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem evaluationCLM_apply (I : Window) {ε R : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hR20 : R < 20) (k m : ℕ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) (hp : |p.1| ≤ R)
    (A : AxisSpace I ε) :
    evaluationCLM I hε hR hR20 k m p hp A = mixedSeries I ε A k m p

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.iteratedDeriv_Y
statement:
theorem iteratedDeriv_Y (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (A : AxisSpace I ε) (k m r : ℕ) {Y η : ℝ}
    (hY : Y ∈ Ioo (-20 : ℝ) 20) (hη : η ∈ Ioo I.left I.right) :
    iteratedDeriv r (fun y => mixedSeries I ε A k m (y, η)) Y =
      mixedSeries I ε A (k + r) m (Y, η)

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.iteratedDeriv_eta
statement:
theorem iteratedDeriv_eta (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (A : AxisSpace I ε) (k m r : ℕ) {Y η : ℝ}
    (hY : Y ∈ Ioo (-20 : ℝ) 20) (hη : η ∈ Ioo I.left I.right) :
    iteratedDeriv r (fun x => mixedSeries I ε A k m (Y, x)) η =
      mixedSeries I ε A k (m + r) (Y, η)

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.jetBound_nonneg
statement:
theorem jetBound_nonneg {ε R : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (k m : ℕ) :

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.linearForm_norm
statement: theorem linearForm_norm (u v : ℝ) : ‖linearForm u v‖ ≤ |u| + |v|

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.linearForm_tsum
statement:
theorem linearForm_tsum {u v : ℕ → ℝ} (hu : Summable u) (hv : Summable v) :

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.majorant_scale
statement:
theorem majorant_scale (ε C R : ℝ) (k m n : ℕ) :
    majorant ε C R k m n = C * majorant ε 1 R k m n

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.mixedSeries_add
statement:
theorem mixedSeries_add (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (A B : AxisSpace I ε) (k m : ℕ) {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : |p.1| < 20) :
    mixedSeries I ε (A + B) k m p = mixedSeries I ε A k m p + mixedSeries I ε B k m p

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.mixedSeries_bound
statement:
theorem mixedSeries_bound (I : Window) {ε R : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hR20 : R < 20) (A : AxisSpace I ε) (k m : ℕ)
    {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : |p.1| ≤ R) :
    ‖mixedSeries I ε A k m p‖ ≤ jetBound ε R k m * ‖A‖

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.mixedSeries_contDiffAt_nat
statement:
theorem mixedSeries_contDiffAt_nat (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (A : AxisSpace I ε) (r : ℕ) :
    ∀ (k m : ℕ) (p : ℝ × ℝ), p ∈ strip I 20 →
      ContDiffAt ℝ r (mixedSeries I ε A k m) p

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.mixedSeries_hasDerivAt_Y
statement:
theorem mixedSeries_hasDerivAt_Y (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (A : AxisSpace I ε) (k m : ℕ) {Y η : ℝ}
    (hY : Y ∈ Ioo (-20 : ℝ) 20) (hη : η ∈ Ioo I.left I.right) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => mixedSeries I ε A k m (y, η))

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.mixedSeries_hasDerivAt_eta
statement:
theorem mixedSeries_hasDerivAt_eta (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (A : AxisSpace I ε) (k m : ℕ) {Y η : ℝ}

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.mixedSeries_hasFDerivAt
statement:
theorem mixedSeries_hasFDerivAt (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (A : AxisSpace I ε) (k m : ℕ) {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : p ∈ strip I 20) :
    HasFDerivAt (mixedSeries I ε A k m)
      (linearForm (mixedSeries I ε A (k + 1) m p) (mixedSeries I ε A k (m + 1) p)) p

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.mixedSeries_hasFDerivAt_strip
statement:
theorem mixedSeries_hasFDerivAt_strip (I : Window) {ε R : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hR20 : R < 20) (A : AxisSpace I ε) (k m : ℕ)

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.mixedSeries_smooth
statement:
theorem mixedSeries_smooth (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (A : AxisSpace I ε) (k m : ℕ) {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : p ∈ strip I 20) :

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.mixedSeries_smul
statement:
theorem mixedSeries_smul (I : Window) (ε c : ℝ)
    (A : AxisSpace I ε) (k m : ℕ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) :
    mixedSeries I ε (c • A) k m p = c * mixedSeries I ε A k m p

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.mixedSeries_sub
statement:
theorem mixedSeries_sub (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (A B : AxisSpace I ε) (k m : ℕ) {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : |p.1| < 20) :
    mixedSeries I ε (A - B) k m p = mixedSeries I ε A k m p - mixedSeries I ε B k m p

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.mixedSeries_sub_bound
statement:
theorem mixedSeries_sub_bound (I : Window) {ε R : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hR20 : R < 20) (A B : AxisSpace I ε) (k m : ℕ)
    {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : |p.1| ≤ R) :
    ‖mixedSeries I ε A k m p - mixedSeries I ε B k m p‖ ≤
      jetBound ε R k m * ‖A - B‖

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.mixedSeries_summable
statement:
theorem mixedSeries_summable (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (A : AxisSpace I ε) (k m : ℕ) {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : |p.1| < 20) :
    Summable (fun n => term I ε A k m n p)

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.mixedSeries_uniform
statement:
theorem mixedSeries_uniform (I : Window) {ε R : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hR20 : R < 20)
    (A : AxisSpace I ε) (k m : ℕ) :
    TendstoUniformlyOn
      (fun N (p : ℝ × ℝ) => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, term I ε A k m n p)
      (mixedSeries I ε A k m) atTop {p : ℝ × ℝ | |p.1| ≤ R}

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.mixedSeries_zero
statement:
theorem mixedSeries_zero (I : Window) (ε : ℝ) (A : AxisSpace I ε) :
    mixedSeries I ε A 0 0 = profile I ε A

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.mixed_derivative_profile
statement:
theorem mixed_derivative_profile (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (A : AxisSpace I ε) (k m : ℕ) {Y η : ℝ}
    (hY : Y ∈ Ioo (-20 : ℝ) 20) (hη : η ∈ Ioo I.left I.right) :
    iteratedDeriv m (fun x => iteratedDeriv k (fun y => profile I ε A (y, x)) Y) η =
      ∑' n : ℕ, (n.descFactorial k : ℝ) * Y ^ (n - k) *
        jet I (weight ε) A.1 n m η

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.mixed_derivative_profile_coefficients
statement:
theorem mixed_derivative_profile_coefficients (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (A : AxisSpace I ε) (k m : ℕ) {Y η : ℝ}
    (hY : Y ∈ Ioo (-20 : ℝ) 20) (hη : η ∈ Ioo I.left I.right) :
    iteratedDeriv m (fun x => iteratedDeriv k (fun y => profile I ε A (y, x)) Y) η =
      ∑' n : ℕ, (n.descFactorial k : ℝ) * Y ^ (n - k) *
        iteratedDeriv m (coefficient I (weight ε) A n) η

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.polynomialJet_bound
statement:
theorem polynomialJet_bound {R Y : ℝ} (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hY : |Y| ≤ R) (n k : ℕ) :
    |polynomialJet n k Y| ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ k * R ^ n

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.polynomialJet_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem polynomialJet_hasDerivAt (n k : ℕ) (Y : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (polynomialJet n k) (polynomialJet n (k + 1) Y) Y

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.profile_hasSum
statement:
theorem profile_hasSum (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (A : AxisSpace I ε) {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : |p.1| < 20) :

theorem profile_smooth (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.profile_smooth_radius

theorem profile_smooth_radius (I : Window) {ε R : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hR20 : R < 20)

theorem summable_majorant {ε C R : ℝ} (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hR20 : R < 20) (k m : ℕ) :

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.summable_term
statement:
theorem summable_term (I : Window) {ε R : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.term_add
statement:
theorem term_add (I : Window) (ε : ℝ) (A B : AxisSpace I ε) (k m n : ℕ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) :
    term I ε (A + B) k m n p = term I ε A k m n p + term I ε B k m n p

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.term_bound
statement:
theorem term_bound (I : Window) {ε R : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hR : 1 ≤ R)

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.term_continuous
statement:
theorem term_continuous (I : Window) (ε : ℝ) (A : AxisSpace I ε) (k m n : ℕ) :

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.term_hasFDerivAt
statement:
theorem term_hasFDerivAt (I : Window) (ε : ℝ) (A : AxisSpace I ε) (k m n : ℕ)

    HasFDerivAt (term I ε A k m n)
      (linearForm (term I ε A (k + 1) m n p) (term I ε A k (m + 1) n p)) p

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.term_smul
statement:
theorem term_smul (I : Window) (ε c : ℝ) (A : AxisSpace I ε) (k m n : ℕ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.term_sub
statement:
theorem term_sub (I : Window) (ε : ℝ) (A B : AxisSpace I ε) (k m n : ℕ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) :
    term I ε (A - B) k m n p = term I ε A k m n p - term I ε B k m n p

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.unitInterval_in_enlargedWindow
statement:
theorem unitInterval_in_enlargedWindow {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 ⊆ Ioo (enlargedUnitWindow δ hδ).left (enlargedUnitWindow δ hδ).right

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.weight_upper
statement:
theorem weight_upper {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (n m : ℕ) :
    weight ε n m ≤ (1 / 20 : ℝ) ^ n * (ε⁻¹) ^ m * (m.factorial : ℝ) *
      (((m : ℝ) + 1) ^ m * ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ m)

name: NavierStokes.AxisOperators.average_row_bound
statement:
theorem average_row_bound {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (n m : ℕ) :
    |1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)| * weight ε n (0 + m) ≤ 1 * weight ε n m

name: NavierStokes.AxisOperators.coefficient_product
statement:
theorem coefficient_product (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (A B : AxisSpace I ε)
    (n : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ I.interval) :
    coefficient I (weight ε) (product I hε A B) n x =
      ∑ ij ∈ antidiagonal n,
        coefficient I (weight ε) A ij.1 x * coefficient I (weight ε) B ij.2 x

name: NavierStokes.AxisOperators.continuousOn_leibnizSum
statement:
theorem continuousOn_leibnizSum (I : Window) (f g : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ k, ContinuousOn (f k) I.interval)
    (hg : ∀ k, ContinuousOn (g k) I.interval) (m : ℕ) :
    ContinuousOn (fun x => leibnizSum (fun k => f k x) (fun k => g k x) m) I.interval

name: NavierStokes.AxisOperators.differentialFamily_bound
statement:
theorem differentialFamily_bound (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (r p : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (d b : ℕ → ℝ) (C : ℝ)
    (hd : ∀ j, 0 ≤ d j) (hb : ∀ i, 0 ≤ b i) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hshift : ∀ i k, weight ε i (p + k) ≤ C * b i * weight ε (i + 1) k)
    (hfactor : ∀ n i j, i + j = n → b i * d j ≤ radialDivisor r n)
    (A B : AxisSpace I ε) (n m : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    |differentialFamily I ε r p d A B n m x| ≤
      ((64 * C) * ‖A‖ * ‖B‖) * weight ε n m

name: NavierStokes.AxisOperators.differentialFamily_continuous
statement:
theorem differentialFamily_continuous (I : Window) (ε : ℝ) (r p : ℕ) (d : ℕ → ℝ)
    (A B : AxisSpace I ε) (n m : ℕ) :
    ContinuousOn (differentialFamily I ε r p d A B n m) I.interval

name: NavierStokes.AxisOperators.differentialFamily_deriv
statement:
theorem differentialFamily_deriv (I : Window) (ε : ℝ) (r p : ℕ) (d : ℕ → ℝ)
    (A B : AxisSpace I ε) (n m : ℕ) (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ I.interval) :
    HasDerivWithinAt (differentialFamily I ε r p d A B n m)
      (differentialFamily I ε r p d A B n (m + 1) x) I.interval x

name: NavierStokes.AxisOperators.differentialFamily_succ_eq
statement:
theorem differentialFamily_succ_eq (I : Window) (ε : ℝ) (r p : ℕ) (d : ℕ → ℝ)
    (A B : AxisSpace I ε) (n m : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    differentialFamily I ε r p d A B (n + 1) m x =
      ∑ ij ∈ antidiagonal n, (d ij.2 / radialDivisor r n) *
        leibnizSum (fun k => inputJet I ε A ij.1 (p + k) x)
          (fun l => inputJet I ε B ij.2 l x) m

name: NavierStokes.AxisOperators.hasDerivWithinAt_leibnizSum
statement:
theorem hasDerivWithinAt_leibnizSum (I : Window) (f g : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ k x, x ∈ I.interval → HasDerivWithinAt (f k) (f (k + 1) x) I.interval x)
    (hg : ∀ k x, x ∈ I.interval → HasDerivWithinAt (g k) (g (k + 1) x) I.interval x)
    (m : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ I.interval) :
    HasDerivWithinAt
      (fun y => leibnizSum (fun k => f k y) (fun k => g k y) m)
      (leibnizSum (fun k => f k x) (fun k => g k x) (m + 1)) I.interval x

name: NavierStokes.AxisOperators.inputJet_bound
statement:
theorem inputJet_bound (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (A : AxisSpace I ε)
    (n m : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    |inputJet I ε A n m x| ≤ ‖A‖ * weight ε n m

name: NavierStokes.AxisOperators.inverse_row_bound
statement:
theorem inverse_row_bound {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) {r : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (n m : ℕ) :
    |inverseScale r n| * weight ε n.pred (0 + m) ≤ 80 * weight ε n m

name: NavierStokes.AxisOperators.jet_bilinearLift
statement:
theorem jet_bilinearLift (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (F : BoundedBilinearJetFamily I ε) (A B : AxisSpace I ε) (n m : ℕ)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ I.interval) :
    inputJet I ε (bilinearLift I hε F A B) n m x = F.value A B n m x

name: NavierStokes.AxisOperators.jet_bilinearValue
statement:
theorem jet_bilinearValue (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (F : BoundedBilinearJetFamily I ε) (A B : AxisSpace I ε) (n m : ℕ)

name: NavierStokes.AxisContraction.angular_remainder_expansion
statement:
theorem angular_remainder_expansion
    (t h D η d U W H κ φ u bu buη φdot φη : ℝ) :
    ((W + h - 2 * h * η * U) * φ + W * φdot + H * φη) +
        d * κ * u * φ -
        t * (((2 * D * η) * bu + (2 * h * η) * u) * φ +
          d * buη * φ + (2 * D * η) * bu * φdot +
          d * buη * φdot - d * u * φη) =
      ((W - t * ((2 * D * η) * bu + d * buη)) +
          h * (1 - 2 * η * (U + t * u)) + d * u * κ) * φ +
        (W - t * ((2 * D * η) * bu + d * buη)) * φdot +
        (H + t * d * u) * φη

name: NavierStokes.AxisContraction.axial_remainder_expansion
statement:
theorem axial_remainder_expansion
    (t A D η d U Uη W H u bu buη udot uη P Pη Pdot : ℝ) :
    ((A - 4 * A * η * U + d * Uη) * u + W * udot + H * uη) -
        t * ((2 * A * η) * (u * u) + (2 * D * η) * bu * udot +
          d * buη * udot - d * u * uη) +
        (-4 * A * η * P + d * Pη - 2 * η * Pdot) =
      A * (1 - 4 * η * U) * u - 2 * A * η * t * (u * u) +
        (W - t * ((2 * D * η) * bu + d * buη)) * udot +
        H * uη + d * Uη * u + t * d * u * uη -
        4 * A * η * P + d * Pη - 2 * η * Pdot

name: NavierStokes.AxisContraction.coefficient_fixedPoint
statement:
theorem coefficient_fixedPoint
    (I : AxisCoefficientSpace.Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (d : AxisData (AxisCoefficientSpace.AxisSpace I ε))
    (S : AxisCoefficientSpace.AxisSpace I ε →L[ℝ] AxisCoefficientSpace.AxisSpace I ε)
    (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) :
    let O := coefficientOperators I hε
    ∃ Λ₀ : ℝ, 0 < Λ₀ ∧ ∀ Λ : ℝ, Λ₀ ≤ Λ →
      ∀ a : AxisCoefficientSpace.AxisSpace I ε, ‖a‖ ≤ M →
      ∃ x : AxisCoefficientSpace.AxisSpace I ε × AxisCoefficientSpace.AxisSpace I ε,
        ‖x - referencePair O d S‖ ≤ 1 ∧
        referencePair O d S +
          (1 / (2 * Λ)) • naturalRemainder O d S (1 / Λ) a x = x ∧
        ‖x - referencePair O d S‖ ≤
          remainderBound O d S (‖referencePair O d S‖ + 1) M (by positivity) hM / (2 * Λ) ∧
        ∀ y, ‖y - referencePair O d S‖ ≤ 1 →
          referencePair O d S +
            (1 / (2 * Λ)) • naturalRemainder O d S (1 / Λ) a y = y → y = x

theorem evaluated_mixed_error (I : AxisCoefficientSpace.Window)
    {ε R : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hR20 : R < 20)
    (A B : AxisCoefficientSpace.AxisSpace I ε) (K : ℝ) (hK : ‖A - B‖ ≤ K)
    (k m : ℕ) {Y η : ℝ} (hY : |Y| ≤ R) (hη : η ∈ Ioo I.left I.right) :
    ‖iteratedDeriv m
        (fun z => iteratedDeriv k (fun y => AxisEvaluation.profile I ε A (y, z)) Y) η -
      iteratedDeriv m
        (fun z => iteratedDeriv k (fun y => AxisEvaluation.profile I ε B (y, z)) Y) η‖ ≤
        AxisEvaluation.jetBound ε R k m * K

name: NavierStokes.AxisContraction.exists_fixedPoint_of_controlled
statement:
theorem exists_fixedPoint_of_controlled [CompleteSpace E]
    (x₀ : E) (f : Controlled E E (‖x₀‖ + 1))
    (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hbound : s * f.bound ≤ 1)
    (hlip : s * f.lip ≤ 1 / 2) :
    ∃ x : E, ‖x - x₀‖ ≤ 1 ∧
      x₀ + s • f.eval x = x ∧
      ‖x - x₀‖ ≤ s * f.bound ∧
      ∀ y : E, ‖y - x₀‖ ≤ 1 → x₀ + s • f.eval y = y → y = x

name: NavierStokes.AxisContraction.exists_unique_natural_fixedPoint
statement:
theorem exists_unique_natural_fixedPoint [CompleteSpace V]
    (O : NaturalOperators V) (d : AxisData V) (S : V →L[ℝ] V)
    (x₀ : V × V) (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (Λ : ℝ) (hΛ : contractionThreshold O d S x₀ M hM ≤ Λ)
    (a : V) (ha : ‖a‖ ≤ M) :
    ∃ x : V × V, ‖x - x₀‖ ≤ 1 ∧
      x₀ + (1 / (2 * Λ)) • naturalRemainder O d S (1 / Λ) a x = x ∧
      ‖x - x₀‖ ≤ remainderBound O d S (‖x₀‖ + 1) M (by positivity) hM / (2 * Λ) ∧
      ∀ y : V × V, ‖y - x₀‖ ≤ 1 →
        x₀ + (1 / (2 * Λ)) • naturalRemainder O d S (1 / Λ) a y = y → y = x

name: NavierStokes.AxisContraction.fixedPoint_integrated_equations
statement:
theorem fixedPoint_integrated_equations (O : NaturalOperators V) (d : AxisData V)
    (S Q : V →L[ℝ] V) (hS : ∀ y : V, S y + Q (S y) = y)
    (t s : ℝ) (a : V) (x : V × V)
    (hfixed : referencePair O d S + s • naturalRemainder O d S t a x = x) :
    x.1 + Q x.1 =
        d.one + s • (naturalRemainder O d (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ V) t a x).1 ∧
      x.2 = -(1 / 2 : ℝ) • O.j1 (O.product d.inverseL d.zStar) +
        s • (naturalRemainder O d (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ V) t a x).2

name: NavierStokes.AxisContraction.integrated_equations_fixedPoint
statement:
theorem integrated_equations_fixedPoint (O : NaturalOperators V) (d : AxisData V)
    (S Q : V →L[ℝ] V) (hS : ∀ y : V, S (y + Q y) = y)
    (t s : ℝ) (a : V) (x : V × V)
    (hφ : x.1 + Q x.1 =
      d.one + s • (naturalRemainder O d (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ V) t a x).1)
    (hu : x.2 = -(1 / 2 : ℝ) • O.j1 (O.product d.inverseL d.zStar) +
      s • (naturalRemainder O d (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ V) t a x).2) :
    referencePair O d S + s • naturalRemainder O d S t a x = x

name: NavierStokes.AxisContraction.naturalRemainder_fst_resolvent
statement:
theorem naturalRemainder_fst_resolvent (O : NaturalOperators V) (d : AxisData V)
    (S : V →L[ℝ] V) (t : ℝ) (a : V) (x : V × V) :
    (naturalRemainder O d S t a x).1 =
      S ((naturalRemainder O d (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ V) t a x).1)

name: NavierStokes.AxisContraction.naturalRemainder_sub_le
statement:
theorem naturalRemainder_sub_le (O : NaturalOperators V) (d : AxisData V)
    (S : V →L[ℝ] V) (R M : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : |t| ≤ 1) (a : V) (ha : ‖a‖ ≤ M)
    (x y : V × V) (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ R) (hy : ‖y‖ ≤ R) :
    ‖naturalRemainder O d S t a x - naturalRemainder O d S t a y‖ ≤
      remainderLip O d S R M hR hM * ‖x - y‖

name: NavierStokes.AxisContraction.norm_naturalRemainder_le
statement:
theorem norm_naturalRemainder_le (O : NaturalOperators V) (d : AxisData V)
    (S : V →L[ℝ] V) (R M : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : |t| ≤ 1) (a : V) (ha : ‖a‖ ≤ M)
    (x : V × V) (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ R) :
    ‖naturalRemainder O d S t a x‖ ≤ remainderBound O d S R M hR hM

name: NavierStokes.AxisContraction.remainderBound_nonneg
statement:
theorem remainderBound_nonneg (O : NaturalOperators V) (d : AxisData V)
    (S : V →L[ℝ] V) (R M : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hM : 0 ≤ M) :
    0 ≤ remainderBound O d S R M hR hM

name: NavierStokes.AxisContraction.remainderLip_nonneg
statement:
theorem remainderLip_nonneg (O : NaturalOperators V) (d : AxisData V)
    (S : V →L[ℝ] V) (R M : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hM : 0 ≤ M) :
    0 ≤ remainderLip O d S R M hR hM

name: NavierStokes.AxisContraction.uniform_natural_fixedPoint
statement:
theorem uniform_natural_fixedPoint [CompleteSpace V]
    (O : NaturalOperators V) (d : AxisData V) (S : V →L[ℝ] V)
    (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) :
    ∃ Λ₀ : ℝ, 0 < Λ₀ ∧ ∀ Λ : ℝ, Λ₀ ≤ Λ → ∀ a : V, ‖a‖ ≤ M →
      ∃ x : V × V,
        ‖x - referencePair O d S‖ ≤ 1 ∧
        referencePair O d S +
          (1 / (2 * Λ)) • naturalRemainder O d S (1 / Λ) a x = x ∧
        ‖x - referencePair O d S‖ ≤
          remainderBound O d S (‖referencePair O d S‖ + 1) M (by positivity) hM / (2 * Λ) ∧
        ∀ y : V × V, ‖y - referencePair O d S‖ ≤ 1 →
          referencePair O d S +
            (1 / (2 * Λ)) • naturalRemainder O d S (1 / Λ) a y = y → y = x

    (hε : 0 < ε) (hερ : ε < ρ)
    (hF : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ F (closedTube I ρ))
    (hM : ∀ z ∈ closedTube I ρ, (F z).re ≤ M)
    (hreal : ∀ x ∈ I.interval, (F (x : ℂ)).im = 0) :
    ∀ Λ : ℝ, 0 ≤ Λ → ∀ C : ℝ, Real.exp (Λ * M) ≤ C →
      ∃ a : AxisSpace I ε,
        ‖a‖ ≤ radiusLoss (ε / ρ) ∧
        (∀ x ∈ I.interval, coefficient I (AxisWeightEstimates.weight ε) a 0 x =
          Real.exp (Λ * (F (x : ℂ)).re) / C) ∧
        (∀ n : ℕ, n ≠ 0 → ∀ x ∈ I.interval,
          coefficient I (AxisWeightEstimates.weight ε) a n x = 0)

    ∀ Λ : ℝ, 0 ≤ Λ → ∀ C : ℝ, Real.exp (Λ * realPartSup F K) ≤ C →
      ∃ a : AxisSpace I ε,
        ‖a‖ ≤ radiusLoss (ε / ρ) ∧
        (∀ x ∈ I.interval, coefficient I (AxisWeightEstimates.weight ε) a 0 x =
          Real.exp (Λ * (F (x : ℂ)).re) / C) ∧
        (∀ n : ℕ, n ≠ 0 → ∀ x ∈ I.interval,
          coefficient I (AxisWeightEstimates.weight ε) a n x = 0)

theorem ideal_prefix_cutoff_parameters {h j : ℝ} (p : Parameters h j)
    {g a : ℝ → ℝ} {cap B : ℝ}
    (hp : PressureDatum.Admissible g a cap) (hB : 2 ≤ B)
    (hg : ∀ y ≤ 0, g y = B ^ 2 * Real.exp ((1 / 5 : ℝ) * y))
    (ha : ∀ y ≤ 0, a y = 1) :
    ∃ δ σ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ 0 < σ ∧
      (∀ η ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
        |Z h j (PressureDatum.pressure g a) η| ≤ δ → 99 / 100 < chi h j σ η) ∧
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (chi h j σ)

    (hg : ∀ y ≤ 0, g y = B ^ 2 * Real.exp ((1 / 5 : ℝ) * y))
    (ha : ∀ y ≤ 0, a y = 1) :
    ∃ η₀ : ℝ, η₀ ∈ Ioo (-j / 4) (-j / 5) ∧ H h j η₀ = 0 ∧
      j / 5 < Z h j (PressureDatum.pressure g a) η₀ ∧

name: NavierStokes.NaturalProfile.angular_equation_reconstruct
statement:
theorem angular_equation_reconstruct {h j σ Λ : ℝ} {P0 a₀ : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hsmall : NaturalAxisRange.Parameters h j) (hΛ : Λ ≠ 0)
    {Φ u B P : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ}
    (hs : IsScaledSolution window (actualData h j σ P0) (1 / Λ) a₀ Φ u B P)
    {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : p ∈ domain Λ)
    (ha : HasDerivAt a₀ ((Λ * realGradient h j σ p.2) * a₀ p.2) p.2) :
    2 * NaturalAxisData.L h p.2 * radialDifferential 2 (angularProfile a₀ Λ Φ) p =
      transportW h (affineProfile (NaturalAxisData.U j) (1 / Λ) Λ B) p *
        (p.1 * partialY (angularProfile a₀ Λ Φ) p + angularProfile a₀ Λ Φ p) +
      h * (1 - 2 * p.2 * affineProfile (NaturalAxisData.U j) (1 / Λ) Λ u p) *
        angularProfile a₀ Λ Φ p +
      transportH h (affineProfile (NaturalAxisData.U j) (1 / Λ) Λ u) p *
        partialEta (angularProfile a₀ Λ Φ) p

    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u (AxisEvaluation.strip window 20))
    (havg : ∀ q ∈ AxisEvaluation.strip window 20,
      q.1 * B q = ∫ Y in (0 : ℝ)..q.1, u (Y, q.2))
    {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : p ∈ domain Λ) :
    p.1 * affineProfile b c Λ B p =
      ∫ X in (0 : ℝ)..p.1, affineProfile b c Λ u (X, p.2)

name: NavierStokes.NaturalProfile.axial_equation_reconstruct
statement:
theorem axial_equation_reconstruct {h j σ Λ : ℝ} {P0 a₀ : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hsmall : NaturalAxisRange.Parameters h j) (hΛ : Λ ≠ 0)
    (hP0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ P0) {Φ u B P : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ}
    (hs : IsScaledSolution window (actualData h j σ P0) (1 / Λ) a₀ Φ u B P)
    {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : p ∈ domain Λ) :
    2 * NaturalAxisData.L h p.2 *
        radialDifferential 1 (affineProfile (NaturalAxisData.U j) (1 / Λ) Λ u) p =
      transportW h (affineProfile (NaturalAxisData.U j) (1 / Λ) Λ B) p *
        (p.1 * partialY (affineProfile (NaturalAxisData.U j) (1 / Λ) Λ u) p) +
      NaturalAxisData.A h *
        (1 - 2 * p.2 * affineProfile (NaturalAxisData.U j) (1 / Λ) Λ u p) *
        affineProfile (NaturalAxisData.U j) (1 / Λ) Λ u p +
      transportH h (affineProfile (NaturalAxisData.U j) (1 / Λ) Λ u) p *
        partialEta (affineProfile (NaturalAxisData.U j) (1 / Λ) Λ u) p +
      NaturalAxisData.d p.2 * partialEta (affineProfile P0 (1 / Λ) Λ P) p -
      4 * NaturalAxisData.A h * p.2 * affineProfile P0 (1 / Λ) Λ P p -
      2 * p.2 * p.1 * partialY (affineProfile P0 (1 / Λ) Λ P) p

name: NavierStokes.StressActivation.FromReference.histories_difference_factorization
statement:
theorem histories_difference_factorization {T δ : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hδT : 2 * δ < rampLimit) (κ : ℝ) (P0 : ℝ → ℝ) (hP0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ P0)
    (r : HistoryRow) (y : ℝ) {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ parameterInterval) :
    profileHistory (histories N hT hδ hδT κ P0 hP0) r (radius N.endpoint y, η) -
      profileHistory (N.histories hδ hδT P0 hP0) r (radius N.endpoint y, η) =
        y * activation T κ y *
          historyDifferenceFamily T N.endpoint (refLog N δ) (refAxial N δ) r ((κ, y), η)
