    (r : HistoryRow) (η : ℝ) :
    profileHistory (histories N hT hδ hδT κ P0 hP0) r (N.endpoint, η) =
      profileHistory (N.histories hδ hδT P0 hP0) r (N.endpoint, η)

name: NavierStokes.StressActivation.FromReference.histories_log_formula
statement:
theorem histories_log_formula {T δ : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hδT : 2 * δ < rampLimit) (κ : ℝ) (P0 : ℝ → ℝ) (hP0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ P0)
    (r : HistoryRow) (y : ℝ) {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ parameterInterval) :
    profileHistory (histories N hT hδ hδT κ P0 hP0) r (radius N.endpoint y, η) =
      logHistory N.endpoint
        (fun s ξ => profileHistory (N.histories hδ hδT P0 hP0) s (N.endpoint, ξ))
        (activatedAngular T κ (refLog N δ)) (controlled T κ (refAxial N δ)) r (y, η)

name: NavierStokes.StressActivation.FromReference.histories_parameter_jet_bounds
statement:
theorem histories_parameter_jet_bounds {T δ : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hδT : 2 * δ < rampLimit) (P0 : ℝ → ℝ) (hP0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ P0)
    {K : Set ℝ} (hK : IsCompact K) (hKJ : K ⊆ parameterInterval) (r : HistoryRow) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ κ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ η ∈ K,
      |iteratedDeriv n (fun ξ =>
        profileHistory (histories N hT hδ hδT κ P0 hP0) r (radius N.endpoint y, ξ) -
          profileHistory (N.histories hδ hδT P0 hP0) r (radius N.endpoint y, ξ)) η| ≤
            M * y * activation T κ y

statement:
theorem actualP2_eq (T κ : ℝ) {X0 : ℝ} (hX0 : 0 < X0)

NavierStokes.StressActivation.angular_difference_factorization
statement:
theorem angular_difference_factorization {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (κ : ℝ)
    {J : Set ℝ} (hJ : IsOpen J) {L : Field}

statement:
theorem angular_relative_difference {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (κ : ℝ)

statement:
theorem angular_relative_parameter_jet_bounds {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) {J K : Set ℝ}

    (hL : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ L (logDomain J hJ).carrier) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ κ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ η ∈ K,
      |iteratedDeriv n (fun ξ =>
        activatedAngular T κ L (y, ξ) / referenceAngular L (y, ξ) - 1) η| ≤
          M * y * activation T κ y

name: NavierStokes.StressActivation.controlledFamily_smooth

    (hB : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) y, |radialPartial F (t, η)| ≤ M) :

name: NavierStokes.StressActivation.controlled_difference_factorization

theorem controlled_difference_factorization {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (κ : ℝ)

theorem densityDifferenceFamily_smooth {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (X0 : ℝ)

name: NavierStokes.StressActivation.density_difference_factorization
statement:
theorem density_difference_factorization {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (κ X0 : ℝ)
    {J : Set ℝ} (hJ : IsOpen J) {L U : Field}
    (hL : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ L (logDomain J hJ).carrier)
    (hU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ U (logDomain J hJ).carrier)
    (r : HistoryRow) (y : ℝ) {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ J) :
    logDensity X0 (activatedAngular T κ L) (controlled T κ U) r (y, η) -
      logDensity X0 (referenceAngular L) U r (y, η) =
        y * activation T κ y * densityDifferenceFamily T X0 L U r ((κ, y), η)

name: NavierStokes.StressActivation.differenceFamily_smooth
statement:

name: NavierStokes.StressActivation.history_difference_factorization
statement:
theorem history_difference_factorization {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (κ X0 : ℝ)
    (initial : HistoryRow → ℝ → ℝ) {J : Set ℝ} (hJ : IsOpen J) {L U : Field}
    (hL : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ L (logDomain J hJ).carrier)
    (hU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ U (logDomain J hJ).carrier)
    (r : HistoryRow) (y : ℝ) {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ J) :
    logHistory X0 initial (activatedAngular T κ L) (controlled T κ U) r (y, η) -
      logHistory X0 initial (referenceAngular L) U r (y, η) =
        y * activation T κ y * historyDifferenceFamily T X0 L U r ((κ, y), η)

name: NavierStokes.StressActivation.history_difference_integral
statement:
theorem history_difference_integral {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (κ X0 : ℝ)
    (initial : HistoryRow → ℝ → ℝ) {J : Set ℝ} (hJ : IsOpen J) {L U : Field}
    (hL : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ L (logDomain J hJ).carrier)
    (hU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ U (logDomain J hJ).carrier)
    (r : HistoryRow) (y : ℝ) {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ J) :
    logHistory X0 initial (activatedAngular T κ L) (controlled T κ U) r (y, η) -
      logHistory X0 initial (referenceAngular L) U r (y, η) =
        weightedPrimitive T κ (fun p => historyIntegrandFamily T X0 L U r ((κ, p.1), p.2))
          (y, η)

    ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ κ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ η ∈ K,
      |iteratedDeriv n (fun ξ =>
        logHistory X0 initial (activatedAngular T κ L) (controlled T κ U) r (y, ξ) -
          logHistory X0 initial (referenceAngular L) U r (y, ξ)) η| ≤
            M * y * activation T κ y

    {H : FamilyPoint → ℝ} (hH : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ H ((univ : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) ×ˢ J))
    {E : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ}
    (hE : ∀ κ y, ∀ η ∈ J, E κ y η = y * activation T κ y * H ((κ, y), η))
    (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ κ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ η ∈ K,
      |iteratedDeriv n (E κ y) η| ≤ M * y * activation T κ y

name: NavierStokes.StressActivation.shearSize_error
statement:
theorem shearSize_error (T : ℝ) {κ X0 : ℝ} (hκ : κ ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hX0 : 0 < X0)
    {J : Set ℝ} (hJ : IsOpen J) {L U : Field}
    (hL : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ L (logDomain J hJ).carrier)
    (hU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ U (logDomain J hJ).carrier) (y : ℝ) {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ J)
    (hp : referenceP1 L (y, η) ≠ 0) :
    shearSize T κ X0 L U (y, η) - damping T κ y * referenceSize X0 L U (y, η) =
      damping T κ y * (referenceP2 X0 L U (y, η) ^ 2 / referenceP1 L (y, η)) *
        ((referenceAngular L (y, η) / activatedAngular T κ L (y, η)) ^ 2 - 1)

name: NavierStokes.StressActivation.shearSlope_eq
statement:
theorem shearSlope_eq (T : ℝ) {κ X0 : ℝ} (hκ : κ ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hX0 : 0 < X0)
    {J : Set ℝ} (hJ : IsOpen J) {L U : Field}
    (hL : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ L (logDomain J hJ).carrier)
    (hU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ U (logDomain J hJ).carrier) (y : ℝ) {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ J)
    (hp : referenceP1 L (y, η) ≠ 0) :
    shearSlope T κ X0 L U (y, η) =
      (referenceP2 X0 L U (y, η) / referenceP1 L (y, η)) *
        (referenceAngular L (y, η) / activatedAngular T κ L (y, η))

name: NavierStokes.ActivationBounds.NaturalOverlap.diagonal_histories_uniform_jets
statement:
theorem diagonal_histories_uniform_jets {δ0 : ℝ} (hδ0 : 0 < δ0)
    (hδ0R : 2 * δ0 < rampLimit) (P0 : ℝ → ℝ) (hP0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ P0)
    {K : Set ℝ} (hK : IsCompact K) (hKJ : K ⊆ parameterInterval) (r : HistoryRow) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ T (hT : T ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) δ0) (hTR : 2 * T < rampLimit),
      ∀ κ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ η ∈ K,
        |iteratedDeriv n (fun ξ =>
          profileHistory (FromReference.histories N hT.1 hT.1 hTR κ P0 hP0) r (radius N.endpoint y, ξ) -
            profileHistory (N.histories hT.1 hTR P0 hP0) r (radius N.endpoint y, ξ)) η| ≤
              M * y * activation T κ y

name: NavierStokes.ActivationBounds.NaturalOverlap.diagonal_history_scaled_factor
statement:
theorem diagonal_history_scaled_factor {T δ0 : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T)
    (hTR : 2 * T < rampLimit) (hδ0 : 0 < δ0) (hδ0R : 2 * δ0 < rampLimit)
    (hTδ0 : T ≤ δ0) (κ : ℝ) (P0 : ℝ → ℝ) (hP0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ P0)
    (r : HistoryRow) {u η : ℝ} (hu : u ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hη : η ∈ parameterInterval) :
    profileHistory (FromReference.histories N hT hT hTR κ P0 hP0) r
        (radius N.endpoint (T * u), η) -
      profileHistory (N.histories hT hTR P0 hP0) r (radius N.endpoint (T * u), η) =
        scaledDistance ((κ, T), (u, η)) *
          historyErrorFactor N.endpoint (FromReference.refLog N δ0) (FromReference.refAxial N δ0) r
            ((κ, T), (u, η))

NavierStokes.ActivationBounds.angular_relative_scaled_factor
statement:
theorem angular_relative_scaled_factor {T : ℝ} (hT : T ≠ 0) (κ : ℝ)
    {J : Set ℝ} (hJ : IsOpen J) {L : Field}
    (hL : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ L (logDomain J hJ).carrier) (u : ℝ) {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ J) :

name: NavierStokes.ActivationBounds.angular_relative_uniform_jets
statement:
theorem angular_relative_uniform_jets {J K : Set ℝ} (hJ : IsOpen J) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hKJ : K ⊆ J) {L : Field} (hL : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ L (logDomain J hJ).carrier)

    (hsmall : NaturalAxisRange.Parameters h j) (hΛ : 0 < Λ)
    (hsource : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, rescalePoint Λ p ∈ entranceSet →
      0 < Sq h F.family.f F.family.U F.family.Ubar p)
    {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : rescalePoint Λ p ∈ entranceSet) (hX : 0 < p.1) :

name: NavierStokes.NaturalEntrance.EntranceProfile.regular_cone_at_four
statement:
theorem EntranceProfile.regular_cone_at_four {h j σ Λ C : ℝ} {P0 : ℝ → ℝ}
    {d : AnalyticInputs h j σ P0} (F : EntranceProfile d Λ C)
    (hsmall : NaturalAxisRange.Parameters h j) (hΛ : 0 < Λ)
    {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    let p : ℝ × ℝ := (4 / Λ, η)
    let q := p.1 * regularAngularLag h F.profile.family.f F.profile.family.U
      F.profile.family.Ubar p / NaturalAxisData.L h η
    let n := p.1 * regularAxialLag h F.profile.family.U F.profile.family.Ubar
      F.profile.family.Pi p / (NaturalAxisData.L h η * angularVelocity F.profile.family.f p)
    9 / 4 < q + n ^ 2 / q

name: NavierStokes.NaturalEntrance.EntranceProfile.regular_lag_coordinates
statement:
theorem EntranceProfile.regular_lag_coordinates {h j σ Λ C : ℝ} {P0 : ℝ → ℝ}
    {d : AnalyticInputs h j σ P0} (F : EntranceProfile d Λ C)
    (hsmall : NaturalAxisRange.Parameters h j) (hΛ : 0 < Λ)
    {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : rescalePoint Λ p ∈ entranceSet) (hX : 0 < p.1) :
    p1 F.profile.family.f p = p.1 * regularAngularLag h F.profile.family.f
        F.profile.family.U F.profile.family.Ubar p / NaturalAxisData.L h p.2 ∧
      p2 F.profile.family.f F.profile.family.U p =
        p.1 * regularAxialLag h F.profile.family.U F.profile.family.Ubar F.profile.family.Pi p /
          (NaturalAxisData.L h p.2 * angularVelocity F.profile.family.f p)

name: NavierStokes.NaturalEntrance.Sq_coefficient_identity
statement:
theorem Sq_coefficient_identity {h j σ Λ C : ℝ} {P0 : ℝ → ℝ}
    (d : AnalyticInputs h j σ P0) (x : CoefficientPair d.coefficients.epsilon)
    (hΛ : 0 < Λ) (hC : 0 < C) {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : p ∈ domain Λ)
    (hval : 1 / 8 ≤ AxisEvaluation.profile window d.coefficients.epsilon x.1
      (rescalePoint Λ p)) :
    Sq h (angularField h j σ Λ C x) (axialField j Λ x)
        (averageField j Λ d.coefficients.epsilon_pos x) p =
      NaturalAxisData.L h p.2 * Λ * NaturalAxisData.chi h j σ p.2 +
        sourceRemainder h j σ (rescalePoint Λ p) (1 / Λ)
          (sourceJets d.coefficients.epsilon_pos x (rescalePoint Λ p))

name: NavierStokes.NaturalEntrance.Sq_eq_radial
statement:
theorem Sq_eq_radial {h j Λ : ℝ} {P0 a₀ : ℝ → ℝ} {f U V Pr : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ}
    (hs : IsNaturalSolution h j Λ P0 a₀ f U V Pr)
    {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : p ∈ domain Λ) (hf : f p ≠ 0) :
    Sq h f U V p = -2 * NaturalAxisData.L h p.2 * radialDifferential 2 f p / f p

name: NavierStokes.NaturalEntrance.Sq_reconstruction
statement:
theorem Sq_reconstruction {h j σ Λ : ℝ} (P0 : ℝ → ℝ) {a : ℝ → ℝ}
    {Φ u B : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ}
    (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ (AxisEvaluation.strip window 20))
    (hB : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ B (AxisEvaluation.strip window 20))
    (hΛ : Λ ≠ 0) {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : p ∈ domain Λ) (ha : a p.2 ≠ 0)
    (hval : 1 / 8 ≤ Φ (rescalePoint Λ p))
    (had : HasDerivAt a ((Λ * realGradient h j σ p.2) * a p.2) p.2) :
    Sq h (angularProfile a Λ Φ)
      (affineProfile (NaturalAxisData.U j) (1 / Λ) Λ u)
      (affineProfile (NaturalAxisData.U j) (1 / Λ) Λ B) p =
      NaturalAxisData.L h p.2 * Λ * NaturalAxisData.chi h j σ p.2 +
        sourceRemainder h j σ (rescalePoint Λ p) (1 / Λ)
          ![Φ (rescalePoint Λ p), partialY Φ (rescalePoint Λ p),
            partialEta Φ (rescalePoint Λ p), u (rescalePoint Λ p),
            B (rescalePoint Λ p), partialEta B (rescalePoint Λ p)]

name: NavierStokes.NaturalEntrance.angularProfile_parameter_log_derivative
statement:
theorem angularProfile_parameter_log_derivative {a : ℝ → ℝ} {Λ κ : ℝ}
    {Φ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ} (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ (AxisEvaluation.strip window 20))
    {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : p ∈ domain Λ) (ha : a p.2 ≠ 0)
    (hval : Φ (rescalePoint Λ p) ≠ 0)
    (had : HasDerivAt a ((Λ * κ) * a p.2) p.2) :
    partialEta (angularProfile a Λ Φ) p / angularProfile a Λ Φ p =
      Λ * κ + partialEta Φ (rescalePoint Λ p) / Φ (rescalePoint Λ p)

name: NavierStokes.NaturalEntrance.angularProfile_radial_log_derivative

theorem angularProfile_radial_log_derivative {a : ℝ → ℝ} {Λ : ℝ}

name: NavierStokes.NaturalEntrance.angular_flux_integral
statement:

name: NavierStokes.NaturalEntrance.angular_source_integral

name: NavierStokes.NaturalEntrance.axial_source_integral
statement:

statement:

    (h : ℝ) (hcoef : ∀ η ∈ parameterInterval, NaturalAxisData.L h η ≠ 0)
    (P0 : ℝ → ℝ) (hP0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ P0) :
    ∃ P Q : ScaledPoint → ℝ,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ P (scaledDomain parameterInterval) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Q (scaledDomain parameterInterval) ∧
      ∀ T : ℝ, ∀ hT : 0 < T, ∀ κ u η : ℝ, η ∈ parameterInterval →
        profileStockOne (StressActivation.FromReference.histories N hT hδ hδT κ P0 hP0) h
            (radius N.endpoint (T * u), η) -
          profileStockOne (N.histories hδ hδT P0 hP0) h (radius N.endpoint (T * u), η) =
            scaledDistance ((κ, T), (u, η)) * P ((κ, T), (u, η)) ∧
        profileStockTwo (StressActivation.FromReference.histories N hT hδ hδT κ P0 hP0) h
            (radius N.endpoint (T * u), η) -
          profileStockTwo (N.histories hδ hδT P0 hP0) h (radius N.endpoint (T * u), η) =
            scaledDistance ((κ, T), (u, η)) * Q ((κ, T), (u, η))

    (P0 : ℝ → ℝ) (hP0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ P0) (T0 : ℝ) :
    ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ T : ℝ, ∀ hT : 0 < T, T ≤ T0 → ∀ κ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,

          profileStockOne (N.histories hδ hδT P0 hP0) h (radius N.endpoint y, η)| ≤

        |profileStockTwo (StressActivation.FromReference.histories N hT hδ hδT κ P0 hP0) h

          profileStockTwo (N.histories hδ hδT P0 hP0) h (radius N.endpoint y, η)| ≤

theorem exists_log_stock_factors :
    ∃ P Q : ScaledPoint → ℝ,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ P (scaledDomain J) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Q (scaledDomain J) ∧
      ∀ T : ℝ, T ≠ 0 → ∀ κ u η : ℝ, η ∈ J →
        logViewOne h X0 (activatedAngular T κ L)
            (logHistory X0 initial (activatedAngular T κ L) (controlled T κ U)) (T * u, η) -
          logViewOne h X0 (referenceAngular L)
            (logHistory X0 initial (referenceAngular L) U) (T * u, η) =
            scaledDistance ((κ, T), (u, η)) * P ((κ, T), (u, η)) ∧
        logViewTwo h X0 (activatedAngular T κ L) (controlled T κ U)
            (logHistory X0 initial (activatedAngular T κ L) (controlled T κ U)) (T * u, η) -
          logViewTwo h X0 (referenceAngular L) U
            (logHistory X0 initial (referenceAngular L) U) (T * u, η) =
            scaledDistance ((κ, T), (u, η)) * Q ((κ, T), (u, η))

name: NavierStokes.ActivationStocks.historyEtaPair_actual

theorem historyEtaPair_actual {T : ℝ} (hT : T ≠ 0) (κ u : ℝ)

name: NavierStokes.ActivationStocks.historyPair_actual_eq
statement:
theorem historyPair_actual_eq (X0 : ℝ) (initial : HistoryRow → ℝ → ℝ)

    (hL : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ L (logDomain J hJ).carrier)
    (hU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ U (logDomain J hJ).carrier)
    (hi : ∀ r, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (initial r) J)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : T ≠ 0) (κ : ℝ) (r : HistoryRow) (u : ℝ) {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ J) :

name: NavierStokes.ActivationStocks.log_stocks_uniform_jets
statement:
theorem log_stocks_uniform_jets {K : Set ℝ} (hK : IsCompact K) (hKJ : K ⊆ J)
    (T0 : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ T ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) T0, ∀ κ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ η ∈ K,
        |iteratedDeriv n (fun ξ =>
          logViewOne h X0 (activatedAngular T κ L)
              (logHistory X0 initial (activatedAngular T κ L) (controlled T κ U)) (y, ξ) -
            logViewOne h X0 (referenceAngular L)
              (logHistory X0 initial (referenceAngular L) U) (y, ξ)) η| ≤ M * y * activation T κ y ∧
        |iteratedDeriv n (fun ξ =>
          logViewTwo h X0 (activatedAngular T κ L) (controlled T κ U)
              (logHistory X0 initial (activatedAngular T κ L) (controlled T κ U)) (y, ξ) -
            logViewTwo h X0 (referenceAngular L) U
              (logHistory X0 initial (referenceAngular L) U) (y, ξ)) η| ≤ M * y * activation T κ y

name: NavierStokes.ActivationStocks.naturalHistories_W

name: NavierStokes.ActivationStocks.profiles_stocks_congr

theorem reference_stocks_natural {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)

name: NavierStokes.ConeAlgebra.boundary_polynomial
statement:
theorem boundary_polynomial (P J v : ℝ) :
    2 * (P - v) ^ 2 - (v - 2) * J ^ 2 =
      2 * v ^ 2 - (4 * P + J ^ 2) * v + 2 * P ^ 2 + 2 * J ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.ConeAlgebra.coneBound_gt_two
statement: theorem coneBound_gt_two {P J : ℝ} (hP : 2 < P) : 2 < coneBound P J

name: NavierStokes.ConeAlgebra.coneBound_le_parameter
statement: theorem coneBound_le_parameter {P J : ℝ} (hP : 2 < P) : coneBound P J ≤ P

name: NavierStokes.ConeAlgebra.equation_eleven_sufficient
statement:
theorem equation_eleven_sufficient {a b w : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hfirst : 0 < a - b * w)
    (hsecond : 2 * b * w + b ^ 2 / a + (a - 2) * w ^ 2 < 2) :
    ∃ p₀ : ℝ, ∀ p : ℝ, p₀ < p →
      2 < p * (1 - b * w / a) ∧ a * (1 + (b / a) ^ 2) <
        coneBound (p * (1 - b * w / a)) (p * (w + b / a))

name: NavierStokes.ConeAlgebra.finite_amplitude_cone
statement:
theorem finite_amplitude_cone {c j v p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p)
    (hP : 2 < p * c) (hvP : v < p * c)
    (hscale : 4 * c * v < p * (2 * c ^ 2 - (v - 2) * j ^ 2)) :
    v < coneBound (p * c) (p * j)

name: NavierStokes.ConeAlgebra.normalized_factorization
statement:
theorem normalized_factorization (a b w : ℝ) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    (a * (1 + (b / a) ^ 2) - 2) * (w + b / a) ^ 2 -
        2 * (1 - b * w / a) ^ 2 =
      (1 + (b / a) ^ 2) * ((a - 2) * w ^ 2 + 2 * b * w + b ^ 2 / a - 2)

name: NavierStokes.ConeAlgebra.normalized_test_negative
statement:
theorem normalized_test_negative {a b w : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hcriterion : 2 * b * w + b ^ 2 / a + (a - 2) * w ^ 2 < 2) :
    (a * (1 + (b / a) ^ 2) - 2) * (w + b / a) ^ 2 -
      2 * (1 - b * w / a) ^ 2 < 0

name: NavierStokes.ConeAlgebra.relaxed_cone_of_le_two
statement:
theorem relaxed_cone_of_le_two {P J v : ℝ} (hP : 2 < P) (hv : v ≤ 2) :
    v < coneBound P J

name: NavierStokes.ConeAlgebra.rootTerm_ge_quarter
statement:
theorem rootTerm_ge_quarter {P J : ℝ} (hP : 2 < P) :
    J ^ 2 / 4 ≤ rootTerm P J

name: NavierStokes.ConeAlgebra.rootTerm_nonneg
statement: theorem rootTerm_nonneg (P J : ℝ) : 0 ≤ rootTerm P J

name: NavierStokes.ConeAlgebra.rootTerm_sq
statement:
theorem rootTerm_sq {P J : ℝ} (hP : 2 < P) :
    rootTerm P J ^ 2 = J ^ 2 * ((P - 2) / 2 + J ^ 2 / 16)

name: NavierStokes.ConeAlgebra.square_difference
statement:
theorem square_difference (P J v : ℝ) :
    (P + J ^ 2 / 4 - v) ^ 2 - J ^ 2 * ((P - 2) / 2 + J ^ 2 / 16) =
      (P - v) ^ 2 - (v - 2) * J ^ 2 / 2

name: NavierStokes.ConeAlgebra.sufficiently_large_amplitude_cone
statement:
theorem sufficiently_large_amplitude_cone {c j v : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c)
    (hmargin : (v - 2) * j ^ 2 < 2 * c ^ 2) :
    ∃ p₀ : ℝ, ∀ p : ℝ, p₀ < p →
      2 < p * c ∧ v < coneBound (p * c) (p * j)

name: NavierStokes.ConeAlgebra.true_cone_iff
statement:
theorem true_cone_iff {P J v : ℝ} (hv : 2 < v) :
    (2 < P ∧ v < coneBound P J) ↔
      (v < P ∧ (v - 2) * J ^ 2 < 2 * (P - v) ^ 2)

name: NavierStokes.UniformCone.compact_equation_eleven
statement:
theorem compact_equation_eleven {K : Set X} (hK : IsCompact K)
    {a b w : X → ℝ} (ha : ContinuousOn a K) (hb : ContinuousOn b K)
    (hw : ContinuousOn w K) (hapos : ∀ x ∈ K, 0 < a x)
    (hfirst : ∀ x ∈ K, 0 < a x - b x * w x)
    (hsecond : ∀ x ∈ K,
      2 * b x * w x + b x ^ 2 / a x + (a x - 2) * w x ^ 2 < 2) :
    ∃ ε p₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ 0 ≤ p₀ ∧
      (∀ x ∈ K, ε ≤ 1 - b x * w x / a x ∧
        ε ≤ 2 * (1 - b x * w x / a x) ^ 2 -
          (a x * (1 + (b x / a x) ^ 2) - 2) * (w x + b x / a x) ^ 2) ∧
      ∀ p : ℝ, p₀ < p → ∀ x ∈ K,
        2 < p * (1 - b x * w x / a x) ∧
        a x * (1 + (b x / a x) ^ 2) <
          coneBound (p * (1 - b x * w x / a x)) (p * (w x + b x / a x))

name: NavierStokes.UniformCone.compact_equation_eleven_gap
statement:
theorem compact_equation_eleven_gap {K : Set X} (hK : IsCompact K)
    {a b w : X → ℝ} (ha : ContinuousOn a K) (hb : ContinuousOn b K)
    (hw : ContinuousOn w K) (hapos : ∀ x ∈ K, 0 < a x)
    (hfirst : ∀ x ∈ K, 0 < a x - b x * w x)
    (hsecond : ∀ x ∈ K,
      2 * b x * w x + b x ^ 2 / a x + (a x - 2) * w x ^ 2 < 2) :
    ∃ η p₀ : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ 0 ≤ p₀ ∧ ∀ p : ℝ, p₀ < p → ∀ x ∈ K,
      2 + η < p * (1 - b x * w x / a x) ∧
        a x * (1 + (b x / a x) ^ 2) + η <
          coneBound (p * (1 - b x * w x / a x)) (p * (w x + b x / a x))

name: NavierStokes.UniformCone.compact_family_quadratic_stable
statement:
theorem compact_family_quadratic_stable {K : Set X} (hK : IsCompact K)
    {P J v : X → ℝ} (hP : ContinuousOn P K) (hJ : ContinuousOn J K)
    (hv : ContinuousOn v K)
    (hcone : ∀ x ∈ K, 2 < v x ∧ 2 < P x ∧ v x < coneBound (P x) (J x)) :
    ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ P' J' v' : ℝ,
      |P' - P x| ≤ ρ → |J' - J x| ≤ ρ → |v' - v x| ≤ ρ →
        2 < v' ∧ v' < P' ∧ (v' - 2) * J' ^ 2 < 2 * (P' - v') ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.UniformCone.compact_family_trueCone_stable
statement:
theorem compact_family_trueCone_stable {K : Set X} (hK : IsCompact K)
    {P J v : X → ℝ} (hP : ContinuousOn P K) (hJ : ContinuousOn J K)
    (hv : ContinuousOn v K)
    (hcone : ∀ x ∈ K, 2 < v x ∧ 2 < P x ∧ v x < coneBound (P x) (J x)) :
    ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ P' J' v' : ℝ,
      dist (P', J', v') (P x, J x, v x) ≤ ρ →
        2 < v' ∧ 2 < P' ∧ v' < coneBound P' J'

name: NavierStokes.UniformCone.compact_normalized_cone
statement:
theorem compact_normalized_cone {K : Set X} (hK : IsCompact K)
    {c j v : X → ℝ} (hc : ContinuousOn c K) (hj : ContinuousOn j K)
    (hv : ContinuousOn v K) (hcpos : ∀ x ∈ K, 0 < c x)
    (hmargin : ∀ x ∈ K, (v x - 2) * j x ^ 2 < 2 * c x ^ 2) :
    ∃ ε p₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ 0 ≤ p₀ ∧
      (∀ x ∈ K, ε ≤ c x ∧ ε ≤ 2 * c x ^ 2 - (v x - 2) * j x ^ 2) ∧
      ∀ p : ℝ, p₀ < p → ∀ x ∈ K,
        2 < p * c x ∧ v x < coneBound (p * c x) (p * j x)

name: NavierStokes.UniformCone.compact_normalized_cone_gap
statement:
theorem compact_normalized_cone_gap {K : Set X} (hK : IsCompact K)
    {c j v : X → ℝ} (hc : ContinuousOn c K) (hj : ContinuousOn j K)
    (hv : ContinuousOn v K) (hcpos : ∀ x ∈ K, 0 < c x)
    (hmargin : ∀ x ∈ K, (v x - 2) * j x ^ 2 < 2 * c x ^ 2) :
    ∃ η p₀ : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ 0 ≤ p₀ ∧ ∀ p : ℝ, p₀ < p → ∀ x ∈ K,
      2 + η < p * c x ∧ v x + η < coneBound (p * c x) (p * j x)

name: NavierStokes.UniformCone.compact_source_margins
statement:
theorem compact_source_margins {K : Set X} (hK : IsCompact K)
    {a b w : X → ℝ} (ha : ContinuousOn a K) (hb : ContinuousOn b K)
    (hw : ContinuousOn w K) (hapos : ∀ x ∈ K, 0 < a x)
    (hfirst : ∀ x ∈ K, 0 < a x - b x * w x)
    (hsecond : ∀ x ∈ K,
      2 * b x * w x + b x ^ 2 / a x + (a x - 2) * w x ^ 2 < 2) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ x ∈ K,
      ε ≤ a x ∧ ε ≤ a x - b x * w x ∧
        ε ≤ 2 - (2 * b x * w x + b x ^ 2 / a x + (a x - 2) * w x ^ 2)

name: NavierStokes.UniformCone.compact_trueCone_margins
statement:
theorem compact_trueCone_margins {K : Set X} (hK : IsCompact K)
    {P J v : X → ℝ} (hP : ContinuousOn P K) (hJ : ContinuousOn J K)
    (hv : ContinuousOn v K)
    (hcone : ∀ x ∈ K, 2 < v x ∧ 2 < P x ∧ v x < coneBound (P x) (J x)) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ x ∈ K,
      ε ≤ v x - 2 ∧ ε ≤ P x - 2 ∧ ε ≤ coneBound (P x) (J x) - v x

name: NavierStokes.UniformCone.compact_trueCone_stable
statement:
theorem compact_trueCone_stable {S : Set ConeDatum} (hS : IsCompact S)
    (hcone : S ⊆ trueCone) :
    ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∀ z ∈ S, ∀ z' : ConeDatum,
      dist z' z ≤ ρ → z' ∈ trueCone

name: NavierStokes.UniformCone.continuous_coneBound
statement: theorem continuous_coneBound : Continuous (fun z : ConeDatum => coneBound z.1 z.2.1)

name: NavierStokes.UniformCone.isOpen_trueCone
statement: theorem isOpen_trueCone : IsOpen trueCone

name: NavierStokes.UniformCone.positive_uniform_margin
statement:
theorem positive_uniform_margin {K : Set X} (hK : IsCompact K)
    {g : X → ℝ} (hg : ContinuousOn g K) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ K, 0 < g x) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ x ∈ K, ε ≤ g x

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.activation_pos
statement:
theorem activation_pos {T κ y : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (hκ : κ < 1) (hy : 0 < y) :
    0 < activation T κ y

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.activation_uniform_collar
statement:
theorem activation_uniform_collar {m : ℝ} (hm : 0 < m) :
    ∃ θ : ℝ, 0 < θ ∧ θ ≤ 1 ∧ ∀ T : ℝ, 0 < T → ∀ κ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) (θ * T), activation T κ y < m

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.actual_comparisons
statement:
theorem actual_comparisons (h : ℝ) {X0 : ℝ} (hX0 : 0 < X0)
    (initial : HistoryRow → ℝ → ℝ) {J K : Set ℝ} (hJ : IsOpen J)
    (hK : IsCompact K) (hKJ : K ⊆ J) {L U : Field}
    (hL : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ L (logDomain J hJ).carrier)
    (hU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ U (logDomain J hJ).carrier)
    (hi : ∀ r, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (initial r) J)
    (hcoef : ∀ η ∈ J, NaturalAxisData.L h η ≠ 0)
    {T0 Mref : ℝ} (hT0 : T0 ≤ 1) (hMref : 0 ≤ Mref)
    (href : ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T0, ∀ η ∈ K,
      referenceP1 L (y, η) ≠ 0 ∧
      |referenceP2 X0 L U (y, η)| ≤ Mref ∧
      |referenceP2 X0 L U (y, η) / referenceP1 L (y, η)| ≤ Mref ∧
      |referenceP2 X0 L U (y, η) ^ 2 / referenceP1 L (y, η)| ≤ Mref)
    (hmatch : ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T0, ∀ η ∈ K,
      ActivationStocks.logViewOne h X0 (referenceAngular L)
          (logHistory X0 initial (referenceAngular L) U) (y, η) = referenceP1 L (y, η) ∧
      ActivationStocks.logViewTwo h X0 (referenceAngular L) U
          (logHistory X0 initial (referenceAngular L) U) (y, η) = referenceP2 X0 L U (y, η)) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ T ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) T0, ∀ κ ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ η ∈ K,
        |activatedProjection h X0 initial L U T κ (y, η) - referenceSize X0 L U (y, η)| ≤
          C * y * activation T κ y ∧
        |shearSize T κ X0 L U (y, η) - damping T κ y * referenceSize X0 L U (y, η)| ≤
          C * y * activation T κ y ∧
        |activatedCross h X0 initial L U T κ (y, η)| ≤ C * y * activation T κ y

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.collar_lower_of_errors
statement:
theorem collar_lower_of_errors {c B r e s v : ℝ}
    (hc : 0 < c) (hr : 2 + c ≤ r) (hrB : r ≤ B)
    (he : 0 ≤ e) (hs : s ≤ 1) (heB : e * (B + 1) ≤ c / 4)
    (hv : |v - (1 - e) * r| ≤ s * e) :
    2 + c / 2 < v

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.compact_reference_bounds
statement:
theorem compact_reference_bounds {K : Set ℝ} (hK : IsCompact K)
    {T c : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (hc : 0 < c) {A B : Field}
    (hA : ContinuousOn A (Icc (0 : ℝ) T ×ˢ K))
    (hB : ContinuousOn B (Icc (0 : ℝ) T ×ˢ K))
    (hApos : ∀ p ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T ×ˢ K, 0 < A p)
    (hzero : ∀ η ∈ K, 2 + 2 * c ≤ A (0, η) + B (0, η) ^ 2 / A (0, η)) :
    ∃ τ α M : ℝ, 0 < τ ∧ τ ≤ T ∧ 0 < α ∧ 1 ≤ M ∧
      ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) τ, ∀ η ∈ K,
        α ≤ A (y, η) ∧ 2 + c < A (y, η) + B (y, η) ^ 2 / A (y, η) ∧
        A (y, η) + B (y, η) ^ 2 / A (y, η) ≤ M ∧
        |B (y, η)| ≤ M ∧ |B (y, η) / A (y, η)| ≤ M ∧
        |B (y, η) ^ 2 / A (y, η)| ≤ M

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.compact_reference_collar
statement:
theorem compact_reference_collar {K : Set ℝ} (hK : IsCompact K)
    {T c : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (hc : 0 < c) {r : Field}
    (hr : ContinuousOn r (Icc (0 : ℝ) T ×ˢ K))
    (hzero : ∀ η ∈ K, 2 + 2 * c ≤ r (0, η)) :
    ∃ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ ∧ τ ≤ T ∧ ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) τ, ∀ η ∈ K,
      2 + c < r (y, η)

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.cone_comparison_from_stock_bounds
statement:
theorem cone_comparison_from_stock_bounds {κ A B z p q R M : ℝ}
    (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hA : A ≠ 0) (hκ : |κ| ≤ 1) (hz : 0 ≤ z) (hz1 : z ≤ 1)
    (hB : |B| ≤ M) (hBA : |B / A| ≤ M) (hB2A : |B ^ 2 / A| ≤ M)
    (hp : |p - A| ≤ M * z) (hq : |q - B| ≤ M * z) (hR : |R - 1| ≤ M * z) :
    |stockProjection p q ((B / A) * R) - (A + B ^ 2 / A)| ≤ comparisonConstant M * z ∧
    |κ * (A + (B ^ 2 / A) * R ^ 2) - κ * (A + B ^ 2 / A)| ≤ comparisonConstant M * z ∧
    |stockCross p q ((B / A) * R)| ≤ comparisonConstant M * z

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.cone_error_bounds
statement:
theorem cone_error_bounds {κ A B z dA dB dR M : ℝ}
    (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hκ : |κ| ≤ 1) (hz : |z| ≤ 1)
    (hB : |B| ≤ M) (hBA : |B / A| ≤ M) (hB2A : |B ^ 2 / A| ≤ M)
    (hdA : |dA| ≤ M) (hdB : |dB| ≤ M) (hdR : |dR| ≤ M) :
    |projectionError A B z dA dB dR| ≤ comparisonConstant M ∧
    |crossError A B z dA dB dR| ≤ comparisonConstant M ∧
    |sizeError κ A B z dR| ≤ comparisonConstant M

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.cone_error_factorizations
statement:
theorem cone_error_factorizations (κ A B z dA dB dR : ℝ) (hA : A ≠ 0) :
    stockProjection (A + z * dA) (B + z * dB) ((B / A) * (1 + z * dR)) -
        (A + B ^ 2 / A) = z * projectionError A B z dA dB dR ∧
    stockCross (A + z * dA) (B + z * dB) ((B / A) * (1 + z * dR)) =
        z * crossError A B z dA dB dR ∧
    κ * (A + (B ^ 2 / A) * (1 + z * dR) ^ 2) - κ * (A + B ^ 2 / A) =
        z * sizeError κ A B z dR

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.cone_gap_factorization
statement:
theorem cone_gap_factorization (r e y dP dv dJ : ℝ) :
    2 * ((r + y * e * dP) - ((1 - e) * r + y * e * dv)) ^ 2 -
        (((1 - e) * r + y * e * dv) - 2) * (y * e * dJ) ^ 2 =
      e ^ 2 * normalizedConeGap r ((1 - e) * r + y * e * dv) y dP dv dJ

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.errorTolerance_bounds
statement:
theorem errorTolerance_bounds {c B s : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hs : s ≤ errorTolerance c B) :
    s ≤ 1 / 4 ∧ s ≤ c / 2 ∧ (B + 1) * s ≤ 1 / 4

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.errorTolerance_pos
statement:
theorem errorTolerance_pos {c B : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hB : 0 ≤ B) :
    0 < errorTolerance c B

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.exists_actual_stress_direction
statement:
theorem exists_actual_stress_direction (h : ℝ) {X0 : ℝ} (hX0 : 0 < X0)
    (initial : HistoryRow → ℝ → ℝ) {J K : Set ℝ} (hJ : IsOpen J) (hKJ : K ⊆ J)
    {L U : Field} (hL : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ L (logDomain J hJ).carrier)
    (hU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ U (logDomain J hJ).carrier)
    (hi : ∀ r, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (initial r) J)
    (hcoef : ∀ η ∈ J, NaturalAxisData.L h η ≠ 0) {T0 : ℝ}
    (hmatch : ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T0, ∀ η ∈ K,
      ActivationStocks.logViewOne h X0 (referenceAngular L)
          (logHistory X0 initial (referenceAngular L) U) (y, η) = referenceP1 L (y, η) ∧
      ActivationStocks.logViewTwo h X0 (referenceAngular L) U
          (logHistory X0 initial (referenceAngular L) U) (y, η) = referenceP2 X0 L U (y, η)) :
    ∃ D : ActivationBounds.ScaledPoint → ℝ × ℝ,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ D (ActivationBounds.scaledDomain J) ∧
      (∀ κ T η : ℝ, D ((κ, T), (0, η)) =
        (referenceAngular L (0, η) * referenceP1 L (0, η),
          referenceAngular L (0, η) * referenceP2 X0 L U (0, η))) ∧
      ∀ T : ℝ, 0 < T → ∀ κ u η : ℝ, T * u ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T0 → η ∈ K →
        activatedStress h X0 initial L U T κ (T * u, η) =
          (activation 1 κ u * (D ((κ, T), (u, η))).1,
            activation 1 κ u * (D ((κ, T), (u, η))).2)

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.inverseRelativeError_smooth
NavierStokes.ActivationCone.inverse_relative_scaled_factor
statement:
theorem inverse_relative_scaled_factor {T : ℝ} (hT : T ≠ 0) (κ : ℝ)
    {J : Set ℝ} (hJ : IsOpen J) {L : Field}
    (hL : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ L (logDomain J hJ).carrier) (u : ℝ) {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ J) :
    referenceAngular L (T * u, η) / activatedAngular T κ L (T * u, η) - 1 =
      ActivationBounds.scaledDistance ((κ, T), (u, η)) * inverseRelativeError L ((κ, T), (u, η))

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.inverse_relative_uniform_jets
statement:
theorem inverse_relative_uniform_jets {J K : Set ℝ} (hJ : IsOpen J) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hKJ : K ⊆ J) {L : Field} (hL : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ L (logDomain J hJ).carrier)
    (T0 : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ T ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) T0, ∀ κ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ η ∈ K,
        |iteratedDeriv n (fun ξ =>
          referenceAngular L (y, ξ) / activatedAngular T κ L (y, ξ) - 1) η| ≤
            M * y * activation T κ y

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.natural_activation_direction
statement:
theorem natural_activation_direction {h j σ Λ C : ℝ} {P0 : ℝ → ℝ}
    {d : NaturalAxisCoefficients.AnalyticInputs h j σ P0}
    (hΛ : 0 < Λ) (F : NaturalEntrance.EntranceProfile d Λ C)
    (hP0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ P0) (hsmall : NaturalAxisData.SmallParameters h j)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδlim : 2 * δ < ReferencePath.rampLimit) :
    let N := ReferencePath.Input.ofNatural hΛ F.profile.family
    let L := FromReference.refLog N δ
    let U := FromReference.refAxial N δ
    let I := ActivationStocks.FromReference.initial N hδ hδlim P0 hP0
    ∃ D : ActivationBounds.ScaledPoint → ℝ × ℝ, ∃ ε : ℝ,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ D (ActivationBounds.scaledDomain ReferencePath.parameterInterval) ∧ 0 < ε ∧
      (∀ κ T η : ℝ, η ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 →
        ε ≤ (D ((κ, T), (0, η))).1 ∧
        ε ≤ (D ((κ, T), (0, η))).1 +
          (referenceP2 N.endpoint L U (0, η) / referenceP1 L (0, η)) *
            (D ((κ, T), (0, η))).2 - 2 * referenceAngular L (0, η)) ∧
      ∀ T : ℝ, 0 < T → ∀ κ u η : ℝ, T * u ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) δ → η ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 →
        activatedStress h N.endpoint I L U T κ (T * u, η) =
          (activation 1 κ u * (D ((κ, T), (u, η))).1,
            activation 1 κ u * (D ((κ, T), (u, η))).2)

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.natural_initial_activation
statement:
theorem natural_initial_activation {h j σ Λ C : ℝ} {P0 : ℝ → ℝ}
    {d : NaturalAxisCoefficients.AnalyticInputs h j σ P0}
    (hΛ : 0 < Λ) (F : NaturalEntrance.EntranceProfile d Λ C)
    (hP0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ P0) (hsmall : NaturalAxisData.SmallParameters h j)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδlim : 2 * δ < ReferencePath.rampLimit) :
    let N := ReferencePath.Input.ofNatural hΛ F.profile.family
    let L := FromReference.refLog N δ
    let U := FromReference.refAxial N δ
    let I := ActivationStocks.FromReference.initial N hδ hδlim P0 hP0
    ∃ Tstar θ : ℝ, 0 < Tstar ∧ Tstar ≤ δ ∧ 0 < θ ∧ θ ≤ 1 ∧
      ∀ T ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) Tstar, ∀ κ ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
        ∀ y ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ η ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
          activation T κ y ≤ activatedProjection h N.endpoint I L U T κ (y, η) -
            shearSize T κ N.endpoint L U (y, η) ∧
          2 + 1 / 32 < activatedProjection h N.endpoint I L U T κ (y, η) ∧
          (shearSize T κ N.endpoint L U (y, η) - 2) *
              activatedCross h N.endpoint I L U T κ (y, η) ^ 2 <
            2 * (activatedProjection h N.endpoint I L U T κ (y, η) -
              shearSize T κ N.endpoint L U (y, η)) ^ 2 ∧
          shearSize T κ N.endpoint L U (y, η) <
            coneBound (activatedProjection h N.endpoint I L U T κ (y, η))
              (activatedCross h N.endpoint I L U T κ (y, η)) ∧
          (y ≤ θ * T → 2 + 1 / 16 < shearSize T κ N.endpoint L U (y, η))

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.natural_reference_bounds
NavierStokes.ActivationCone.natural_reference_log_match
statement:
theorem natural_reference_log_match {h j σ Λ C : ℝ} {P0 : ℝ → ℝ}
    {d : NaturalAxisCoefficients.AnalyticInputs h j σ P0}
    (hΛ : 0 < Λ) (F : NaturalProfile.ProfileFamily d Λ C) (hP0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ P0)
    (hsmall : NaturalAxisData.SmallParameters h j)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδlim : 2 * δ < ReferencePath.rampLimit)
    {y η : ℝ} (hy : y ≤ δ) (hη : η ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    let N := ReferencePath.Input.ofNatural hΛ F
    let L := FromReference.refLog N δ
    let U := FromReference.refAxial N δ
    let I := ActivationStocks.FromReference.initial N hδ hδlim P0 hP0
    ActivationStocks.logViewOne h N.endpoint (referenceAngular L)
        (logHistory N.endpoint I (referenceAngular L) U) (y, η) = referenceP1 L (y, η) ∧
      ActivationStocks.logViewTwo h N.endpoint (referenceAngular L) U
        (logHistory N.endpoint I (referenceAngular L) U) (y, η) = referenceP2 N.endpoint L U (y, η)

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.normalizedConeGap_at_edge
statement:
@[simp] theorem normalizedConeGap_at_edge (r v dP dv dJ : ℝ) :
    normalizedConeGap r v 0 dP dv dJ = 2 * r ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.normalizedConeGap_edge_positive
statement:
theorem normalizedConeGap_edge_positive {r : ℝ} (hr : r ≠ 0) (v dP dv dJ : ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.ramp_cone_of_errors
statement:
theorem ramp_cone_of_errors {c B r e s P J v : ℝ}
    (hc : 0 < c) (hr : 2 + c ≤ r) (hrB : r ≤ B)
    (he : 0 < e) (he1 : e ≤ 1) (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (hsquarter : s ≤ 1 / 4) (hsc : s ≤ c / 2)
    (hsB : (B + 1) * s ≤ 1 / 4)
    (hP : |P - r| ≤ s * e) (hv : |v - (1 - e) * r| ≤ s * e)
    (hJ : |J| ≤ s * e) :
    e ≤ P - v ∧ 2 + c / 4 < P ∧ (v - 2) * J ^ 2 < 2 * (P - v) ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.reducedStress_at_edge
statement:
@[simp] theorem reducedStress_at_edge (F A B κ dA dB dR : ℝ) :
    reducedStress F A B κ 0 dA dB dR = (F * A, F * B)

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.reducedStress_edge_margin
statement:
theorem reducedStress_edge_margin {F A B c κ dA dB dR : ℝ}
    (hF : 0 < F) (hc : 0 < c) (hr : 2 + c ≤ A + B ^ 2 / A) :
    2 * F < (reducedStress F A B κ 0 dA dB dR).1 +
      (B / A) * (reducedStress F A B κ 0 dA dB dR).2

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.reducedStress_edge_projection
statement:
theorem reducedStress_edge_projection (F A B κ dA dB dR : ℝ) :
    (reducedStress F A B κ 0 dA dB dR).1 +
      (B / A) * (reducedStress F A B κ 0 dA dB dR).2 =
      F * (A + B ^ 2 / A)

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.reducedStress_first_positive
statement:
theorem reducedStress_first_positive {F A B κ y dA dB dR α M : ℝ}
    (hF : 0 < F) (hα : 0 < α) (hA : α ≤ A) (hy : 0 ≤ y)
    (hdA : |dA| ≤ M) (hsmall : y * M ≤ α / 2) :
    0 < (reducedStress F A B κ y dA dB dR).1

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.reducedStress_nonzero
statement:
theorem reducedStress_nonzero {F A B κ y dA dB dR α M : ℝ}
    (hF : 0 < F) (hα : 0 < α) (hA : α ≤ A) (hy : 0 ≤ y)
    (hdA : |dA| ≤ M) (hsmall : y * M ≤ α / 2) :
    reducedStress F A B κ y dA dB dR ≠ 0

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.reducedStress_smooth
statement:
theorem reducedStress_smooth {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {S : Set E} {F A B κ y dA dB dR : E → ℝ}
    (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F S) (hA : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ A S)
    (hB : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ B S) (hκ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ κ S)
    (hy : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ y S) (hdA : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ dA S)
    (hdB : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ dB S) (hdR : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ dR S) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p => reducedStress (F p) (A p) (B p) (κ p) (y p) (dA p) (dB p) (dR p)) S

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.reference_coordinates_smooth
statement:
theorem reference_coordinates_smooth {X0 : ℝ} (hX0 : 0 < X0)
    {J : Set ℝ} (hJ : IsOpen J) {L U : Field}
    (hL : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ L (logDomain J hJ).carrier)
    (hU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ U (logDomain J hJ).carrier) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (referenceP1 L) (logDomain J hJ).carrier ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (referenceP2 X0 L U) (logDomain J hJ).carrier

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.shearSize_eq
statement:
theorem shearSize_eq (T : ℝ) {κ X0 : ℝ} (hκ : κ ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hX0 : 0 < X0)
    {J : Set ℝ} (hJ : IsOpen J) {L U : Field}
    (hL : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ L (logDomain J hJ).carrier)
    (hU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ U (logDomain J hJ).carrier) (y : ℝ) {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ J)
    (hA : referenceP1 L (y, η) ≠ 0) :
    shearSize T κ X0 L U (y, η) = damping T κ y *
      (referenceP1 L (y, η) + (referenceP2 X0 L U (y, η) ^ 2 / referenceP1 L (y, η)) *
        (referenceAngular L (y, η) / activatedAngular T κ L (y, η)) ^ 2)

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.stress_factorization
statement:
theorem stress_factorization (F A B κ y e dA dB dR : ℝ) (hκ : κ = 1 - e) :
    (F * ((A + y * e * dA) - κ * A),
      F * ((B + y * e * dB) - κ * B * (1 + y * e * dR))) =
    (e * (F * (A + y * dA)),
      e * (F * (B + y * (dB - κ * B * dR))))

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.true_collar_of_errors
statement:
theorem true_collar_of_errors {c B r e s P J v : ℝ}
    (hc : 0 < c) (hr : 2 + c ≤ r) (hrB : r ≤ B)
    (he : 0 < e) (he1 : e ≤ 1) (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (hsquarter : s ≤ 1 / 4) (hsc : s ≤ c / 2)
    (hsB : (B + 1) * s ≤ 1 / 4) (heB : e * (B + 1) ≤ c / 4)
    (hP : |P - r| ≤ s * e) (hv : |v - (1 - e) * r| ≤ s * e)
    (hJ : |J| ≤ s * e) :
    e ≤ P - v ∧ 2 + c / 2 < v ∧ 2 < P ∧ v < coneBound P J

name: NavierStokes.ActivationCone.uniform_ramp_from_comparison
statement:
theorem uniform_ramp_from_comparison {K : Set ℝ} {r : Field}
    {P J v : ℝ → ℝ → Field} {c B C T0 : ℝ}
    (hc : 0 < c) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hT0 : 0 < T0)
    (href : ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T0, ∀ η ∈ K, 2 + c ≤ r (y, η) ∧ r (y, η) ≤ B)
    (herr : ∀ T ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) T0, ∀ κ ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ η ∈ K,
        |P T κ (y, η) - r (y, η)| ≤ C * y * activation T κ y ∧
        |v T κ (y, η) - damping T κ y * r (y, η)| ≤ C * y * activation T κ y ∧
        |J T κ (y, η)| ≤ C * y * activation T κ y) :
    ∃ Tstar θ : ℝ, 0 < Tstar ∧ Tstar ≤ T0 ∧ 0 < θ ∧ θ ≤ 1 ∧
      ∀ T ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) Tstar, ∀ κ ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
        ∀ y ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ η ∈ K,
          activation T κ y ≤ P T κ (y, η) - v T κ (y, η) ∧
          2 + c / 4 < P T κ (y, η) ∧
          (v T κ (y, η) - 2) * J T κ (y, η) ^ 2 <
            2 * (P T κ (y, η) - v T κ (y, η)) ^ 2 ∧
          v T κ (y, η) < coneBound (P T κ (y, η)) (J T κ (y, η)) ∧
          (y ≤ θ * T → 2 + c / 2 < v T κ (y, η))

    (hf : ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) p.1, |P.f (s, p.2)| ≤ K / C)
    (hfη : ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) p.1, |parameterPartial P.f (s, p.2)| ≤ K / C) :
    ‖pressureJets P Λ p‖ < ε

name: NavierStokes.ReferenceBounds.pressure_dot_bound
statement:
theorem pressure_dot_bound {p : Point} (hp : p ∈ D.carrier) (hX : 0 ≤ p.1)
    {K C : ℝ} (hf : |P.f p| ≤ K / C) :
    |p.1 * radialPartial P.pressure p| ≤ p.1 * K ^ 2 / C ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.ReferenceBounds.pressure_increment_bound
statement:
theorem pressure_increment_bound {p : Point} (_ : p ∈ D.carrier) (hX : 0 ≤ p.1)
    {K C : ℝ} (_ : 0 ≤ K) (_ : 0 < C)
    (hf : ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) p.1, |P.f (s, p.2)| ≤ K / C) :
    |P.pressure p - P.pressure0 p.2| ≤ p.1 * K ^ 2 / C ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.ReferenceBounds.pressure_parameter_increment
statement:
theorem pressure_parameter_increment {p : Point} (hp : p ∈ D.carrier) :
    parameterPartial P.pressure p - deriv P.pressure0 p.2 =
      ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..p.1, 2 * P.f (s, p.2) * parameterPartial P.f (s, p.2)

name: NavierStokes.ReferenceBounds.pressure_parameter_increment_bound
statement:
theorem pressure_parameter_increment_bound {p : Point} (hp : p ∈ D.carrier) (hX : 0 ≤ p.1)
    {K C : ℝ} (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hC : 0 < C)
    (hf : ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) p.1, |P.f (s, p.2)| ≤ K / C)
    (hfη : ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) p.1, |parameterPartial P.f (s, p.2)| ≤ K / C) :
    |parameterPartial P.pressure p - deriv P.pressure0 p.2| ≤ 2 * p.1 * K ^ 2 / C ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.ReferenceBounds.qJets_bound
statement:
theorem qJets_bound (h j σ : ℝ) {Λ B φ : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B) {p : Point}

    (hu : |Λ * (P.U p - NaturalAxisData.U j p.2)| ≤ B)
    (hv : |Λ * (P.Ubar p - NaturalAxisData.U j p.2)| ≤ B)
    (hvη : |Λ * (average (parameterPartial P.U) p - 4)| ≤ B)
    (hfη : |parameterPartial P.f p / P.f p - Λ * realGradient h j σ p.2| ≤ B) :
    qJets P j σ h Λ φ p ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : Fin 5 → ℝ) B

name: NavierStokes.ReferenceBounds.qModel_continuous
NavierStokes.ReferenceBounds.qRemainder_continuous
statement:

name: NavierStokes.ReferenceBounds.reference_p1_natural
statement:
theorem reference_p1_natural {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδT : 2 * δ < rampLimit)

statement:

name: NavierStokes.ReferenceBounds.sourceN_model
statement:
theorem sourceN_model (h j : ℝ) {Λ B : ℝ} (hΛ : Λ ≠ 0)
    (p : Point) (hη : p.2 ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (hv : nJets P j Λ p ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : Fin 5 → ℝ) B) :
    P.axialSource h p = nModel h j P.pressure0 B
      (⟨p.2, hη⟩, ⟨nJets P j Λ p, hv⟩) (pressureJets P Λ p)

name: NavierStokes.ReferenceBounds.sourceQ_model
statement:
theorem sourceQ_model (h j σ : ℝ) {Λ φ Y θ r : ℝ} (hΛ : Λ ≠ 0)
    (hφ : (1 / 8 : ℝ) ≤ φ) (p : Point)
    (hrad : p.1 * radialPartial P.f p / P.f p = θ * Y * r / φ) :
    sourceQ P h p = NaturalAxisData.L h p.2 * Λ * NaturalAxisData.chi h j σ p.2 +
      qRemainder h j σ (Y, p.2) θ (qJets P j σ h Λ φ p) (1 / Λ) r

name: NavierStokes.TransitionRamp.StockReference.endpointLog_jets_of_control
statement:
theorem endpointLog_jets_of_control (hJ : IsOpen J) {K : Set ℝ} (hKJ : K ⊆ J)

    (hc : R.SmallLogControl K N 1 T κ w₁ w₂)
    (hi : ∀ n ≤ N, ∀ η ∈ K, |iteratedDeriv n (R.normalizedInitial C) η| ≤ B) :
    ∀ n ≤ N, ∀ η ∈ K, |iteratedDeriv n (R.endpointLog T κ w₁ w₂ C) η| ≤

name: NavierStokes.TransitionRamp.StockReference.exists_small_log_control
statement:
theorem exists_small_log_control (hJ : IsOpen J) {K : Set ℝ} (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hKJ : K ⊆ J) (N : ℕ) (hb : 0 ≤ R.bigTime) {Tmax ε : ℝ}
    (hTmax : 0 < Tmax) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ T0 > 0, ∃ κ0 > 0, ∃ w0 > 0, T0 ≤ Tmax ∧ κ0 < 1 ∧
      2 * w0 < R.finalTime - R.bigTime ∧
      ∀ T ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T0, ∀ κ ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) κ0,
      ∀ w₁ ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) w0, ∀ w₂ ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) w0,
        R.SmallLogControl K N ε T κ w₁ w₂

name: NavierStokes.TransitionRamp.StockReference.physicalF_held
statement:
theorem physicalF_held (hJ : IsOpen J) {T κ w₁ w₂ C X η : ℝ}
    (hw₂ : 0 < w₂) (hstart : R.bigTime + w₁ + w₂ ≤ R.finalTime)
    (hR : R.radius0 < 110) (hC : 0 < C) (hX : 110 ≤ X) (hη : η ∈ J) :
    R.physicalF T κ w₁ w₂ (X, η) =
      C⁻¹ * Real.exp (Real.log (X / 110) / 10 + R.endpointLog T κ w₁ w₂ C η) / Real.sqrt (2 * X)

statement:
theorem physicalF_held_log (hJ : IsOpen J) {T κ w₁ w₂ X η : ℝ}

    (hR : R.radius0 < 110) (hX : 110 ≤ X) (hη : η ∈ J) :
    R.physicalF T κ w₁ w₂ (X, η) =
      Real.exp (R.logAmplitude T κ w₁ w₂ (R.finalTime, η) - (2 / 5 : ℝ) * Real.log (X / 110))

name: NavierStokes.TransitionRamp.StockReference.physicalF_postaxis_jet_bound
statement:
theorem physicalF_postaxis_jet_bound (hJ : IsOpen J) {K : Set ℝ} (hKJ : K ⊆ J)
    {N : ℕ} {T κ w₁ w₂ C B X η : ℝ} (hb : 0 ≤ R.bigTime) (hw₁ : 0 < w₁) (hw₂ : 0 < w₂)
    (hC : 0 < C) (hB : 1 ≤ B) (hX : R.radius0 < X) (hη : η ∈ K)
    (hc : R.SmallLogControl K N 1 T κ w₁ w₂)
    (hi : ∀ n ≤ N, ∀ η ∈ K, |iteratedDeriv n (R.normalizedInitial C) η| ≤ B)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≤ N) :
    |iteratedDeriv n (fun ξ => R.physicalF T κ w₁ w₂ (X, ξ)) η| ≤
      (n.factorial * Real.exp (B + 1) * (B + 1) ^ n) / C

name: NavierStokes.TransitionRamp.StockReference.prescribed_angular_control
statement:
theorem prescribed_angular_control (hJ : IsOpen J) (T κ w₁ w₂ y : ℝ)
    {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ J) :
    -2 * deriv (fun x => R.logAmplitude T κ w₁ w₂ (x, η)) y =
      (1 - step (R.bigTime + w₁) w₂ y) * damping T κ y * R.angularStock (y, η) +

name: NavierStokes.TransitionRamp.axialField_jet_error_bound
statement:
theorem axialField_jet_error_bound {J : Set ℝ} (hJ : IsOpen J) {stock : Field}
    (hs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ stock (logDomain J hJ).carrier) (initial : ℝ → ℝ)
    {T κ b w y η M : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (hκ : κ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hη : η ∈ J) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (n : ℕ)
    (hb : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) y, |parameterJet n stock (t, η)| ≤ M) :
    |iteratedDeriv n (fun ξ => axialField T κ b w initial stock (y, ξ) - initial ξ) η| ≤
      M * (T + κ * y)

statement:
theorem base_integrals_eq_activation (T κ y : ℝ) (hy : y ≤ δ)

name: NavierStokes.TransitionRamp.controlled_product_bound

name: NavierStokes.TransitionRamp.damped_integral_bound

theorem damped_integral_bound {F : ℝ → ℝ} (hF : Continuous F) {T κ y M : ℝ}

name: NavierStokes.TransitionRamp.damping_eq_constant

name: NavierStokes.TransitionRamp.endpointU_error_jet_bound
statement:
theorem endpointU_error_jet_bound (hΛ : 0 < Λ) (hsmall : NaturalAxisData.SmallParameters h j)
    (hP0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ P0) {C : ℝ} (E : NaturalEntrance.CoefficientProfile d Λ C)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδT : 2 * δ < rampLimit)
    {N : ℕ} {ε T κ w₁ w₂ : ℝ}
    (hb : 0 ≤ (ofNatural E.family hΛ hsmall hδ hδT hP0).bigTime)
    (hc : (ofNatural E.family hΛ hsmall hδ hδT hP0).SmallLogControl (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) N ε T κ w₁ w₂)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≤ N) {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    |iteratedDeriv n (fun ξ => (ofNatural E.family hΛ hsmall hδ hδT hP0).endpointU T κ w₁ ξ -
      NaturalAxisData.U j ξ) η| ≤ ReferenceJetBounds.jetConstant d.coefficients 0 n / Λ + ε

name: NavierStokes.TransitionRamp.endpointU_four_eta_jet_bound
statement:
theorem endpointU_four_eta_jet_bound (hΛ : 0 < Λ) (hsmall : NaturalAxisData.SmallParameters h j)

    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδT : 2 * δ < rampLimit)
    {N : ℕ} {ε T κ w₁ w₂ : ℝ}
    (hb : 0 ≤ (ofNatural E.family hΛ hsmall hδ hδT hP0).bigTime)
    (hc : (ofNatural E.family hΛ hsmall hδ hδT hP0).SmallLogControl (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) N ε T κ w₁ w₂)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≤ N) {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    |iteratedDeriv n (fun ξ => (ofNatural E.family hΛ hsmall hδ hδT hP0).endpointU T κ w₁ ξ - 4 * ξ) η| ≤
      ReferenceJetBounds.jetConstant d.coefficients 0 n / Λ + ε + |j|

name: NavierStokes.TransitionRamp.exists_joint_small_control
statement:
theorem exists_joint_small_control {K : Set ℝ} (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hKJ : K ⊆ parameterInterval) (N : ℕ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hb : δ ≤ (ofNatural F hΛ hsmall hδ hδT hP0).bigTime) :
    let R := ofNatural F hΛ hsmall hδ hδT hP0
    ∃ T0 > 0, ∃ κ0 > 0, ∃ w0 > 0, T0 ≤ δ ∧ κ0 < 1 ∧
      2 * w0 < R.finalTime - R.bigTime ∧
      ∀ T ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T0, ∀ κ ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) κ0,
      ∀ w₁ ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) w0, ∀ w₂ ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) w0,
        R.SmallLogControl K N ε T κ w₁ w₂ ∧ R.SmallPhysicalControl K N ε T κ w₁ w₂

name: NavierStokes.TransitionRamp.exists_naturalU_jets
statement:
theorem exists_naturalU_jets (hΛ : 0 < Λ) (N : ℕ) :
    ∃ B, 1 ≤ B ∧ ∀ C, ∀ E : NaturalEntrance.CoefficientProfile d Λ C,
      ∀ X, Λ * X ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) (41 / 10) → ∀ n ≤ N, ∀ η ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
        |iteratedDeriv n (fun ξ => E.family.U (X, ξ)) η| ≤ B

name: NavierStokes.TransitionRamp.exists_phase_bound
statement:

name: NavierStokes.TransitionRamp.exists_small_physical_control
statement:

    (hb : δ ≤ (ofNatural F hΛ hsmall hδ hδT hP0).bigTime) :
    let R := ofNatural F hΛ hsmall hδ hδT hP0
    ∃ T0 > 0, ∃ κ0 > 0, ∃ w0 > 0, T0 ≤ δ ∧ κ0 < 1 ∧
      2 * w0 < R.finalTime - R.bigTime ∧
      ∀ T ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T0, ∀ κ ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) κ0,
      ∀ w₁ ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) w0, ∀ w₂ ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) w0,
        R.SmallPhysicalControl K N ε T κ w₁ w₂

name: NavierStokes.TransitionRamp.initialU_error_jet
statement:
theorem initialU_error_jet (E : NaturalEntrance.CoefficientProfile d Λ C) (n : ℕ)

name: NavierStokes.TransitionRamp.initialU_natural
statement:
theorem initialU_natural (η : ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.TransitionRamp.initial_layer_bound
statement:
theorem initial_layer_bound {F : ℝ → ℝ} (hF : Continuous F) {T y M : ℝ}

name: NavierStokes.TransitionRamp.integrate_affine_after
NavierStokes.TransitionRamp.integrate_congr

theorem integrate_congr (initial : ℝ → ℝ) (slope₁ slope₂ : Field) (p : Point)

name: NavierStokes.TransitionRamp.integrate_error_jet
statement:
theorem integrate_error_jet {J : Set ℝ} (hJ : IsOpen J) (initial : ℝ → ℝ) {slope : Field}

statement:
theorem jet_transfer {A B : ℝ → ℝ} {η M ε : ℝ} (n : ℕ)

    (he : |iteratedDeriv n (fun ξ => A ξ - B ξ) η| ≤ ε)

name: NavierStokes.TransitionRamp.late_layer_bound
statement:
theorem late_layer_bound {F : ℝ → ℝ} (hF : Continuous F) {a y w M : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hyw : y ≤ a + w) (hw : 0 ≤ w) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hb : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) y, |F t| ≤ M)
    (hz : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) a, F t = 0) :
    |∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..y, F t| ≤ M * w

name: NavierStokes.TransitionRamp.local_composition_jet_bound
statement:
theorem local_composition_jet_bound {S U : Set ℝ} (hS : IsOpen S) (hU : IsOpen U)
    {f g : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f S) (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U)
    (hmap : MapsTo f S U) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ S) (n : ℕ) {B D : ℝ}
    (hB : ∀ i ≤ n, |iteratedDeriv i g (f x)| ≤ B)
    (hD : ∀ i, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ n → |iteratedDeriv i f x| ≤ D ^ i) :
    |iteratedDeriv n (g ∘ f) x| ≤ n.factorial * B * D ^ n

name: NavierStokes.TransitionRamp.logField_before
statement:
theorem logField_before {T κ b w₁ w₂ : ℝ} (hb : 0 ≤ b + w₁) (hw₂ : 0 < w₂)
    (initial : ℝ → ℝ) (stock : Field) {p : Point} (hp : p.1 ≤ b + w₁) :
    logField T κ b w₁ w₂ initial stock p = integrate initial (baseSlope T κ stock) p

name: NavierStokes.TransitionRamp.logField_hold
statement:
theorem logField_hold {T κ b w₁ w₂ : ℝ} (hw₂ : 0 < w₂) {J : Set ℝ} (hJ : IsOpen J)
    (initial : ℝ → ℝ) {stock : Field} (hs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ stock (logDomain J hJ).carrier)
    {a y η : ℝ} (ha : b + w₁ + w₂ ≤ a) (hay : a ≤ y) (hη : η ∈ J) :
    logField T κ b w₁ w₂ initial stock (y, η) =
      logField T κ b w₁ w₂ initial stock (a, η) - (2 / 5 : ℝ) * (y - a)

name: NavierStokes.TransitionRamp.logField_positive_jet_error_bound
statement:
theorem logField_positive_jet_error_bound {J : Set ℝ} (hJ : IsOpen J) {stock : Field}
    (hs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ stock (logDomain J hJ).carrier) (initial : ℝ → ℝ)
    {T κ b w₁ w₂ y η M : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (hκ : κ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hη : η ∈ J) (hM : 0 ≤ M) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (hb : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) y, |parameterJet n stock (t, η)| ≤ M) :
    |iteratedDeriv n (fun ξ => logField T κ b w₁ w₂ initial stock (y, ξ) - initial ξ) η| ≤
      M * (T + κ * y)

name: NavierStokes.TransitionRamp.logField_smooth
statement:
theorem logField_smooth (T κ b w₁ w₂ : ℝ) {J : Set ℝ} (hJ : IsOpen J)
    {initial : ℝ → ℝ} {stock : Field} (hi : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ initial J)
    (hs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ stock (logDomain J hJ).carrier) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (logField T κ b w₁ w₂ initial stock) (logDomain J hJ).carrier

name: NavierStokes.TransitionRamp.logField_value_error_bound
statement:
theorem logField_value_error_bound {J : Set ℝ} (hJ : IsOpen J) {stock : Field}
    (hs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ stock (logDomain J hJ).carrier) (initial : ℝ → ℝ)
    {T κ b w₁ w₂ y η M : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (hκ : κ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hb0 : 0 ≤ b) (hw₁ : 0 ≤ w₁) (hw₂ : 0 < w₂)
    (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hyend : y ≤ b + w₁ + w₂) (hη : η ∈ J) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hb : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) y, |stock (t, η)| ≤ M) :
    |logField T κ b w₁ w₂ initial stock (y, η) - initial η| ≤
      M * (T + κ * y) + (2 / 5 : ℝ) * (w₁ + w₂)

name: NavierStokes.TransitionRamp.log_fields_eq_activation
statement:
theorem log_fields_eq_activation {T κ w₁ w₂ y : ℝ}
    (hb : δ ≤ (ofNatural F hΛ hsmall hδ hδT hP0).bigTime)
    (hw₁ : 0 < w₁) (hw₂ : 0 < w₂) (hy : y ≤ δ)
    {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ parameterInterval) :
    let R := ofNatural F hΛ hsmall hδ hδT hP0
    let N := Input.ofNatural hΛ F
    R.logAmplitude T κ w₁ w₂ (y, η) = controlled T κ (StressActivation.FromReference.refLog N δ) (y, η) ∧
    R.axialVelocity T κ w₁ (y, η) = controlled T κ (StressActivation.FromReference.refAxial N δ) (y, η)

statement:
theorem naturalU_error_jet {C : ℝ} (E : NaturalEntrance.CoefficientProfile d Λ C)
    {X η : ℝ} (hY : Λ * X ∈ Ioo (-20 : ℝ) 20) (hη : η ∈ parameterInterval) (n : ℕ) :
    iteratedDeriv n (fun ξ => E.family.U (X, ξ) - NaturalAxisData.U j ξ) η =

name: NavierStokes.TransitionRamp.natural_normalization_identity
statement:
theorem natural_normalization_identity {C : ℝ} (E : NaturalEntrance.CoefficientProfile d Λ C)
    (hC : 0 < C) {X η : ℝ}
    (hφ : 0 < AxisEvaluation.profile window d.coefficients.epsilon E.coefficients.1 (Λ * X, η)) :
    E.family.f (X, η) = C⁻¹ * Real.exp (normalizedNaturalLog d E (Λ * X) η)

name: NavierStokes.TransitionRamp.natural_stock_identity
statement:
theorem natural_stock_identity (y : ℝ) (hy : y ≤ δ) {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ parameterInterval) :
    let N := Input.ofNatural hΛ F
    let p := N.fromLog (y, η)
    ActivationStocks.profileStockOne (N.histories hδ hδT P0 hP0) h p = NaturalEntrance.p1 F.f p ∧
      ActivationStocks.profileStockTwo (N.histories hδ hδT P0 hP0) h p = NaturalEntrance.p2 F.f F.U p

name: NavierStokes.TransitionRamp.normalized_initialLog_formula
statement:
theorem normalized_initialLog_formula (E : NaturalEntrance.CoefficientProfile d Λ C)
    (hC : 0 < C) {η : ℝ}
    (hφ : AxisEvaluation.profile window d.coefficients.epsilon E.coefficients.1 (4, η) ≠ 0) :
    Real.log C + (ofNatural E.family hΛ hsmall hδ hδT hP0).initialLog η =
      Λ * realPhase h j σ η + Real.log (AxisEvaluation.profile window d.coefficients.epsilon E.coefficients.1 (4, η))

theorem ofNatural_initialLog {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ parameterInterval) :

statement:

name: NavierStokes.TransitionRamp.ofNatural_stock_slopes
statement:
theorem ofNatural_stock_slopes (y : ℝ) (hy : y ≤ δ) {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ parameterInterval) :
    let R := ofNatural F hΛ hsmall hδ hδT hP0
    let N := Input.ofNatural hΛ F
    R.angularStock (y, η) = -2 * radialPartial (StressActivation.FromReference.refLog N δ) (y, η) ∧
      R.axialStock (y, η) = -2 * radialPartial (StressActivation.FromReference.refAxial N δ) (y, η)

name: NavierStokes.TransitionRamp.parameterJet_angularSlope
statement:
theorem parameterJet_angularSlope {J : Set ℝ} (hJ : IsOpen J) {stock : Field}
    (hs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ stock (logDomain J hJ).carrier) (T κ b w₁ w₂ : ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    {p : Point} (hp : p.2 ∈ J) :
    parameterJet n (angularSlope T κ b w₁ w₂ stock) p =
      (1 - step (b + w₁) w₂ p.1) * (-(damping T κ p.1 * parameterJet n stock p) / 2) -
        if n = 0 then (2 / 5 : ℝ) * step (b + w₁) w₂ p.1 else 0

name: NavierStokes.TransitionRamp.parameterJet_axialSlope
statement:
theorem parameterJet_axialSlope {J : Set ℝ} (hJ : IsOpen J) {stock : Field}
    (hs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ stock (logDomain J hJ).carrier) (T κ b w : ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    {p : Point} (hp : p.2 ∈ J) :
    parameterJet n (axialSlope T κ b w stock) p =
      (1 - step b w p.1) * (-(damping T κ p.1 * parameterJet n stock p) / 2)

name: NavierStokes.TransitionRamp.parameterJet_baseSlope
statement:
theorem parameterJet_baseSlope {J : Set ℝ} (hJ : IsOpen J) {stock : Field}
    (hs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ stock (logDomain J hJ).carrier) (T κ : ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    {p : Point} (hp : p.2 ∈ J) :
    parameterJet n (baseSlope T κ stock) p = -(damping T κ p.1 * parameterJet n stock p) / 2

statement:
theorem physical_fields_eq_activation {T κ w₁ w₂ : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T)

    (hw₁ : 0 < w₁) (hw₂ : 0 < w₂) {p : Point} (hη : p.2 ∈ parameterInterval)
    (hX : p.1 ≤ (Input.ofNatural hΛ F).endpoint * Real.exp δ) :
    let R := ofNatural F hΛ hsmall hδ hδT hP0
    let N := Input.ofNatural hΛ F

      R.physicalU T κ w₁ p = StressActivation.FromReference.U N T κ δ p

name: NavierStokes.TransitionRamp.physical_radial_equations
statement:
theorem physical_radial_equations {T κ w₁ w₂ : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T)
    (hb : δ ≤ (ofNatural F hΛ hsmall hδ hδT hP0).bigTime)
    (hw₁ : 0 < w₁) (hw₂ : 0 < w₂) {p : Point}
    (hη : p.2 ∈ parameterInterval) (hX : 0 < p.1) :
    let R := ofNatural F hΛ hsmall hδ hδT hP0
    p.1 * radialPartial (R.physicalF T κ w₁ w₂) p / R.physicalF T κ w₁ w₂ p =
      angularSlope T κ R.bigTime w₁ w₂ R.angularStock (R.logPoint p) ∧
    p.1 * radialPartial (R.physicalU T κ w₁) p =
      axialSlope T κ R.bigTime w₁ R.axialStock (R.logPoint p)

        r.kappa * ReferenceBounds.p1 r.reference.profiles h p +
      (4 / 5 : ℝ) * TransitionRamp.step (r.reference.bigTime + r.widthU) r.widthA (r.reference.logTime p.1) ∧
    shearB r.profiles p = r.kappa * (1 - TransitionRamp.step r.reference.bigTime r.widthU

        (r.reference.profiles.f p / r.profiles.f p)

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.actual_hold_source_threshold
statement:
theorem actual_hold_source_threshold {h j σ B : ℝ}
    (hsmall : NaturalAxisData.SmallParameters h j) (hσ : 0 < σ) (hB : 1 ≤ B) :
    ∃ M > 0, ∀ Λ : ℝ, M ≤ Λ → ∀ {D : RadialDomain} (P : Profiles D) (p : Point),
      p.2 ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 → ReferenceBounds.logSlope P p = 3 / 5 →
      |Λ * (P.U p - NaturalAxisData.U j p.2)| ≤ B →
      |Λ * (P.Ubar p - NaturalAxisData.U j p.2)| ≤ B →
      |Λ * (average (parameterPartial P.U) p - 4)| ≤ B →
      |parameterPartial P.f p / P.f p - Λ * realGradient h j σ p.2| ≤ B →
      (5 / 4 : ℝ) < ReferenceBounds.sourceQ P h p

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.angular_endpoint_transfer
statement:
theorem angular_endpoint_transfer (N : ReferencePath.Input) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ τ > 0, ∀ {D : RadialDomain} (P : Profiles D) (p : Point),
      p.2 ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 → 0 < P.f p →
      |Real.log (P.f p) - Real.log (N.f (N.endpoint, p.2))| < τ →
      |parameterPartial P.f p / P.f p - parameterPartial N.f (N.endpoint, p.2) /
        N.f (N.endpoint, p.2)| < τ →
      |P.f p - N.f (N.endpoint, p.2)| < ε ∧
      |parameterPartial P.f p - parameterPartial N.f (N.endpoint, p.2)| < ε

statement:
theorem exists_comparable_ramp {h j σ Λ C B K r0 : ℝ} {P0 : ℝ → ℝ}
    {d : AnalyticInputs h j σ P0} (E : NaturalEntrance.EntranceProfile d Λ C)
    (hΛ : 0 < Λ) (hΛ1 : 1 ≤ Λ) (hC : 1 ≤ C) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hsmall : NaturalAxisData.SmallParameters h j) (hσ : 0 < σ) (hP0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ P0)
    (hr0 : 0 < r0)
    (href : ∀ δ : ℝ, ∀ hδ : 0 < δ, δ < r0 →
      ∃ hδT : 2 * δ < ReferencePath.rampLimit,
        ReferenceBounds.ReferenceBoundsOnHold E.profile hΛ hδ hδT hP0 ∧
        ReferenceJetBounds.JetBounds h j σ Λ C B K
          ((ReferencePath.Input.ofNatural hΛ E.profile.family).refF δ)
          ((ReferencePath.Input.ofNatural hΛ E.profile.family).refU δ))
    (Nextra : ℕ) {εextra : ℝ} (hεextra : 0 < εextra) :
    ∃ r : RampParameters E.profile.family hΛ hsmall hP0, ∃ c : ComparisonScales,
      ComparableRamp (B := B) (K := K) E r c ∧ InitialActivationBound r ∧
      r.reference.SmallPhysicalControl (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) Nextra εextra
        r.actTime r.kappa r.widthU r.widthA ∧
      r.reference.SmallLogControl (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) Nextra εextra
        r.actTime r.kappa r.widthU r.widthA
