name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.field_to_stockJet_transfer
statement:
theorem field_to_stockJet_transfer (B : ℝ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ τ > 0, ∀ {D E : RadialDomain} (P : Profiles D) (Q : Profiles E),
      P.pressure0 = Q.pressure0 → ∀ p : Point, p ∈ D.carrier → p ∈ E.carrier →
      p.1 ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 110 →
      (∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) p.1, ‖fieldJet Q (t, p.2)‖ ≤ B) →
      (∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) p.1, ‖fieldJet P (t, p.2) - fieldJet Q (t, p.2)‖ < τ) →
      ‖stockJet P p - stockJet Q p‖ < ε

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.holdModel_chi_zero
statement:
theorem holdModel_chi_zero (h j B : ℝ) {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (p : HoldParameter B)
    (hchi : NaturalAxisData.chi h j σ p.1.val = 0) :
    holdModel h j σ B p 0 = -(3 / 5 : ℝ) * NaturalAxisData.W h j p.1.val -
      h * (1 - 2 * p.1.val * NaturalAxisData.U j p.1.val)

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.holdModel_continuous
statement:
theorem holdModel_continuous (h j B : ℝ) {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) :
    Continuous (fun p : HoldParameter B × ℝ => holdModel h j σ B p.1 p.2)

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.holdModel_uniform_lower
statement:
theorem holdModel_uniform_lower {h j σ : ℝ} (hsmall : NaturalAxisData.SmallParameters h j)
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (B : ℝ) :
    ∃ M > 0, ∀ Λ : ℝ, M ≤ Λ → ∀ p : HoldParameter B,
      (5 / 4 : ℝ) < NaturalAxisData.L h p.1.val * Λ * NaturalAxisData.chi h j σ p.1.val +
        holdModel h j σ B p (1 / Λ)

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.hold_axis_source_lower
statement:
theorem hold_axis_source_lower {h j η : ℝ} (hsmall : NaturalAxisData.SmallParameters h j)
    (hη : η ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    (17 / 10 : ℝ) < -(3 / 5 : ℝ) * NaturalAxisData.W h j η -
      h * (1 - 2 * η * NaturalAxisData.U j η)

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.hold_source_identity
statement:
theorem hold_source_identity {D : RadialDomain} (P : Profiles D) (h j σ : ℝ)
    {Λ : ℝ} (hΛ : Λ ≠ 0) (p : Point)
    (hl : ReferenceBounds.logSlope P p = 3 / 5) :
    ReferenceBounds.sourceQ P h p = NaturalAxisData.L h p.2 * Λ * NaturalAxisData.chi h j σ p.2 +
      holdRemainder h j σ p.2 (ReferenceBounds.qJets P j σ h Λ 1 p) (1 / Λ)

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.integral_bounded_length
statement:
theorem integral_bounded_length {f : ℝ → ℝ} {X K : ℝ} (hX : X ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 110)
    (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hf : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) X, |f t| ≤ K) :
    |∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..X, f t| ≤ 110 * K

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.logSlope_eq_shear
statement:
theorem logSlope_eq_shear (p : Point) :
    ReferenceBounds.logSlope P p = 1 - shearA P p / 2

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.log_control_mono
statement:
theorem log_control_mono {J K : Set ℝ} (R : TransitionRamp.StockReference J)
    {N n : ℕ} {ε ε' T κ w₁ w₂ : ℝ} (hn : n ≤ N) (he : ε ≤ ε')
    (hc : R.SmallLogControl K N ε T κ w₁ w₂) :
    R.SmallLogControl K n ε' T κ w₁ w₂

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.nearby_axial_bounds
statement:
theorem nearby_axial_bounds {D E : RadialDomain} (P : Profiles D) (Q : Profiles E)
    {h j σ Λ C B K : ℝ} (hΛ : 0 < Λ)
    (hj : ReferenceJetBounds.JetBounds h j σ Λ C B K Q.f Q.U)
    (hu : ∀ p ∈ ReferenceBounds.holdRegion, |P.U p - Q.U p| ≤ 1 / Λ)
    (huη : ∀ p ∈ ReferenceBounds.holdRegion,
      |parameterPartial P.U p - parameterPartial Q.U p| ≤ 1 / Λ) :
    (∀ p ∈ ReferenceBounds.holdRegion, |Λ * (P.U p - NaturalAxisData.U j p.2)| ≤ B + 1) ∧
    (∀ p ∈ ReferenceBounds.holdRegion, |Λ * (parameterPartial P.U p - 4)| ≤ B + 1)

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.nearby_source_jets
statement:
theorem nearby_source_jets {D E : RadialDomain} (P : Profiles D) (Q : Profiles E)
    {h j σ Λ C B K : ℝ} (hΛ : 0 < Λ)
    (hj : ReferenceJetBounds.JetBounds h j σ Λ C B K Q.f Q.U)
    (hu : ∀ p ∈ ReferenceBounds.holdRegion, |P.U p - Q.U p| ≤ 1 / Λ)
    (huη : ∀ p ∈ ReferenceBounds.holdRegion,
      |parameterPartial P.U p - parameterPartial Q.U p| ≤ 1 / Λ)
    (hfη : ∀ p ∈ ReferenceBounds.holdRegion,
      |parameterPartial P.f p / P.f p - parameterPartial Q.f p / Q.f p| ≤ 1)
    {p : Point} (hp : p ∈ ReferenceBounds.holdRegion) (hpD : p ∈ D.carrier) :
    |Λ * (P.U p - NaturalAxisData.U j p.2)| ≤ B + 2 ∧
    |Λ * (P.Ubar p - NaturalAxisData.U j p.2)| ≤ B + 2 ∧
    |Λ * (average (parameterPartial P.U) p - 4)| ≤ B + 2 ∧
    |parameterPartial P.f p / P.f p - Λ * realGradient h j σ p.2| ≤ B + 2

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.physical_control_mono
statement:
theorem physical_control_mono {J K : Set ℝ} (R : TransitionRamp.StockReference J)
    {N n : ℕ} {ε ε' T κ w₁ w₂ : ℝ} (hn : n ≤ N) (he : ε ≤ ε')
    (hc : R.SmallPhysicalControl K N ε T κ w₁ w₂) :
    R.SmallPhysicalControl K n ε' T κ w₁ w₂

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.physical_endpoint_control
statement:
theorem physical_endpoint_control {ε : ℝ}
    (hc : (ofNatural F hΛ hsmall hδ hδT hP0).SmallPhysicalControl
      (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) 1 ε T κ w₁ w₂)
    {p : Point} (hp : p ∈ continuationRegion (4 / Λ)) :
    let N := Input.ofNatural hΛ F
    let P := physicalProfiles F hΛ hsmall hδ hδT hP0 (κ := κ) hT hb hw₁ hw₂
    |P.U p - N.U (N.endpoint, p.2)| < ε ∧
    |parameterPartial P.U p - parameterPartial N.U (N.endpoint, p.2)| < ε ∧
    |parameterPartial P.f p / P.f p - parameterPartial N.f (N.endpoint, p.2) /
      N.f (N.endpoint, p.2)| < ε

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.physical_endpoint_log_value
statement:
theorem physical_endpoint_log_value {ε : ℝ}
    (hc : (ofNatural F hΛ hsmall hδ hδT hP0).SmallPhysicalControl
      (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) 1 ε T κ w₁ w₂)
    {p : Point} (hη : p.2 ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (hx : p.1 ∈ Icc (4 / Λ)
      (radius (4 / Λ) ((ofNatural F hΛ hsmall hδ hδT hP0).bigTime + w₁ + w₂))) :
    let N := Input.ofNatural hΛ F
    let P := physicalProfiles F hΛ hsmall hδ hδT hP0 (κ := κ) hT hb hw₁ hw₂
    |Real.log (P.f p) - Real.log (N.f (N.endpoint, p.2))| < ε

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.physical_fieldJet_before
statement:
theorem physical_fieldJet_before {p : Point}
    (hp : p ∈ (Input.ofNatural hΛ F).radialDomain.carrier)
    (hx : p.1 ≤ (Input.ofNatural hΛ F).endpoint) :
    let R := ofNatural F hΛ hsmall hδ hδT hP0
    let P := physicalProfiles F hΛ hsmall hδ hδT hP0 (κ := κ) hT hb hw₁ hw₂
    fieldJet P p = fieldJet R.profiles p

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.physical_shear_equations
statement:
theorem physical_shear_equations {p : Point} (hp : p.2 ∈ parameterInterval) (hX : 0 < p.1)
    (ht : T ≤ (ofNatural F hΛ hsmall hδ hδT hP0).logTime p.1) :
    let R := ofNatural F hΛ hsmall hδ hδT hP0
    let P := physicalProfiles F hΛ hsmall hδ hδT hP0 (κ := κ) hT hb hw₁ hw₂
    shearA P p = (1 - step (R.bigTime + w₁) w₂ (R.logTime p.1)) * κ *
        ReferenceBounds.p1 R.profiles h p + (4 / 5 : ℝ) * step (R.bigTime + w₁) w₂ (R.logTime p.1) ∧
    shearB P p = κ * (1 - step R.bigTime w₁ (R.logTime p.1)) *
      ReferenceBounds.p2 R.profiles h p * (R.profiles.f p / P.f p)

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.prepare_stock_comparison
statement:
theorem prepare_stock_comparison {h j σ Λ C B K : ℝ} {P0 : ℝ → ℝ}
    {d : AnalyticInputs h j σ P0} (E : NaturalEntrance.EntranceProfile d Λ C)
    (hΛ : 0 < Λ) (hΛ1 : 1 ≤ Λ) (hC : 1 ≤ C)
    (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hsmall : NaturalAxisData.SmallParameters h j)
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (hP0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ P0) :
    ∃ c : ComparisonScales, ∀ δ : ℝ, ∀ hδ : 0 < δ, δ < c.referenceRadius →
      ∀ hδT : 2 * δ < ReferencePath.rampLimit,
      ReferenceBounds.ReferenceBoundsOnHold E.profile hΛ hδ hδT hP0 →
      ReferenceJetBounds.JetBounds h j σ Λ C B K
        ((ReferencePath.Input.ofNatural hΛ E.profile.family).refF δ)
        ((ReferencePath.Input.ofNatural hΛ E.profile.family).refU δ) →
      let Q := ReferenceBounds.referenceProfiles E.profile hΛ hδ hδT hP0
      StockControl Q h c.bound (continuationRegion (4 / Λ)) ∧
        ∀ {D : RadialDomain} (P : Profiles D), P.pressure0 = Q.pressure0 →
          ∀ p ∈ continuationRegion (4 / Λ), p ∈ D.carrier →
            (∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) p.1,
              ‖fieldJet P (t, p.2) - fieldJet Q (t, p.2)‖ < c.fieldTolerance) →
              StockClose P Q h c.error p

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.pressure_initial_bound
statement:
theorem pressure_initial_bound {P0 : ℝ → ℝ} (hP0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ P0) :
    ∃ B0 > 0, ∀ η ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, |P0 η| ≤ B0 ∧ |deriv P0 η| ≤ B0

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.profileHistory_difference
statement:
theorem profileHistory_difference {D E : RadialDomain} (P : Profiles D) (Q : Profiles E)
    (h0 : P.pressure0 = Q.pressure0) (r : HistoryRow) {p : Point}
    (hp : p ∈ D.carrier) (hq : p ∈ E.carrier) :
    profileHistory P r p - profileHistory Q r p =
      ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..p.1, profileDensity P r (t, p.2) - profileDensity Q r (t, p.2)

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.profileHistory_parameter_difference
statement:
theorem profileHistory_parameter_difference {D E : RadialDomain} (P : Profiles D) (Q : Profiles E)
    (h0 : P.pressure0 = Q.pressure0) (r : HistoryRow) {p : Point}
    (hp : p ∈ D.carrier) (hq : p ∈ E.carrier) :
    parameterPartial (profileHistory P r) p - parameterPartial (profileHistory Q r) p =
      ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..p.1, parameterPartial (profileDensity P r) (t, p.2) -
        parameterPartial (profileDensity Q r) (t, p.2)

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.profileHistory_parameter_formula
statement:
theorem profileHistory_parameter_formula {D : RadialDomain} (P : Profiles D) (r : HistoryRow)
    {p : Point} (hp : p ∈ D.carrier) :
    parameterPartial (profileHistory P r) p = deriv (profileInitial P r) p.2 +
      primitive (parameterPartial (profileDensity P r)) p

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.projectionConstant_pos
statement: theorem projectionConstant_pos {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M) : 0 < projectionConstant M

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.projection_comparison
statement:
theorem projection_comparison {A B p q θ R M ε : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) (hθ : θ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hB : |B| ≤ M) (hBA : |B / A| ≤ M)
    (hp : |p - A| ≤ ε) (hq : |q - B| ≤ ε) (hR : |R - 1| ≤ ε) :
    |p + q * (θ * (B / A) * R) - (A + θ * B ^ 2 / A)| ≤
      ε * projectionConstant M

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.projection_identity
statement:
theorem projection_identity (A B p q θ R : ℝ) :
    p + q * (θ * (B / A) * R) - (A + θ * B ^ 2 / A) =
      (p - A) + (q - B) * θ * (B / A) * R + θ * B * (B / A) * (R - 1)

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.reference_endpoint_control
statement:
theorem reference_endpoint_control {εU εF εL : ℝ} (hU : 0 < εU) (hF : 0 < εF) (hL : 0 < εL) :
    ∃ r > 0, ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < r →
      ReferenceJetBounds.TransitionControl N δ εU εF ∧
      ∀ p : Point, N.endpoint ≤ p.1 → p.2 ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 →
        |parameterPartial (N.refF δ) p / N.refF δ p -
          parameterPartial N.f (N.endpoint, p.2) / N.f (N.endpoint, p.2)| < εL

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.reference_fieldJet_bound
statement:
theorem reference_fieldJet_bound {D : RadialDomain} (P : Profiles D)
    {h j σ Λ C B K : ℝ} (hsmall : NaturalAxisData.SmallParameters h j)
    (hΛ : 1 ≤ Λ) (hC : 1 ≤ C) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hj : ReferenceJetBounds.JetBounds h j σ Λ C B K P.f P.U)
    {p : Point} (hp : p ∈ ReferenceBounds.holdRegion) :
    ‖fieldJet P p‖ ≤ K + B + 6

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.reference_first_lower
statement:
theorem reference_first_lower {h j σ Λ C δ : ℝ} {P0 : ℝ → ℝ}
    {d : AnalyticInputs h j σ P0} (E : NaturalEntrance.EntranceProfile d Λ C)
    (hΛ : 0 < Λ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδT : 2 * δ < ReferencePath.rampLimit)
    (hP0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ P0) (hsmall : NaturalAxisData.SmallParameters h j) (hσ : 0 < σ)
    (hb : ReferenceBounds.ReferenceBoundsOnHold E.profile hΛ hδ hδT hP0)
    {p : Point} (hp : p ∈ ReferenceBounds.holdRegion) (hX : 0 < p.1) :
    (6 / 5 : ℝ) * p.1 ≤ ReferenceBounds.p1 (ReferenceBounds.referenceProfiles E.profile hΛ hδ hδT hP0) h p

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.reference_positive_uniform
statement:
theorem reference_positive_uniform :
    ∃ μ r : ℝ, 0 < μ ∧ 0 < r ∧ ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < r →
      ∀ p : Point, N.endpoint ≤ p.1 → p.2 ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 → 2 * μ ≤ N.refF δ p

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.scalar_hold_barrier
statement:
theorem scalar_hold_barrier {g : ℝ → ℝ} {a X b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (haX : a ≤ X)
    (hg : ∀ t ∈ Icc a X, DifferentiableAt ℝ g t)
    (heq : ∀ t ∈ Icc a X, (3 / 5 : ℝ) * b ≤ t * deriv g t + (3 / 5) * g t)
    (hinit : b < g a) : b < g X

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.short_integral_bound
statement:
theorem short_integral_bound {f : ℝ → ℝ} {X ε : ℝ}
    (hX : X ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 110) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hf : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) X, |f t| ≤ ε / 111) :
    |∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..X, f t| < ε

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.speedConstant_nonneg
statement: theorem speedConstant_nonneg {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M) : 0 ≤ speedConstant M

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.stockJet_coordinates
statement:
theorem stockJet_coordinates {D : RadialDomain} (P : Profiles D) (h : ℝ)
    {p : Point} (hp : p ∈ D.carrier) (hX : 0 < p.1) (hf : P.f p ≠ 0) :
    stockOneMap h p (stockJet P p) = ReferenceBounds.p1 P h p ∧
      stockTwoMap h p (stockJet P p) = ReferenceBounds.p2 P h p

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.stockJet_uniform_bound
statement:
theorem stockJet_uniform_bound {B B0 : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hB0 : 0 ≤ B0) :
    ∃ K > 0, ∀ {D : RadialDomain} (P : Profiles D) (p : Point), p ∈ D.carrier →
      p.1 ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 110 → |P.pressure0 p.2| ≤ B0 → |deriv P.pressure0 p.2| ≤ B0 →
      (∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) p.1, ‖fieldJet P (t, p.2)‖ ≤ B) → ‖stockJet P p‖ ≤ K

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.two_ramp_relaxed
statement:
theorem two_ramp_relaxed (c : ComparisonScales) {κ A B p q R b w₁ w₂ y : ℝ}
    (hκ : 0 < κ) (hκc : κ ≤ c.damping) (hw₁ : 0 < w₁) (hw₂ : 0 < w₂)
    (hA : 0 < A) (hAM : A ≤ c.bound) (hB : |B| ≤ c.bound)
    (hBA : |B / A| ≤ c.bound)
    (hp : |p - A| < c.error) (hq : |q - B| < c.error) (hR : |R - 1| < c.error)
    (hc : (9 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ A + B ^ 2 / A) (hbig : b ≤ y → 3 ≤ A) :
    Relaxed
      ((1 - TransitionRamp.step (b + w₁) w₂ y) * κ * A +
        (4 / 5 : ℝ) * TransitionRamp.step (b + w₁) w₂ y)
      (κ * (1 - TransitionRamp.step b w₁ y) * B * R) p q

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.uniform_density_bound
statement:
theorem uniform_density_bound (B : ℝ) :
    ∃ K ≥ 0, ∀ X ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 110, ∀ z : FieldJet, ‖z‖ ≤ B → ‖densityJet X z‖ ≤ K

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.uniform_density_transfer
statement:
theorem uniform_density_transfer (B : ℝ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ τ > 0, ∀ X ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 110, ∀ z w : FieldJet,
      ‖z‖ ≤ B → ‖w - z‖ < τ → ‖densityJet X w - densityJet X z‖ < ε

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.uniform_stock_bound
statement:
theorem uniform_stock_bound {h j μ B : ℝ} (hsmall : NaturalAxisData.SmallParameters h j)
    (hμ : 0 < μ) {S : Set Point} (hS : IsCompact S)
    (hX : ∀ p ∈ S, 0 < p.1) (hη : ∀ p ∈ S, p.2 ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    ∃ M > 0, ∀ p ∈ S, ∀ z : StockJet, ‖z‖ ≤ B → μ ≤ z 0 →
      |stockOneMap h p z| ≤ M ∧ |stockTwoMap h p z| ≤ M

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.uniform_stock_transfer
statement:
theorem uniform_stock_transfer {h j μ B ε : ℝ}
    (hsmall : NaturalAxisData.SmallParameters h j) (hμ : 0 < μ) (hε : 0 < ε)
    {S : Set Point} (hS : IsCompact S)
    (hX : ∀ p ∈ S, 0 < p.1) (hη : ∀ p ∈ S, p.2 ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    ∃ τ > 0, ∀ p ∈ S, ∀ z w : StockJet, ‖z‖ ≤ B → 2 * μ ≤ z 0 → ‖w - z‖ < τ →
      μ < w 0 ∧ |stockOneMap h p w - stockOneMap h p z| < ε ∧
        |stockTwoMap h p w - stockTwoMap h p z| < ε ∧ |z 0 / w 0 - 1| < ε

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.weightedGap_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem weightedGap_hasDerivAt {g : ℝ → ℝ} {g' X : ℝ} (hX : 0 < X)
    (hg : HasDerivAt g g' X) (b : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (weightedGap g b)
      (Real.exp ((3 / 5 : ℝ) * Real.log X) / X *
        (X * g' + (3 / 5) * g X - (3 / 5) * b)) X

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.zero_axial_relaxed
statement:
theorem zero_axial_relaxed {a p q : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ha2 : a ≤ 2) (hp : 2 < p) :
    Relaxed a 0 p q

name: NavierStokes.ActivationContinuation.zero_axial_relaxed_profile
statement:
theorem zero_axial_relaxed_profile {h : ℝ} {p : Point} (ha : 0 < shearA P p)
    (ha2 : shearA P p ≤ 2) (hu : radialPartial P.U p = 0)
    (hp : 2 < ReferenceBounds.p1 P h p) : IsRelaxed P h p

name: NavierStokes.AxisHolomorphic.choose_geometric_le
statement:
theorem choose_geometric_le {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (hs1 : s < 1) (n m : ℕ) :
    ((n + m).choose m : ℝ) * s ^ n ≤ 1 / (1 - s) ^ (m + 1)

name: NavierStokes.AxisHolomorphic.complexLinearForm_norm
statement:
theorem complexLinearForm_norm (u v : ℂ) :
    ‖complexLinearForm u v‖ ≤ ‖u‖ + ‖v‖

name: NavierStokes.AxisHolomorphic.complexLinearForm_tsum
statement:
theorem complexLinearForm_tsum {u v : ℕ → ℂ} (hu : Summable u) (hv : Summable v) :
    (∑' n, complexLinearForm (u n) (v n)) =
      complexLinearForm (∑' n, u n) (∑' n, v n)

name: NavierStokes.AxisHolomorphic.complexProfile_analytic
statement:
theorem complexProfile_analytic (I : Window) {ε R s : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hs : R / 20 < s) (hs1 : s < 1) (A : AxisSpace I ε)
    (k : ℕ) {Y : ℝ} (hY : |Y| ≤ R) :
    AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (complexProfile I ε A k Y) (parameterStrip I (ε * (1 - s)))

name: NavierStokes.AxisHolomorphic.complexProfile_bound
statement:
theorem complexProfile_bound (I : Window) {ε R s : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hs : R / 20 < s) (hs1 : s < 1) (A : AxisSpace I ε)
    (k : ℕ) {Y : ℝ} (hY : |Y| ≤ R) {z : ℂ} (hz : |z.im| ≤ ε * (1 - s) / 2) :
    ‖complexProfile I ε A k Y z‖ ≤ (2 * jetConstant R s k) * ‖A‖

name: NavierStokes.AxisHolomorphic.complexProfile_hasDerivAt_Y
statement:
theorem complexProfile_hasDerivAt_Y (I : Window) {ε R s : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hs : R / 20 < s) (hs1 : s < 1) (A : AxisSpace I ε)
    (k : ℕ) {Y : ℝ} (hY : |Y| < R) {z : ℂ}
    (hz : z ∈ parameterStrip I (ε * (1 - s))) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => complexProfile I ε A k y z)
      (complexProfile I ε A (k + 1) Y z) Y

name: NavierStokes.AxisHolomorphic.complexProfile_iteratedDeriv_Y
statement:
theorem complexProfile_iteratedDeriv_Y (I : Window) {ε R s : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hs : R / 20 < s) (hs1 : s < 1) (A : AxisSpace I ε)
    (k r : ℕ) {Y : ℝ} (hY : |Y| < R) {z : ℂ}
    (hz : z ∈ parameterStrip I (ε * (1 - s))) :
    iteratedDeriv r (fun y => complexProfile I ε A k y z) Y =
      complexProfile I ε A (k + r) Y z

name: NavierStokes.AxisHolomorphic.complexProfile_iteratedDeriv_ofReal
statement:
theorem complexProfile_iteratedDeriv_ofReal (I : Window) {ε R s : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hs : R / 20 < s) (hs1 : s < 1) (A : AxisSpace I ε)
    (k m : ℕ) {Y x : ℝ} (hY : |Y| ≤ R) (hx : x ∈ Ioo I.left I.right) :
    iteratedDeriv m (complexProfile I ε A k Y) (x : ℂ) =
      (mixedSeries I ε A k m (Y, x) : ℂ)

name: NavierStokes.AxisHolomorphic.complexProfile_ofReal
statement:
theorem complexProfile_ofReal (I : Window) (ε : ℝ) (A : AxisSpace I ε)
    (k : ℕ) (Y x : ℝ) :
    complexProfile I ε A k Y (x : ℂ) = (mixedSeries I ε A k 0 (Y, x) : ℂ)

name: NavierStokes.AxisHolomorphic.complexProfile_zero_ofReal
statement:
theorem complexProfile_zero_ofReal (I : Window) (ε : ℝ) (A : AxisSpace I ε) (Y x : ℝ) :
    complexProfile I ε A 0 Y (x : ℂ) = (profile I ε A (Y, x) : ℂ)

name: NavierStokes.AxisHolomorphic.exists_common_holomorphic_extension
statement:
theorem exists_common_holomorphic_extension (I J : Window) (hleft : I.left < J.left)
    (hright : J.right < I.right) {ε R : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hR20 : R < 20) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∃ B : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ k, 0 ≤ B k) ∧
      ∀ (A : AxisSpace I ε) (Y : ℝ), |Y| ≤ R → ∀ k : ℕ,
        AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (complexProfile I ε A k Y) (parameterTube J δ) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ parameterTube J δ, ‖complexProfile I ε A k Y z‖ ≤ B k * ‖A‖) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ parameterTube J δ,
          iteratedDeriv k (fun y => complexProfile I ε A 0 y z) Y =
            complexProfile I ε A k Y z) ∧
        (∀ (m : ℕ) (x : ℝ), x ∈ J.interval →
          iteratedDeriv m (complexProfile I ε A k Y) (x : ℂ) =
            (mixedSeries I ε A k m (Y, x) : ℂ))

name: NavierStokes.AxisHolomorphic.exists_parameterTube_subset
statement:
theorem exists_parameterTube_subset (I J : Window) (hleft : I.left < J.left)
    (hright : J.right < I.right) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ parameterTube J δ ⊆ parameterStrip I a

name: NavierStokes.AxisHolomorphic.geometricMoment_nonneg
statement:
theorem geometricMoment_nonneg {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 ≤ q) (k : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ geometricMoment q k

name: NavierStokes.AxisHolomorphic.jetConstant_nonneg
statement:
theorem jetConstant_nonneg {R s : ℝ} (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hs : R / 20 < s)
    (hs1 : s < 1) (k : ℕ) : 0 ≤ jetConstant R s k

name: NavierStokes.AxisHolomorphic.mixedSeries_factorial_bound
statement:
theorem mixedSeries_factorial_bound (I : Window) {ε R s : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hs : R / 20 < s) (hs1 : s < 1) (A : AxisSpace I ε)
    (k m : ℕ) {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : |p.1| ≤ R) :
    ‖mixedSeries I ε A k m p‖ ≤
      (‖A‖ / (1 - s) * geometricMoment (R / 20 / s) k) *
        (m.factorial : ℝ) * ((ε * (1 - s))⁻¹) ^ m

name: NavierStokes.AxisHolomorphic.normalizedJet_bound
statement:
theorem normalizedJet_bound (I : Window) {ε R s : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hs : R / 20 < s) (hs1 : s < 1) (A : AxisSpace I ε)
    (k m : ℕ) {Y : ℝ} (hY : |Y| ≤ R) (x : ℝ) :
    ‖normalizedJet I ε A k Y m x‖ ≤
      (jetConstant R s k * ‖A‖) * ((ε * (1 - s))⁻¹) ^ m

name: NavierStokes.AxisHolomorphic.normalizedJet_hasDerivAt_Y
statement:
theorem normalizedJet_hasDerivAt_Y (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (A : AxisSpace I ε) (k m : ℕ) {Y x : ℝ}
    (hY : |Y| < 20) (hx : x ∈ Ioo I.left I.right) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => normalizedJet I ε A k y m x)
      (normalizedJet I ε A (k + 1) Y m x) Y

name: NavierStokes.AxisHolomorphic.normalizedJet_hasDerivAt_eta
statement:
theorem normalizedJet_hasDerivAt_eta (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (A : AxisSpace I ε) (k m : ℕ) {Y x : ℝ}
    (hY : |Y| < 20) (hx : x ∈ Ioo I.left I.right) :
    HasDerivAt (normalizedJet I ε A k Y m)
      (((m : ℝ) + 1) * normalizedJet I ε A k Y (m + 1) x) x

name: NavierStokes.AxisHolomorphic.parameterStrip_convex
statement:
theorem parameterStrip_convex (I : Window) (a : ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.AxisHolomorphic.parameterStrip_isOpen

statement:
theorem summable_geometricMoment {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (hq1 : q < 1) (k : ℕ) :

name: NavierStokes.AxisHolomorphic.summable_verticalTerm
statement:
theorem summable_verticalTerm {c : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ} {C a : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (ha : 0 < a)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : |z.im| ≤ a / 2)
    (hc : ∀ n, ‖c n z.re‖ ≤ C * (a⁻¹) ^ n) :

name: NavierStokes.AxisHolomorphic.summable_verticalX
statement:
theorem summable_verticalX {c : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ} {C a : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (ha : 0 < a)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : |z.im| ≤ a / 2)

name: NavierStokes.AxisHolomorphic.summable_verticalY
statement:
theorem summable_verticalY {c : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ} {C a : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (ha : 0 < a)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : |z.im| ≤ a / 2)
    (hc : ∀ n, ‖c n z.re‖ ≤ C * (a⁻¹) ^ n) :

name: NavierStokes.AxisHolomorphic.term_factorial_bound
statement:
theorem term_factorial_bound (I : Window) {ε R s : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hs : R / 20 < s) (hs1 : s < 1) (A : AxisSpace I ε)
    (k m n : ℕ) {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : |p.1| ≤ R) :
    ‖term I ε A k m n p‖ ≤
      (‖A‖ / (1 - s) * (m.factorial : ℝ) * ((ε * (1 - s))⁻¹) ^ m) *
        (((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ k * (R / 20 / s) ^ n)

name: NavierStokes.AxisHolomorphic.verticalExtension_analytic
statement:
theorem verticalExtension_analytic (I : Window) {c : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ} {C a : ℝ}
    (hC : 0 ≤ C) (ha : 0 < a)
    (hderiv : ∀ m x, x ∈ Ioo I.left I.right →
      HasDerivAt (c m) (((m : ℝ) + 1) * c (m + 1) x) x)
    (hbound : ∀ m x, x ∈ Ioo I.left I.right → ‖c m x‖ ≤ C * (a⁻¹) ^ m) :
    AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (verticalExtension c) (parameterStrip I a)

name: NavierStokes.AxisHolomorphic.verticalExtension_bound
statement:
theorem verticalExtension_bound {c : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ} {C a : ℝ}
    (hC : 0 ≤ C) (ha : 0 < a) {z : ℂ} (hz : |z.im| ≤ a / 2)
    (hbound : ∀ m, ‖c m z.re‖ ≤ C * (a⁻¹) ^ m) :
    ‖verticalExtension c z‖ ≤ 2 * C

name: NavierStokes.AxisHolomorphic.verticalExtension_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem verticalExtension_hasDerivAt (I : Window) {c : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ} {C a : ℝ}
    (hC : 0 ≤ C) (ha : 0 < a)
    (hderiv : ∀ m x, x ∈ Ioo I.left I.right →
      HasDerivAt (c m) (((m : ℝ) + 1) * c (m + 1) x) x)
    (hbound : ∀ m x, x ∈ Ioo I.left I.right → ‖c m x‖ ≤ C * (a⁻¹) ^ m)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ parameterStrip I a) :
    HasDerivAt (verticalExtension c) (∑' m, verticalX c m z) z

name: NavierStokes.AxisHolomorphic.verticalExtension_ofReal
statement:
theorem verticalExtension_ofReal (c : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) :
    verticalExtension c (x : ℂ) = (c 0 x : ℂ)

name: NavierStokes.AxisHolomorphic.verticalTerm_bound
statement:
theorem verticalTerm_bound {c : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ} {C a : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (ha : 0 < a)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : |z.im| ≤ a / 2)
    (hc : ∀ n, ‖c n z.re‖ ≤ C * (a⁻¹) ^ n) (m : ℕ) :
    ‖verticalTerm c m z‖ ≤ C * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m

name: NavierStokes.AxisHolomorphic.verticalTerm_hasDerivAt_Y
statement:
theorem verticalTerm_hasDerivAt_Y (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (A : AxisSpace I ε) (k m : ℕ) {Y : ℝ} {z : ℂ}
    (hY : |Y| < 20) (hz : z.re ∈ Ioo I.left I.right) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => verticalTerm (normalizedJet I ε A k y) m z)
      (verticalTerm (normalizedJet I ε A (k + 1) Y) m z) Y

name: NavierStokes.AxisHolomorphic.verticalTerm_hasFDerivAt
statement:
theorem verticalTerm_hasFDerivAt {c : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ} {z : ℂ} (m : ℕ)
    (hc : ∀ n, HasDerivAt (c n) (((n : ℝ) + 1) * c (n + 1) z.re) z.re) :
    HasFDerivAt (verticalTerm c m)
      (complexLinearForm (verticalX c m z) (verticalY c m z)) z

name: NavierStokes.AxisHolomorphic.verticalX_bound
statement:
theorem verticalX_bound {c : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ} {C a : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (ha : 0 < a)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : |z.im| ≤ a / 2)
    (hc : ∀ n, ‖c n z.re‖ ≤ C * (a⁻¹) ^ n) (m : ℕ) :
    ‖verticalX c m z‖ ≤ (C / a) * ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m

name: NavierStokes.AxisHolomorphic.verticalY_bound
statement:
theorem verticalY_bound {c : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ} {C a : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (ha : 0 < a)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : |z.im| ≤ a / 2)
    (hc : ∀ n, ‖c n z.re‖ ≤ C * (a⁻¹) ^ n) (m : ℕ) :
    ‖verticalY c m z‖ ≤ 2 * ((C / a) * ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m)

name: NavierStokes.AxisHolomorphic.verticalY_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem verticalY_succ (c : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (m : ℕ) (z : ℂ) :
    verticalY c (m + 1) z = Complex.I * verticalX c m z

name: NavierStokes.AxisHolomorphic.verticalY_tsum
statement:
theorem verticalY_tsum {c : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ} {z : ℂ}
    (hX : Summable (fun m => verticalX c m z))
    (hY : Summable (fun m => verticalY c m z)) :
    (∑' m, verticalY c m z) = Complex.I * ∑' m, verticalX c m z

name: NavierStokes.AxisHolomorphic.verticalY_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem verticalY_zero (c : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (z : ℂ) : verticalY c 0 z = 0

name: NavierStokes.AxisHolomorphic.weight_le_core

theorem weight_le_core {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (n m : ℕ) :

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.ball_subset_outer
statement:
theorem ball_subset_outer (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (z : Disk c ρ) :

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.cauchyMap_add
statement:
theorem cauchyMap_add (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (hgap : ρ < σ)
    (f g : C(Disk c σ, E)) : cauchyMap c hgap (f + g) = cauchyMap c hgap f + cauchyMap c hgap g

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.cauchyMap_smul
statement:
theorem cauchyMap_smul (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (hgap : ρ < σ)

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.circle_kernel_identity
statement:
theorem circle_kernel_identity {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (z : ℂ) (θ : ℝ) (v : E) :
    weight δ θ • v = deriv (circleMap z δ) θ •
      ((circleMap z δ θ - z) ^ (-2 : ℤ) • v)

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.contDiff_derivative_path
statement:
theorem contDiff_derivative_path {X : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X]
    (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (hgap : ρ < σ) {n : WithTop ℕ∞}
    {f : X → C(Disk c σ, E)} (hf : ContDiff ℝ n f) :
    ContDiff ℝ n (fun x => derivativeCLM c hgap (f x))

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.continuous_derivative_path
statement:
theorem continuous_derivative_path {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (hgap : ρ < σ) {f : X → C(Disk c σ, E)} (hf : Continuous f) :
    Continuous (fun x => derivativeCLM c hgap (f x))

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.continuous_integrand
statement:
theorem continuous_integrand (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (hgap : ρ < σ)

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.continuous_weight
statement: theorem continuous_weight {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) : Continuous (weight δ)

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.derivativeCLM_apply_integral
statement:
theorem derivativeCLM_apply_integral (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (hgap : ρ < σ)
    (f : C(Disk c σ, E)) (z : Disk c ρ) :
    derivativeCLM c hgap f z = (2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ •
      ∫ θ : ℝ in (0)..(2 * Real.pi),
        weight (σ - ρ) θ • f (sample c hgap θ z)

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.derivativeCLM_apply_of_diffContOnCl
statement:
theorem derivativeCLM_apply_of_diffContOnCl (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (hgap : ρ < σ)
    (F : ℂ → E) (hF : DiffContOnCl ℂ F (ball c σ)) (z : Disk c ρ) :
    derivativeCLM c hgap (ofContinuousOn c σ F hF.continuousOn_ball) z = deriv F z

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.derivativeCLM_apply_of_differentiableOn
statement:
theorem derivativeCLM_apply_of_differentiableOn (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (hgap : ρ < σ)
    (F : ℂ → E) (hF : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (closedBall c σ)) (z : Disk c ρ) :
    derivativeCLM c hgap (ofContinuousOn c σ F hF.continuousOn) z = deriv F z

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.derivativeCLM_apply_of_eq
statement:
theorem derivativeCLM_apply_of_eq (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (hgap : ρ < σ)
    (f : C(Disk c σ, E)) (F : ℂ → E)
    (hF : DiffContOnCl ℂ F (ball c σ))
    (hvalues : ∀ w : Disk c σ, f w = F w) (z : Disk c ρ) :
    derivativeCLM c hgap f z = deriv F z

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.derivativeCLM_restrict_of_eq
statement:
theorem derivativeCLM_restrict_of_eq (c : ℂ) {r ρ σ : ℝ}
    (hgap : r < ρ) (houter : ρ ≤ σ) (f : C(Disk c σ, E)) (F : ℂ → E)
    (hF : DiffContOnCl ℂ F (ball c σ))
    (hvalues : ∀ w : Disk c σ, f w = F w) :
    derivativeCLM c hgap (restrictionCLM c houter f) =
      derivativeCLM c (hgap.trans_le houter) f

statement:
theorem norm_cauchyMap_le (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (hgap : ρ < σ)

theorem norm_derivativeCLM_le (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (hgap : ρ < σ) :

theorem norm_restrictionCLM_le (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (h : ρ ≤ σ) :

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.norm_weight

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.offset_ne_zero
statement: theorem offset_ne_zero {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (θ : ℝ) : circleMap 0 δ θ ≠ 0

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.restrict_derivativeCLM_of_eq
statement:
theorem restrict_derivativeCLM_of_eq (c : ℂ) {r ρ σ : ℝ}
    (hr : r ≤ ρ) (hgap : ρ < σ) (f : C(Disk c σ, E)) (F : ℂ → E)
    (hF : DiffContOnCl ℂ F (ball c σ))
    (hvalues : ∀ w : Disk c σ, f w = F w) :
    restrictionCLM c hr (derivativeCLM c hgap f) =
      derivativeCLM c (hr.trans_lt hgap) f

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.restrictionCLM_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem restrictionCLM_apply (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (h : ρ ≤ σ)
    (f : C(Disk c σ, E)) (z : Disk c ρ) :
    restrictionCLM c h f z = f ⟨z.1, closedBall_subset_closedBall h z.2⟩

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.restrictionCLM_comp
statement:
theorem restrictionCLM_comp (c : ℂ) {r ρ σ : ℝ} (h₁ : r ≤ ρ) (h₂ : ρ ≤ σ) :

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.translated_mem
statement:
theorem translated_mem (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (hgap : ρ < σ)

name: NavierStokes.CompactSmoothFamily.contDiffOn_family_nat
statement:
theorem contDiffOn_family_nat (K : Set Z) [CompactSpace K] (U : Set P) (V : Set Z)

name: NavierStokes.CompactSmoothFamily.family_apply_of_joint
NavierStokes.CompactSmoothFamily.flipCLM_apply
statement:
theorem flipCLM_apply (K : Set Z) [CompactSpace K]
    (g : C(K, P →L[ℝ] E)) (v : P) (z : K) :
    flipCLM (P := P) (E := E) K g v z = g z v

name: NavierStokes.CompactSmoothFamily.hasFDerivAt_family
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_family (K : Set Z) [CompactSpace K] {U : Set P} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (F : P × Z → E) (G : P × Z → P →L[ℝ] E)
    (hF : ContinuousOn F (U ×ˢ K)) (hG : ContinuousOn G (U ×ˢ K))
    (hderiv : ∀ p ∈ U, ∀ z : K, HasFDerivAt (fun q => F (q, z)) (G (p, z)) p)
    {p : P} (hp : p ∈ U) :
    HasFDerivAt (family K F) (flipCLM (P := P) (E := E) K (family K G p)) p

name: NavierStokes.CompactSmoothFamily.iteratedFDeriv_family_apply
statement:
theorem iteratedFDeriv_family_apply (K : Set Z) [CompactSpace K] (U : Set P) (V : Set Z)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V) (hK : K ⊆ V)
    (F : P × Z → E) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (U ×ˢ V))
    {p : P} (hp : p ∈ U) (k : ℕ) (v : Fin k → P) (z : K) :

      iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun q => F (q, z)) p v

statement:

name: NavierStokes.AxisHolomorphicJoint.diskProfile_norm_sub_le
statement:
theorem diskProfile_norm_sub_le (I : Window) {ε R s : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)

    (c : ℂ) (σ : ℝ) (hK : closedBall c σ ⊆ parameterStrip I (ε * (1 - s)))
    (k : ℕ) {Y Y' : ℝ} (hY : |Y| < R) (hY' : |Y'| < R) :
    ‖diskProfile I ε A c σ k Y' - diskProfile I ε A c σ k Y‖ ≤
      ((2 * jetConstant R s (k + 1)) * ‖A‖) * ‖Y' - Y‖

name: NavierStokes.AxisHolomorphicJoint.exists_common_joint_extension
statement:
theorem exists_common_joint_extension (I J : Window) (hleft : I.left < J.left)
    (hright : J.right < I.right) {ε R : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hR20 : R < 20) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∃ S : ℝ, R < S ∧ S < 20 ∧ ∃ B : ℕ → ℝ,
      (∀ k, 0 ≤ B k) ∧ ∀ (A : AxisSpace I ε) (k : ℕ),
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => complexProfile I ε A k p.1 p.2)
          (Ioo (-S) S ×ˢ parameterTube J δ) ∧
        ∀ Y : ℝ, |Y| ≤ R →
          AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (complexProfile I ε A k Y) (parameterTube J δ) ∧
          (∀ z ∈ parameterTube J δ, ‖complexProfile I ε A k Y z‖ ≤ B k * ‖A‖) ∧
          (∀ z ∈ parameterTube J δ,
            iteratedDeriv k (fun y => complexProfile I ε A 0 y z) Y =
              complexProfile I ε A k Y z) ∧
          (∀ (m : ℕ) (x : ℝ), x ∈ J.interval →
            iteratedDeriv m (complexProfile I ε A k Y) (x : ℂ) =
              (mixedSeries I ε A k m (Y, x) : ℂ))

name: NavierStokes.ActivationHolomorphic.InitialTube.natural_all_radial_jets
statement:
theorem InitialTube.natural_all_radial_jets {N : ReferencePath.Input} {h R : ℝ} {P0 : ℝ → ℝ} {Ω : Set ℂ}
    (E : InitialTube N h P0 R Ω) (k : ℕ) :
    Regular (Ioo (-R) R) Ω (radialJet E.natural.f k) ∧
    Regular (Ioo (-R) R) Ω (radialJet E.natural.U k) ∧
    Regular (Ioo (-R) R) Ω (radialJet (average E.natural.U) k) ∧

name: NavierStokes.ActivationHolomorphic.InitialTube.natural_real_profiles
statement:
theorem InitialTube.natural_real_profiles {h j σ Λ C : ℝ} {P0 : ℝ → ℝ}
    {d : AnalyticInputs h j σ P0} (F : CoefficientProfile d Λ C) (hΛ : 0 < Λ)
    {R : ℝ} {Ω : Set ℂ} (E : InitialTube (ReferenceJetBounds.referenceInput F hΛ) h P0 R Ω)
    {p : ProfileHistories.Point} (hp : p ∈ NaturalProfile.domain Λ) :
    E.natural.f (p.1,(p.2 : ℂ)) = (F.family.f p : ℂ) ∧
    E.natural.U (p.1,(p.2 : ℂ)) = (F.family.U p : ℂ) ∧
    average E.natural.U (p.1,(p.2 : ℂ)) = (F.family.Ubar p : ℂ) ∧
    pressure E.pressure0 E.natural.f (p.1,(p.2 : ℂ)) = (F.family.Pi p : ℂ)

name: NavierStokes.ActivationHolomorphic.InitialTube.natural_regular
statement:
theorem InitialTube.natural_regular {N : ReferencePath.Input} {h R : ℝ} {P0 : ℝ → ℝ} {Ω : Set ℂ}
    (E : InitialTube N h P0 R Ω) :
    Regular (Ioo (-R) R) Ω E.natural.f ∧
    Regular (Ioo (-R) R) Ω E.natural.U ∧
    Regular (Ioo (-R) R) Ω (average E.natural.U) ∧
    Regular (Ioo (-R) R) Ω (pressure E.pressure0 E.natural.f)

name: NavierStokes.ActivationHolomorphic.InitialTube.real_profiles
statement:
theorem real_profiles {T δ : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hδT : 2*δ < ReferencePath.rampLimit) (κ : ℝ) (hP0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ P0)
    (x : ℝ) {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ ReferencePath.parameterInterval) :
    let P := StressActivation.FromReference.histories N hT hδ hδT κ P0 hP0
    E.f T κ δ (x,(η : ℂ)) = (P.f (x,η) : ℂ) ∧
    E.U T κ δ (x,(η : ℂ)) = (P.U (x,η) : ℂ) ∧
    E.Ubar T κ δ (x,(η : ℂ)) = (P.Ubar (x,η) : ℂ) ∧
    E.Pi T κ δ (x,(η : ℂ)) = (P.pressure (x,η) : ℂ)

name: NavierStokes.ActivationHolomorphic.InitialTube.real_radial_jets
statement:
theorem InitialTube.real_radial_jets {N : ReferencePath.Input} {h R : ℝ} {P0 : ℝ → ℝ} {Ω : Set ℂ}
    (E : InitialTube N h P0 R Ω) {T δ : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hδT : 2*δ < ReferencePath.rampLimit) (κ : ℝ) (hP0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ P0)
    (k : ℕ) {x η : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Ioi (-R)) (hη : η ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    let P := StressActivation.FromReference.histories N hT hδ hδT κ P0 hP0
    radialJet (E.f T κ δ) k (x,(η : ℂ)) = ((iteratedDeriv k (fun y => P.f (y,η)) x : ℝ) : ℂ) ∧
    radialJet (E.U T κ δ) k (x,(η : ℂ)) = ((iteratedDeriv k (fun y => P.U (y,η)) x : ℝ) : ℂ) ∧
    radialJet (E.Ubar T κ δ) k (x,(η : ℂ)) = ((iteratedDeriv k (fun y => P.Ubar (y,η)) x : ℝ) : ℂ) ∧
    radialJet (E.Pi T κ δ) k (x,(η : ℂ)) = ((iteratedDeriv k (fun y => P.pressure (y,η)) x : ℝ) : ℂ)

name: NavierStokes.ActivationHolomorphic.InitialTube.reference_all_radial_jets
statement:
theorem InitialTube.reference_all_radial_jets {N : ReferencePath.Input} {h R : ℝ} {P0 : ℝ → ℝ} {Ω : Set ℂ}
    (E : InitialTube N h P0 R Ω) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδT : 2*δ < ReferencePath.rampLimit) (k : ℕ) :
    Regular (Ioi (-R)) Ω (radialJet (E.natural.refF δ) k) ∧
    Regular (Ioi (-R)) Ω (radialJet (E.natural.refU δ) k) ∧
    Regular (Ioi (-R)) Ω (radialJet (average (E.natural.refU δ)) k) ∧
    Regular (Ioi (-R)) Ω (radialJet (pressure E.pressure0 (E.natural.refF δ)) k)

name: NavierStokes.ActivationHolomorphic.InitialTube.reference_real_profiles
statement:
theorem reference_real_profiles {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδT : 2*δ < ReferencePath.rampLimit)
    (hP0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ P0) (x : ℝ) {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ ReferencePath.parameterInterval) :
    let P := N.histories hδ hδT P0 hP0
    E.natural.refF δ (x,(η : ℂ)) = (P.f (x,η) : ℂ) ∧
    E.natural.refU δ (x,(η : ℂ)) = (P.U (x,η) : ℂ) ∧
    average (E.natural.refU δ) (x,(η : ℂ)) = (P.Ubar (x,η) : ℂ) ∧
    pressure E.pressure0 (E.natural.refF δ) (x,(η : ℂ)) = (P.pressure (x,η) : ℂ)

theorem signed_regular {T δ : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (hδ : 0 < δ)

      Regular (Ioo (-(5/Λ)) (5/Λ)) Ω (naturalU F) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) ((41/10)/Λ), ∀ z ∈ Ω, 0 < (naturalF F (x,z)).re

statement:
theorem complex_pressure_sign (A c : ℂ) (hc : c ≠ 0) :

name: NavierStokes.TangentProjection.damping_dissipative
statement:
theorem damping_dissipative (δ : ℝ) (t : E) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) :
    ⟪t, -δ • t⟫_ℝ ≤ 0

name: NavierStokes.TangentProjection.differentiated_tangency
statement:
theorem differentiated_tangency {n t : ℝ → E} {n' t' : E} {x : ℝ}
    (hn : HasDerivAt n n' x) (ht : HasDerivAt t t' x)
    (htangent : ∀ y, ⟪n y, t y⟫_ℝ = 0) :
    ⟪n x, t'⟫_ℝ = -⟪n', t x⟫_ℝ

name: NavierStokes.TangentProjection.normal_projectedRhs
statement:
theorem normal_projectedRhs {n : E} (hn : n ≠ 0) (n' t Kt f : E) (δ : ℝ) :
    ⟪n, projectedRhs n n' t Kt f δ⟫_ℝ = -⟪n', t⟫_ℝ - δ * ⟪n, t⟫_ℝ

name: NavierStokes.TangentProjection.normal_projectedRhs_of_tangent
statement:
theorem normal_projectedRhs_of_tangent {n : E} (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (n' t Kt f : E) (δ : ℝ) (ht : ⟪n, t⟫_ℝ = 0) :
    ⟪n, projectedRhs n n' t Kt f δ⟫_ℝ = -⟪n', t⟫_ℝ

name: NavierStokes.TangentProjection.pressure_cancellation
statement:
theorem pressure_cancellation (n n' t Kt f : E) (δ : ℝ) :
    projectedRhs n n' t Kt f δ + Kt + δ • t -
      pressureCoefficient n n' t Kt f • n = -f

name: NavierStokes.TangentProjection.projected_balance
statement:
theorem projected_balance (n n' t Kt f : E) (δ : ℝ) :
    projectedRhs n n' t Kt f δ + Kt + δ • t + f =
      pressureCoefficient n n' t Kt f • n

name: NavierStokes.TangentProjection.scalar_defect_zero
statement:
theorem scalar_defect_zero (h δ D : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hD : ∀ x, HasDerivAt D (δ x) x)
    (hh : ∀ x, HasDerivAt h (-δ x * h x) x)
    (x₀ : ℝ) (hzero : h x₀ = 0) : ∀ x, h x = 0

name: NavierStokes.TangentProjection.tangency_defect_derivative
statement:
theorem tangency_defect_derivative {n t : ℝ → E} {n' : E} {x : ℝ}
    {Kt f : E} {δ : ℝ} (hn0 : n x ≠ 0)
    (hn : HasDerivAt n n' x)
    (ht : HasDerivAt t (projectedRhs (n x) n' (t x) Kt f δ) x) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => ⟪n y, t y⟫_ℝ) (-δ * ⟪n x, t x⟫_ℝ) x

name: NavierStokes.TangentProjection.tangency_preserved
statement:
theorem tangency_preserved (n n' t Kt f : ℝ → E) (δ D : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hn0 : ∀ x, n x ≠ 0)
    (hn : ∀ x, HasDerivAt n (n' x) x)
    (ht : ∀ x, HasDerivAt t (projectedRhs (n x) (n' x) (t x) (Kt x) (f x) (δ x)) x)
    (hD : ∀ x, HasDerivAt D (δ x) x)
    (x₀ : ℝ) (hzero : ⟪n x₀, t x₀⟫_ℝ = 0) : ∀ x, ⟪n x, t x⟫_ℝ = 0

name: NavierStokes.TangentProjection.tangentProj_idempotent
statement:
theorem tangentProj_idempotent {n : E} (hn : n ≠ 0) (f : E) :

name: NavierStokes.TangentProjection.tangentProj_normal
statement:
theorem tangentProj_normal {n : E} (hn : n ≠ 0) (f : E) :

name: NavierStokes.TangentProjection.tangentProj_of_tangent
statement:
theorem tangentProj_of_tangent (n f : E) (hf : ⟪n, f⟫_ℝ = 0) :

name: NavierStokes.TangentProjection.viscous_coefficient_nonneg
statement:
theorem viscous_coefficient_nonneg (ε k j : ℝ) (n : E) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) :

name: NavierStokes.TangentODE.IntervalSystem.continuous_composeField
statement:
theorem continuous_composeField (f : C(Icc v.left v.right, E)) :

name: NavierStokes.TangentODE.IntervalSystem.continuous_proj
statement: theorem continuous_proj : Continuous v.proj

name: NavierStokes.TangentODE.IntervalSystem.dist_iterate_next_apply_le
statement:
theorem dist_iterate_next_apply_le (f g : C(Icc v.left v.right, E))
    (n : ℕ) (t : Icc v.left v.right) :
    dist (v.next^[n] f t) (v.next^[n] g t) ≤
      (v.lip * |t.1 - v.left|) ^ n / n ! * dist f g

name: NavierStokes.TangentODE.IntervalSystem.dist_iterate_next_le
statement:
theorem dist_iterate_next_le (f g : C(Icc v.left v.right, E)) (n : ℕ) :
    dist (v.next^[n] f) (v.next^[n] g) ≤
      (v.lip * (v.right - v.left)) ^ n / n ! * dist f g

name: NavierStokes.TangentODE.IntervalSystem.dist_next_apply_le_of_le
statement:
theorem dist_next_apply_le_of_le {f g : C(Icc v.left v.right, E)} {n : ℕ} {d : ℝ}
    (h : ∀ t, dist (f t) (g t) ≤ (v.lip * |t.1 - v.left|) ^ n / n ! * d)
    (t : Icc v.left v.right) :
    dist (v.next f t) (v.next g t) ≤
      (v.lip * |t.1 - v.left|) ^ (n + 1) / (n + 1)! * d

name: NavierStokes.TangentODE.IntervalSystem.exists_contracting_iterate
statement:
theorem exists_contracting_iterate :
    ∃ (N : ℕ) (K : ℝ≥0), ContractingWith K v.next^[N]

name: NavierStokes.TangentODE.IntervalSystem.exists_fixed
statement: theorem exists_fixed : ∃ f : C(Icc v.left v.right, E), v.next f = f

name: NavierStokes.TangentODE.IntervalSystem.exists_solution
statement:
theorem exists_solution :
    ∃ u : ℝ → E, u v.left = v.initial ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Icc v.left v.right, HasDerivAt u (v.field t (u t)) t

name: NavierStokes.TangentODE.IntervalSystem.hasDerivAt_integralCurve
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_integralCurve (f : C(Icc v.left v.right, E)) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (v.integralCurve f) (v.composeField f t) t

name: NavierStokes.TangentODE.IntervalSystem.integrable_composeField
statement:
theorem integrable_composeField (f : C(Icc v.left v.right, E)) (a b : ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.TangentODE.IntervalSystem.next_apply
statement:
theorem next_apply (f : C(Icc v.left v.right, E)) (t : Icc v.left v.right) :
    v.next f t = v.initial + ∫ s in v.left..t, v.composeField f s

name: NavierStokes.TangentODE.IntervalSystem.proj_coe
statement: theorem proj_coe (t : Icc v.left v.right) : v.proj t = t

name: NavierStokes.TangentODE.IntervalSystem.proj_of_mem

theorem proj_of_mem {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Icc v.left v.right) :

name: NavierStokes.TangentODE.continuousOn_projectedForcing
statement:
theorem continuousOn_projectedForcing {s : Set ℝ}
    (n f : ℝ → H) (hn : ContinuousOn n s) (hf : ContinuousOn f s)
    (hn0 : ∀ t ∈ s, n t ≠ 0) :
    ContinuousOn (fun t => -TangentProjection.tangentProj (n t) (f t)) s

name: NavierStokes.TangentODE.continuousOn_projectedOperator
statement:
theorem continuousOn_projectedOperator {s : Set ℝ}
    (n n' : ℝ → H) (K : ℝ → H →L[ℝ] H) (δ : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hn : ContinuousOn n s) (hn' : ContinuousOn n' s)
    (hK : ContinuousOn K s) (hδ : ContinuousOn δ s)
    (hn0 : ∀ t ∈ s, n t ≠ 0) :
    ContinuousOn (fun t => projectedOperator (n t) (n' t) (K t) (δ t)) s

name: NavierStokes.TangentODE.exists_linear_solution
statement:
theorem exists_linear_solution {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (A : ℝ → E →L[ℝ] E) (g : ℝ → E)
    (hA : ContinuousOn A (Icc a b)) (hg : ContinuousOn g (Icc a b)) (x₀ : E) :
    ∃ u : ℝ → E, u a = x₀ ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, HasDerivAt u (A t (u t) + g t) t

name: NavierStokes.TangentODE.exists_projected_solution
statement:
theorem exists_projected_solution {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (n n' f : ℝ → H) (K : ℝ → H →L[ℝ] H) (δ : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hn : ContinuousOn n (Icc a b)) (hn' : ContinuousOn n' (Icc a b))
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b)) (hK : ContinuousOn K (Icc a b))
    (hδ : ContinuousOn δ (Icc a b)) (hn0 : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, n t ≠ 0)
    (x₀ : H) :
    ∃ u : ℝ → H, u a = x₀ ∧ ∀ t ∈ Icc a b,
      HasDerivAt u (TangentProjection.projectedRhs (n t) (n' t) (u t)
        (K t (u t)) (f t) (δ t)) t

name: NavierStokes.TangentODE.exists_unique_tangent_solution
statement:
theorem exists_unique_tangent_solution {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (n n' f : ℝ → H) (K : ℝ → H →L[ℝ] H) (δ : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hn : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, HasDerivAt n (n' t) t)
    (hn' : ContinuousOn n' (Icc a b)) (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b))
    (hK : ContinuousOn K (Icc a b)) (hδ : ContinuousOn δ (Icc a b))
    (hn0 : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, n t ≠ 0) (x₀ : H) (hx₀ : ⟪n a, x₀⟫_ℝ = 0) :
    ∃ u : ℝ → H, u a = x₀ ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Icc a b, HasDerivAt u
        (TangentProjection.projectedRhs (n t) (n' t) (u t) (K t (u t)) (f t) (δ t)) t) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Icc a b, ⟪n t, u t⟫_ℝ = 0) ∧
      ∀ w : ℝ → H, w a = x₀ →
        (∀ t ∈ Icc a b, HasDerivAt w
          (TangentProjection.projectedRhs (n t) (n' t) (w t) (K t (w t)) (f t) (δ t)) t) →
        EqOn w u (Icc a b)

name: NavierStokes.TangentODE.linear_solution_unique
statement:
theorem linear_solution_unique {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (A : ℝ → E →L[ℝ] E) (g : ℝ → E) (hA : ContinuousOn A (Icc a b))
    {u w : ℝ → E}
    (hu : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, HasDerivAt u (A t (u t) + g t) t)
    (hw : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, HasDerivAt w (A t (w t) + g t) t)
    (hinit : u a = w a) : EqOn u w (Icc a b)

name: NavierStokes.TangentODE.linear_uniform_lipschitz
statement:
theorem linear_uniform_lipschitz {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (A : ℝ → E →L[ℝ] E) (g : ℝ → E) (hA : ContinuousOn A (Icc a b)) :
    ∃ L : ℝ≥0, ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, LipschitzWith L (fun x => A t x + g t)

name: NavierStokes.TangentODE.projectedOperator_apply
statement:
theorem projectedOperator_apply (n n' x f : H) (K : H →L[ℝ] H) (δ : ℝ) :
    projectedOperator n n' K δ x - TangentProjection.tangentProj n f =
      TangentProjection.projectedRhs n n' x (K x) f δ

name: NavierStokes.TangentODE.projected_solution_unique
statement:
theorem projected_solution_unique {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (n n' f : ℝ → H) (K : ℝ → H →L[ℝ] H) (δ : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hn : ContinuousOn n (Icc a b)) (hn' : ContinuousOn n' (Icc a b))
    (hK : ContinuousOn K (Icc a b)) (hδ : ContinuousOn δ (Icc a b))
    (hn0 : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, n t ≠ 0) {u w : ℝ → H}
    (hu : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, HasDerivAt u
      (TangentProjection.projectedRhs (n t) (n' t) (u t) (K t (u t)) (f t) (δ t)) t)
    (hw : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, HasDerivAt w
      (TangentProjection.projectedRhs (n t) (n' t) (w t) (K t (w t)) (f t) (δ t)) t)
    (hinit : u a = w a) : EqOn u w (Icc a b)

name: NavierStokes.TangentODE.projected_tangency_preserved
statement:
theorem projected_tangency_preserved {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (n n' f u : ℝ → H) (K : ℝ → H →L[ℝ] H) (δ : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hδ : ContinuousOn δ (Icc a b)) (hn0 : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, n t ≠ 0)
    (hn : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, HasDerivAt n (n' t) t)
    (hu : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, HasDerivAt u
      (TangentProjection.projectedRhs (n t) (n' t) (u t) (K t (u t)) (f t) (δ t)) t)
    (hinit : ⟪n a, u a⟫_ℝ = 0) : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, ⟪n t, u t⟫_ℝ = 0

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.affine_iterate_sub
statement:
theorem affine_iterate_sub (L : X →L[ℝ] X) (g : X) (n : ℕ) (u w : X) :
    (fun x => g + L x)^[n] u - (fun x => g + L x)^[n] w =
      L^[n] u - L^[n] w

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.coefficientAction_apply
statement:
theorem coefficientAction_apply (A : Coefficient a b E) (u : Curve a b E) (t : Icc a b) :
    coefficientAction (E := E) A u t = A t (u t)

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.contDiffOn_solution_family
statement:
theorem contDiffOn_solution_family {s : Set P}
    (A : P → Coefficient a b E) (x₀ : P → E) (f : P → Curve a b E)
    (hA : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ A s) (hx₀ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ x₀ s)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f s) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p => solution hab (A p) (x₀ p) (f p)) s

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.contDiff_inverse_family
statement:
theorem contDiff_inverse_family {X Q : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X] [CompleteSpace X]
    [NormedAddCommGroup Q] [NormedSpace ℝ Q]
    (L : Q → X →L[ℝ] X) (hL : ContDiff ℝ ∞ L) (hInv : ∀ q, (L q).IsInvertible) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun q => (L q).inverse)

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.contDiff_resolvent
statement: theorem contDiff_resolvent : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (resolvent (E := E) hab)

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.contDiff_solution_family
statement:
theorem contDiff_solution_family (A : P → Coefficient a b E) (x₀ : P → E)
    (f : P → Curve a b E) (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (hx₀ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ x₀)
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p => solution hab (A p) (x₀ p) (f p))

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.continuous_extend
statement: theorem continuous_extend (f : Curve a b E) : Continuous (extend hab f)

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.equationOperator_isInvertible
statement:
theorem equationOperator_isInvertible (A : Coefficient a b E) :
    (equationOperator hab A).IsInvertible

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.extend_coe
statement: theorem extend_coe (f : Curve a b E) (t : Icc a b) : extend hab f t = f t

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.fderiv_resolvent_family
statement:
theorem fderiv_resolvent_family (A : P → Coefficient a b E) (g : P → Curve a b E)
    {p : P} {A' : P →L[ℝ] Coefficient a b E} {g' : P →L[ℝ] Curve a b E}
    (hA : HasFDerivAt A A' p) (hg : HasFDerivAt g g' p) (v : P) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun q => resolvent hab (A q) (g q)) p v =
      resolvent hab (A p) (g' v + volterra (E := E) hab (A' v)
        (resolvent hab (A p) (g p)))

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.id_sub_isInvertible
statement:
theorem id_sub_isInvertible (L : X →L[ℝ] X)
    (hL : ∃ (N : ℕ) (K : ℝ≥0), ContractingWith K L^[N]) :
    (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ X - L).IsInvertible

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.integrator_apply
statement:
theorem integrator_apply (f : Curve a b E) (t : Icc a b) :
    integrator hab f t = ∫ s in a..(t : ℝ), extend hab f s

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.norm_applyCoefficient_le
statement:
theorem norm_applyCoefficient_le (A : Coefficient a b E) (u : Curve a b E) :
    ‖applyCoefficient A u‖ ≤ ‖A‖ * ‖u‖

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.norm_constantCurve_le
statement:
theorem norm_constantCurve_le (x : E) :
    ‖constantCurve (a := a) (b := b) x‖ ≤ ‖x‖

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.norm_integralPath_le
statement:
theorem norm_integralPath_le (f : Curve a b E) :
    ‖integralPath hab f‖ ≤ (b - a) * ‖f‖

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.norm_parameter_derivative_le
statement:
theorem norm_parameter_derivative_le
    (A : P → Coefficient a b E) (x₀ : P → E) (f : P → Curve a b E)
    {p : P} {A' : P →L[ℝ] Coefficient a b E} {x₀' : P →L[ℝ] E}
    {f' : P →L[ℝ] Curve a b E}
    (hA : HasFDerivAt A A' p) (hx₀ : HasFDerivAt x₀ x₀' p)
    (hf : HasFDerivAt f f' p) (v : P) :
    ‖fderiv ℝ (fun q => solution hab (A q) (x₀ q) (f q)) p v‖ ≤
      ‖resolvent hab (A p)‖ * (‖x₀' v‖ + (b - a) *
        (‖A' v‖ * ‖solution hab (A p) (x₀ p) (f p)‖ + ‖f' v‖))

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.norm_solution_le
statement:
theorem norm_solution_le (A : Coefficient a b E) (x₀ : E) (f : Curve a b E) :
    ‖solution hab A x₀ f‖ ≤ ‖resolvent hab A‖ * (‖x₀‖ + (b - a) * ‖f‖)

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.norm_source_le
statement:
theorem norm_source_le (x₀ : E) (f : Curve a b E) :
    ‖source hab x₀ f‖ ≤ ‖x₀‖ + (b - a) * ‖f‖

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.norm_volterra_apply_le
statement:
theorem norm_volterra_apply_le (A : Coefficient a b E) (u : Curve a b E) :
    ‖volterra (E := E) hab A u‖ ≤ (b - a) * ‖A‖ * ‖u‖

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.parameter_derivative_eq_solution
statement:
theorem parameter_derivative_eq_solution
    (A : P → Coefficient a b E) (x₀ : P → E) (f : P → Curve a b E)
    {p : P} {A' : P →L[ℝ] Coefficient a b E} {x₀' : P →L[ℝ] E}
    {f' : P →L[ℝ] Curve a b E}
    (hA : HasFDerivAt A A' p) (hx₀ : HasFDerivAt x₀ x₀' p)
    (hf : HasFDerivAt f f' p) (v : P) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun q => solution hab (A q) (x₀ q) (f q)) p v =
      solution hab (A p) (x₀' v)
        (applyCoefficient (A' v) (solution hab (A p) (x₀ p) (f p)) + f' v)

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.parameter_derivative_hasDerivWithinAt
statement:
theorem parameter_derivative_hasDerivWithinAt
    (A : P → Coefficient a b E) (x₀ : P → E) (f : P → Curve a b E)
    {p : P} {A' : P →L[ℝ] Coefficient a b E} {x₀' : P →L[ℝ] E}
    {f' : P →L[ℝ] Curve a b E}
    (hA : HasFDerivAt A A' p) (hx₀ : HasFDerivAt x₀ x₀' p)
    (hf : HasFDerivAt f f' p) (v : P) (t : Icc a b) :
    HasDerivWithinAt
      (extend hab (fderiv ℝ (fun q => solution hab (A q) (x₀ q) (f q)) p v))
      (A p t ((fderiv ℝ (fun q => solution hab (A q) (x₀ q) (f q)) p v) t) +
        A' v t (solution hab (A p) (x₀ p) (f p) t) + f' v t) (Icc a b) t

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.parameter_derivatives_bounded_on_compact
statement:
theorem parameter_derivatives_bounded_on_compact
    (A : P → Coefficient a b E) (x₀ : P → E) (f : P → Curve a b E)
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (hx₀ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ x₀) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    {s : Set P} (hs : IsCompact s) (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ s,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun q => solution hab (A q) (x₀ q) (f q)) p‖ ≤ C

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.resolvent_equation
statement:
theorem resolvent_equation (A : Coefficient a b E) (g : Curve a b E) :
    equationOperator hab A (resolvent hab A g) = g

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.solutionExtension_coe
statement:
theorem solutionExtension_coe (A : Coefficient a b E) (x₀ : E)
    (f : Curve a b E) (t : Icc a b) :
    solutionExtension hab A x₀ f t = solution hab A x₀ f t

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.solutionExtension_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem solutionExtension_hasDerivAt (A : Coefficient a b E) (x₀ : E)
    (f : Curve a b E) (t : Icc a b) :
    HasDerivAt (solutionExtension hab A x₀ f)
      (A t (solutionExtension hab A x₀ f t) + f t) t

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.solution_hasDerivWithinAt
statement:
theorem solution_hasDerivWithinAt (A : Coefficient a b E) (x₀ : E)
    (f : Curve a b E) (t : Icc a b) :
    HasDerivWithinAt (extend hab (solution hab A x₀ f))
      (A t (solution hab A x₀ f t) + f t) (Icc a b) t

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.solution_initial
statement:
theorem solution_initial (A : Coefficient a b E) (x₀ : E) (f : Curve a b E) :

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.solution_integralEquation
statement:
theorem solution_integralEquation (A : Coefficient a b E) (x₀ : E) (f : Curve a b E) :
    solution hab A x₀ f = constantCurve x₀ +
      integrator hab (applyCoefficient A (solution hab A x₀ f) + f)

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.volterra_apply
statement:
theorem volterra_apply (A : Coefficient a b E) (u : Curve a b E) (t : Icc a b) :
    volterra (E := E) hab A u t =

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.volterra_contracting_iterate
statement:
theorem volterra_contracting_iterate (A : Coefficient a b E) :

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.volterra_eq_next
statement:
theorem volterra_eq_next (A : Coefficient a b E) :

name: NavierStokes.SmoothPathFamily.hasFDerivAt_pathFamily

    (hG : ContinuousOn G (U ×ˢ Icc a b))

name: NavierStokes.SmoothPathFamily.iteratedFDeriv_pathFamily_apply

name: NavierStokes.SmoothPathFamily.odeFamily_hasDerivWithinAt
statement:
theorem odeFamily_hasDerivWithinAt (U : Set P) (V : Set ℝ)

    (hcolor : ∀ i j, Adj i j → color i ≠ color j)
    (hlevel : ∀ i j, Adj i j → level i ≤ level j + D ∧ level j ≤ level i + D) :
    ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∀ i j, Adj i j →
      Disjoint
        (liftedSupport (level i) (orientedRectangle (center m D (color i)) a b (2 * r)))
        (liftedSupport (level j) (orientedRectangle (center m D (color j)) a b (2 * r)))

name: NavierStokes.SlotGeometry.exists_common_radius
statement:
theorem exists_common_radius (m D : ℕ) :
    ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧
      (∀ n ≤ D, ∀ i j : Fin m, 0 < n ∨ i ≠ j →
        ∀ x ∈ rectangle (center m D i) (2 * r),
        ∀ y ∈ rectangle (center m D j) (2 * r), ¬ torusEq ((cover ^ n) x) y) ∧
      (∀ n ≤ D, ∀ i : Fin m,
        ∀ x ∈ rectangle (center m D i) (2 * r),
        ∀ y ∈ rectangle (center m D i) (2 * r),
          torusEq ((cover ^ n) x) ((cover ^ n) y) → x = y)

      0 < n ∨ i ≠ j →
      Disjoint (liftedSupport level (rectangle (center m D i) (2 * r)))
        (liftedSupport (level + n) (rectangle (center m D j) (2 * r)))

name: NavierStokes.SlotGeometry.exists_oriented_slots

        Disjoint (liftedSupport level (orientedRectangle (center m D i) a b (2 * r)))
          (liftedSupport (level + n) (orientedRectangle (center m D j) a b (2 * r)))) ∧
      (∀ n ≤ D, ∀ i : Fin m,
        ∀ x ∈ orientedRectangle (center m D i) a b (2 * r),
        ∀ y ∈ orientedRectangle (center m D i) a b (2 * r),
          torusEq ((cover ^ n) x) ((cover ^ n) y) → x = y)

name: NavierStokes.Covariance.determinant_ne_zero
statement:
theorem determinant_ne_zero {a b scaleMinus scalePlus : ℝ}

    (hratio : |c * t / m| < u / Real.sqrt (1 + u ^ 2)) :
    ∃ velocity : Fin 2 → ℝ,
      (∀ i, 0 < velocity i) ∧

    (hG : ∀ i j, ContinuousOn (fun x => G x i j) K)
    (hT : ∀ i, ContinuousOn (fun x => T x i) K)
    (hcone : ∀ x ∈ K, SmoothCovariance.StrictCone (G x) (T x)) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ i,
      δ * edge (σ - κ i) x ≤ inverseCoefficients σ κ G T x i ∧
      δ * edge ((σ - κ i) / 2) x ≤ primaryAmplitude σ κ G T x i

name: NavierStokes.FlatCovariance.signedAmplitude_factor
statement:
theorem signedAmplitude_factor (σ τ : ℝ) (κ : Vec2)
    (G : ℝ → Mat2) (T R : ℝ → Vec2) {x : ℝ} (hG : (G x).det ≠ 0) (i : Fin 2) :
    signedAmplitude σ τ κ G T R x i = edge (τ - (σ + κ i) / 2) x *
      (SmoothCovariance.weights (G x) (R x) i /
        (2 * SmoothCovariance.amplitudes (G x) (T x) i))

name: NavierStokes.FlatCovariance.signedAmplitude_of_nonpos
statement:
theorem signedAmplitude_of_nonpos (σ τ : ℝ) (κ : Vec2)
    (G : ℝ → Mat2) (T R : ℝ → Vec2) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≤ 0) (i : Fin 2) :
    signedAmplitude σ τ κ G T R x i = 0

name: NavierStokes.FlatCovariance.signedAmplitude_target_factor
statement:
theorem signedAmplitude_target_factor (σ τ : ℝ) (κ : Vec2)
    (G : ℝ → Mat2) (T R : ℝ → Vec2) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) (i : Fin 2) :
    signedAmplitude σ τ κ G T (fun y j => f y * R y j) x i =
      f x * signedAmplitude σ τ κ G T R x i

name: NavierStokes.FlatCovariance.signed_cross_reconstruct
NavierStokes.FlatCovariance.signed_inverse_power_target_contDiffOn
statement:
theorem signed_inverse_power_target_contDiffOn
    (hG : ∀ i j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) s)
    (hT : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => T x i) s)
    (hR : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => R x i) s)
    (hcone : ∀ x ∈ s, SmoothCovariance.StrictCone (G x) (T x))
    (hgap : ∀ i, (σ + κ i) / 2 < τ) (i : Fin 2) (loss : ℕ) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => signedAmplitude σ τ κ G T
      (fun y j => (y ^ loss)⁻¹ * R y j) x i) s

name: NavierStokes.FlatCovariance.signed_normal_contDiffOn
statement:
theorem signed_normal_contDiffOn
    (hG : ∀ i j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) s)
    (hT : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => T x i) s)
    (hR : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => R x i) s)
    (hcone : ∀ x ∈ s, SmoothCovariance.StrictCone (G x) (T x)) (i : Fin 2) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => SmoothCovariance.weights (G x) (R x) i /
      (2 * SmoothCovariance.amplitudes (G x) (T x) i)) s

name: NavierStokes.FlatCovariance.signed_weighted_derivatives_zero
statement:
theorem signed_weighted_derivatives_zero
    (hG : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j))
    (hT : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => T x i))
    (hR : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => R x i))
    (hcone : ∀ x, SmoothCovariance.StrictCone (G x) (T x))
    (hgap : ∀ i, (σ + κ i) / 2 < τ) (i : Fin 2) (loss n : ℕ) :
    iteratedDeriv n (fun x => signedAmplitude σ τ κ G T R x i / x ^ loss) 0 = 0

name: NavierStokes.FlatCovariance.squared_factors_smooth
statement:
theorem squared_factors_smooth {lam : Vec2}
    (hG : ∀ i j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) s)
    (hT : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => T x i) s)
    (hR : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => R x i) s)
    (hcone : ∀ x ∈ s, SmoothCovariance.StrictCone (G x) (T x))
    (hgap : ∀ i, lam i < σ / 2) (i : Fin 2) (loss : ℕ) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => primaryAmplitude σ (fun j => 2 * lam j) G T x i / x ^ loss) s ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => signedAmplitude σ σ (fun j => 2 * lam j) G T R x i / x ^ loss) s

name: NavierStokes.GaussianEnvelope.envelope_lt_one_away_from_midpoint
statement:
theorem envelope_lt_one_away_from_midpoint {D : Set ℝ} {rate : ℝ → ℝ}
    {midpoint time c C ell : ℝ} (hD : Convex ℝ D)
    (hcont : ContinuousOn rate D)
    (hdiff : DifferentiableOn ℝ rate (interior D))
    (hderiv : ∀ x ∈ interior D,
      -C / ell ≤ deriv rate x ∧ deriv rate x ≤ -c / ell)
    (hm : midpoint ∈ D) (ht : time ∈ D) (hzero : rate midpoint = 0)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hell : 0 < ell) (hne : time ≠ midpoint) :
    envelope rate midpoint time < 1

name: NavierStokes.GaussianEnvelope.gaussian_envelope_bounds
statement:
theorem gaussian_envelope_bounds {D : Set ℝ} {rate : ℝ → ℝ}
    {midpoint time c C ell : ℝ} (hD : Convex ℝ D)
    (hcont : ContinuousOn rate D)
    (hdiff : DifferentiableOn ℝ rate (interior D))
    (hderiv : ∀ x ∈ interior D,
      -C / ell ≤ deriv rate x ∧ deriv rate x ≤ -c / ell)
    (hm : midpoint ∈ D) (ht : time ∈ D) (hzero : rate midpoint = 0) :
    Real.exp (-C * (time - midpoint) ^ 2 / (2 * ell)) ≤ envelope rate midpoint time ∧
      envelope rate midpoint time ≤ Real.exp (-c * (time - midpoint) ^ 2 / (2 * ell))

name: NavierStokes.GaussianEnvelope.integral_quadratic_bounds
statement:
theorem integral_quadratic_bounds {D : Set ℝ} {rate : ℝ → ℝ}
    {midpoint time lower upper : ℝ} (hD : Convex ℝ D)
    (hcont : ContinuousOn rate D)
    (hdiff : DifferentiableOn ℝ rate (interior D))
    (hderiv : ∀ x ∈ interior D, lower ≤ deriv rate x ∧ deriv rate x ≤ upper)
    (hm : midpoint ∈ D) (ht : time ∈ D) (hzero : rate midpoint = 0) :
    lower * (time - midpoint) ^ 2 / 2 ≤ (∫ x in midpoint..time, rate x) ∧
      (∫ x in midpoint..time, rate x) ≤ upper * (time - midpoint) ^ 2 / 2

    (hlam : 0 < lam) (hu : 0 < u) (hell : 0 < ell) (ht : time ∈ Icc 0 ell) :
    -(u * referenceMaxSlope lam u) / ell ≤ deriv (referenceRate lam u ell) time ∧
      deriv (referenceRate lam u ell) time ≤ -(u * referenceMinSlope lam u) / ell

name: NavierStokes.GaussianEnvelope.reference_gaussian_bounds
statement:

    (hlam : 0 < lam) (hu : 0 < u) (hell : 0 < ell) (ht : time ∈ Icc 0 ell) :
    Real.exp (-(u * referenceMaxSlope lam u) * (time - ell / 2) ^ 2 / (2 * ell)) ≤
        envelope (referenceRate lam u ell) (ell / 2) time ∧
      envelope (referenceRate lam u ell) (ell / 2) time ≤
        Real.exp (-(u * referenceMinSlope lam u) * (time - ell / 2) ^ 2 / (2 * ell))

      Real.exp (-C * (time - ell / 2) ^ 2 / ell) ≤
          envelope (referenceRate lam u ell) (ell / 2) time ∧
        envelope (referenceRate lam u ell) (ell / 2) time ≤
          Real.exp (-c * (time - ell / 2) ^ 2 / ell)

    (hqbound : ∀ v ∈ Icc 0 (r ^ 2),
      |q v - q₀| ≤ ε + K * |v - r ^ 2 / 2| / r ^ 2) :

      |q v - q₀| ≤ E / r ^ 2 + K * |v - r ^ 2 / 2| / r ^ 2) :
    |averagedDirection ψ x q - q₀| ≤
      (E + K * concentrationConstant a A b B) / r

name: NavierStokes.PulseCovariance.PulseBounds.averagedDirection_sub

NavierStokes.PulseCovariance.compact_actual_positive_inverse
statement:
theorem compact_actual_positive_inverse
    {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {K : Set X} (hK : IsCompact K)
    {c₀ u : X → ℝ} {T : X → Vec2}
    (hmodel : ∀ i j, ContinuousOn (fun p => signedModel (c₀ p) (u p) i j) K)
    (hT : ∀ i, ContinuousOn (fun p => T p i) K)
    (hcone : ∀ p ∈ K, SmoothCovariance.StrictCone (signedModel (c₀ p) (u p)) (T p))
    {a A b B E C U : ℝ} (hE : 0 ≤ E) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hU : 0 ≤ U)
    (hc₀ : ∀ p ∈ K, |c₀ p| ≤ C) (hu : ∀ p ∈ K, |u p| ≤ U) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 1 ≤ R ∧ ∀ p ∈ K, ∀ r : ℝ, R ≤ r →
      ∀ pulses : SignedPulsePair r a A b B (c₀ p) (u p) E,
      ∀ ci : Vec2, (∀ j, 0 < ci j) →
        (actualMatrix pulses ci).det ≠ 0 ∧
        (∀ i, 0 < SmoothCovariance.weights (actualMatrix pulses ci) (T p) i) ∧
        (∀ i, 0 < SmoothCovariance.amplitudes (actualMatrix pulses ci) (T p) i)

name: NavierStokes.PulseCovariance.compact_actual_positive_inverse_of_scalar_cone
statement:
theorem compact_actual_positive_inverse_of_scalar_cone
    {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {K : Set X} (hK : IsCompact K)
    {c₀ u m t : X → ℝ} (hc₀ : ContinuousOn c₀ K) (hu : ContinuousOn u K)
    (hm : ContinuousOn m K) (ht : ContinuousOn t K)
    (hc₀neg : ∀ p ∈ K, c₀ p < 0) (hupos : ∀ p ∈ K, 0 < u p)
    (hcone : ∀ p ∈ K, |Covariance.normalMagnitude (c₀ p) (u p) * t p| < u p * m p)
    {a A b B E : ℝ} (hE : 0 ≤ E) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 1 ≤ R ∧ ∀ p ∈ K, ∀ r : ℝ, R ≤ r →
      ∀ pulses : SignedPulsePair r a A b B (c₀ p) (u p) E,
      ∀ ci : Vec2, (∀ j, 0 < ci j) →
        (actualMatrix pulses ci).det ≠ 0 ∧
        (∀ i, 0 < SmoothCovariance.weights (actualMatrix pulses ci) (Covariance.target (m p) (t p)) i) ∧
        (∀ i, 0 < SmoothCovariance.amplitudes (actualMatrix pulses ci) (Covariance.target (m p) (t p)) i)

name: NavierStokes.SmoothFourierData.coefficient_polynomial_bound
statement:
theorem coefficient_polynomial_bound {f : Plane → ℂ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hp : UnitPeriodic f) (p : ℕ) {C : ℝ}
    (hzero : ∀ x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖f (x, y)‖ ≤ C)
    (hfirst : ∀ x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖xJet p f (x, y)‖ ≤ C)
    (hsecond : ∀ x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ‖xJet p (swapFunction f) (x, y)‖ ≤ C) (k : Frequency) :
    weight k ^ p * ‖coefficient f k‖ ≤ 3 ^ p * C

name: NavierStokes.SmoothFourierData.coefficient_seminorm_bound
statement:
theorem coefficient_seminorm_bound {f : Plane → ℂ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hp : UnitPeriodic f) (p : ℕ) {C : ℝ}
    (hzero : ∀ x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖f (x, y)‖ ≤ C)
    (hfirst : ∀ x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ‖xJet (p + 4) f (x, y)‖ ≤ C)
    (hsecond : ∀ x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ‖xJet (p + 4) (swapFunction f) (x, y)‖ ≤ C) :
    coeffSeminorm p (coefficient f) ≤
      (3 ^ (p + 4) * C) * ∑' k : Frequency, (weight k ^ 4)⁻¹

name: NavierStokes.LoopMoments.exists_projected_twoPoint

theorem exists_projected_twoPoint (p₁ p₂ m V : ℝ)

statement:
theorem rephased_mass (s : Finset ι) (w t : ι → ℝ) (a m ρ v : ℝ)
    (ha : a ≠ 0) (hv : v ≠ 0) (hmass : ∑ i ∈ s, w i = 1)
    (hmean : avg s w t = m)
    (hvar : avg s w (fun i => (t i - m) ^ 2) = ρ / a)
    (hspeed : v = a * (1 + m ^ 2) + ρ) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, w i * phaseDensity a v (t i) = 1

name: NavierStokes.LoopMoments.rephased_moments
statement:
theorem rephased_moments (s : Finset ι) (w t : ι → ℝ) (a b ρ v : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (hmass : ∑ i ∈ s, w i = 1)
    (hmean : avg s w t = -b / a)
    (hvar : avg s w (fun i => (t i - (-b / a)) ^ 2) = ρ / a)
    (hspeed : v = a * (1 + (-b / a) ^ 2) + ρ) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, w i * phaseDensity a v (t i) = 1) ∧
      avg s (fun i => w i * phaseDensity a v (t i)) (fun i => loopA v (t i)) = a ∧
      avg s (fun i => w i * phaseDensity a v (t i)) (fun i => loopC v (t i)) = -b

    (hvar : angularMean (fun θ => (t θ - m) ^ 2) = ρ / a)
    (hspeed : v = a * (1 + m ^ 2) + ρ) :
    angularMean (fun θ => phaseDensity a v (t θ)) = 1 ∧
      angularMean (fun θ => phaseDensity a v (t θ) * loopA v (t θ)) = a ∧
      angularMean (fun θ => phaseDensity a v (t θ) * loopC v (t θ)) = a * m

      Function.Periodic t (2 * Real.pi) ∧ angularMean t = m ∧
      angularMean (fun θ => (t θ - m) ^ 2) = V

name: NavierStokes.SmoothLoop.exists_cosine_moments_with_projection
statement:
theorem exists_cosine_moments_with_projection (p₁ p₂ m V : ℝ) (hV : 0 ≤ V)
    (hmargin : 2 + |p₂ * Real.sqrt (2 * V)| < p₁ + p₂ * m) :
    ∃ t : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) t ∧
      Function.Periodic t (2 * Real.pi) ∧ angularMean t = m ∧
      angularMean (fun θ => (t θ - m) ^ 2) = V ∧
      ∀ θ, 2 < p₁ + p₂ * t θ

name: NavierStokes.SmoothLoop.exists_prescribed_mean_shear_loop
statement:
theorem exists_prescribed_mean_shear_loop (a b ρ : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) :
    ∃ A C : ℝ → ℝ,
      ContDiff ℝ (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) A ∧ ContDiff ℝ (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) C ∧
      Function.Periodic A 1 ∧ Function.Periodic C 1 ∧
      (∫ φ in (0 : ℝ)..1, A φ) = a ∧ (∫ φ in (0 : ℝ)..1, C φ) = -b ∧
      ∀ φ, 0 < A φ ∧
        A φ * (1 + (C φ / A φ) ^ 2) = a * (1 + (-b / a) ^ 2) + ρ

name: NavierStokes.SmoothLoop.exists_rephased_shear_loop
statement:
theorem exists_rephased_shear_loop (t : ℝ → ℝ) (a m ρ v : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hv : 0 < v) (ht : ContDiff ℝ (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) t)
    (hperiodic : Function.Periodic t (2 * Real.pi))
    (hmean : angularMean t = m)
    (hvar : angularMean (fun θ => (t θ - m) ^ 2) = ρ / a)
    (hspeed : v = a * (1 + m ^ 2) + ρ) :
    ∃ A C : ℝ → ℝ,
      ContDiff ℝ (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) A ∧ ContDiff ℝ (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) C ∧
      Function.Periodic A 1 ∧ Function.Periodic C 1 ∧
      (∫ φ in (0 : ℝ)..1, A φ) = a ∧ (∫ φ in (0 : ℝ)..1, C φ) = a * m ∧
      ∀ φ, 0 < A φ ∧ A φ * (1 + (C φ / A φ) ^ 2) = v

statement:
theorem primary_covariance_average (vr vt center : Plane)
    (hdet : vr.1 * vt.2 - vr.2 * vt.1 ≠ 0) (ci r0 : ℝ) (hci : 0 < ci)
    {χ ψ x : ℝ → ℝ} {t : ℝ → PulseCovariance.Vec2}
    (hχ : Continuous χ) (hψ : Continuous ψ) (hx : Continuous x) (ht : Continuous t)
    (hcχ : HasCompactSupport χ) (hcψ : HasCompactSupport ψ) (i : Fin 2) (n : ℕ)
    (phase : Plane → ℝ) (j : ℤ) (hj : j ≠ 0) :
    let a := fun z => periodize
      (nativeField (slotChart vr vt hdet) center
        (transverseStretch ci r0 (pulseProfile χ ψ x t i)))
      (covering^[n] z)
    squareAverage (fun z => SmoothLoop.angularMean
      (fun θ => a z * Real.cos ((j : ℝ) * θ + phase z) ^ 2)) =
      (|vr.1 * vt.2 - vr.2 * vt.1| / 2) * (∫ ξ : ℝ, χ ξ ^ 2) *
        PulseCovariance.actualColumn ci ψ x t i

    {r a A b B : ℝ} {χ ψ x : ℝ → ℝ} {t : ℝ → PulseCovariance.Vec2}
    (hp : PulseCovariance.PulseBounds r a A b B ψ x)
    (hχ : Continuous χ) (ht : Continuous t) (hcχ : HasCompactSupport χ)
    (i : Fin 2) (n : ℕ) (phase : Plane → ℝ) (j : ℤ) (hj : j ≠ 0) :
    let amp := fun z => periodize
      (nativeField (slotChart vr vt hdet) center
        (transverseStretch ci r0 (pulseProfile χ ψ x t i)))
      (covering^[n] z)
    squareAverage (fun z => SmoothLoop.angularMean
      (fun θ => amp z * Real.cos ((j : ℝ) * θ + phase z) ^ 2)) =
      (|vr.1 * vt.2 - vr.2 * vt.1| / 2) * (∫ ξ : ℝ, χ ξ ^ 2) *
        (ci * ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..r ^ 2, ψ v ^ 2 * x v * t v i)

theorem exists_solution_with_envelope_bound [CompleteSpace H]
    {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (A : ℝ → H →L[ℝ] H) (f : ℝ → H)
    (rate P : ℝ → ℝ) {μ : ℝ} (hμ : 0 ≤ μ)
    (hPpos : ∀ t, 0 < P t) (hP : ∀ t, HasDerivAt P (rate t * P t) t)
    (hcA : ContinuousOn A (Icc a b)) (hcf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b))
    (hA : ∀ t ∈ Ico a b, ∀ x : H,
      ⟪x, A t x⟫_ℝ ≤ (rate t + μ) * ‖x‖ ^ 2) (x₀ : H) :
    ∃ u : ℝ → H, u a = x₀ ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Icc a b, HasDerivAt u (A t (u t) + f t) t) ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, ‖u t‖ ≤ Real.exp (μ * (t - a)) * P t *
        (‖x₀‖ / P a + ∫ s in a..t, ‖f s‖ / P s)

name: NavierStokes.ViscousPropagator.high_harmonic_propagator_estimate
statement:
theorem high_harmonic_propagator_estimate
    {a b midpoint S dampingError matrixError : ℝ}
    (hS : 0 < S) (hdampingError : 0 ≤ dampingError) (hmatrixError : 0 ≤ matrixError)
    (lam fundamentalDamping referenceDamping rate : ℝ → ℝ)
    (E : ℝ → Plane →L[ℝ] Plane) {u f : ℝ → Plane} {j : ℤ} (hj : j ≠ 0)
    (hrate : Continuous rate)
    (hreference : ∀ t ∈ Ico a b, rate t = lam t - referenceDamping t)
    (hlam : ∀ t ∈ Ico a b, 0 ≤ lam t)
    (hD : ∀ t ∈ Ico a b, 0 ≤ fundamentalDamping t)
    (hdamping : ∀ t ∈ Ico a b,
      referenceDamping t - dampingError / S ≤ fundamentalDamping t)
    (hE : ∀ t ∈ Ico a b, ‖E t‖ ≤ matrixError / S)
    (hu : ContinuousOn u (Icc a b)) (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b))
    (hode : ∀ t ∈ Ico a b, HasDerivWithinAt u
      (coefficient (lam t) ((j : ℝ) ^ 2 * fundamentalDamping t) (E t) (u t) + f t)
      (Ici t) t) :
    ∀ t ∈ Icc a b,
      ‖u t‖ ≤ Real.exp (((dampingError + matrixError) / S) * (t - a)) *
        GaussianEnvelope.envelope rate midpoint t *
        (‖u a‖ / GaussianEnvelope.envelope rate midpoint a +
          ∫ s in a..t, ‖f s‖ / GaussianEnvelope.envelope rate midpoint s)

name: NavierStokes.ViscousPropagator.homogeneous_viscous_propagator_estimate

theorem homogeneous_viscous_propagator_estimate
    {a b midpoint S dampingError matrixError : ℝ}
    (hS : 0 < S) (hdampingError : 0 ≤ dampingError) (hmatrixError : 0 ≤ matrixError)
    (lam damping referenceDamping rate : ℝ → ℝ)
    (E : ℝ → Plane →L[ℝ] Plane) {u : ℝ → Plane}
    (hrate : Continuous rate)
    (hreference : ∀ t ∈ Ico a b, rate t = lam t - referenceDamping t)
    (hlam : ∀ t ∈ Ico a b, 0 ≤ lam t)
    (hdamping : ∀ t ∈ Ico a b, referenceDamping t - dampingError / S ≤ damping t)
    (hE : ∀ t ∈ Ico a b, ‖E t‖ ≤ matrixError / S)
    (hu : ContinuousOn u (Icc a b))
    (hode : ∀ t ∈ Ico a b, HasDerivWithinAt u
      (coefficient (lam t) (damping t) (E t) (u t)) (Ici t) t) :
    ∀ t ∈ Icc a b,
      ‖u t‖ ≤ Real.exp (((dampingError + matrixError) / S) * |t - a|) *
        (GaussianEnvelope.envelope rate midpoint t /
          GaussianEnvelope.envelope rate midpoint a) * ‖u a‖

name: NavierStokes.ViscousPropagator.norm_le_envelope_mul_integral
statement:
theorem norm_le_envelope_mul_integral
    {a b : ℝ} {u f : ℝ → H} (A : ℝ → H →L[ℝ] H)
    (rate P : ℝ → ℝ) {μ : ℝ} (hμ : 0 ≤ μ)
    (hPpos : ∀ t, 0 < P t) (hP : ∀ t, HasDerivAt P (rate t * P t) t)
    (hu : ContinuousOn u (Icc a b)) (hf : Continuous f)
    (hode : ∀ t ∈ Ico a b,
      HasDerivWithinAt u (A t (u t) + f t) (Ici t) t)
    (hA : ∀ t ∈ Ico a b, ∀ x : H,
      ⟪x, A t x⟫_ℝ ≤ (rate t + μ) * ‖x‖ ^ 2) :
    ∀ t ∈ Icc a b,
      ‖u t‖ ≤ Real.exp (μ * (t - a)) * P t *
        (‖u a‖ / P a + ∫ s in a..t, ‖f s‖ / P s)

name: NavierStokes.ViscousPropagator.reference_pulse_propagator_estimate
statement:
theorem reference_pulse_propagator_estimate
    {a b S dampingError matrixError lam₀ u₀ ell : ℝ}
    (hS : 0 < S) (hdampingError : 0 ≤ dampingError) (hmatrixError : 0 ≤ matrixError)
    (hlam₀ : 0 ≤ lam₀) (damping : ℝ → ℝ)
    (E : ℝ → Plane →L[ℝ] Plane) {u f : ℝ → Plane}
    (hdamping : ∀ t ∈ Ico a b,
      referenceViscosity lam₀ u₀ ell t - dampingError / S ≤ damping t)
    (hE : ∀ t ∈ Ico a b, ‖E t‖ ≤ matrixError / S)
    (hu : ContinuousOn u (Icc a b)) (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b))
    (hode : ∀ t ∈ Ico a b, HasDerivWithinAt u
      (coefficient (referenceEigenvalue lam₀ u₀ ell t) (damping t) (E t) (u t) + f t)
      (Ici t) t) :
    let P := GaussianEnvelope.envelope (GaussianEnvelope.referenceRate lam₀ u₀ ell) (ell / 2)
    ∀ t ∈ Icc a b,
      ‖u t‖ ≤ Real.exp (((dampingError + matrixError) / S) * (t - a)) * P t *
        (‖u a‖ / P a + ∫ s in a..t, ‖f s‖ / P s)

NavierStokes.ViscousPropagator.viscous_propagator_estimate
statement:
theorem viscous_propagator_estimate
    {a b midpoint S dampingError matrixError : ℝ}
    (hS : 0 < S) (hdampingError : 0 ≤ dampingError) (hmatrixError : 0 ≤ matrixError)
    (lam damping referenceDamping rate : ℝ → ℝ)
    (E : ℝ → Plane →L[ℝ] Plane) {u f : ℝ → Plane}
    (hrate : Continuous rate)
    (hreference : ∀ t ∈ Ico a b, rate t = lam t - referenceDamping t)
    (hlam : ∀ t ∈ Ico a b, 0 ≤ lam t)
    (hdamping : ∀ t ∈ Ico a b, referenceDamping t - dampingError / S ≤ damping t)
    (hE : ∀ t ∈ Ico a b, ‖E t‖ ≤ matrixError / S)
    (hu : ContinuousOn u (Icc a b)) (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b))
    (hode : ∀ t ∈ Ico a b, HasDerivWithinAt u
      (coefficient (lam t) (damping t) (E t) (u t) + f t) (Ici t) t) :
    ∀ t ∈ Icc a b,
      ‖u t‖ ≤ Real.exp (((dampingError + matrixError) / S) * (t - a)) *
        GaussianEnvelope.envelope rate midpoint t *
        (‖u a‖ / GaussianEnvelope.envelope rate midpoint a +
          ∫ s in a..t, ‖f s‖ / GaussianEnvelope.envelope rate midpoint s)

name: NavierStokes.ViscousPropagator.zero_initial_source_bound

theorem zero_initial_source_bound
    {a b K : ℝ} {u f : ℝ → H} (A : ℝ → H →L[ℝ] H)
    (rate P : ℝ → ℝ) {μ : ℝ} (hμ : 0 ≤ μ)

      ⟪x, A t x⟫_ℝ ≤ (rate t + μ) * ‖x‖ ^ 2)

name: NavierStokes.WeightedODEJets.amplitude_le_polynomial
statement:
theorem amplitude_le_polynomial {S K w L : ℝ} (hS : 1 ≤ S) (hK : 1 ≤ K)
    (hw : 0 ≤ w) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hLS : L ≤ K * S) (m N n : ℕ) :
    K * (w * K * S ^ m + L * (w * K * S ^ m)) *
        (1 + K * L * ((2 : ℝ) ^ N * (K * S ^ m))) ^ n ≤
      w * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (N + 1) * K ^ 3) ^ (n + 1) * S ^ ((m + 1) * (n + 1))

name: NavierStokes.WeightedODEJets.jet_solution_eq_solution
statement:
theorem jet_solution_eq_solution (hab : a ≤ b) {U : Set P} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (A : P → Coefficient a b E) (x₀ : P → E) (f : P → Curve a b E)
    (hA : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ A U) (hx₀ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ x₀ U)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U) (l : List P) {p : P} (hp : p ∈ U) :
    jet (fun q => solution hab (A q) (x₀ q) (f q)) l p =
      solution hab (A p) (jet x₀ l p)
        (jetSource A f (fun q => solution hab (A q) (x₀ q) (f q)) l p)

statement:
theorem jet_solution_hasDerivWithinAt (hab : a ≤ b) {U : Set P} (hU : IsOpen U)

    (hA : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ A U) (hx₀ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ x₀ U)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U) (l : List P) {p : P} (hp : p ∈ U) (t : Icc a b) :
    let u := fun q => solution hab (A q) (x₀ q) (f q)
    HasDerivWithinAt (extend hab (jet u l p))
      (A p t (jet u l p t) + jetSource A f u l p t) (Icc a b) t

name: NavierStokes.WeightedODEJets.norm_iteratedFDeriv_odeFamily_le_polynomial
statement:
theorem norm_iteratedFDeriv_odeFamily_le_polynomial (hab : a ≤ b)
    (U : Set Q) (V : Set ℝ) (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V) (hI : Icc a b ⊆ V)
    (A : Q × ℝ → H →L[ℝ] H) (x₀ : Q → H) (f : Q × ℝ → H)
    (hA : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ A (U ×ˢ V)) (hx₀ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ x₀ U)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (U ×ˢ V)) {p : Q} (hp : p ∈ U)
    (rate W : ℝ → ℝ) {μ S K w : ℝ} (hμ : 0 ≤ μ)
    (hW : ∀ t, 0 < W t) (hdW : ∀ t, HasDerivAt W (rate t * W t) t)
    (henergy : ∀ t : Icc a b, ∀ x : H, ⟪x, A (p, t) x⟫_ℝ ≤ (rate t + μ) * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    (hC : Real.exp (μ * (b - a)) ≤ K) (hS : 1 ≤ S) (hK : 1 ≤ K) (hw : 0 ≤ w)
    (hslot : b - a ≤ K * S) (m N : ℕ)
    (hAj : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ N → ∀ t : Icc a b,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun q => A (q, t)) p‖ ≤ K * S ^ m)
    (hxj : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ N → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j x₀ p‖ ≤ w * K * S ^ m * W a)
    (hfj : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ N → ∀ t : Icc a b,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun q => f (q, t)) p‖ ≤ w * K * S ^ m * W t)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ N) (t : Icc a b) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun q => odeFamily hab A x₀ f q t) p‖ ≤
      w * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (N + 1) * K ^ 3) ^ (n + 1) * S ^ ((m + 1) * (n + 1)) * W t
