statement:
theorem norm_jet_solution_le (hab : a ≤ b) {U : Set P} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (A : P → Coefficient a b H) (x₀ : P → H) (f : P → Curve a b H)
    (hA : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ A U) (hx₀ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ x₀ U)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U) {p : P} (hp : p ∈ U)
    (rate W : ℝ → ℝ) {μ C M X F₀ : ℝ} (hμ : 0 ≤ μ)
    (hW : ∀ t, 0 < W t) (hdW : ∀ t, HasDerivAt W (rate t * W t) t)
    (henergy : ∀ t : Icc a b, ∀ x : H, ⟪x, A p t x⟫_ℝ ≤ (rate t + μ) * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    (hC : Real.exp (μ * (b - a)) ≤ C) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hX : 0 ≤ X) (hF : 0 ≤ F₀)
    (N : ℕ)
    (hAj : ∀ l : List P, l.length ≤ N → UnitWord l → ∀ t : Icc a b, ‖jet A l p t‖ ≤ M)
    (hxj : ∀ l : List P, l.length ≤ N → UnitWord l → ‖jet x₀ l p‖ ≤ X * W a)
    (hfj : ∀ l : List P, l.length ≤ N → UnitWord l → ∀ t : Icc a b,
      ‖jet f l p t‖ ≤ F₀ * W t)
    (l : List P) (hlN : l.length ≤ N) (hl : UnitWord l) (t : Icc a b) :
    ‖jet (fun q => solution hab (A q) (x₀ q) (f q)) l p t‖ ≤
      C * (X + (b - a) * F₀) * (1 + C * (b - a) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ N * M)) ^ l.length * W t

name: NavierStokes.WeightedODEJets.norm_jet_solution_le_polynomial
statement:
theorem norm_jet_solution_le_polynomial (hab : a ≤ b) {U : Set P} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (A : P → Coefficient a b H) (x₀ : P → H) (f : P → Curve a b H)

    (henergy : ∀ t : Icc a b, ∀ x : H, ⟪x, A p t x⟫_ℝ ≤ (rate t + μ) * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    (hC : Real.exp (μ * (b - a)) ≤ K) (hS : 1 ≤ S) (hK : 1 ≤ K) (hw : 0 ≤ w)
    (hslot : b - a ≤ K * S) (m N : ℕ)
    (hAj : ∀ l : List P, l.length ≤ N → UnitWord l → ∀ t : Icc a b,
      ‖jet A l p t‖ ≤ K * S ^ m)
    (hxj : ∀ l : List P, l.length ≤ N → UnitWord l → ‖jet x₀ l p‖ ≤ w * K * S ^ m * W a)
    (hfj : ∀ l : List P, l.length ≤ N → UnitWord l → ∀ t : Icc a b,
      ‖jet f l p t‖ ≤ w * K * S ^ m * W t)
    (l : List P) (hlN : l.length ≤ N) (hl : UnitWord l) (t : Icc a b) :
    ‖jet (fun q => solution hab (A q) (x₀ q) (f q)) l p t‖ ≤
      w * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (N + 1) * K ^ 3) ^ (l.length + 1) *
        S ^ ((m + 1) * (l.length + 1)) * W t

name: NavierStokes.WeightedODEJets.norm_productJet_le

name: NavierStokes.CommonCoverSolve.LinearData.anchoredSolve_jets_le_polynomial
statement:
theorem LinearData.anchoredSolve_jets_le_polynomial
    {P V E : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup P] [NormedSpace ℝ P]
    [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    {a b : ℝ} (d : LinearData P V E) (g : Geometry) (hab : a ≤ b)
    {U : Set P} (hU : IsOpen U) (k : Frequency)
    (hA : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ d.coefficient (U ×ˢ univ))
    (hB : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ d.forcingMap (U ×ˢ univ))
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ d.source (U ×ˢ univ))
    {p : P × Plane} (hp : p.1 ∈ U)
    (rate W : ℝ → ℝ) {μ S K w : ℝ} (hμ : 0 ≤ μ)
    (hW : ∀ t, 0 < W t) (hdW : ∀ t, HasDerivAt W (rate t * W t) t)
    (henergy : ∀ t : Icc a b, ∀ x : E,
      ⟪x, d.coefficientAlong g k (p, t) x⟫_ℝ ≤ (rate t + μ) * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    (hC : Real.exp (μ * (b - a)) ≤ K) (hS : 1 ≤ S) (hK : 1 ≤ K) (hw : 0 ≤ w)
    (hslot : b - a ≤ K * S) (m N : ℕ)
    (hAj : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ N → ∀ t : Icc a b,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun q => d.coefficientAlong g k (q, t)) p‖ ≤ K * S ^ m)
    (hfj : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ N → ∀ t : Icc a b,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun q => d.forcingAlong g k (q, t)) p‖ ≤ w * K * S ^ m * W t)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ N) (t : Icc a b) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun q => d.anchoredSolve g hab k q t) p‖ ≤
      w * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (N + 1) * K ^ 3) ^ (n + 1) * S ^ ((m + 1) * (n + 1)) * W t

statement:
theorem anchoredSolve_projected_equation {U : Set P} (k : Frequency)
    (hA : ContinuousOn t.linearData.coefficient (U ×ˢ univ))
    (hB : ContinuousOn t.linearData.forcingMap (U ×ˢ univ))
    (hf : ContinuousOn t.source (U ×ˢ univ)) {p : P} (hp : p ∈ U)
    (Y : Plane) (s : Icc a b) :
    let z := (p, ((g.coordinates k Y).1, (s : ℝ)))
    HasDerivAt (t.linearData.anchoredSolve g hab k (p, Y))
      (TangentProjection.projectedRhs (t.normal z) (t.normalDot z)
        (t.linearData.anchoredSolve g hab k (p, Y) s)
        (t.action z (t.linearData.anchoredSolve g hab k (p, Y) s))
        (t.source (p, g.path k Y s)) (t.damping z)) s

    (hn : ∀ s ∈ Icc a b,

        (t.normalDot (p, ((g.coordinates k Y).1, s))) s)

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.axial_chain_coefficient
statement:
theorem axial_chain_coefficient {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (b h η X F FX Fη : ℝ) :
    b * q ^ (b - 1) * qAxial q h η * F +
        q ^ b * (FX * xAxial q h η X + Fη * etaAxial q h η) =
      q ^ (b - D h) * axialCoeff b h η X F FX Fη

statement:
theorem forward_coordinate_identity {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (h η : ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.incompressibility_coefficient
statement:
theorem incompressibility_coefficient
    (h η X U UX Uη Ubar UbarX Ubarη UbarηX : ℝ)
    (hU : Ubar + X * UbarX = U) (hUη : Ubarη + X * UbarηX = Uη) :
    (2 * η * U - 2 * D h * η * Ubar - d η * Ubarη +
        X * (2 * η * UX - 2 * D h * η * UbarX - d η * UbarηX)) / L h η =
      -axialCoeff (-A h) h η X U UX Uη

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.incompressibility_numerator
statement:
theorem incompressibility_numerator
    (h η X U UX Uη Ubar UbarX Ubarη UbarηX : ℝ)
    (hU : Ubar + X * UbarX = U) (hUη : Ubarη + X * UbarηX = Uη) :
    2 * η * U - 2 * D h * η * Ubar - d η * Ubarη +
        X * (2 * η * UX - 2 * D h * η * UbarX - d η * UbarηX) =
      2 * A h * η * U - d η * Uη + 2 * η * X * UX

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.inverseEta_recover
statement:
theorem inverseEta_recover {q h η : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (hL : L h η ≠ 0)
    (q' η' : ℝ) :
    inverseEta q h η (d η * q' - 2 * q * η * η')
      (D h * η * (q ^ D h / q) * q' + q ^ D h * η') = η'

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.inverseQ_recover
statement:
theorem inverseQ_recover {q h η : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (hL : L h η ≠ 0)
    (q' η' : ℝ) :
    inverseQ q h η (d η * q' - 2 * q * η * η')
      (D h * η * (q ^ D h / q) * q' + q ^ D h * η') = q'

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.inverse_satisfies_tau
statement:
theorem inverse_satisfies_tau {q h η : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hL : L h η ≠ 0) (τ' z' : ℝ) :
    d η * inverseQ q h η τ' z' -
        2 * q * η * inverseEta q h η τ' z' = τ'

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.inverse_satisfies_z
statement:
theorem inverse_satisfies_z {q h η : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hL : L h η ≠ 0) (τ' z' : ℝ) :
    D h * η * (q ^ D h / q) * inverseQ q h η τ' z' +
        q ^ D h * inverseEta q h η τ' z' = z'

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.jacobian_det
statement:
theorem jacobian_det {q : ℝ} (hq : q ≠ 0) (h η : ℝ) :
    d η * q ^ D h - (-2 * q * η) * (D h * η * (q ^ D h / q)) =
      q ^ D h * L h η

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.jacobian_det_pos
statement:
theorem jacobian_det_pos {q h η : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hh₀ : 0 ≤ h) (hh : h < 1 / 2) (hη : η ^ 2 ≤ 1) :
    0 < d η * q ^ D h - (-2 * q * η) * (D h * η * (q ^ D h / q))

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.qAxial_rpow
statement:
theorem qAxial_rpow {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (h η : ℝ) :
    qAxial q h η = 2 * η * q ^ (1 - D h) / L h η

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.rates_unique
statement:
theorem rates_unique {q h η q' η' τ' z' : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hL : L h η ≠ 0) (hτ : d η * q' - 2 * q * η * η' = τ')
    (hz : D h * η * (q ^ D h / q) * q' + q ^ D h * η' = z') :
    q' = inverseQ q h η τ' z' ∧ η' = inverseEta q h η τ' z'

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.time_chain_coefficient
statement:
theorem time_chain_coefficient {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (b h η X F FX Fη : ℝ) :
    b * q ^ (b - 1) * qTime h η * F +
        q ^ b * (FX * xTime q h η X + Fη * etaTime q h η) =
      q ^ (b - 1) * timeCoeff b h η X F FX Fη

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.time_rates
statement:
theorem time_rates (q h η : ℝ) :
    inverseQ q h η (-1) 0 = qTime h η ∧
      inverseEta q h η (-1) 0 = etaTime q h η

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.xAxial_from_qAxial
statement:
theorem xAxial_from_qAxial {q : ℝ} (hq : q ≠ 0) (h η X : ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.xTime_from_qTime

    fderiv ℝ (radialVector d vr) p (timeVector vt) = 0

name: NavierStokes.GraphCalculus.hasDerivAt_graph_radial
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_graph_radial (d : ℝ) (vr vt : Plane) (r t : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => graph d vr vt (s, t))
      (radialVector d vr (graph d vr vt (r, t))) r

name: NavierStokes.GraphCalculus.hasDerivAt_graph_time
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_graph_time (d : ℝ) (vr vt : Plane) (r t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => graph d vr vt (r, s)) (timeVector vt) t

name: NavierStokes.GraphCalculus.mixed_partial_pullback_comm
statement:
theorem mixed_partial_pullback_comm (d : ℝ) (vr vt : Plane) (F : Lift → ℝ)
    (q : Plane) (hr : q.1 ≠ 0) (hF : ContDiff ℝ 2 F) :
    partialR (partialT (pullback d vr vt F)) q =
      partialT (partialR (pullback d vr vt F)) q

name: NavierStokes.GraphCalculus.partialR_partialT_pullback
statement:
theorem partialR_partialT_pullback (d : ℝ) (vr vt : Plane) (F : Lift → ℝ)
    (q : Plane) (hr : q.1 ≠ 0) (hF : ContDiff ℝ 2 F) :
    partialR (partialT (pullback d vr vt F)) q =
      radialOp d vr (timeOp vt F) (graph d vr vt q)

name: NavierStokes.GraphCalculus.partialR_pullback
statement:
theorem partialR_pullback (d : ℝ) (vr vt : Plane) (F : Lift → ℝ) (q : Plane)
    (hr : q.1 ≠ 0) (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ F (graph d vr vt q)) :
    partialR (pullback d vr vt F) q = radialOp d vr F (graph d vr vt q)

name: NavierStokes.GraphCalculus.partialT_partialR_pullback
statement:
theorem partialT_partialR_pullback (d : ℝ) (vr vt : Plane) (F : Lift → ℝ)
    (q : Plane) (hr : q.1 ≠ 0) (hF : ContDiff ℝ 2 F) :
    partialT (partialR (pullback d vr vt F)) q =
      timeOp vt (radialOp d vr F) (graph d vr vt q)

name: NavierStokes.GraphCalculus.partialT_pullback
statement:
theorem partialT_pullback (d : ℝ) (vr vt : Plane) (F : Lift → ℝ) (q : Plane)
    (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ F (graph d vr vt q)) :
    partialT (pullback d vr vt F) q = timeOp vt F (graph d vr vt q)

name: NavierStokes.GraphCalculus.radialOp_expanded
statement:
theorem radialOp_expanded (d : ℝ) (vr : Plane) (F : Lift → ℝ) (p : Lift) :
    radialOp d vr F p = fderiv ℝ F p ((1, 0), (0, 0)) +
      radialSpeed d p.1.1 *
        (vr.1 * fderiv ℝ F p ((0, 0), (1, 0)) +
          vr.2 * fderiv ℝ F p ((0, 0), (0, 1)))

name: NavierStokes.GraphCalculus.radialOp_timeOp_comm
statement:
theorem radialOp_timeOp_comm (d : ℝ) (vr vt : Plane) (F : Lift → ℝ) (p : Lift)
    (hr : p.1.1 ≠ 0) (hF : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 F p) :
    radialOp d vr (timeOp vt F) p = timeOp vt (radialOp d vr F) p

name: NavierStokes.GraphCalculus.timeOp_expanded
statement:
theorem timeOp_expanded (vt : Plane) (F : Lift → ℝ) (p : Lift) :
    timeOp vt F p = fderiv ℝ F p ((0, 1), (0, 0)) +
      (vt.1 * fderiv ℝ F p ((0, 0), (1, 0)) +
        vt.2 * fderiv ℝ F p ((0, 0), (0, 1)))

name: NavierStokes.JetBounds.AllJetBound.add
statement:
theorem AllJetBound.add {f g : D → E} {s : Set D} {A B : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hs : IsOpen s) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f s) (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g s)
    (hA : AllJetBound f s A) (hB : AllJetBound g s B) :
    AllJetBound (fun x => f x + g x) s (fun n => A n + B n)

name: NavierStokes.JetBounds.AllJetBound.bilinear
statement:
theorem AllJetBound.bilinear (L : E →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] G)
    {f : D → E} {g : D → F} {s : Set D} {A B : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hs : IsOpen s) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f s) (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g s)
    (hA : AllJetBound f s A) (hB : AllJetBound g s B) :
    AllJetBound (fun x => L (f x) (g x)) s (fun n => ‖L‖ * leibnizProfile A B n)

name: NavierStokes.JetBounds.AllJetBound.fderiv
NavierStokes.JetBounds.AllJetBound.mul
statement:
theorem AllJetBound.mul {f g : D → ℝ} {s : Set D} {A B : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hs : IsOpen s) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f s) (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g s)
    (hA : AllJetBound f s A) (hB : AllJetBound g s B) :
    AllJetBound (fun x => f x * g x) s (leibnizProfile A B)

name: NavierStokes.JetBounds.AllJetBound.mul_rpow
statement:
theorem AllJetBound.mul_rpow {f g : D → ℝ} {s : Set D}
    {A B : ℕ → ℝ} {ε α β : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hs : IsOpen s)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f s) (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g s)
    (hA : AllJetBound f s (fun n => A n * ε ^ α))
    (hB : AllJetBound g s (fun n => B n * ε ^ β)) :
    AllJetBound (fun x => f x * g x) s
      (fun n => leibnizProfile A B n * ε ^ (α + β))

name: NavierStokes.JetBounds.FiniteJetBound.add
statement:
theorem FiniteJetBound.add {m : ℕ} {f g : D → E} {s : Set D} {A B : ℝ}
    (hs : IsOpen s) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ m f s) (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ m g s)
    (hA : FiniteJetBound m f s A) (hB : FiniteJetBound m g s B) :
    FiniteJetBound m (fun x => f x + g x) s (A + B)

name: NavierStokes.JetBounds.FiniteJetBound.bilinear
statement:
theorem FiniteJetBound.bilinear {m : ℕ} (B : E →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] G)
    {f : D → E} {g : D → F} {s : Set D} {A C : ℝ}
    (hs : IsOpen s) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ m f s) (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ m g s)
    (hA : FiniteJetBound m f s A) (hC : FiniteJetBound m g s C) :
    FiniteJetBound m (fun x => B (f x) (g x)) s (‖B‖ * (2 : ℝ) ^ m * A * C)

name: NavierStokes.JetBounds.FiniteJetBound.bilinear_perturbation
statement:
theorem FiniteJetBound.bilinear_perturbation {m : ℕ} (L : E →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] G)
    {f u : D → E} {g v : D → F} {s : Set D} {A U B V : ℝ}
    (hs : IsOpen s) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ m f s) (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ m u s)
    (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ m g s) (hv : ContDiffOn ℝ m v s)
    (hA : FiniteJetBound m f s A) (hU : FiniteJetBound m u s U)
    (hB : FiniteJetBound m g s B) (hV : FiniteJetBound m v s V) :
    FiniteJetBound m
      (fun x => L (f x + u x) (g x + v x) - L (f x) (g x)) s
      (‖L‖ * (2 : ℝ) ^ m * (A * V + U * B + U * V))

name: NavierStokes.JetBounds.FiniteJetBound.clm_apply
statement:
theorem FiniteJetBound.clm_apply {m : ℕ} {f : D → E →L[ℝ] F} {g : D → E}
    {s : Set D} {A B : ℝ} (hs : IsOpen s)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ m f s) (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ m g s)
    (hA : FiniteJetBound m f s A) (hB : FiniteJetBound m g s B) :
    FiniteJetBound m (fun x => (f x) (g x)) s ((2 : ℝ) ^ m * A * B)

name: NavierStokes.JetBounds.FiniteJetBound.fderiv
NavierStokes.JetBounds.FiniteJetBound.mono
statement:
theorem FiniteJetBound.mono {m : ℕ} {f : D → E} {s : Set D} {A B : ℝ}

name: NavierStokes.JetBounds.FiniteJetBound.mul
statement:
theorem FiniteJetBound.mul {m : ℕ} {f g : D → ℝ} {s : Set D} {A B : ℝ}
    (hs : IsOpen s) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ m f s) (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ m g s)

    FiniteJetBound m (fun x => f x * g x) s ((2 : ℝ) ^ m * A * B)

name: NavierStokes.JetBounds.FiniteJetBound.mul_rpow
statement:
theorem FiniteJetBound.mul_rpow {m : ℕ} {f g : D → ℝ} {s : Set D}
    {A B ε α β : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hs : IsOpen s)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ m f s) (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ m g s)
    (hA : FiniteJetBound m f s (A * ε ^ α))
    (hB : FiniteJetBound m g s (B * ε ^ β)) :
    FiniteJetBound m (fun x => f x * g x) s
      ((2 : ℝ) ^ m * A * B * ε ^ (α + β))

statement:
theorem FiniteJetBound.nonneg {m : ℕ} {f : D → E} {s : Set D} {C : ℝ}

statement:
theorem FiniteJetBound.norm_le {m : ℕ} {f : D → E} {s : Set D} {C : ℝ}

statement:
theorem FiniteJetBound.of_le {m n : ℕ} {f : D → E} {s : Set D} {C : ℝ}

name: NavierStokes.JetBounds.FiniteJetBound.secondFDeriv
NavierStokes.JetBounds.FiniteJetBound.transport
statement:
theorem FiniteJetBound.transport {m : ℕ} {f : D → D} {g : D → E}
    {s : Set D} {A B : ℝ} (hs : IsOpen s)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ m f s) (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ (m + 1) g s)
    (hA : FiniteJetBound m f s A) (hB : FiniteJetBound (m + 1) g s B) :
    FiniteJetBound m (fun x => _root_.fderiv ℝ g x (f x)) s ((2 : ℝ) ^ m * B * A)

name: NavierStokes.JetBounds.leibnizProfile_scale
statement:
theorem leibnizProfile_scale (A B : ℕ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    leibnizProfile (fun i => A i * a) (fun i => B i * b) n =
      leibnizProfile A B n * (a * b)

name: NavierStokes.JetBounds.norm_iteratedFDeriv_bilinear_le_on
statement:
theorem norm_iteratedFDeriv_bilinear_le_on (B : E →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] G)
    {f : D → E} {g : D → F} {s : Set D} {N : WithTop ℕ∞}
    (hs : IsOpen s) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ N f s) (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ N g s)
    {x : D} (hx : x ∈ s) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≤ N) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y => B (f y) (g y)) x‖ ≤
      ‖B‖ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) *
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f x‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n - i) g x‖

name: NavierStokes.JetBounds.norm_iteratedFDeriv_mul_le_on
statement:
theorem norm_iteratedFDeriv_mul_le_on {f g : D → ℝ} {s : Set D}
    {N : WithTop ℕ∞} (hs : IsOpen s) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ N f s)
    (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ N g s) {x : D} (hx : x ∈ s) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≤ N) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y => f y * g y) x‖ ≤
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) *
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f x‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n - i) g x‖

name: NavierStokes.PhaseCalculus.backwardMaterialOp_phase
statement:
theorem backwardMaterialOp_phase (ε p pz x0 : ℝ) (b F G : Slow → ℝ) (q : Slot)
    (hε : ε ≠ 0) (hR : 0 < q.1.1)
    (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ F q.1) (hG : DifferentiableAt ℝ G q.1) :
    backwardMaterialOp ε b F G (phase ε p pz x0 F G) q =
      b q.1 * x0 - q.2.2 *
        (b q.1 * (p * slowR F q.1 + pz * slowR G q.1) -
          ε * (p * slowT F q.1 + pz * slowT G q.1) +
          ε * G q.1 * (p * slowZ F q.1 + pz * slowZ G q.1))

name: NavierStokes.PhaseCalculus.contDiffAt_phaseNormal
statement:
theorem contDiffAt_phaseNormal (ε p pz x0 : ℝ) (F G : Slow → ℝ) (q : Slot)
    (hR : q.1.1 ≠ 0) (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (phaseNormal ε p pz x0 F G) q

name: NavierStokes.PhaseCalculus.contDiff_harmonic
statement:
theorem contDiff_harmonic {n : WithTop ℕ∞} (k : ℝ) (j : ℤ) (ε p pz x0 : ℝ)
    (F G : Slow → ℝ) (hF : ContDiff ℝ n F) (hG : ContDiff ℝ n G) :
    ContDiff ℝ n (harmonic k j ε p pz x0 F G)

name: NavierStokes.PhaseCalculus.contDiff_phase
statement:
theorem contDiff_phase {n : WithTop ℕ∞} (ε p pz x0 : ℝ) (F G : Slow → ℝ)
    (hF : ContDiff ℝ n F) (hG : ContDiff ℝ n G) :
    ContDiff ℝ n (phase ε p pz x0 F G)

name: NavierStokes.PhaseCalculus.fderiv_phase_apply
statement:
theorem fderiv_phase_apply (ε p pz x0 : ℝ) (F G : Slow → ℝ) (q w : Slot)
    (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ F q.1) (hG : DifferentiableAt ℝ G q.1) :
    fderiv ℝ (phase ε p pz x0 F G) q w =
      p * w.2.1 + (pz / ε) * w.1.2.1 + x0 * w.1.1 -
        (w.2.2 * (p * F q.1 + pz * G q.1) +
          q.2.2 * (p * fderiv ℝ F q.1 w.1 + pz * fderiv ℝ G q.1 w.1))

name: NavierStokes.PhaseCalculus.harmonic_angularShift_two_pi
statement:
theorem harmonic_angularShift_two_pi (k : ℝ) (j m : ℤ) (ε p pz x0 : ℝ)
    (F G : Slow → ℝ) (q : Slot) (hkp : k * p = (m : ℝ)) :
    harmonic k j ε p pz x0 F G (angularShift (2 * Real.pi) q) =
      harmonic k j ε p pz x0 F G q

name: NavierStokes.PhaseCalculus.harmonic_theta_periodic
statement:
theorem harmonic_theta_periodic (k : ℝ) (j m : ℤ) (ε p pz x0 : ℝ)
    (F G : Slow → ℝ) (s : Slow) (v : ℝ) (hkp : k * p = (m : ℝ)) :
    Function.Periodic (fun θ => harmonic k j ε p pz x0 F G (s, (θ, v))) (2 * Real.pi)

name: NavierStokes.PhaseCalculus.hasDerivAt_phaseNormal_slot
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_phaseNormal_slot (ε p pz x0 θ v : ℝ) (F G : Slow → ℝ) (s : Slow)
    (hε : ε ≠ 0) (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ F s) (hG : DifferentiableAt ℝ G s) :
    HasDerivAt (fun w => phaseNormal ε p pz x0 F G (s, (θ, w)))
      (normalSlotDerivative ε p pz F G s) v

name: NavierStokes.PhaseCalculus.phaseNormal_formula
statement:
theorem phaseNormal_formula (ε p pz x0 : ℝ) (F G : Slow → ℝ) (q : Slot)
    (hε : ε ≠ 0) (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ F q.1) (hG : DifferentiableAt ℝ G q.1) :
    phaseNormal ε p pz x0 F G q =
      !₂[x0 - q.2.2 * (p * slowR F q.1 + pz * slowR G q.1),
        p / q.1.1,
        pz - ε * q.2.2 * (p * slowZ F q.1 + pz * slowZ G q.1)]

name: NavierStokes.PhaseCalculus.phaseNormal_ne_zero_of_close
statement:
theorem phaseNormal_ne_zero_of_close (ε p pz x0 B s Kθ Kz : ℝ)
    (F G : Slow → ℝ) (q : Slot) (hB : 0 < B) (hK : Kθ ^ 2 + Kz ^ 2 = 1)
    (hclose : ‖phaseNormal ε p pz x0 F G q - referenceNormal B s Kθ Kz‖ ≤ B / 2) :
    phaseNormal ε p pz x0 F G q ≠ 0

name: NavierStokes.PhaseCalculus.phaseNormal_norm_lower
statement:
theorem phaseNormal_norm_lower (ε p pz x0 B s Kθ Kz δ : ℝ)
    (F G : Slow → ℝ) (q : Slot) (hK : Kθ ^ 2 + Kz ^ 2 = 1)
    (hclose : ‖phaseNormal ε p pz x0 F G q - referenceNormal B s Kθ Kz‖ ≤ δ) :
    B - δ ≤ ‖phaseNormal ε p pz x0 F G q‖

name: NavierStokes.PhaseCalculus.phase_angularShift
statement:
theorem phase_angularShift (ε p pz x0 h : ℝ) (F G : Slow → ℝ) (q : Slot) :
    phase ε p pz x0 F G (angularShift h q) = phase ε p pz x0 F G q + p * h

name: NavierStokes.PhaseCalculus.phase_dR
statement:
theorem phase_dR (ε p pz x0 : ℝ) (F G : Slow → ℝ) (q : Slot)
    (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ F q.1) (hG : DifferentiableAt ℝ G q.1) :
    fderiv ℝ (phase ε p pz x0 F G) q eR =
      x0 - q.2.2 * (p * slowR F q.1 + pz * slowR G q.1)

name: NavierStokes.PhaseCalculus.phase_dT
statement:
theorem phase_dT (ε p pz x0 : ℝ) (F G : Slow → ℝ) (q : Slot)
    (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ F q.1) (hG : DifferentiableAt ℝ G q.1) :
    fderiv ℝ (phase ε p pz x0 F G) q eT =
      -q.2.2 * (p * slowT F q.1 + pz * slowT G q.1)

name: NavierStokes.PhaseCalculus.phase_dTheta
statement:
theorem phase_dTheta (ε p pz x0 : ℝ) (F G : Slow → ℝ) (q : Slot)
    (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ F q.1) (hG : DifferentiableAt ℝ G q.1) :
    fderiv ℝ (phase ε p pz x0 F G) q eTheta = p

name: NavierStokes.PhaseCalculus.phase_dV
statement:
theorem phase_dV (ε p pz x0 : ℝ) (F G : Slow → ℝ) (q : Slot)
    (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ F q.1) (hG : DifferentiableAt ℝ G q.1) :
    fderiv ℝ (phase ε p pz x0 F G) q eV = -(p * F q.1 + pz * G q.1)

name: NavierStokes.PhaseCalculus.phase_dZ
statement:
theorem phase_dZ (ε p pz x0 : ℝ) (F G : Slow → ℝ) (q : Slot)
    (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ F q.1) (hG : DifferentiableAt ℝ G q.1) :
    fderiv ℝ (phase ε p pz x0 F G) q eZ =
      pz / ε - q.2.2 * (p * slowZ F q.1 + pz * slowZ G q.1)

name: NavierStokes.PhaseCalculus.referenceNormal_norm_ge
statement:
theorem referenceNormal_norm_ge (B s Kθ Kz : ℝ)
    (hK : Kθ ^ 2 + Kz ^ 2 = 1) :
    B ≤ ‖referenceNormal B s Kθ Kz‖

name: NavierStokes.PhaseCalculus.signedMaterialOp_phase
statement:
theorem signedMaterialOp_phase (σ ε p pz x0 : ℝ) (b F G : Slow → ℝ) (q : Slot)
    (hε : ε ≠ 0) (hR : 0 < q.1.1)
    (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ F q.1) (hG : DifferentiableAt ℝ G q.1) :
    signedMaterialOp σ ε b F G (phase ε p pz x0 F G) q =
      b q.1 * x0 - q.2.2 *
        (b q.1 * (p * slowR F q.1 + pz * slowR G q.1) +
          σ * ε * (p * slowT F q.1 + pz * slowT G q.1) +
          ε * G q.1 * (p * slowZ F q.1 + pz * slowZ G q.1))

name: NavierStokes.PhaseCalculus.vec3_norm_sq
statement:
theorem vec3_norm_sq (w : Vec3) :
    ‖w‖ ^ 2 = (w 0) ^ 2 + (w 1) ^ 2 + (w 2) ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.RadialAlias.aliasIntegral_directionalDeriv
statement:
theorem aliasIntegral_directionalDeriv [CompleteSpace F]

name: NavierStokes.RadialAlias.sourceJet_continuous
statement:
theorem sourceJet_continuous
    (J : (ℝ × E → F) → (ℝ × E → F)) (f : ℝ × E → F) (p : ℕ)

theorem wholeAlias_directionalDeriv [CompleteSpace F]

    (hM : M ≠ 0) (hg : ContDiff ℝ 1 g) (hs : RadiallySupported a b g) :

name: NavierStokes.RadialAlias.wholeAlias_inverse_iterate

theorem wholeAlias_inverse_iterate [CompleteSpace F] {a b M : ℝ} {v Y : E}
    (J : (ℝ × E → F) → (ℝ × E → F)) (f : ℝ × E → F) (p : ℕ) (hM : M ≠ 0)
    (hcomm : Function.Commute slowDeriv J)
    (hJ : ∀ n < p, ContDiff ℝ 1 (J (sourceJet J f n)))
    (hs : ∀ n < p, RadiallySupported a b (J (sourceJet J f n)))
    (hr : ∀ n < p, directionalDeriv v (J (sourceJet J f n)) = sourceJet J f n) :
    wholeAlias M v Y f = (-M⁻¹) ^ p •
      wholeAlias M v Y (slowDeriv^[p] (J^[p] f))

name: NavierStokes.TransportPrimitive.iteratedFDeriv_compactIntegral_eq
statement:
theorem iteratedFDeriv_compactIntegral_eq [CompleteSpace F] {a b M : ℝ} {v : E}
    {f : ℝ × E → F} {χ : ℝ → ℝ} (hχ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ)
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hs : RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b f) (n : ℕ) (z : ℝ × E) :
    iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (compactIntegral χ M v f) z =
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (pastIntegral M v f) z -
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y => χ y.1 • totalIntegral M v f y) z

name: NavierStokes.TransportPrimitive.iteratedFDeriv_compactIntegral_norm_le
statement:
theorem iteratedFDeriv_compactIntegral_norm_le [CompleteSpace F] {a b M : ℝ} {v : E}
    {f : ℝ × E → F} {χ : ℝ → ℝ} (hχ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ)
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hs : RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b f) (n : ℕ) (z : ℝ × E) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (compactIntegral χ M v f) z‖ ≤
      ‖pastIntegral M v (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f) z‖ +
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) *
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun y : ℝ × E => χ y.1) z‖ *
            ‖totalIntegral M v (iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n - i) f) z‖

statement:

    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hs : RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b f) (n : ℕ)
    (A B : ℕ → ℝ) (hB : ∀ i ≤ n, 0 ≤ B i)
    (hsource : ∀ j ≤ n, ∀ s ∈ Icc a b, ∀ Y : E, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f (s, Y)‖ ≤ A j)
    (hcutoff : ∀ i ≤ n, ∀ z : ℝ × E, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun y : ℝ × E => χ y.1) z‖ ≤ B i)
    (z : ℝ × E) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (compactIntegral χ M v f) z‖ ≤
      (A n + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) * B i * A (n - i)) * (b - a)

name: NavierStokes.TransportPrimitive.transport_compactIntegral
statement:
theorem transport_compactIntegral [CompleteSpace F] {a b M : ℝ} {v : E}
    {f : ℝ × E → F} {χ : ℝ → ℝ} (hχ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ)
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hs : RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b f)
    (z : ℝ × E) :
    fixedDeriv (1, M • v) (compactIntegral χ M v f) z =
      f z - deriv χ z.1 • totalIntegral M v f z

name: NavierStokes.WeightedRadialPrimitive.canonical_transport_compact_uniform
statement:
theorem canonical_transport_compact_uniform
    {a b cL cR : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b)
    (hcL : 0 < cL) (hcR : 0 < cR) (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ (M : ℝ) (v : E) (f : ℝ × E → V), Continuous f →
      RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b f → ∀ A : ℝ, 0 ≤ A →
      (∀ X ∈ Ioo a b, ∀ Y : E, ‖f (X, Y)‖ ≤ A * logWeight cL cR a b m X) →
      ∀ z : ℝ × E, z.1 ∈ Ioo a b →
        ‖TransportPrimitive.compactIntegral (TransportPrimitive.interiorCutoff a b) M v f z‖ ≤
          K * A * logWeight cL cR a b m z.1

statement:
theorem canonical_transport_finiteJets_uniform
    {a b cL cR : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b)
    (hcL : 0 < cL) (hcR : 0 < cR) (p m : ℕ) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ (M : ℝ) (v : E) (f : ℝ × E → V), ContDiff ℝ ∞ f →
      RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b f → ∀ A : ℝ, 0 ≤ A →
      (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ m → ∀ X ∈ Ioo a b, ∀ Y : E,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f (X, Y)‖ ≤ A * logWeight cL cR a b p X) →
      ∀ z : ℝ × E, z.1 ∈ Ioo a b → ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ m →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j
          (TransportPrimitive.compactIntegral (TransportPrimitive.interiorCutoff a b) M v f) z‖ ≤
          K * A * logWeight cL cR a b p z.1

theorem compact_jet_eq_neg_future_on_right

    (ha : 0 < a) (hf : Continuous f) (hs : RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b f)
    (hright : ∀ s, logLength a b - ρ ≤ s → χ (expCoordinate a s) = 1)
    (z : ℝ × E) (hz : 0 < z.1) (hzρ : logLength a b - ρ < logPosition a z.1) (j : ℕ) :
    iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (TransportPrimitive.compactIntegral χ M v f) z =
      -iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (TransportPrimitive.futureIntegral M v f) z

    (z : ℝ × E) (hz : 0 < z.1) (hzρ : logPosition a z.1 < ρ) (j : ℕ) :

statement:
theorem compact_primitive_uniform
    {cL cR L ρ : ℝ} (hcL : 0 < cL) (hcR : 0 < cR) (hL : 0 < L)
    (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρL : ρ ≤ L / 2) (m : ℕ) (χ : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hχ : ∀ x, |χ x| ≤ 1)
    (hleft : ∀ x, x ≤ ρ → χ x = 0)
    (hright : ∀ x, L - ρ ≤ x → χ x = 1) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ (f : ℝ → V), Continuous f → ∀ A : ℝ, 0 ≤ A →
      (∀ s ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) L, ‖f s‖ ≤ A * weight cL cR L m s) →
      ∀ x ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) L,
        ‖compactPrimitive χ f L x‖ ≤ K * A * weight cL cR L m x

theorem logStrip_majorant_eq
    {a b cL cR : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hcL : 0 < cL) (hcR : 0 < cR)
    (ε S : ℕ → ℝ) (hε : ∀ n, 0 < ε n) (hεone : ∀ n, ε n ≤ 1) (hS : ∀ n, 1 ≤ S n)
    (α C : ℝ) (p n : ℕ) (z : ℝ × E) (hz : z.1 ∈ Ioo a b) :
    WeightedClasses.majorant (logStripData a b cL cR ha hcL hcR ε S hε hεone hS)
      (fun _ y => (logStripData a b cL cR ha hcL hcR ε S hε hεone hS).zeta y) α C p n z =
      (C * (ε n) ^ α * (S n) ^ p) * logWeight cL cR a b p z.1

name: NavierStokes.WeightedRadialPrimitive.logWeight_formula
statement:
theorem logWeight_formula {a b X : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hX : X ∈ Ioo a b)
    (cL cR : ℝ) (m : ℕ) :
    logWeight cL cR a b m X =
      Real.exp (-cL / (Real.log (X / a)) ^ 2 - cR / (Real.log (b / X)) ^ 2) /
        (min 1 (min (Real.log (X / a)) (Real.log (b / X)))) ^ m

name: NavierStokes.WeightedRadialPrimitive.log_compact_primitive_uniform
statement:
theorem log_compact_primitive_uniform

    (hχ : ∀ x, |χ x| ≤ 1)
    (hleft : ∀ x, x ≤ ρ → χ x = 0)
    (hright : ∀ x, logLength a b - ρ ≤ x → χ x = 1) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ (f : ℝ → V), Continuous f → ∀ A : ℝ, 0 ≤ A →
      (∀ X ∈ Ioo a b, ‖f X‖ ≤ A * logWeight cL cR a b m X) →
      ∀ X ∈ Ioo a b,
        ‖logCompactPrimitive χ f a b X‖ ≤ K * A * logWeight cL cR a b m X

    (ε S : ℕ → ℝ) (hε : ∀ n, 0 < ε n) (hεone : ∀ n, ε n ≤ 1) (hS : ∀ n, 1 ≤ S n)
    (α : ℝ) (M : ℕ → ℝ) (v : ℕ → E) (f : ℕ → ℝ × E → V)
    (hf : ∀ n, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (f n)) (hs : ∀ n, RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b (f n))
    (hclass : WeightedClasses.MeanClass
      (logStripData a b cL cR ha hcL hcR ε S hε hεone hS) α f) :
    let g := fun n => TransportPrimitive.compactIntegral (TransportPrimitive.interiorCutoff a b)
      (M n) (v n) (f n)

      (∀ n, RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b (g n)) ∧
      WeightedClasses.MeanClass (logStripData a b cL cR ha hcL hcR ε S hε hεone hS) α g

theorem logWeight_power_reverse {a b R d : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hR : R ∈ Ioo a b) (cL cR : ℝ) (p : ℕ) :
    logWeight cL cR a b p R ≤ ((min 1 d⁻¹) ^ p)⁻¹ *
      logWeight (d ^ 2 * cL) (d ^ 2 * cR) (a ^ d) (b ^ d) p (R ^ d)

    (ε S : ℕ → ℝ) (hε : ∀ n, 0 < ε n) (hεone : ∀ n, ε n ≤ 1) (hS : ∀ n, 1 ≤ S n)
    (α : ℝ) (M : ℕ → ℝ) (v : ℕ → E) (g : ℕ → ℝ × E → V)
    (hg : ∀ n, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (g n)) (hs : ∀ n, RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b (g n))
    (hclass : WeightedClasses.MeanClass
      (logStripData a b cL cR ha hcL hcR ε S hε hεone hS) α g) :
    WeightedClasses.MeanClass (logStripData a b cL cR ha hcL hcR ε S hε hεone hS) α

name: NavierStokes.RadialPullback.normalizeSource_finiteJets_uniform
statement:
theorem normalizeSource_finiteJets_uniform {a b d : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (hd : 0 < d) (cL cR : ℝ) (p m : ℕ) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ (g : ℝ × E → V), ContDiff ℝ ∞ g → ∀ A : ℝ, 0 ≤ A →
      (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ m → ∀ R ∈ Ioo a b, ∀ Y : E,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j g (R, Y)‖ ≤ A * logWeight cL cR a b p R) →
      ∀ z : ℝ × E, z.1 ∈ Ioo (a ^ d) (b ^ d) → ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ m →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (normalizeSource d a g) z‖ ≤
          K * A * logWeight (d ^ 2 * cL) (d ^ 2 * cR) (a ^ d) (b ^ d) p z.1

statement:

    {g : ℝ × E → V} (hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g) (M U₀ : ℝ) (v Y : E) :
    (∫ U in (a ^ d)..(R ^ d), normalizeSource d a g (U, Y + (M * (U - U₀)) • v)) =
      ∫ s in a..R, g (s, Y + (M * (s ^ d - U₀)) • v)

theorem physicalAlias_eq_cutoff_derivative {a d b M : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)

name: NavierStokes.RadialPullback.physicalCompact_contDiff
NavierStokes.RadialPullback.physicalCompact_eq_radialIntegral
statement:
theorem physicalCompact_eq_radialIntegral {a b d : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (hd : 0 < d) {g : ℝ × E → V}
    (hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g) (hs : RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b g)
    (M : ℝ) (v : E) (z : ℝ × E) (hz : a ≤ z.1) :
    physicalCompact d a b M v g z =
      (∫ s in a..z.1, g (s, z.2 + (M * (s ^ d - z.1 ^ d)) • v)) -
      TransportPrimitive.interiorCutoff (a ^ d) (b ^ d) (z.1 ^ d) •
        (∫ s in a..b, g (s, z.2 + (M * (s ^ d - z.1 ^ d)) • v))

    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ (M : ℝ) (v : E) (g : ℝ × E → V), ContDiff ℝ ∞ g →
      RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b g → ∀ A : ℝ, 0 ≤ A →
      (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ m → ∀ R ∈ Ioo a b, ∀ Y : E,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j g (R, Y)‖ ≤ A * logWeight cL cR a b p R) →
      ∀ z : ℝ × E, z.1 ∈ Ioo a b → ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ m →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (physicalCompact d a b M v g) z‖ ≤
          K * A * logWeight cL cR a b p z.1

    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ (F : ℝ × E → V), ContDiff ℝ ∞ F →
      ∀ (z : ℝ × E), z.1 ∈ Icc a b → ∀ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C →
      (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ m → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F (liftChart φ z)‖ ≤ C) →
      ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ m → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (F ∘ liftChart φ) z‖ ≤ K * C

    (ε S : ℕ → ℝ) (hε : ∀ n, 0 < ε n) (hεone : ∀ n, ε n ≤ 1) (hS : ∀ n, 1 ≤ S n)
    (α : ℝ) (M : ℕ → ℝ) (v : ℕ → E) (g : ℕ → ℝ × E → V)
    (hg : ∀ n, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (g n)) (hs : ∀ n, RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b (g n))
    (hclass : WeightedClasses.MeanClass
      (logStripData a b cL cR ha hcL hcR ε S hε hεone hS) α g) :
    let F := fun n => physicalCompact d a b (M n) (v n) (g n)
    (∀ n, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (F n)) ∧
      (∀ n, RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b (F n)) ∧
      WeightedClasses.MeanClass (logStripData a b cL cR ha hcL hcR ε S hε hεone hS) α F

statement:
theorem carrier_class_physical_bound {h a b : ℝ} (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hh1 : h ≤ 1 / 2)
    (ha : 0 < a) (m : ℕ) (g d e A B H : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 1 ≤ B)
    (he : 0 ≤ e) (hH : 0 ≤ H) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, 4 ≤ n → ∀ p : SpaceTime,
      scaledRadial n p ∈ annulus a b → |p.1| ≤ 1 →
      ∀ q : ℝ, 0 < q → q / 2 ≤ ChartScales.Q n → ChartScales.Q n ≤ 2 * q →
      ∀ (amp : LiftPoint → ℂ) (Φ : LiftPoint → ℝ) (j : ℤ),
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ amp → ContDiff ℝ ∞ Φ → |(j : ℝ)| ≤ H →
      (∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i amp (physicalLift h n p)‖ ≤
        A * ChartScales.Q n ^ g * ChartScales.S n ^ d) →
      (∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i Φ (physicalLift h n p)‖ ≤
        B * ChartScales.S n ^ e * ChartScales.Q n ^ (-1 : ℝ)) →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m
        ((fun y => amp y * character ((ChartScales.carrier h n : ℝ) * (j : ℝ)) (Φ y)) ∘
          physicalLift h n) p‖ ≤ C * q ^ (g - waveLoss h m)

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalGraphBounds.carrier_graph_jet_bound
statement:
theorem carrier_graph_jet_bound {h a b : ℝ} (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hh1 : h ≤ 1 / 2)
    (ha : 0 < a) (m : ℕ) : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
    ∀ n : ℕ, 4 ≤ n → ∀ p : SpaceTime,
      scaledRadial n p ∈ annulus a b → |p.1| ≤ 1 →
      ∀ (A : LiftPoint → ℂ) (Φ : LiftPoint → ℝ),
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ A → ContDiff ℝ ∞ Φ → ∀ (P B H : ℝ) (j : ℤ),
      0 ≤ P → 1 ≤ B → |(j : ℝ)| ≤ H →
      (∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i A (physicalLift h n p)‖ ≤ P) →
      (∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i Φ (physicalLift h n p)‖ ≤ B) →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m
        ((fun y => A y * character ((ChartScales.carrier h n : ℝ) * (j : ℝ)) (Φ y)) ∘
          physicalLift h n) p‖ ≤
        C * P * B ^ m * (1 + 2 * H) ^ m *
          ChartScales.Q n ^ (-(graphLoss m + h * (m : ℝ) / 2))

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalGraphBounds.liftedPhase_jet_bound
statement:
theorem liftedPhase_jet_bound {κ : Plane → Plane} (hκ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ κ)
    (h : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (center : Plane) (r0 p pz x0 : ℝ) {F G : Slow → ℝ}
    (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (y : LiftPoint) (m : ℕ)
    {K M B : ℝ} (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hκb : ∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i κ (liftXY y)‖ ≤ K)
    (hpoint : ‖slotMap κ (ChartScales.timeCoefficient h n) center r0 y‖ ≤ M)
    (hFb : ∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F
      (slotMap κ (ChartScales.timeCoefficient h n) center r0 y).1‖ ≤ B)
    (hGb : ∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i G
      (slotMap κ (ChartScales.timeCoefficient h n) center r0 y).1‖ ≤ B) :
    ∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (liftedPhase κ h n center r0 p pz x0 F G) y‖ ≤
      (m.factorial : ℝ) *
        ((|p| + |pz / ChartScales.epsilon h n| + |x0|) * M +
          (2 : ℝ) ^ m * M * ((|p| + |pz|) * B)) *
        (K + 1 + |(ChartScales.timeCoefficient h n)⁻¹| * ‖etaCoordinate‖) ^ m

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalGraphBounds.liftedPhase_physical_formula
statement:
theorem liftedPhase_physical_formula {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (chart : PolarCharts.Index) (h : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (center : Plane)
    (r0 p pz x0 : ℝ) (F G : Slow → ℝ) (w : SpaceTime)
    (hw : scaledRadial n w ∈ PolarCharts.sector a b chart) :
    let R := PolarCharts.radius (scaledRadial n w)
    let θ := Real.arctan ((PolarCharts.rotate chart (scaledRadial n w)).2 /
      (PolarCharts.rotate chart (scaledRadial n w)).1) + PolarCharts.offset chart
    let Z := ChartScales.Q n ^ (-CoordinateAlgebra.D h) * w.2 2
    let T := (1 - w.1) / ChartScales.Q n
    liftedPhase (PolarCharts.chart a chart) h n center r0 p pz x0 F G (physicalLift h n w) =
      p * θ + (pz / ChartScales.epsilon h n) * Z + x0 * R -
        slotTime h n center r0 w * (p * F (R, (Z, T)) + pz * G (R, (Z, T)))

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalGraphBounds.liftedPhase_power_bound
statement:
theorem liftedPhase_power_bound {h K Z r0 P B d : ℝ}
    (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hh1 : h ≤ 1) (hK : 1 ≤ K)
    (hZ : 0 ≤ Z) (hr0 : 0 ≤ r0) (hP : 1 ≤ P) (hB : 1 ≤ B) (hd : 0 ≤ d) (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧ ∀ κ : Plane → Plane, ContDiff ℝ ∞ κ →
      ∀ n : ℕ, 4 ≤ n → ∀ (center : Plane) (p pz x0 : ℝ),
      |p| ≤ P → |pz| ≤ P → |x0| ≤ P → ∀ (F G : Slow → ℝ),
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ F → ContDiff ℝ ∞ G → ∀ y : LiftPoint,
      (∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i κ (liftXY y)‖ ≤ K) →
      ‖liftZT y‖ ≤ Z → |etaCoordinate (y.2 - center)| ≤ r0 →
      (∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F
        (slotMap κ (ChartScales.timeCoefficient h n) center r0 y).1‖ ≤ B * ChartScales.S n ^ d) →
      (∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i G
        (slotMap κ (ChartScales.timeCoefficient h n) center r0 y).1‖ ≤ B * ChartScales.S n ^ d) →
      ∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (liftedPhase κ h n center r0 p pz x0 F G) y‖ ≤
        C * ChartScales.S n ^ (d + (m : ℝ) + 1) * ChartScales.Q n ^ (-1 : ℝ)

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalGraphBounds.native_carrier_physical_bound
statement:
theorem native_carrier_physical_bound {h a b Z r0 P B dBase : ℝ}
    (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hh1 : h ≤ 1 / 2) (ha : 0 < a)
    (hZ : 0 ≤ Z) (hr0 : 0 ≤ r0) (hP : 1 ≤ P) (hB : 1 ≤ B) (hdBase : 0 ≤ dBase)
    (m : ℕ) (g dAmp A H : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hH : 0 ≤ H) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, 4 ≤ n → ∀ w : SpaceTime,
      scaledRadial n w ∈ annulus a b → |w.1| ≤ 1 →
      ‖liftZT (physicalLift h n w)‖ ≤ Z →
      ∀ q : ℝ, 0 < q → q / 2 ≤ ChartScales.Q n → ChartScales.Q n ≤ 2 * q →
      ∀ (chart : PolarCharts.Index) (center : Plane) (p pz x0 : ℝ),
      |p| ≤ P → |pz| ≤ P → |x0| ≤ P →
      |etaCoordinate (nativeGraph h n w - center)| ≤ r0 →
      ∀ (amp : LiftPoint → ℂ) (F G : Slow → ℝ) (j : ℤ),
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ amp → ContDiff ℝ ∞ F → ContDiff ℝ ∞ G → |(j : ℝ)| ≤ H →
      (∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i amp (physicalLift h n w)‖ ≤
        A * ChartScales.Q n ^ g * ChartScales.S n ^ dAmp) →
      (∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F
        (slotMap (PolarCharts.chart a chart) (ChartScales.timeCoefficient h n) center r0
          (physicalLift h n w)).1‖ ≤ B * ChartScales.S n ^ dBase) →
      (∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i G
        (slotMap (PolarCharts.chart a chart) (ChartScales.timeCoefficient h n) center r0
          (physicalLift h n w)).1‖ ≤ B * ChartScales.S n ^ dBase) →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m
        ((fun y => amp y * character ((ChartScales.carrier h n : ℝ) * (j : ℝ))
          (liftedPhase (PolarCharts.chart a chart) h n center r0 p pz x0 F G y)) ∘
          physicalLift h n) w‖ ≤ C * q ^ (g - waveLoss h m)

    (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (q : Slot) (m : ℕ)

    (hGb : ∀ k ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k G q.1‖ ≤ B) :

        ContDiff ℝ ∞ (PolarCharts.chart a j) ∧

theorem pointwise_composition_jet_bound {E F G : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G]
    {f : E → F} {g : F → G} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g) (x : E)

    (hgb : ∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i g (f x)‖ ≤ B)
    (hfb : ∀ i, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ m → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f x‖ ≤ D) :

    (hgb : ∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i g x‖ ≤ Q) :

statement:
theorem slotMap_formula (κ : Plane → Plane) (ci : ℝ) (center : Plane) (r0 : ℝ) (y : LiftPoint) :
    slotMap κ ci center r0 y =
      (((κ (liftXY y)).1, (y.1.2.2.2, y.1.1)),
        ((κ (liftXY y)).2, (etaCoordinate (y.2 - center) + r0) / ci))

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalGraphBounds.slotMap_norm_bound
statement:
theorem slotMap_norm_bound (κ : Plane → Plane) (ci : ℝ) (center : Plane) (r0 : ℝ)
    (y : LiftPoint) {K Z V : ℝ} (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hZ : 0 ≤ Z) (hV : 0 ≤ V)
    (hk : ‖κ (liftXY y)‖ ≤ K) (hz : ‖liftZT y‖ ≤ Z)
    (hv : |(etaCoordinate (y.2 - center) + r0) / ci| ≤ V) :

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalGraphBounds.slotMap_physical
statement:
theorem slotMap_physical (κ : Plane → Plane) (h : ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    (center : Plane) (r0 : ℝ) (p : SpaceTime) :
    slotMap κ (ChartScales.timeCoefficient h n) center r0 (physicalLift h n p) =
      (((κ (scaledRadial n p)).1,
        (ChartScales.Q n ^ (-CoordinateAlgebra.D h) * p.2 2, (1 - p.1) / ChartScales.Q n)),
       ((κ (scaledRadial n p)).2, slotTime h n center r0 p))

statement:
theorem slotMap_positive_jet_bound {κ : Plane → Plane} (hκ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ κ)

    (hκb : ∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i κ (liftXY y)‖ ≤ K) :
    ∀ i, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ m → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (slotMap κ ci center r0) y‖ ≤
      K + 1 + |ci⁻¹| * ‖etaCoordinate‖

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalGraphBounds.stripped_class_physical_bound
statement:
theorem stripped_class_physical_bound {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {h a b : ℝ} (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hh1 : h ≤ 1 / 2) (ha : 0 < a)
    (m : ℕ) (g d A : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
    ∀ n : ℕ, 4 ≤ n → ∀ p : SpaceTime,
      scaledRadial n p ∈ annulus a b → |p.1| ≤ 1 →
      ∀ q : ℝ, 0 < q → q / 2 ≤ ChartScales.Q n → ChartScales.Q n ≤ 2 * q →
      ∀ F : LiftPoint → E, ContDiff ℝ ∞ F →
      (∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F (physicalLift h n p)‖ ≤
        A * ChartScales.Q n ^ g * ChartScales.S n ^ d) →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (F ∘ physicalLift h n) p‖ ≤
        C * q ^ (g - (graphLoss m + 1))

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.coordinateEta_abs_lt_one
statement:
theorem coordinateEta_abs_lt_one {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1)
    {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : 0 < p.1) : |coordinateEta a p| < 1

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.coordinateEta_hasDerivAt_tau
statement:
theorem coordinateEta_hasDerivAt_tau {a τ z : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => coordinateEta a (t, z))
      (-((1 - a) / 2) * coordinateEta a (τ, z) /
        (coordinateQ a (τ, z) * scalarSlope a z (coordinateQ a (τ, z)))) τ

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.coordinateEta_hasDerivAt_time
statement:
theorem coordinateEta_hasDerivAt_time {a t z : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) (ht : t < 1) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => coordinateEta a (1 - s, z))
      (((1 - a) / 2) * coordinateEta a (1 - t, z) /
        (coordinateQ a (1 - t, z) *
          (1 - a * coordinateEta a (1 - t, z) ^ 2))) t

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.coordinateEta_hasDerivAt_z
statement:
theorem coordinateEta_hasDerivAt_z {a τ z : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun x => coordinateEta a (τ, x))
      ((1 - coordinateEta a (τ, z) ^ 2) /
        (coordinateQ a (τ, z) ^ ((1 - a) / 2) *
          scalarSlope a z (coordinateQ a (τ, z)))) z

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.coordinateEta_hasDerivAt_z_L
statement:
theorem coordinateEta_hasDerivAt_z_L {a τ z : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun x => coordinateEta a (τ, x))
      ((1 - coordinateEta a (τ, z) ^ 2) /
        (coordinateQ a (τ, z) ^ ((1 - a) / 2) *
          (1 - a * coordinateEta a (τ, z) ^ 2))) z

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.coordinateEta_smooth
statement:
theorem coordinateEta_smooth {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1)
    {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : 0 < p.1) : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (coordinateEta a) p

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.coordinateEta_sq
statement:
theorem coordinateEta_sq {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1)
    {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : 0 < p.1) :
    coordinateEta a p ^ 2 = p.2 ^ 2 * coordinateQ a p ^ a / coordinateQ a p

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.coordinateEta_sq_lt_one
statement:
theorem coordinateEta_sq_lt_one {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1)

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.coordinateQ_above_threshold
statement:
theorem coordinateQ_above_threshold {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1)
    {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : 0 < p.1) :
    |p.2| ^ (((1 - a) / 2)⁻¹) < coordinateQ a p

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.coordinateQ_fderiv_apply
statement:
theorem coordinateQ_fderiv_apply {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1)
    {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : 0 < p.1) (v : ℝ × ℝ) :
    fderiv ℝ (coordinateQ a) p v =
      (v.1 + 2 * p.2 * coordinateQ a p ^ a * v.2) /
        scalarSlope a p.2 (coordinateQ a p)

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.coordinateQ_hasDerivAt_tau
statement:
theorem coordinateQ_hasDerivAt_tau {a τ z : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => coordinateQ a (t, z))
      (1 / scalarSlope a z (coordinateQ a (τ, z))) τ

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.coordinateQ_hasDerivAt_tau_L
statement:
theorem coordinateQ_hasDerivAt_tau_L {a τ z : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => coordinateQ a (t, z))
      (1 / (1 - a * coordinateEta a (τ, z) ^ 2)) τ

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.coordinateQ_hasDerivAt_time
statement:
theorem coordinateQ_hasDerivAt_time {a t z : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) (ht : t < 1) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => coordinateQ a (1 - s, z))
      (-1 / scalarSlope a z (coordinateQ a (1 - t, z))) t

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.coordinateQ_hasDerivAt_time_L
statement:
theorem coordinateQ_hasDerivAt_time_L {a t z : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) (ht : t < 1) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => coordinateQ a (1 - s, z))
      (-1 / (1 - a * coordinateEta a (1 - t, z) ^ 2)) t

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.coordinateQ_hasDerivAt_z
statement:
theorem coordinateQ_hasDerivAt_z {a τ z : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun x => coordinateQ a (τ, x))
      (2 * z * coordinateQ a (τ, z) ^ a /

name: NavierStokes.CommonCoverClass.bandChart_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem bandChart_apply (D : ℝ) (n m : ℕ) (x : SlowPoint) :
    bandChart D n m x = (bandRatio (1 / 2) n m * x.1,
      (bandRatio D n m * x.2.1, bandRatio 1 n m * x.2.2))

name: NavierStokes.CommonCoverClass.bandChart_eq_transition
statement:
theorem bandChart_eq_transition (h : ℝ) (n m : ℕ) (x : SlowPoint) :

statement:
theorem bandChart_formula (D : ℝ) (n m : ℕ) (x : SlowPoint) :
    bandChart D n m x = ((ChartScales.Q n / ChartScales.Q m) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * x.1,
      ((ChartScales.Q n / ChartScales.Q m) ^ D * x.2.1,
        (ChartScales.Q n / ChartScales.Q m) * x.2.2))

name: NavierStokes.CommonCoverClass.bandCommonChart_apply
statement:

name: NavierStokes.CommonCoverClass.bandCommonChart_envelope
statement:
theorem bandCommonChart_envelope {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V]
    (D : ℝ) {n m gap gapBound r : ℕ} (hnm : n ≤ m + 4) (hmn : m ≤ n + 4)
    (forward : Bool) (hgap : gap ≤ gapBound) {f : SlowPoint × Plane → V}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) {e : SlowPoint × Plane → ℝ} (he : EnvelopeJets r f e) :
    EnvelopeJets r (fun x => f (bandCommonChart D n m forward gap x))
      (fun x => e (bandCommonChart D n m forward gap x) * commonChartCost D gapBound ^ r)

name: NavierStokes.CommonCoverClass.bandGeometry_argumentCost_le
statement:
theorem bandGeometry_argumentCost_le (B : Plane ≃L[ℝ] Plane) {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 ≤ h)

name: NavierStokes.CommonCoverClass.bandGeometry_path
statement:
theorem bandGeometry_path (B : Plane ≃L[ℝ] Plane) (h : ℝ) (n gap : ℕ)
    (center : Plane) (k : Frequency) (Y : Plane) (s : ℝ) :
    (bandGeometry B h n gap center).path k Y s =
      Y + (CommonCoverSolve.coverPower gap).symm
        ((ChartScales.timeCoefficient h n *
          (s - ((bandGeometry B h n gap center).coordinates k Y).2)) • B (0, 1))

name: NavierStokes.CommonCoverClass.exists_coarsest_band
statement:
theorem exists_coarsest_band (h : ℝ) (hh : 0 ≤ h) (levels : Finset ℕ)
    (hne : levels.Nonempty) (hpos : ∀ n ∈ levels, 1 ≤ n)
    (hspan : ∀ n ∈ levels, ∀ m ∈ levels, n ≤ m + 4) :
    ∃ c ∈ levels, ∀ n ∈ levels,
      ChartScales.nativeIndex h c ≤ ChartScales.nativeIndex h n ∧

statement:
theorem forcingAlong_band_jet_bound (d : CommonCoverSolve.LinearData P V E)
    (B : Plane ≃L[ℝ] Plane) {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 ≤ h)
    {n gap D : ℕ} (hn : 4 ≤ n) (hd : gap ≤ D) (center : Plane) (k : Frequency)
    (hB : ContDiff ℝ ∞ d.forcingMap) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ d.source)
    (m : ℕ) (w : Joint P) {A C : ℝ}
    (hA : ∀ j ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j d.forcingMap
      (nativeArgument (bandGeometry B h n gap center) k w)‖ ≤ A)
    (hC : ∀ j ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j d.source
      (sourceArgument (bandGeometry B h n gap center) k w)‖ ≤ C) :
    ∀ j ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j
      (d.forcingAlong (bandGeometry B h n gap center) k) w‖ ≤
        2 ^ m * A * C * bandArgumentCost B D ^ (2 * m) * ChartScales.S n ^ (2 * m)

statement:
theorem meanClass_profile_bandCommonChart
    {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V]
    {h a b : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2) (ha : 0 < a)
    (band : ℕ → ℕ) (hband : ∀ n, 1 ≤ band n)
    (ζ : ℝ → ℝ) (hζ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ) (hζ0 : ∀ X ∈ Ioo a b, 0 ≤ ζ X)
    {α : ℝ} {f : ℕ → SlowPoint × Plane → V}
    (hf : WeightedClasses.MeanClass
      (sourceStrip (profileSlowStrip hh hh1 ha band hband ζ hζ hζ0)) α f)
    (gapBound : ℕ) (index gap : ℕ → ℕ) (forward : ℕ → Bool)
    (hoverlap : ∀ n, band n ≤ band (index n) + 4 ∧ band (index n) ≤ band n + 4)
    (hgap : ∀ n, gap n ≤ gapBound) :
    WeightedClasses.MeanClass
      (sourceStrip (profileSlowStrip hh hh1 ha band hband ζ hζ hζ0)) α
      (fun n x => f (index n) (bandCommonChart (CoordinateAlgebra.D h)
        (band n) (band (index n)) (forward n) (gap n) x))

name: NavierStokes.CommonCoverClass.memClass_affine_transport
statement:
theorem memClass_affine_transport
    (s : WeightedClasses.StripData Y) (t : WeightedClasses.StripData X)
    {w : ℕ → Y → ℝ} {v : ℕ → X → ℝ} {α : ℝ} {f : ℕ → Y → V}
    (hf : WeightedClasses.MemClass s w α f)
    (index : ℕ → ℕ) (L : ℕ → X →L[ℝ] Y) (c : ℕ → Y)
    (hmap : ∀ n x, x ∈ t.domain → c n + L n x ∈ s.domain)
    (hweight : ∀ n x, x ∈ t.domain → w (index n) (c n + L n x) = v n x)
    {Ce Cg CL : ℝ} (hCe : 0 ≤ Ce) (hCg : 1 ≤ Cg) (hCL : 1 ≤ CL) (r l : ℕ)
    (heps : ∀ n, s.epsilon (index n) ^ α ≤ Ce * t.epsilon n ^ α)
    (hgrowth : ∀ n x, x ∈ t.domain →
      s.growth (index n) (c n + L n x) ≤ Cg * t.growth n x ^ r)
    (hlinear : ∀ n x, x ∈ t.domain → ‖L n‖ ≤ CL * t.growth n x ^ l) :
    WeightedClasses.MemClass t v α (fun n x => f (index n) (c n + L n x))

name: NavierStokes.CommonCoverClass.memClass_bandCommonChart
statement:
theorem memClass_bandCommonChart {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V]
    (s : WeightedClasses.StripData (SlowPoint × Plane))
    {w v : ℕ → SlowPoint × Plane → ℝ} {α h : ℝ} {f : ℕ → SlowPoint × Plane → V}
    (hf : WeightedClasses.MemClass s w α f) (D : ℝ) (gapBound : ℕ)
    (band index gap : ℕ → ℕ) (forward : ℕ → Bool)
    (hband : ∀ n, 1 ≤ band n)
    (hoverlap : ∀ n, band n ≤ band (index n) + 4 ∧ band (index n) ≤ band n + 4)
    (hgap : ∀ n, gap n ≤ gapBound)
    (hepsilon : ∀ n, s.epsilon n = ChartScales.epsilon h (band n))
    (hslow : ∀ n, s.slow n = ChartScales.S (band n))
    (hmap : ∀ n x, x ∈ s.domain →
      bandCommonChart D (band n) (band (index n)) (forward n) (gap n) x ∈ s.domain)
    (hdelta : ∀ n x, x ∈ s.domain →
      s.delta (bandCommonChart D (band n) (band (index n)) (forward n) (gap n) x) = s.delta x)
    (hweight : ∀ n x, x ∈ s.domain →
      w (index n) (bandCommonChart D (band n) (band (index n)) (forward n) (gap n) x) = v n x) :
    WeightedClasses.MemClass s v α
      (fun n x => f (index n) (bandCommonChart D (band n) (band (index n)) (forward n) (gap n) x))

statement:
theorem memClass_profile_bandCommonChart
    {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V]
    {h a b : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2) (ha : 0 < a)
    (band : ℕ → ℕ) (hband : ∀ n, 1 ≤ band n)
    (ζ : ℝ → ℝ) (hζ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ) (hζ0 : ∀ X ∈ Ioo a b, 0 ≤ ζ X)
    {w v : ℕ → SlowPoint × Plane → ℝ} {α : ℝ} {f : ℕ → SlowPoint × Plane → V}
    (hf : WeightedClasses.MemClass
      (sourceStrip (profileSlowStrip hh hh1 ha band hband ζ hζ hζ0)) w α f)

name: NavierStokes.CopySolveCompatibility.commonSolve_family_represents
statement:
theorem commonSolve_family_represents
    {A B : ℝ} (hAB : A ≤ B) (d : LinearData P V E) (g : Geometry)
    {U : Set P} (hA : ContinuousOn d.coefficient (U ×ˢ univ))
    (hB : ContinuousOn d.forcingMap (U ×ˢ univ)) (hf : ContinuousOn d.source (U ×ˢ univ))
    (κ : Plane → ℝ) (hκ : support κ ⊆ univ ×ˢ Icc A B)
    (χ : X → P × Plane) (domains : I → Set X)
    (charts : I → X → Q × Plane) (φ : I → Q → P) (gaps : I → ℕ)
    (entry exit shift rate amplitude : I → ℝ)
    (hrate : ∀ i, 0 < rate i) (hinterval : ∀ i, entry i ≤ exit i)
    (hentry : ∀ i, shift i + rate i * entry i = A)
    (hexit : ∀ i, shift i + rate i * exit i = B)
    (hchart : ∀ i x, x ∈ domains i →
      (φ i (charts i x).1, coverPower (gaps i) (charts i x).2) = χ x)
    (hslow : ∀ i x, x ∈ domains i → (χ x).1 ∈ U) :
    ∀ i x, x ∈ domains i →
      (transportData d (φ i) (gaps i) (shift i) (rate i) (amplitude i)).commonSolve
          (transportGeometry g (gaps i) (shift i) (rate i) (hrate i).ne') (hinterval i)
          (κ ∘ nativeTimeMap (shift i) (rate i)) (charts i x) =
        amplitude i • physicalOutput d g hAB κ χ x

    {U : Set P} (hA : ContinuousOn d.coefficient (U ×ˢ univ))
    (hB : ContinuousOn d.forcingMap (U ×ˢ univ)) (hf : ContinuousOn d.source (U ×ˢ univ))

    (q : Q) (hq : φ q ∈ U)

    e.commonSolve (transportGeometry g k τ rate hrate.ne') hab

      amplitude • d.commonSolve g (time_interval_mono τ hrate hab) κ (φ q, coverPower k Y)

statement:
theorem compatible_family_represents
    {A B : ℝ} (hAB : A ≤ B) (d : LinearData P V E) (g : Geometry)
    {U : Set P} (hA : ContinuousOn d.coefficient (U ×ˢ univ))
    (hB : ContinuousOn d.forcingMap (U ×ˢ univ)) (hf : ContinuousOn d.source (U ×ˢ univ))
    (κ : Plane → ℝ) (hκ : support κ ⊆ univ ×ˢ Icc A B)
    (χ : X → P × Plane) (domains : I → Set X)
    (charts : I → X → Q × Plane) (φ : I → Q → P) (gaps : I → ℕ)
    (entry exit shift rate amplitude : I → ℝ)
    (hrate : ∀ i, 0 < rate i) (hinterval : ∀ i, entry i ≤ exit i)
    (hentry : ∀ i, shift i + rate i * entry i = A)
    (hexit : ∀ i, shift i + rate i * exit i = B)
    (hchart : ∀ i x, x ∈ domains i →
      (φ i (charts i x).1, coverPower (gaps i) (charts i x).2) = χ x)
    (hslow : ∀ i x, x ∈ domains i → (χ x).1 ∈ U)
    (data : I → LinearData Q V E)
    (hdata : ∀ i x, x ∈ domains i → SameInputsAt (data i)
      (transportData d (φ i) (gaps i) (shift i) (rate i) (amplitude i)) (charts i x).1) :
    ∀ i x, x ∈ domains i →
      (data i).commonSolve
          (transportGeometry g (gaps i) (shift i) (rate i) (hrate i).ne') (hinterval i)
          (κ ∘ nativeTimeMap (shift i) (rate i)) (charts i x) =
        amplitude i • physicalOutput d g hAB κ χ x

statement:
theorem along_along_mode {U : Set E} {V : E → E} (κ : ℝ)
    {Φ : E → ℝ} {a : E → ℂ} {x : E}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ V U)
    (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U) (ha : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a U) (hx : x ∈ U) :
    along V (along V (mode κ Φ a)) x =
      (along V (along V a) x +
        2 * phaseFactor κ * Complex.ofReal (along V Φ x) * along V a x +
        (phaseFactor κ * Complex.ofReal (along V (along V Φ) x) -
          (κ : ℂ) ^ 2 * Complex.ofReal (along V Φ x) ^ 2) * a x) * carrier κ Φ x

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicCalculus.cylindricalDivergence_vectorMode
statement:
theorem cylindricalDivergence_vectorMode (R : E → ℝ) (Vr Vθ Vz : E → E)
    (κ : ℝ) {Φ : E → ℝ} {a : E → ComplexVector} {x : E}
    (hΦ : DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ x)
    (ha : ∀ i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => a y i) x) :
    cylindricalDivergence R Vr Vθ Vz (vectorMode κ Φ a) x =
      (cylindricalDivergence R Vr Vθ Vz a x +
        phaseFactor κ * normalDot (phaseNormal R Vr Vθ Vz Φ x) (a x)) * carrier κ Φ x

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicCalculus.cylindricalLaplacian_angular_independent
statement:
theorem cylindricalLaplacian_angular_independent {U : Set E} (R : E → ℝ)
    (Vr Vθ Vz : E → E) {f : E → F} {x : E}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hf : EqOn (along Vθ f) (fun _ => 0) U) (hx : x ∈ U) :
    cylindricalLaplacian R Vr Vθ Vz f x =
      along Vr (along Vr f) x + (R x)⁻¹ • along Vr f x + along Vz (along Vz f) x

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicCalculus.cylindricalLaplacian_mode
statement:
theorem cylindricalLaplacian_mode {U : Set E} (R : E → ℝ)
    {Vr Vθ Vz : E → E} (κ : ℝ) {Φ : E → ℝ} {a : E → ℂ} {x : E}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hr : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vr U) (hθ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vθ U)
    (hz : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vz U) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U)
    (ha : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a U) (hx : x ∈ U) :
    cylindricalLaplacian R Vr Vθ Vz (mode κ Φ a) x =
      (cylindricalLaplacian R Vr Vθ Vz a x +
        2 * phaseFactor κ * phaseCross R Vr Vθ Vz Φ a x +
        (phaseFactor κ * Complex.ofReal (cylindricalLaplacian R Vr Vθ Vz Φ x) -
          (κ : ℂ) ^ 2 * Complex.ofReal (phaseSquare R Vr Vθ Vz Φ x)) * a x) *
        carrier κ Φ x

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicCalculus.cylindricalLaplacian_mode_angular_independent
statement:
theorem cylindricalLaplacian_mode_angular_independent {U : Set E} (R : E → ℝ)
    {Vr Vθ Vz : E → E} (κ : ℝ) {Φ : E → ℝ} {a : E → ℂ} {p : ℝ} {x : E}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hr : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vr U) (hθ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vθ U)
    (hz : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vz U) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U)
    (ha : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a U) (haθ : EqOn (along Vθ a) (fun _ => 0) U)
    (hΦθ : EqOn (along Vθ Φ) (fun _ => p) U) (hx : x ∈ U) :
    cylindricalLaplacian R Vr Vθ Vz (mode κ Φ a) x =
      (along Vr (along Vr a) x + (R x)⁻¹ • along Vr a x + along Vz (along Vz a) x +
        2 * phaseFactor κ *
          (Complex.ofReal (phaseNormal R Vr Vθ Vz Φ x 0) * along Vr a x +
            Complex.ofReal (phaseNormal R Vr Vθ Vz Φ x 2) * along Vz a x) +
        (phaseFactor κ * Complex.ofReal
          (along Vr (fun y => phaseNormal R Vr Vθ Vz Φ y 0) x +
            phaseNormal R Vr Vθ Vz Φ x 0 / R x +
            along Vz (fun y => phaseNormal R Vr Vθ Vz Φ y 2) x) -
          (κ : ℂ) ^ 2 * Complex.ofReal (‖phaseNormal R Vr Vθ Vz Φ x‖ ^ 2)) * a x) *
        carrier κ Φ x

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicCalculus.cylindricalLaplacian_mode_normal
statement:
theorem cylindricalLaplacian_mode_normal {U : Set E} (R : E → ℝ)
    {Vr Vθ Vz : E → E} (κ : ℝ) {Φ : E → ℝ} {a : E → ℂ} {x : E}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hr : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vr U) (hθ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vθ U)
    (hz : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vz U) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U)
    (ha : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a U) (hx : x ∈ U) :
    cylindricalLaplacian R Vr Vθ Vz (mode κ Φ a) x =
      (cylindricalLaplacian R Vr Vθ Vz a x +
        2 * phaseFactor κ * phaseCross R Vr Vθ Vz Φ a x +
        (phaseFactor κ * Complex.ofReal (cylindricalLaplacian R Vr Vθ Vz Φ x) -
          (κ : ℂ) ^ 2 * Complex.ofReal (‖phaseNormal R Vr Vθ Vz Φ x‖ ^ 2)) * a x) *
        carrier κ Φ x

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicCalculus.cylindricalLaplacian_phase
statement:
theorem cylindricalLaplacian_phase {U : Set E} (R : E → ℝ)
    (Vr Vθ Vz : E → E) {Φ : E → ℝ} {p : ℝ} {x : E}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hΦθ : EqOn (along Vθ Φ) (fun _ => p) U) (hx : x ∈ U) :
    cylindricalLaplacian R Vr Vθ Vz Φ x =
      along Vr (fun y => phaseNormal R Vr Vθ Vz Φ y 0) x +
        phaseNormal R Vr Vθ Vz Φ x 0 / R x +
        along Vz (fun y => phaseNormal R Vr Vθ Vz Φ y 2) x

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicCalculus.cylindricalVectorLaplacian_angular_independent
statement:
theorem cylindricalVectorLaplacian_angular_independent {U : Set E} (R : E → ℝ)
    (Vr Vθ Vz : E → E) {a : E → ComplexVector} {x : E}
    (hU : IsOpen U)
    (haθ : ∀ i, EqOn (along Vθ (fun y => a y i)) (fun _ => 0) U) (hx : x ∈ U) :
    cylindricalVectorLaplacian R Vr Vθ Vz a x = fun i =>
      along Vr (along Vr (fun y => a y i)) x +
        (R x)⁻¹ • along Vr (fun y => a y i) x +
        along Vz (along Vz (fun y => a y i)) x +
        ((R x) ^ 2)⁻¹ • angularGenerator (angularGenerator (a x)) i

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicCalculus.cylindricalVectorLaplacian_vectorMode
statement:
theorem cylindricalVectorLaplacian_vectorMode {U : Set E} (R : E → ℝ)
    {Vr Vθ Vz : E → E} (κ : ℝ) {Φ : E → ℝ} {a : E → ComplexVector} {x : E}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hr : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vr U) (hθ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vθ U)
    (hz : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vz U) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U)
    (ha : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => a y i) U) (hx : x ∈ U) :
    cylindricalVectorLaplacian R Vr Vθ Vz (vectorMode κ Φ a) x = fun i =>
      (cylindricalVectorLaplacian R Vr Vθ Vz a x i +
        2 * phaseFactor κ * phaseCross R Vr Vθ Vz Φ (fun y => a y i) x +
        (phaseFactor κ * Complex.ofReal (cylindricalLaplacian R Vr Vθ Vz Φ x) -
          (κ : ℂ) ^ 2 * Complex.ofReal (‖phaseNormal R Vr Vθ Vz Φ x‖ ^ 2)) * a x i +
        2 * phaseFactor κ * Complex.ofReal (phaseNormal R Vr Vθ Vz Φ x 1 / R x) *
          angularGenerator (a x) i) * carrier κ Φ x

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicCalculus.differentiableAt_carrier
statement:
theorem differentiableAt_carrier (κ : ℝ) {Φ : E → ℝ} {x : E}
    (hΦ : DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ x) : DifferentiableAt ℝ (carrier κ Φ) x

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicCalculus.graph_deriv_radial_mode
statement:
theorem graph_deriv_radial_mode (d : ℝ) (vr vt : GraphCalculus.Plane) (κ : ℝ)
    {Φ : GraphCalculus.Lift → ℝ} {a : GraphCalculus.Lift → ℂ} {r t : ℝ}
    (hr : r ≠ 0) (hΦ : DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ (GraphCalculus.graph d vr vt (r, t)))
    (ha : DifferentiableAt ℝ a (GraphCalculus.graph d vr vt (r, t))) :
    deriv (fun s => mode κ Φ a (GraphCalculus.graph d vr vt (s, t))) r =
      (along (GraphCalculus.radialVector d vr) a (GraphCalculus.graph d vr vt (r, t)) +
        phaseFactor κ * Complex.ofReal
          (along (GraphCalculus.radialVector d vr) Φ (GraphCalculus.graph d vr vt (r, t))) *
            a (GraphCalculus.graph d vr vt (r, t))) *
        carrier κ Φ (GraphCalculus.graph d vr vt (r, t))

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicCalculus.graph_deriv_time_mode
statement:
theorem graph_deriv_time_mode (d : ℝ) (vr vt : GraphCalculus.Plane) (κ : ℝ)
    {Φ : GraphCalculus.Lift → ℝ} {a : GraphCalculus.Lift → ℂ} {r t : ℝ}
    (hΦ : DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ (GraphCalculus.graph d vr vt (r, t)))
    (ha : DifferentiableAt ℝ a (GraphCalculus.graph d vr vt (r, t))) :
    deriv (fun s => mode κ Φ a (GraphCalculus.graph d vr vt (r, s))) t =
      (along (fun _ => GraphCalculus.timeVector vt) a (GraphCalculus.graph d vr vt (r, t)) +
        phaseFactor κ * Complex.ofReal
          (along (fun _ => GraphCalculus.timeVector vt) Φ (GraphCalculus.graph d vr vt (r, t))) *
            a (GraphCalculus.graph d vr vt (r, t))) *
        carrier κ Φ (GraphCalculus.graph d vr vt (r, t))

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicCalculus.longitudinalCoefficient_bound
statement:
theorem longitudinalCoefficient_bound (R : E → ℝ) (Vr Vθ Vz : E → E)
    (κ : ℝ) {Φ : E → ℝ} {a : E → ComplexVector} {x : E}
    (hκ : κ ≠ 0) (hΦ : DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ x)
    (ha : ∀ i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => a y i) x)
    (haθ : along Vθ (fun y => a y 1) x = 0)
    (hdiv : cylindricalDivergence R Vr Vθ Vz (vectorMode κ Φ a) x = 0) :
    ‖longitudinalCoefficient (phaseNormal R Vr Vθ Vz Φ x) (a x)‖ ≤
      (‖along Vr (fun y => a y 0) x‖ + ‖a x 0‖ / |R x| +
        ‖along Vz (fun y => a y 2) x‖) /
        (|κ| * ‖phaseNormal R Vr Vθ Vz Φ x‖)

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicCalculus.longitudinal_gain
statement:
theorem longitudinal_gain (R : E → ℝ) (Vr Vθ Vz : E → E)
    (k : ℝ) (j : ℤ) {Φ : E → ℝ} {a : E → ComplexVector} {x : E}
    {r₀ n₀ A Ar Az : ℝ} (hk : k ≠ 0) (hj : j ≠ 0)
    (hΦ : DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ x)
    (ha : ∀ i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => a y i) x)
    (haθ : along Vθ (fun y => a y 1) x = 0)
    (hdiv : cylindricalDivergence R Vr Vθ Vz (vectorMode (k * (j : ℝ)) Φ a) x = 0)
    (hr₀ : 0 < r₀) (hr : r₀ ≤ R x)
    (hn₀ : 0 < n₀) (hn : n₀ ≤ ‖phaseNormal R Vr Vθ Vz Φ x‖)
    (hA : ‖a x 0‖ ≤ A) (hAr : ‖along Vr (fun y => a y 0) x‖ ≤ Ar)
    (hAz : ‖along Vz (fun y => a y 2) x‖ ≤ Az) :
    ‖longitudinalCoefficient (phaseNormal R Vr Vθ Vz Φ x) (a x)‖ ≤
      (Ar + A / r₀ + Az) / (|k| * |(j : ℝ)| * n₀)

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicCalculus.longitudinal_gain_frequency
statement:
theorem longitudinal_gain_frequency (R : E → ℝ) (Vr Vθ Vz : E → E)
    (κ : ℝ) {Φ : E → ℝ} {a : E → ComplexVector} {x : E}
    {r₀ n₀ A Ar Az : ℝ} (hκ : κ ≠ 0) (hΦ : DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ x)
    (ha : ∀ i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => a y i) x)
    (haθ : along Vθ (fun y => a y 1) x = 0)
    (hdiv : cylindricalDivergence R Vr Vθ Vz (vectorMode κ Φ a) x = 0)
    (hr₀ : 0 < r₀) (hr : r₀ ≤ R x)
    (hn₀ : 0 < n₀) (hn : n₀ ≤ ‖phaseNormal R Vr Vθ Vz Φ x‖)
    (hA : ‖a x 0‖ ≤ A) (hAr : ‖along Vr (fun y => a y 0) x‖ ≤ Ar)
    (hAz : ‖along Vz (fun y => a y 2) x‖ ≤ Az) :
    ‖longitudinalCoefficient (phaseNormal R Vr Vθ Vz Φ x) (a x)‖ ≤
      (Ar + A / r₀ + Az) / (|κ| * n₀)

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicCalculus.longitudinal_identity
statement:
theorem longitudinal_identity (R : E → ℝ) (Vr Vθ Vz : E → E)
    (κ : ℝ) {Φ : E → ℝ} {a : E → ComplexVector} {x : E}
    (hΦ : DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ x)
    (ha : ∀ i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => a y i) x)
    (haθ : along Vθ (fun y => a y 1) x = 0)
    (hdiv : cylindricalDivergence R Vr Vθ Vz (vectorMode κ Φ a) x = 0) :
    phaseFactor κ * normalDot (phaseNormal R Vr Vθ Vz Φ x) (a x) =
      -strippedDivergence R Vr Vz a x

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicCalculus.norm_along_le
statement:
theorem norm_along_le (V : E → E) (f : E → F) (x : E) :
    ‖along V f x‖ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖ * ‖V x‖

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicCalculus.norm_carrier
statement:
@[simp] theorem norm_carrier (κ : ℝ) (Φ : E → ℝ) (x : E) :
    ‖carrier κ Φ x‖ = 1

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicCalculus.norm_longitudinalCoefficient
statement:
@[simp] theorem norm_longitudinalCoefficient (n : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))
    (a : ComplexVector) :
    ‖longitudinalCoefficient n a‖ = ‖normalDot n a‖ / ‖n‖

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicCalculus.norm_phaseFactor
statement: @[simp] theorem norm_phaseFactor (κ : ℝ) : ‖phaseFactor κ‖ = |κ|

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicCalculus.norm_strippedDivergence_le
statement:
theorem norm_strippedDivergence_le (R : E → ℝ) (Vr Vz : E → E)
    (a : E → ComplexVector) (x : E) :
    ‖strippedDivergence R Vr Vz a x‖ ≤
      ‖along Vr (fun y => a y 0) x‖ + ‖a x 0‖ / |R x| +
        ‖along Vz (fun y => a y 2) x‖

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicCalculus.normalDot_finiteJetBound
statement:
theorem normalDot_finiteJetBound {U : Set E} (R : E → ℝ) (Vr Vθ Vz : E → E)
    (κ : ℝ) {Φ : E → ℝ} {a : E → ComplexVector} {m : ℕ} {C : ℝ}
    (hκ : κ ≠ 0) (hU : IsOpen U) (hΦ : DifferentiableOn ℝ Φ U)
    (ha : ∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℝ (fun y => a y i) U)
    (haθ : ∀ y ∈ U, along Vθ (fun z => a z 1) y = 0)
    (hdiv : ∀ y ∈ U, cylindricalDivergence R Vr Vθ Vz (vectorMode κ Φ a) y = 0)
    (hS : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (strippedDivergence R Vr Vz a) U)
    (hJ : JetBounds.FiniteJetBound m (strippedDivergence R Vr Vz a) U C) :
    JetBounds.FiniteJetBound m
      (fun y => normalDot (phaseNormal R Vr Vθ Vz Φ y) (a y)) U (C / |κ|)

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicCalculus.normalDot_jet_norm_eq
statement:
theorem normalDot_jet_norm_eq {U : Set E} (R : E → ℝ) (Vr Vθ Vz : E → E)
    (κ : ℝ) {Φ : E → ℝ} {a : E → ComplexVector} {x : E} (m : ℕ)
    (hκ : κ ≠ 0) (hU : IsOpen U) (hΦ : DifferentiableOn ℝ Φ U)
    (ha : ∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℝ (fun y => a y i) U)
    (haθ : ∀ y ∈ U, along Vθ (fun z => a z 1) y = 0)
    (hdiv : ∀ y ∈ U, cylindricalDivergence R Vr Vθ Vz (vectorMode κ Φ a) y = 0)
    (hS : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (strippedDivergence R Vr Vz a) U) (hx : x ∈ U) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun y => normalDot (phaseNormal R Vr Vθ Vz Φ y) (a y)) x‖ =
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (strippedDivergence R Vr Vz a) x‖ / |κ|

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicCalculus.normalDot_norm_eq_div
statement:
theorem normalDot_norm_eq_div (R : E → ℝ) (Vr Vθ Vz : E → E)
    (κ : ℝ) {Φ : E → ℝ} {a : E → ComplexVector} {x : E}
    (hκ : κ ≠ 0) (hΦ : DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ x)
    (ha : ∀ i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => a y i) x)
    (haθ : along Vθ (fun y => a y 1) x = 0)
    (hdiv : cylindricalDivergence R Vr Vθ Vz (vectorMode κ Φ a) x = 0) :
    ‖normalDot (phaseNormal R Vr Vθ Vz Φ x) (a x)‖ =
      ‖strippedDivergence R Vr Vz a x‖ / |κ|

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicCalculus.phaseFactor_sq
statement: theorem phaseFactor_sq (κ : ℝ) : phaseFactor κ ^ 2 = -(κ : ℂ) ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicCalculus.phaseNormal_eq_slot_normal
statement:
theorem phaseNormal_eq_slot_normal (ε p pz x₀ : ℝ)
    (F G : PhaseCalculus.Slow → ℝ) (q : PhaseCalculus.Slot) :
    phaseNormal (fun y : PhaseCalculus.Slot => y.1.1)
      (fun _ => PhaseCalculus.eR) (fun _ => PhaseCalculus.eTheta)
      (fun _ => ε • PhaseCalculus.eZ) (PhaseCalculus.phase ε p pz x₀ F G) q =
      PhaseCalculus.phaseNormal ε p pz x₀ F G q

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicCalculus.phaseSquare_eq_norm_sq
statement:
theorem phaseSquare_eq_norm_sq (R : E → ℝ) (Vr Vθ Vz : E → E)
    (Φ : E → ℝ) (x : E) :
    phaseSquare R Vr Vθ Vz Φ x = ‖phaseNormal R Vr Vθ Vz Φ x‖ ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicCalculus.strippedDivergence_finiteJetBound
statement:
theorem strippedDivergence_finiteJetBound {U : Set E} {R : E → ℝ} {Vr Vz : E → E}
    {a : E → ComplexVector} {m : ℕ} {Ar Az Cr Cz CI : ℝ}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hR : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ R U) (hRne : ∀ x ∈ U, R x ≠ 0)
    (hr : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vr U) (hz : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vz U)
    (ha₀ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => a y 0) U)
    (ha₂ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => a y 2) U)
    (hAr : JetBounds.FiniteJetBound (m + 1) (fun y => a y 0) U Ar)
    (hAz : JetBounds.FiniteJetBound (m + 1) (fun y => a y 2) U Az)
    (hCr : JetBounds.FiniteJetBound m Vr U Cr)
    (hCz : JetBounds.FiniteJetBound m Vz U Cz)
    (hCI : JetBounds.FiniteJetBound m (fun y => (R y)⁻¹) U CI) :
    JetBounds.FiniteJetBound m (strippedDivergence R Vr Vz a) U
      ((2 : ℝ) ^ m * Ar * Cr +
        ‖(ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ →L[ℝ] ℂ)‖ * (2 : ℝ) ^ m * CI * Ar +
        (2 : ℝ) ^ m * Az * Cz)

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.SliceC2.differentiable
statement:
theorem SliceC2.differentiable {G : Profile} {t : ℝ} (hG : SliceC2 G t) :
    SliceDifferentiable G t

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.advection_velocity
statement:
theorem advection_velocity {B F U : Profile} {t : ℝ}
    (hB : SliceDifferentiable B t) (hF : SliceDifferentiable F t)
    (hU : SliceDifferentiable U t) (x : Space) :
    advection (velocity B F U) t x =
      pack (x 0 * advectionRadial B F U (profilePoint t x) +
        x 1 * advectionAngular B F U (profilePoint t x))
      (x 1 * advectionRadial B F U (profilePoint t x) -
        x 0 * advectionAngular B F U (profilePoint t x))
      (advectionAxial B U (profilePoint t x))

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.contDiff_direction
NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.contDiff_lift
statement:
theorem contDiff_lift {G : Profile} {n : WithTop ℕ∞} (hG : ContDiff ℝ n G) (t : ℝ) :
    ContDiff ℝ n (lift G t)

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.contDiff_lift_slice
statement:
theorem contDiff_lift_slice {G : Profile} {t : ℝ} (hG : SliceC2 G t) :
    ContDiff ℝ 2 (lift G t)

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.contDiff_partialS
statement:
theorem contDiff_partialS {G : Profile} {m n : WithTop ℕ∞}
    (hG : ContDiff ℝ n G) (hmn : m + 1 ≤ n) : ContDiff ℝ m (partialS G)

statement:
theorem contDiff_partialZ {G : Profile} {m n : WithTop ℕ∞}
    (hG : ContDiff ℝ n G) (hmn : m + 1 ≤ n) : ContDiff ℝ m (partialZ G)

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.direction_add
statement:
theorem direction_add {a b : Space → ℝ} (ha : Differentiable ℝ a)
    (hb : Differentiable ℝ b) (i : Fin 3) (x : Space) :
    direction (fun y => a y + b y) i x = direction a i x + direction b i x

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.direction_coord_mul
statement:
theorem direction_coord_mul {g : Space → ℝ} (hg : Differentiable ℝ g)
    (i j : Fin 3) (x : Space) :
    direction (fun y => y i * g y) j x =
      (coordinateVector j) i * g x + x i * direction g j x

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.direction_lift_one
statement:
theorem direction_lift_one {G : Profile} {t : ℝ} (hG : SliceDifferentiable G t) (x : Space) :
    direction (lift G t) 1 x = x 1 * lift (partialS G) t x

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.direction_lift_two
statement:
theorem direction_lift_two {G : Profile} {t : ℝ} (hG : SliceDifferentiable G t) (x : Space) :
    direction (lift G t) 2 x = lift (partialZ G) t x

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.direction_lift_zero
statement:
theorem direction_lift_zero {G : Profile} {t : ℝ} (hG : SliceDifferentiable G t) (x : Space) :
    direction (lift G t) 0 x = x 0 * lift (partialS G) t x

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.direction_neg
statement:
theorem direction_neg (a : Space → ℝ) (i : Fin 3) (x : Space) :
    direction (fun y => -a y) i x = -direction a i x

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.direction_sub
statement:
theorem direction_sub {a b : Space → ℝ} (ha : Differentiable ℝ a)
    (hb : Differentiable ℝ b) (i : Fin 3) (x : Space) :
    direction (fun y => a y - b y) i x = direction a i x - direction b i x

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.divergence_velocity
statement:
theorem divergence_velocity {B F U : Profile} {t : ℝ}
    (hB : SliceDifferentiable B t) (hF : SliceDifferentiable F t)
    (hU : SliceDifferentiable U t) (x : Space) :
    spatialDivergence (velocity B F U) t x =
      partialZ U (profilePoint t x) - 2 * B (profilePoint t x) -
        2 * radialEnergy x * partialS B (profilePoint t x)

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.divergence_velocity_eq_zero
statement:
theorem divergence_velocity_eq_zero {B F U : Profile} {t : ℝ}
    (hB : SliceDifferentiable B t) (hF : SliceDifferentiable F t)
    (hU : SliceDifferentiable U t) (x : Space)
    (h : partialZ U (profilePoint t x) =
      2 * B (profilePoint t x) + 2 * radialEnergy x * partialS B (profilePoint t x)) :
    spatialDivergence (velocity B F U) t x = 0

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.fderiv_lift_apply
statement:
theorem fderiv_lift_apply {G : Profile} {t : ℝ} (hG : SliceDifferentiable G t)
    (x v : Space) : fderiv ℝ (lift G t) x v =
      (x 0 * v 0 + x 1 * v 1) * partialS G (profilePoint t x) +
        v 2 * partialZ G (profilePoint t x)

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.fderiv_pack_apply
statement:
theorem fderiv_pack_apply {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {a b c : E → ℝ} {x : E} (ha : DifferentiableAt ℝ a x)
    (hb : DifferentiableAt ℝ b x) (hc : DifferentiableAt ℝ c x) (v : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun y => pack (a y) (b y) (c y)) x v =
      pack (fderiv ℝ a x v) (fderiv ℝ b x v) (fderiv ℝ c x v)

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.hasFDerivAt_pack
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_pack {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {a b c : E → ℝ} {da db dc : E →L[ℝ] ℝ} {x : E}
    (ha : HasFDerivAt a da x) (hb : HasFDerivAt b db x) (hc : HasFDerivAt c dc x) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun y => pack (a y) (b y) (c y)) (packDerivative da db dc) x

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.hasFDerivAt_time_lift
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_time_lift {G : Profile} {t : ℝ} (hG : SliceDifferentiable G t) (x : Space) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun s => lift G s x) (timeProfileDerivative G (profilePoint t x)) t

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.hasFDerivAt_velocity
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_velocity {B F U : Profile} {t : ℝ}
    (hB : SliceDifferentiable B t) (hF : SliceDifferentiable F t)
    (hU : SliceDifferentiable U t) (x : Space) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun y => velocity B F U (t, y)) (velocityJacobian B F U t x) x

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.navierStokesResidual_eq_zero
statement:
theorem navierStokesResidual_eq_zero {B F U P : Profile} {t : ℝ}
    (hB : SliceC2 B t) (hF : SliceC2 F t) (hU : SliceC2 U t)
    (hP : SliceDifferentiable P t) (x : Space)
    (hr : residualRadial B F U P (profilePoint t x) = 0)
    (ha : residualAngular B F U (profilePoint t x) = 0)
    (hz : residualAxial B U P (profilePoint t x) = 0) :
    navierStokesResidual (velocity B F U) (pressure P) t x = 0

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.navierStokesResidual_on_axis
statement:
theorem navierStokesResidual_on_axis {B F U P : Profile} {t : ℝ}
    (hB : SliceC2 B t) (hF : SliceC2 F t) (hU : SliceC2 U t)
    (hP : SliceDifferentiable P t) (x : Space) (hx0 : x 0 = 0) (hx1 : x 1 = 0) :
    navierStokesResidual (velocity B F U) (pressure P) t x =
      residualAxial B U P (t, (0, x 2)) • coordinateVector 2

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.navierStokesResidual_velocity
statement:
theorem navierStokesResidual_velocity {B F U P : Profile} {t : ℝ}
    (hB : SliceC2 B t) (hF : SliceC2 F t) (hU : SliceC2 U t)
    (hP : SliceDifferentiable P t) (x : Space) :
    navierStokesResidual (velocity B F U) (pressure P) t x =
      pack (x 0 * residualRadial B F U P (profilePoint t x) +
        x 1 * residualAngular B F U (profilePoint t x))
      (x 1 * residualRadial B F U P (profilePoint t x) -
        x 0 * residualAngular B F U (profilePoint t x))
      (residualAxial B U P (profilePoint t x))

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.scalarLaplacian_coord_mul
statement:
theorem scalarLaplacian_coord_mul {g : Space → ℝ} (hg : ContDiff ℝ 2 g)

statement:
theorem scalarLaplacian_neg (a : Space → ℝ) (x : Space) :

statement:
theorem scalarLaplacian_sub {a b : Space → ℝ} (ha : ContDiff ℝ 2 a)

statement:
theorem scalarLaplacian_weighted_one {G : Profile} {t : ℝ} (hG : SliceC2 G t) (x : Space) :

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.scalarLaplacian_weighted_zero
statement:
theorem scalarLaplacian_weighted_zero {G : Profile} {t : ℝ} (hG : SliceC2 G t) (x : Space) :

name: NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.second_direction_coord_mul
statement:
theorem second_direction_coord_mul {g : Space → ℝ} (hg : ContDiff ℝ 2 g)
    (i j : Fin 3) (x : Space) :
    direction (fun y => direction (fun z => z i * g z) j y) j x =
      2 * (coordinateVector j) i * direction g j x +
        x i * direction (fun y => direction g j y) j x

NavierStokes.AxisymmetricResidual.spatialLaplacian_velocity
statement:
theorem spatialLaplacian_velocity {B F U : Profile} {t : ℝ}
    (hB : SliceC2 B t) (hF : SliceC2 F t) (hU : SliceC2 U t) (x : Space) :
    spatialLaplacian (velocity B F U) t x =
      pack (-x 0 * laplaceWeighted B (profilePoint t x) -
        x 1 * laplaceWeighted F (profilePoint t x))
      (-x 1 * laplaceWeighted B (profilePoint t x) +
        x 0 * laplaceWeighted F (profilePoint t x))

theorem temporalDerivative_velocity {B F U : Profile} {t : ℝ}

    (hU : SliceDifferentiable U t) (x : Space) :
    temporalDerivative (velocity B F U) t x =
      pack (-x 0 * partialT B (profilePoint t x) - x 1 * partialT F (profilePoint t x))
        (-x 1 * partialT B (profilePoint t x) + x 0 * partialT F (profilePoint t x))
        (partialT U (profilePoint t x))

statement:
theorem advection_velocity {B F U : Profile} {t : ℝ} {x : Space}

statement:
theorem divergence_velocity {B F U : Profile} {t : ℝ} {x : Space}
    (hB : DifferentiableAt ℝ B (profilePoint t x))
    (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ F (profilePoint t x))
    (hU : DifferentiableAt ℝ U (profilePoint t x)) :

theorem navierStokesResidual_velocity {B F U P : Profile} {t : ℝ} {x : Space}

theorem second_direction_coord_mul {g : Space → ℝ} {x : Space}

name: NavierStokes.LocalAxisymmetricResidual.spatialLaplacian_velocity
statement:
theorem spatialLaplacian_velocity {B F U : Profile} {t : ℝ} {x : Space}

    (hF : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 F (profilePoint t x))
    (hU : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 U (profilePoint t x)) :
    spatialLaplacian (velocity B F U) t x =
      pack (-x 0 * laplaceWeighted B (profilePoint t x) -
        x 1 * laplaceWeighted F (profilePoint t x))
      (-x 1 * laplaceWeighted B (profilePoint t x) +
        x 0 * laplaceWeighted F (profilePoint t x))
