name: NavierStokes.FiveRowRank.gamma_smul
statement:
theorem gamma_smul (lam C a b r : ℝ) (d : Debt) :
    gamma lam C a b (r • d) = r • gamma lam C a b d

name: NavierStokes.FiveRowRank.gamma_tsupport_subset
statement:
theorem gamma_tsupport_subset (lam C a b : ℝ) (d : Debt) (hab : a < b) :
    tsupport (gamma lam C a b d) ⊆ Ioo a b

name: NavierStokes.FiveRowRank.gamma_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem gamma_zero (lam C a b : ℝ) : gamma lam C a b 0 = 0

name: NavierStokes.FiveRowRank.integrable_power_mul_of_patch
statement:
theorem integrable_power_mul_of_patch (p a b : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (hf : Continuous f) (hs : support f ⊆ Ioo a b) :
    Integrable (fun R => R ^ p * f R)

name: NavierStokes.FiveRowRank.pressure_row
statement:
theorem pressure_row (lam C a b : ℝ) (d : Debt) (hlam : 0 < lam) (hC : C ≠ 0)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) :
    (∫ R, (2 * background lam C R / R) * deltaV lam C a b d R) = -(d 0)

name: NavierStokes.FiveRowRank.pressure_weight
statement:
theorem pressure_weight (lam C R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) :
    2 * background lam C R / R = (2 * C) * R ^ (-2 - 2 * lam)

name: NavierStokes.FiveRowRank.repair_joint_contDiffOn
statement:
theorem repair_joint_contDiffOn {n : ℕ} (a l u : Fin n → ℝ) {S : Set E}
    {d : E → Fin n → ℝ} (hd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ d S) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : E × ℝ => LocalizedMomentRepair.repair a l u (d z.1) z.2)
      (S ×ˢ univ)

name: NavierStokes.FiveRowRank.repair_pair_joint_contDiffOn
statement:
theorem repair_pair_joint_contDiffOn (lam a b : ℝ) {S : Set E} {C : E → ℝ} {d : E → Debt}
    (hC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ C S) (hd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ d S)
    (hCn : ∀ p ∈ S, C p ≠ 0) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : E × ℝ =>
      (deltaV lam (C z.1) a b (d z.1) z.2, gamma lam (C z.1) a b (d z.1) z.2))
      (S ×ˢ univ)

name: NavierStokes.FiveRowRank.uniform_finite_jet_bound
statement:
theorem uniform_finite_jet_bound (lam a b η : ℝ) (hab : a < b) (hη : 0 < η) (N : ℕ) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ (C : ℝ), η ≤ |C| → ∀ (k : ℕ), k ≤ N →
      ∀ (d e : Debt) (R : ℝ),
      |iteratedDeriv k (deltaV lam C a b d) R - iteratedDeriv k (deltaV lam C a b e) R| +
      |iteratedDeriv k (gamma lam C a b d) R - iteratedDeriv k (gamma lam C a b e) R| ≤
        K * ‖d - e‖

name: NavierStokes.SmoothMomentRepair.compact_inverse_quadratic_bounds
statement:
theorem compact_inverse_quadratic_bounds [CompleteSpace E]
    {P : Type*} [TopologicalSpace P] (S : Set P) (hS : IsCompact S)
    (B : P → E →L[ℝ] E) (A : P → E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] E)
    (hB : ContinuousOn B S) (hA : ContinuousOn A S)
    (hinv : ∀ p ∈ S, (B p).IsInvertible) :
    ∃ β K : ℝ, 0 < β ∧ 0 < K ∧
      ∀ p ∈ S, ‖(B p).inverse‖ ≤ β ∧ ‖A p‖ ≤ K

name: NavierStokes.SmoothMomentRepair.compact_uniform_small_correction
statement:
theorem compact_uniform_small_correction [CompleteSpace E]
    {P : Type*} [TopologicalSpace P] (S : Set P) (hS : IsCompact S)
    (B : P → E →L[ℝ] E) (A : P → E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] E)
    (hB : ContinuousOn B S) (hA : ContinuousOn A S)
    (hinv : ∀ p ∈ S, (B p).IsInvertible) :
    ∃ β ε : ℝ, 0 < β ∧ 0 < ε ∧ ∀ p ∈ S, ∀ d : E, ‖d‖ ≤ ε →
      ∃! c : E, ‖c‖ ≤ 2 * β * ‖d‖ ∧ B p c + A p c c = d

name: NavierStokes.SmoothMomentRepair.exists_local_analytic_solver
statement:
theorem exists_local_analytic_solver [CompleteSpace E]
    (B : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (A : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] E) :
    ∃ (g : RepairData E → E) (U : Set (RepairData E)),
      IsOpen U ∧ base B A ∈ U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ⊤ g U ∧ g (base B A) = 0 ∧
      ∀ z ∈ U, z.1.1 (g z) + z.1.2 (g z) (g z) = z.2

name: NavierStokes.SmoothMomentRepair.exists_local_bounded_analytic_solver
statement:
theorem exists_local_bounded_analytic_solver [CompleteSpace E]
    (B₀ : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (A₀ : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] E) :
    ∃ (g : RepairData E → E) (U : Set (RepairData E)) (C : ℝ),
      IsOpen U ∧ base B₀ A₀ ∈ U ∧ 0 < C ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ⊤ g U ∧
      g (base B₀ A₀) = 0 ∧ ∀ z ∈ U,
        z.1.1 (g z) + z.1.2 (g z) (g z) = z.2 ∧ ‖g z‖ ≤ C * ‖z.2‖

name: NavierStokes.SmoothMomentRepair.exists_smooth_parameter_branch
statement:
theorem exists_smooth_parameter_branch [CompleteSpace E]
    {P : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup P] [NormedSpace ℝ P]
    (p₀ : P) (B : P → E →L[ℝ] E) (A : P → E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] E) (d : P → E)
    (hB : ContDiff ℝ ∞ B) (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (hd : ContDiff ℝ ∞ d)
    (B₀ : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (hB₀ : B p₀ = B₀.toContinuousLinearMap) (hd₀ : d p₀ = 0) :
    ∃ (c : P → E) (U : Set P) (C : ℝ), IsOpen U ∧ p₀ ∈ U ∧ 0 < C ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c U ∧ c p₀ = 0 ∧
      ∀ p ∈ U, B p (c p) + A p (c p) (c p) = d p ∧ ‖c p‖ ≤ C * ‖d p‖

name: NavierStokes.SmoothMomentRepair.exists_unique_quadratic_correction
statement:
theorem exists_unique_quadratic_correction [CompleteSpace E]
    (B : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (A : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] E) (d : E) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hsmall : 4 * ‖B.symm.toContinuousLinearMap‖ * ‖A‖ * r ≤ 1)
    (hd : 2 * ‖B.symm.toContinuousLinearMap‖ * ‖d‖ ≤ r) :
    ∃! c : E, ‖c‖ ≤ r ∧ B c + A c c = d

name: NavierStokes.SmoothMomentRepair.forward_base
statement:
theorem forward_base (B : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (A : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] E) :
    forward (base B A) = base B A

name: NavierStokes.SmoothMomentRepair.forward_contDiff
statement: theorem forward_contDiff : ContDiff ℝ ⊤ (forward : RepairData E → RepairData E)

name: NavierStokes.SmoothMomentRepair.forward_hasFDerivAt
statement:
theorem forward_hasFDerivAt (B : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (A : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] E) :
    HasFDerivAt forward
      (((ContinuousLinearEquiv.refl ℝ (QuadraticCoefficients E)).prodCongr B).toContinuousLinearMap)
      (base B A)

name: NavierStokes.SmoothMomentRepair.quadratic_norm_le
statement:
theorem quadratic_norm_le (A : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] E) (c : E) :
    ‖A c c‖ ≤ ‖A‖ * ‖c‖ ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.SmoothMomentRepair.quadratic_sub_le
statement:
theorem quadratic_sub_le (A : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] E) (c e : E) :
    ‖A c c - A e e‖ ≤ ‖A‖ * (‖c‖ + ‖e‖) * ‖c - e‖

name: NavierStokes.SmoothMomentRepair.solution_norm_bound
statement:
theorem solution_norm_bound (B₀ : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (B : E →L[ℝ] E)
    (A : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] E) (c d : E) (β δ K r : ℝ)
    (hβ : 0 ≤ β) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hinv : ∀ x, ‖B₀.symm x‖ ≤ β * ‖x‖)
    (hB : ‖B - B₀.toContinuousLinearMap‖ ≤ δ) (hA : ‖A‖ ≤ K)
    (hc : ‖c‖ ≤ r) (hsmall : β * (δ + K * r) ≤ 1 / 2)
    (heq : B c + A c c = d) : ‖c‖ ≤ 2 * β * ‖d‖

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.ResetBranch.angular_change
statement:
theorem angular_change (e0 X0 y0 δ : ℝ) (hX : 0 ≤ X0)
    (hδ : δ ∈ Ioo (-B.radius) B.radius) :
    (∫ y, radiusX X0 y *
      (modifiedH lam e0 X0 y0 (B.coefficients δ) y - baseH lam e0 X0 y)) =
      angularScale lam e0 X0 y0 * δ

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.ResetBranch.exact_endpoint_moment
statement:
theorem ResetBranch.exact_endpoint_moment {lam : ℝ} (B : ResetBranch lam)
    (e0 X0 y0 a b Iprior Itarget : ℝ) (he0 : 0 < e0) (hX : 0 < X0)
    (ha : a ≤ y0 - 1) (hb : y0 + 3 ≤ b)
    (hδ : (Itarget - prefixI lam e0 X0 a b Iprior) / angularScale lam e0 X0 y0 ∈
      Ioo (-B.radius) B.radius) :
    Iprior + (∫ y in Icc a b, radiusX X0 y * modifiedH lam e0 X0 y0
      (B.coefficients ((Itarget - prefixI lam e0 X0 a b Iprior) / angularScale lam e0 X0 y0)) y) =
        Itarget

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.ResetBranch.exact_target
statement:
theorem exact_target (e0 X0 y0 Iold Itarget : ℝ) (he0 : 0 < e0) (hX : 0 < X0)
    (hδ : (Itarget - Iold) / angularScale lam e0 X0 y0 ∈ Ioo (-B.radius) B.radius) :
    Iold + (∫ y, radiusX X0 y *
      (modifiedH lam e0 X0 y0
        (B.coefficients ((Itarget - Iold) / angularScale lam e0 X0 y0)) y -
          baseH lam e0 X0 y)) = Itarget

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.ResetBranch.joint_contDiffOn
statement:
theorem ResetBranch.joint_contDiffOn {lam : ℝ} (B : ResetBranch lam)
    (e0 y0 : ℝ) {P : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup P] [NormedSpace ℝ P]
    {S : Set P} {δ : P → ℝ} (hδ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ δ S)
    (hsmall : ∀ p ∈ S, δ p ∈ Ioo (-B.radius) B.radius) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × ℝ => modifiedE lam e0 y0 (B.coefficients (δ z.1)) z.2)
      (S ×ˢ univ)

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.ResetBranch.logSlope_le
statement:
theorem logSlope_le (hlam : 0 < lam) (e0 y0 δ y : ℝ) (he0 : 0 < e0)
    (hδ : δ ∈ Ioo (-B.radius) B.radius) :
    logSlope (modifiedE lam e0 y0 (B.coefficients δ)) y ≤ -lam / 2

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.ResetBranch.positive
statement:
theorem positive (hlam : 0 < lam) (e0 y0 δ y : ℝ) (he0 : 0 < e0)
    (hδ : δ ∈ Ioo (-B.radius) B.radius) :
    0 < modifiedE lam e0 y0 (B.coefficients δ) y

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.ResetBranch.pressure_interval_neutral
statement:
theorem ResetBranch.pressure_interval_neutral {lam : ℝ} (B : ResetBranch lam)
    (e0 y0 a b δ : ℝ) (ha : a ≤ y0 - 1) (hb : y0 + 3 ≤ b)
    (hδ : δ ∈ Ioo (-B.radius) B.radius) :
    (∫ y in Icc a b, (modifiedE lam e0 y0 (B.coefficients δ) y) ^ 2) =
      ∫ y in Icc a b, (baseE lam e0 y) ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.ResetBranch.pressure_neutral
statement:
theorem pressure_neutral (e0 y0 δ : ℝ) (hδ : δ ∈ Ioo (-B.radius) B.radius) :
    (∫ y, (modifiedE lam e0 y0 (B.coefficients δ) y) ^ 2 - (baseE lam e0 y) ^ 2) = 0

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.angularScale_pos
statement:
theorem angularScale_pos (lam e0 X0 y0 : ℝ) (he0 : 0 < e0) (hX : 0 < X0) :
    0 < angularScale lam e0 X0 y0

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.angular_delta_integrable
statement:
theorem angular_delta_integrable (lam e0 X0 y0 : ℝ) (c : Coeff) :
    Integrable (fun y => radiusX X0 y * (modifiedH lam e0 X0 y0 c y - baseH lam e0 X0 y))

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.angular_integral_formula
statement:
theorem angular_integral_formula (lam e0 X0 y0 : ℝ) (c : Coeff) (hX : 0 ≤ X0) :
    (∫ y, radiusX X0 y * (modifiedH lam e0 X0 y0 c y - baseH lam e0 X0 y)) =
      angularScale lam e0 X0 y0 * ∫ y, Real.exp (angularSlope lam * y) * relative c y

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.angular_interval_change
statement:
theorem angular_interval_change (lam e0 X0 y0 a b : ℝ) (c : Coeff)
    (hX : 0 ≤ X0) (ha : a ≤ y0 - 1) (hb : y0 + 3 ≤ b) :
    (∫ y in Icc a b, radiusX X0 y * modifiedH lam e0 X0 y0 c y) -
      (∫ y in Icc a b, radiusX X0 y * baseH lam e0 X0 y) =
      angularScale lam e0 X0 y0 * ∫ y, Real.exp (angularSlope lam * y) * relative c y

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.angular_weight_formula
statement:
theorem angular_weight_formula (lam e0 X0 y : ℝ) (hX : 0 ≤ X0) :
    radiusX X0 y * baseH lam e0 X0 y =
      X0 * Real.sqrt (2 * X0) * e0 * Real.exp (angularSlope lam * y)

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.baseE_contDiff
statement: theorem baseE_contDiff (lam e0 : ℝ) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (baseE lam e0)

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.baseE_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem baseE_hasDerivAt (lam e0 y : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (baseE lam e0) (baseE lam e0 y * (-1 / 2 - lam)) y

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.baseE_pos
statement: theorem baseE_pos (lam e0 y : ℝ) (he0 : 0 < e0) : 0 < baseE lam e0 y

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.baseE_square
statement:
theorem baseE_square (lam e0 y : ℝ) :
    (baseE lam e0 y) ^ 2 = e0 ^ 2 * Real.exp (pressureSlope lam * y)

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.baseH_continuous
statement: theorem baseH_continuous (lam e0 X0 : ℝ) : Continuous (baseH lam e0 X0)

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.bump_contDiff
statement: theorem bump_contDiff (j : Fin 2) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (bump j)

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.bump_hasCompactSupport
statement: theorem bump_hasCompactSupport (j : Fin 2) : HasCompactSupport (bump j)

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.bump_le_one
statement: theorem bump_le_one (j : Fin 2) (y : ℝ) : bump j y ≤ 1

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.bump_moment
statement:
theorem bump_moment (s : ℝ) (j : Fin 2) :
    (∫ y, Real.exp (s * y) * bump j y) =
      Real.exp (s * (2 * (j.val : ℝ))) * moment s

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.bump_nonneg
statement: theorem bump_nonneg (j : Fin 2) (y : ℝ) : 0 ≤ bump j y

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.bump_support
statement:
theorem bump_support (j : Fin 2) :
    support (bump j) ⊆ Icc (2 * (j.val : ℝ) - 3 / 20) (2 * (j.val : ℝ) + 3 / 20)

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.bumps_disjoint
statement: theorem bumps_disjoint (y : ℝ) : bump 0 y * bump 1 y = 0

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.debt_contDiff
statement: theorem debt_contDiff : ContDiff ℝ ∞ debt

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.debt_norm_le
statement: theorem debt_norm_le (δ : ℝ) : ‖debt δ‖ ≤ |δ|

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.exists_normalized_branch
statement:
theorem exists_normalized_branch (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) :
    ∃ (c : ℝ → Coeff) (ε K : ℝ), 0 < ε ∧ 0 < K ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c (Ioo (-ε) ε) ∧ c 0 = 0 ∧
      ∀ δ ∈ Ioo (-ε) ε,
        (∫ y, Real.exp (angularSlope lam * y) * relative (c δ) y) = δ ∧
        (∫ y, Real.exp (pressureSlope lam * y) * ((1 + relative (c δ) y) ^ 2 - 1)) = 0 ∧
        ‖c δ‖ ≤ K * |δ|

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.exists_resetBranch
statement: theorem exists_resetBranch (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) : Nonempty (ResetBranch lam)

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.linearEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem linearEquiv_apply (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) (c : Coeff) :
    linearEquiv lam hlam c = (linearMatrix lam).mulVec c

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.linearMatrix_det
statement:
theorem linearMatrix_det (lam : ℝ) :
    (linearMatrix lam).det = 2 * moment (angularSlope lam) * moment (pressureSlope lam) *
      (Real.exp (2 * pressureSlope lam) - Real.exp (2 * angularSlope lam))

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.linearMatrix_det_ne_zero
statement:
theorem linearMatrix_det_ne_zero (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) :
    (linearMatrix lam).det ≠ 0

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.modifiedE_contDiff
statement:
theorem modifiedE_contDiff (lam e0 y0 : ℝ) (c : Coeff) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (modifiedE lam e0 y0 c)

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.modifiedE_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem modifiedE_hasDerivAt (lam e0 y0 : ℝ) (c : Coeff) (y : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (modifiedE lam e0 y0 c)
      (baseE lam e0 y * (-1 / 2 - lam) * (1 + relative c (y - y0)) +
        baseE lam e0 y * deriv (relative c) (y - y0)) y

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.modifiedE_logSlope
statement:
theorem modifiedE_logSlope (lam e0 y0 : ℝ) (c : Coeff) (y : ℝ) (he0 : e0 ≠ 0)
    (hpos : 1 + relative c (y - y0) ≠ 0) :
    logSlope (modifiedE lam e0 y0 c) y =
      -lam + deriv (relative c) (y - y0) / (1 + relative c (y - y0))

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.modifiedE_sub_hasCompactSupport
statement:
theorem modifiedE_sub_hasCompactSupport (lam e0 y0 : ℝ) (c : Coeff) :
    HasCompactSupport (modifiedE lam e0 y0 c - baseE lam e0)

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.modifiedE_sub_support
statement:
theorem modifiedE_sub_support (lam e0 y0 : ℝ) (c : Coeff) :
    support (modifiedE lam e0 y0 c - baseE lam e0) ⊆
      Icc (y0 - 3 / 20) (y0 + 43 / 20)

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.modifiedE_sub_tsupport
statement:
theorem modifiedE_sub_tsupport (lam e0 y0 : ℝ) (c : Coeff) :
    tsupport (modifiedE lam e0 y0 c - baseE lam e0) ⊆ Ioo (y0 - 1) (y0 + 3)

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.modifiedE_unchanged
statement:
theorem modifiedE_unchanged (lam e0 y0 : ℝ) (c : Coeff) {y : ℝ}
    (hy : y ∉ Ioo (y0 - 1) (y0 + 3)) : modifiedE lam e0 y0 c y = baseE lam e0 y

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.modifiedH_continuous
statement:
theorem modifiedH_continuous (lam e0 X0 y0 : ℝ) (c : Coeff) :
    Continuous (modifiedH lam e0 X0 y0 c)

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.modifiedH_unchanged
NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.moment_map_identity
statement:
theorem moment_map_identity (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) (c : Coeff) :
    linearEquiv lam hlam c + quadraticCLM lam c c =
      ![∫ y, Real.exp (angularSlope lam * y) * relative c y,
        ∫ y, Real.exp (pressureSlope lam * y) * ((1 + relative c y) ^ 2 - 1)]

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.moment_pos
statement: theorem moment_pos (s : ℝ) : 0 < moment s

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.outside_window
statement:
theorem outside_window {a b y0 y : ℝ} (ha : a ≤ y0 - 1) (hb : y0 + 3 ≤ b)
    (hy : y ∉ Icc a b) : y ∉ Ioo (y0 - 1) (y0 + 3)

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.positive_and_slope_of_small
statement:
theorem positive_and_slope_of_small (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) (c : Coeff) (y : ℝ)
    (h0 : |relative c y| ≤ 1 / 2) (h1 : |deriv (relative c) y| ≤ lam / 4) :
    0 < 1 + relative c y ∧ -lam + deriv (relative c) y / (1 + relative c y) ≤ -lam / 2

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.pressure_change_integrable
statement:
theorem pressure_change_integrable (lam : ℝ) (c : Coeff) :
    Integrable (fun y => Real.exp (pressureSlope lam * y) * ((1 + relative c y) ^ 2 - 1))

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.pressure_change_moment
statement:
theorem pressure_change_moment (lam : ℝ) (c : Coeff) :
    (∫ y, Real.exp (pressureSlope lam * y) * ((1 + relative c y) ^ 2 - 1)) =
      2 * (moment (pressureSlope lam) * c 0 +
        Real.exp (2 * pressureSlope lam) * moment (pressureSlope lam) * c 1) +
      quadraticMoment lam 0 * (c 0) ^ 2 + quadraticMoment lam 1 * (c 1) ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.pressure_delta_integrable
statement:
theorem pressure_delta_integrable (lam e0 y0 : ℝ) (c : Coeff) :
    Integrable (fun y => (modifiedE lam e0 y0 c y) ^ 2 - (baseE lam e0 y) ^ 2)

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.pressure_integral_formula
statement:
theorem pressure_integral_formula (lam e0 y0 : ℝ) (c : Coeff) :
    (∫ y, (modifiedE lam e0 y0 c y) ^ 2 - (baseE lam e0 y) ^ 2) =
      e0 ^ 2 * Real.exp (pressureSlope lam * y0) *
        ∫ y, Real.exp (pressureSlope lam * y) * ((1 + relative c y) ^ 2 - 1)

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.pressure_interval_change
statement:
theorem pressure_interval_change (lam e0 y0 a b : ℝ) (c : Coeff)
    (ha : a ≤ y0 - 1) (hb : y0 + 3 ≤ b) :
    (∫ y in Icc a b, (modifiedE lam e0 y0 c y) ^ 2) -
      (∫ y in Icc a b, (baseE lam e0 y) ^ 2) =
      e0 ^ 2 * Real.exp (pressureSlope lam * y0) *
        ∫ y, Real.exp (pressureSlope lam * y) * ((1 + relative c y) ^ 2 - 1)

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.quadraticCLM_apply
statement:
theorem quadraticCLM_apply (lam : ℝ) (c d : Coeff) :
    quadraticCLM lam c d =
      ![0, quadraticMoment lam 0 * c 0 * d 0 + quadraticMoment lam 1 * c 1 * d 1]

statement:
theorem constructed_tail (d : TailData) :

    (∀ p, 0 < finalAngular d p) ∧
    0 < decayHold d ∧
    holdLag d (decayHold d) = tailLag d 0 ∧
    tailLag d 3 = 0 ∧
    (∀ eta y, y ≤ d.core.endpoint →
      finalAngular d (y, eta) = angular d.core.P d.core.dropLength d.core.lam (y, eta)) ∧
    (∀ eta y, tailEnd d ≤ y →
      finalAngular d (y, eta) = powerConstant d * Real.exp (-(1 / 2 + d.h) * y))

statement:
theorem complete_angular_reset :
    ∃ lam0 : ℝ, 0 < lam0 ∧ ∀ d : TailData, d.core.lam < lam0 →
      ∃ c : ℝ → Coeff,
        ContDiff ℝ ∞ (correctedAngular d c) ∧
        (∀ p, 0 < correctedAngular d c p) ∧
        (∀ eta y, y ∉ Ioo (d.releaseStart - 4) d.releaseStart →
          correctedAngular d c (y, eta) = finalAngular d (y, eta)) ∧
        (∀ eta, (∫ y, (correctedAngular d c (y, eta)) ^ 2 - (finalAngular d (y, eta)) ^ 2) = 0 ∧
          Real.sqrt 2 * correctedHistory d c eta =
            (Real.exp d.releaseStart * Real.sqrt (2 * Real.exp d.releaseStart) *
              correctedAngular d c (d.releaseStart, eta)) / (1 - d.core.lam)) ∧
        (∀ eta y, y ∈ Ioo (d.releaseStart - 4) d.releaseStart →
          logSlope (fun t => correctedAngular d c (t, eta)) y ≤ -d.core.lam / 2)

statement:
theorem exists_smooth_solver_on_ball [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    (B : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (A : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] E)
    (β K r : ℝ) (hβ : 0 < β) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hinv : ∀ x, ‖B.symm x‖ ≤ β * ‖x‖) (hA : ‖A‖ ≤ K)
    (hsmall : 4 * β * K * r ≤ 1) :
    ∃ g : E → E, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g (Metric.ball 0 (r / (4 * β))) ∧
      (∀ d ∈ Metric.ball 0 (r / (4 * β)), quadraticMap B A (g d) = d ∧ ‖g d‖ ≤ 2 * β * ‖d‖) ∧
      ∀ d ∈ Metric.ball 0 (r / (4 * β)), ∀ e ∈ Metric.ball 0 (r / (4 * β)),
        ‖g d - g e‖ ≤ 2 * β * ‖d - e‖

        ∀ δ ∈ Ioo (-ε) ε,
          (∫ y, Real.exp (angularSlope lam * y) * relative (c δ) y) = δ ∧
          (∫ y, Real.exp (pressureSlope lam * y) * ((1 + relative (c δ) y) ^ 2 - 1)) = 0 ∧
          ‖c δ‖ ≤ L * |δ| ∧ ‖deriv c δ‖ ≤ L ∧ ∀ y,

    (S : Set ℝ) (hS : IsCompact S) {f : ℝ → F} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (N : ℕ) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 < K ∧ JetBounds.FiniteJetBound N f S K

name: NavierStokes.FiveProfileMoments.compact_normalization_bound
NavierStokes.FiveProfileMoments.compact_normalizedDebt_jets
statement:
theorem compact_normalizedDebt_jets (S : Set ℝ) (hS : IsCompact S) {A G : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (hAn : ∀ p, A p ≠ 0) (N : ℕ) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 < K ∧ ∀ d : ℝ → Debt, ContDiff ℝ ∞ d → ∀ D : ℝ, 0 ≤ D →
      JetBounds.FiniteJetBound N d S D →
      JetBounds.FiniteJetBound N (fun p => normalizedDebt (A p) (G p) (d p)) S (K * D)

name: NavierStokes.FiveProfileMoments.compact_parameter_repair
statement:
theorem compact_parameter_repair (P : Patch) (b : ℝ) (hb : GoodExponent b)
    (S : Set ℝ) (hS : IsCompact S) (A G : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (hApos : ∀ p, 0 < A p) (N : ℕ) :
    ∃ ε K : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ 0 < K ∧ ∀ d : ℝ → Debt,
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ d → (∀ p ∈ S, ‖d p‖ < ε) →
      ∃ (c : ℝ → Coeff) (V : Set ℝ), IsOpen V ∧ S ⊆ V ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c V ∧
        (∀ p ∈ V, physicalMoments P b (A p) (G p) (c p) = d p ∧
          ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < physicalE P b (A p) (c p) x) ∧
        ∀ p ∈ S, ‖c p‖ ≤ K * ‖d p‖ ∧ ∀ k ≤ N, ∀ x : ℝ,
          |iteratedDeriv k (fun y => A p * u P (c p) y) x| ≤ K * ‖d p‖ ∧
          |iteratedDeriv k (fun y => A p * e P (c p) y) x| ≤ K * ‖d p‖

name: NavierStokes.FiveProfileMoments.correction_square_moment
statement:
theorem correction_square_moment (P : Patch) (s : ℝ) (c : Fin n → ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.FiveProfileMoments.exists_normalized_repair
statement:
theorem exists_normalized_repair (P : Patch) (b : ℝ) (hb : GoodExponent b) :
    ∃ (g : Coeff → Coeff) (ε C : ℝ), 0 < ε ∧ 0 < C ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g (Metric.ball 0 ε) ∧ g 0 = 0 ∧
      ∀ d ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Coeff) ε,
        normalizedMap P b (g d) = d ∧ ‖g d‖ ≤ C * ‖d‖ ∧ ‖fderiv ℝ g d‖ ≤ C ∧
        ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < x ^ b + e P (g d) x

theorem local_profile_change (P : Patch) (b A G : ℝ) (c : Coeff) (U E : ℝ → ℝ)

    (hE : ∀ x ∈ Ioo P.left P.right, E x = A * x ^ b) (x : ℝ) :

    (∫ x in Ioi (0 : ℝ), profileChangeDensity U E (fun y => A * u P c y) (fun y => A * e P c y) x i) =
      physicalMoments P b A G c i

name: NavierStokes.FiveProfileMoments.mixed_jet_bound
statement:
theorem mixed_jet_bound (P : Patch) (N : ℕ) :
    ∃ J : ℝ, 0 < J ∧ ∀ k ≤ N, ∀ (m : ℕ) (v : ℝ → Coeff) (eta : ℝ),
      ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ v eta → ∀ x : ℝ,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun p => iteratedDeriv k (u P (v p)) x) eta‖ ≤
          J * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m v eta‖ ∧
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun p => iteratedDeriv k (e P (v p)) x) eta‖ ≤
          J * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m v eta‖

name: NavierStokes.FiveProfileMoments.physical_mixed_jets_small
statement:
theorem physical_mixed_jets_small (P : Patch) {g : Coeff → Coeff} {r C : ℝ}
    (hr : 0 < r) (hC : 0 < C) (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g (Metric.ball 0 r))
    (hvalue : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Coeff) r, ‖g z‖ ≤ C * ‖z‖) (N : ℕ) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 < K ∧ ∀ (V : Set ℝ), IsOpen V → ∀ (f : ℝ → Coeff) (A : ℝ → ℝ),
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ f → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ A V → ∀ B tau : ℝ,
      0 ≤ B → 0 < tau → tau ≤ min 1 (r / 2) →
      JetBounds.FiniteJetBound N A V B →
      JetBounds.FiniteJetBound N f V (tau ^ (N + 1)) →
      ∀ eta ∈ V, ∀ k ≤ N, ∀ m ≤ N, ∀ x : ℝ,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun p => iteratedDeriv k (fun y => A p * u P (g (f p)) y) x) eta‖ ≤ K * B * tau ∧
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun p => iteratedDeriv k (fun y => A p * e P (g (f p)) y) x) eta‖ ≤ K * B * tau

name: NavierStokes.FiveProfileMoments.smooth_solver_parameter_jets

    (hr : 0 < r) (hC : 0 < C) (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g (Metric.ball 0 r))
    (hvalue : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Coeff) r, ‖g z‖ ≤ C * ‖z‖) (N : ℕ) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 < K ∧ ∀ (f : ℝ → Coeff), ContDiff ℝ ∞ f →

        (∀ j ≤ N, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f x‖ ≤ tau ^ (N + 1)) →
        ∀ k ≤ N, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (g ∘ f) x‖ ≤ K * tau

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalCoordinateBounds.homogeneous_derivative_bound

theorem homogeneous_derivative_bound {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1)

    (hhom : ∀ r > 0, ∀ y ∈ positiveTime, g (dilation a r y) = r ^ b * g y)
    (lo hi qbig : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ p ∈ positiveTime, qCoord a p ≤ qbig → xCoord a p ∈ Icc lo hi →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (g ∘ inverseCoordinates a) p‖ ≤ C * qCoord a p ^ (b - n)

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalCoordinateBounds.inverseCoordinates_dilation
statement:

statement:

      physicalQ a p ≤ qbig → physicalX a p ∈ Icc lo hi →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (physicalQ a) p‖ ≤ C * physicalQ a p ^ (-(n : ℝ)) ∧
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (physicalEta a) p‖ ≤ C * physicalQ a p ^ (-(n : ℝ)) ∧

      ‖fderiv ℝ (physicalQ a) p‖ ≤ C / physicalQ a p ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (physicalEta a) p‖ ≤ C / physicalQ a p ∧

name: NavierStokes.DiagonalScale.exists_diagonal_scales
statement:
theorem exists_diagonal_scales (C p : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (g : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → 0 < g j) (B : ℕ) :
    ∃ a : ℕ → ℕ,
      B ≤ a 0 ∧
      (∀ j, 0 < a j) ∧
      (∀ j, 2 * a j ≤ a (j + 1)) ∧
      StrictMono a ∧
      (∀ q : ℝ, 0 < q → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ j ≥ N, 1 / (a j : ℝ) < q) ∧
      (∀ j, 1 ≤ j → ∀ m, m ≤ j + 2 → ∀ q : ℝ,
        0 < q → q ≤ 1 / (a j : ℝ) →
          |logPowerWeight (C j m) (p j m) (g j / 2) q| ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j)

name: NavierStokes.DiagonalScale.exists_integer_scale
statement:
theorem exists_integer_scale {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (C p : ι → ℝ)
    (r ε : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ a : ℕ, 0 < a ∧
      ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ q : ℝ, 0 < q → q ≤ 1 / (a : ℝ) →
        |logPowerWeight (C i) (p i) r q| ≤ ε

name: NavierStokes.DiagonalScale.exists_uniform_tail_order
statement:
theorem exists_uniform_tail_order (g : ℕ → ℝ) (hg : Monotone g)
    (hgtop : Tendsto g atTop atTop) (L N : ℝ) (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ J : ℕ, m ≤ J ∧ ∀ q : ℝ, 0 < q → q ≤ 1 →
      (∑' n : ℕ, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (J + 1 + n) * q ^ (g (J + 1 + n) / 2 - L)) ≤
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ J * q ^ N

    Summable (fun n : ℕ =>
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (J + 1 + n) * q ^ (g (J + 1 + n) / 2 - L)) ∧
    (∑' n : ℕ, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (J + 1 + n) * q ^ (g (J + 1 + n) / 2 - L)) ≤

theorem extension_preserves_right_jets {a : ℝ} (ha : 1 < a) (n : ℕ) :

theorem extension_sub_one_bound {a : ℝ} (ha : 1 < a) (z : ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.HeatProfileExtension.iteratedDeriv_scaledProfile
statement:
theorem iteratedDeriv_scaledProfile {a : ℝ} (ha : 1 < a) (n : ℕ) (X ν : ℝ) :

statement:
theorem physicalProfile_eq_profile (a : ℝ) {X η : ℝ} (hX : 0 < X)

    physicalProfile a X η = profile a (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / X)

statement:
theorem scaledProfile_eq_profile (a : ℝ) {X ν : ℝ} (hX : 0 < X) (hν : 0 ≤ ν) :

statement:
theorem scaledProfile_sub_one_bound {a : ℝ} (ha : 1 < a) {X : ℝ} (hX : 0 < X)

    |scaledProfile a X ν - 1| ≤ 2 * derivativeBound a 1 * |ν| / X

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.actual_coefficients_bound
statement:
theorem actual_coefficients_bound (c : Parameters) (d : Fin 2 → ℝ) (j : Fin 2) :
    c.lam * |LocalizedMomentRepair.coefficients c.exponents c.lower c.upper d j| ≤
      inverseBound * (|normalizedDebt c d 0| + |normalizedDebt c d 1|)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.actual_coefficients_normalized_system
statement:
theorem actual_coefficients_normalized_system (c : Parameters) (d : Fin 2 → ℝ) :
    (normalizedMatrix c).mulVec
        (LocalizedMomentRepair.coefficients c.exponents c.lower c.upper d) =
      normalizedDebt c d

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.actual_matrix_entry
statement:
theorem actual_matrix_entry (c : Parameters) (i j : Fin 2) :
    LocalizedMomentRepair.matrix c.exponents c.lower c.upper i j =
      rowMoment (c.exponents i) * Real.exp (beta c i * center c j)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.affineCoefficients_decomposition
statement:
theorem affineCoefficients_decomposition (c : Parameters) (q A : ℝ) (j : Fin 2) :
    affineCoefficients c q A j = q * affineCoefficients c 1 0 j +
      A * affineCoefficients c 0 1 j

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.affineCoefficients_exp_bound
statement:
theorem affineCoefficients_exp_bound (c : Parameters) (hsmall : c.lam ≤ 1 / 120)
    (q A : ℝ) (j : Fin 2) :
    |affineCoefficients c q A j| ≤
      coefficientBound c.P c.m * Real.exp (-(1 / (4 * c.lam))) * (|q| + |A|)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.affineDebt_normalized_bound
statement:
theorem affineDebt_normalized_bound (c : Parameters) (hsmall : c.lam ≤ 1 / 120)
    (q A : ℝ) (i : Fin 2) :
    |normalizedDebt c (affineDebt c q A) i| ≤
      (debtBound c.P c.m i / c.lam) * Real.exp (-(1 / (2 * c.lam))) * (|q| + |A|)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.affineProfile_contDiff
statement: theorem affineProfile_contDiff (c : Parameters) (q A : ℝ) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (affineProfile c q A)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.affineProfile_jet_bound
statement:
theorem affineProfile_jet_bound (c : Parameters) (hsmall : c.lam ≤ 1 / 120)
    (q A : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (y : ℝ) :
    |iteratedDeriv k (affineProfile c q A) y| ≤
      correctionJetBound c.P c.m k * Real.exp (-(1 / (4 * c.lam))) * (|q| + |A|)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.affineProfile_jet_decomposition
statement:
theorem affineProfile_jet_decomposition (c : Parameters) (q A : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (y : ℝ) :
    iteratedDeriv k (affineProfile c q A) y =
      q * iteratedDeriv k (affineProfile c 1 0) y +
        A * iteratedDeriv k (affineProfile c 0 1) y

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.affineProfile_jet_formula
statement:
theorem affineProfile_jet_formula (c : Parameters) (q A : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (y : ℝ) :
    iteratedDeriv k (affineProfile c q A) y =
      ∑ j : Fin 2, affineCoefficients c q A j * iteratedDeriv k logTemplate (y - center c j)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.beta_bounds
statement:
theorem beta_bounds (c : Parameters) (i : Fin 2) :
    0 < beta c i ∧ beta c i ≤ 1 / 2

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.beta_small_bounds
statement:
theorem beta_small_bounds (c : Parameters) (hc : c.lam ≤ 1 / 120) (i : Fin 2) :
    2 / 5 ≤ beta c i ∧ 29 ≤ 60 * beta c i

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.bump_log_translate
statement:
theorem bump_log_translate (c : Parameters) (j : Fin 2) (y : ℝ) :
    LocalizedMomentRepair.bump (c.lower j) (c.upper j) (Real.exp y) =
      logTemplate (y - center c j)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.bump_scale
statement:
theorem bump_scale {k : ℝ} (hk : k ≠ 0) (l u x : ℝ) :
    LocalizedMomentRepair.bump (k * l) (k * u) (k * x) =
      LocalizedMomentRepair.bump l u x

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.center_gap_bound
statement:
theorem center_gap_bound (c : Parameters) (hsmall : c.lam ≤ 1 / 120) (i : Fin 2) :
    1 / (2 * c.lam) ≤ beta c i * (center c 0 - 11 / c.lam)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.coefficientBound_pos
statement: theorem coefficientBound_pos {P : ℝ} (hP : 0 < P) (m : ℝ) : 0 < coefficientBound P m

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.correctionJetBound_pos
statement:
theorem correctionJetBound_pos {P : ℝ} (hP : 0 < P) (m : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    0 < correctionJetBound P m k

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.correctionJet_bound
statement:
theorem correctionJet_bound (c : Parameters) (hsmall : c.lam ≤ 1 / 120)
    (amp : ℝ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) {eta : ℝ} (heta : |eta| ≤ 1) (y : ℝ) :
    |correctionJet c amp k eta y| ≤
      (2 * correctionJetBound c.P c.m k) * Real.exp (-(1 / (4 * c.lam))) * (1 + |amp eta|)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.correctionJet_eq
statement:
theorem correctionJet_eq (c : Parameters) (amp : ℝ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) (eta y : ℝ) :
    correctionJet c amp k eta y =
      iteratedDeriv k (affineProfile c (parameterPolynomial eta) (amp eta)) y

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.correctionJet_eta_bound
statement:
theorem correctionJet_eta_bound (c : Parameters) (hsmall : c.lam ≤ 1 / 120)
    {amp : ℝ → ℝ} {eta amp' : ℝ} (ha : HasDerivAt amp amp' eta)
    (heta : |eta| ≤ 1) (k : ℕ) (y : ℝ) :
    |deriv (fun t => correctionJet c amp k t y) eta| ≤
      (4 * correctionJetBound c.P c.m k) * Real.exp (-(1 / (4 * c.lam))) * (1 + |amp'|)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.correctionJet_eta_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem correctionJet_eta_hasDerivAt (c : Parameters) {amp : ℝ → ℝ}
    {eta amp' : ℝ} (ha : HasDerivAt amp amp' eta) (k : ℕ) (y : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => correctionJet c amp k t y)
      (iteratedDeriv k (affineProfile c (1 + 3 * eta ^ 2) amp') y) eta

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.correction_log_eq_affineProfile
statement:
theorem correction_log_eq_affineProfile (c : Parameters) (amp : ℝ → ℝ) (eta y : ℝ) :
    correction c amp eta (Real.exp y) = affineProfile c (parameterPolynomial eta) (amp eta) y

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.debtBound_pos
statement: theorem debtBound_pos {P : ℝ} (hP : 0 < P) (m : ℝ) (i : Fin 2) : 0 < debtBound P m i

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.debt_eq_affine
statement:
theorem debt_eq_affine (c : Parameters) (amp : ℝ → ℝ) (eta : ℝ) :
    debt c amp eta = affineDebt c (parameterPolynomial eta) (amp eta)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.dropEnd_le_pulseStart
statement: theorem dropEnd_le_pulseStart (c : Parameters) : Real.exp c.m ≤ c.pulseStart

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.exists_mainPulse_bound
statement: theorem exists_mainPulse_bound : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ z, |mainPulse z| ≤ C

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.exp_log_inverse_nat
statement:
theorem exp_log_inverse_nat {lam : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam) (n : ℕ) :
    Real.exp (-(n : ℝ) * Real.log (1 / lam)) = lam ^ n

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.holdAmplitude_pos
statement: theorem holdAmplitude_pos (c : Parameters) : 0 < holdAmplitude c

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.holdScale_lower
statement:
theorem holdScale_lower (c : Parameters) (i : Fin 2) :
    scaleFloor c.P c.m i ≤ holdScale c i

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.individual_correction_jet_bound
statement:
theorem individual_correction_jet_bound (c : Parameters) (hsmall : c.lam ≤ 1 / 120)
    (amp : ℝ → ℝ) {eta : ℝ} (heta : |eta| ≤ 1) (j : Fin 2) (k : ℕ) (y : ℝ) :
    |iteratedDeriv k (fun t =>
      LocalizedMomentRepair.coefficients c.exponents c.lower c.upper (debt c amp eta) j *
        LocalizedMomentRepair.bump (c.lower j) (c.upper j) (Real.exp t)) y| ≤
      correctionJetBound c.P c.m k * Real.exp (-(1 / (4 * c.lam))) * (1 + |amp eta|)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.individual_correction_jet_eta_bound
statement:
theorem individual_correction_jet_eta_bound (c : Parameters) (hsmall : c.lam ≤ 1 / 120)
    {amp : ℝ → ℝ} {eta amp' : ℝ} (ha : HasDerivAt amp amp' eta) (heta : |eta| ≤ 1)
    (j : Fin 2) (k : ℕ) (y : ℝ) :
    |deriv (fun s => iteratedDeriv k (fun t =>
      LocalizedMomentRepair.coefficients c.exponents c.lower c.upper (debt c amp s) j *
        LocalizedMomentRepair.bump (c.lower j) (c.upper j) (Real.exp t)) y) eta| ≤
      (2 * correctionJetBound c.P c.m k) * Real.exp (-(1 / (4 * c.lam))) * (1 + |amp'|)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.individual_correction_jet_formula
statement:
theorem individual_correction_jet_formula (c : Parameters) (amp : ℝ → ℝ)
    (eta : ℝ) (j : Fin 2) (k : ℕ) (y : ℝ) :
    iteratedDeriv k (fun t =>
      LocalizedMomentRepair.coefficients c.exponents c.lower c.upper (debt c amp eta) j *
        LocalizedMomentRepair.bump (c.lower j) (c.upper j) (Real.exp t)) y =
      affineCoefficients c (parameterPolynomial eta) (amp eta) j *
        iteratedDeriv k logTemplate (y - center c j)

statement: theorem inverseBound_pos : 0 < inverseBound

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.logTemplate_jet_le
statement: theorem logTemplate_jet_le (k : ℕ) (y : ℝ) : |iteratedDeriv k logTemplate y| ≤ templateJetBound k

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.logTemplate_support
statement: theorem logTemplate_support : support logTemplate ⊆ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1

theorem lower_scale (c : Parameters) (j : Fin 2) :

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.mainBound_pos
statement: theorem mainBound_pos : 0 < mainBound

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.mainMoment_log
statement:
theorem mainMoment_log (c : Parameters) (i : Fin 2) :
    mainMoment c i = ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..c.pulseLength,
      Real.exp (beta c i * y) * mainPulse (c.lam * y)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.mainMoment_log_short
statement:
theorem mainMoment_log_short (c : Parameters) (i : Fin 2) :
    mainMoment c i = ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..11 / c.lam,
      Real.exp (beta c i * y) * mainPulse (c.lam * y)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.mainPulse_abs_le
statement: theorem mainPulse_abs_le (z : ℝ) : |mainPulse z| ≤ mainBound

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.mainPulse_hasCompactSupport
statement: theorem mainPulse_hasCompactSupport : HasCompactSupport mainPulse

statement:
theorem momentScale_split (c : Parameters) (i : Fin 2) :

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.normalizedMatrix_det_ne_zero
statement: theorem normalizedMatrix_det_ne_zero (c : Parameters) : (normalizedMatrix c).det ≠ 0

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.normalizedMatrix_entry
statement:
theorem normalizedMatrix_entry (c : Parameters) (i j : Fin 2) :
    normalizedMatrix c i j = rowMoment (c.exponents i) *
      (if j = 0 then 1 else Real.exp (2 * beta c i))

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.normalized_inverse_entry_bound
statement:
theorem normalized_inverse_entry_bound (c : Parameters) (i j : Fin 2) :
    c.lam * |(normalizedMatrix c)⁻¹ i j| ≤ inverseBound

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.normalized_inverse_norm_bound
statement:
theorem normalized_inverse_norm_bound (c : Parameters) :
    c.lam * ‖fun i : Fin 2 => fun j : Fin 2 => (normalizedMatrix c)⁻¹ i j‖ ≤ inverseBound

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.normalized_mainMoment_bound
statement:
theorem normalized_mainMoment_bound (c : Parameters) (hsmall : c.lam ≤ 1 / 120) (i : Fin 2) :
    |Real.exp (-(beta c i * center c 0)) * mainMoment c i| ≤
      (11 * mainBound / c.lam) * Real.exp (-(1 / (2 * c.lam)))

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.normalized_mass_prefix
statement:
theorem normalized_mass_prefix (c : Parameters) (amp : ℝ → ℝ) (eta : ℝ) :
    massMoment c amp eta c.pulseStart /
        (Real.exp c.pulseStart * angular c.P c.dropLength c.lam (c.pulseStart, eta)) =
      prefixCoefficient c 0 * parameterPolynomial eta

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.normalized_mass_prefix_derivative_small
statement:
theorem normalized_mass_prefix_derivative_small (c : Parameters)
    (hwait : c.wait = 60 * Real.log (1 / c.lam)) (hsmall : c.lam ≤ 1 / 120)
    (amp : ℝ → ℝ) {eta : ℝ} (heta : |eta| ≤ 1) :
    |deriv (fun t => massMoment c amp t c.pulseStart /
        (Real.exp c.pulseStart * angular c.P c.dropLength c.lam (c.pulseStart, t))) eta| ≤
      (4 * prefixBound c.P c.m 0) * c.lam ^ 29

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.normalized_mass_prefix_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem normalized_mass_prefix_hasDerivAt (c : Parameters) (amp : ℝ → ℝ) (eta : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => massMoment c amp t c.pulseStart /
      (Real.exp c.pulseStart * angular c.P c.dropLength c.lam (c.pulseStart, t)))
      (prefixCoefficient c 0 * (1 + 3 * eta ^ 2)) eta

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.normalized_mass_prefix_small
statement:
theorem normalized_mass_prefix_small (c : Parameters)
    (hwait : c.wait = 60 * Real.log (1 / c.lam)) (hsmall : c.lam ≤ 1 / 120)
    (amp : ℝ → ℝ) {eta : ℝ} (heta : |eta| ≤ 1) :
    |massMoment c amp eta c.pulseStart /
        (Real.exp c.pulseStart * angular c.P c.dropLength c.lam (c.pulseStart, eta))| ≤
      (2 * prefixBound c.P c.m 0) * c.lam ^ 29

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.normalized_prefixCoefficient_bound
statement:
theorem normalized_prefixCoefficient_bound (c : Parameters) (hsmall : c.lam ≤ 1 / 120)
    (i : Fin 2) :
    |Real.exp (-(beta c i * center c 0)) * prefixCoefficient c i| ≤
      prefixBound c.P c.m i * Real.exp (-(1 / (2 * c.lam)))

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.normalized_solution_bound
statement:
theorem normalized_solution_bound (c : Parameters) (x d : Fin 2 → ℝ)
    (h : (normalizedMatrix c).mulVec x = d) (j : Fin 2) :
    c.lam * |x j| ≤ inverseBound * (|d 0| + |d 1|)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.paper_correction_bounds
statement:
theorem paper_correction_bounds (P m : ℝ) (hP : 0 < P) (hm : 0 < m) (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) (hsmall : lam ≤ 1 / 120),
      let c := paperParameters P m lam hP hm hlam (by linarith)
      ∀ (amp : ℝ → ℝ) (eta y : ℝ), |eta| ≤ 1 →
        |correctionJet c amp k eta y| ≤ C * Real.exp (-(1 / (4 * lam))) * (1 + |amp eta|) ∧
        ∀ amp' : ℝ, HasDerivAt amp amp' eta →
          |deriv (fun t => correctionJet c amp k t y) eta| ≤
            C * Real.exp (-(1 / (4 * lam))) * (1 + |amp'|)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.paper_prefix_bounds
statement:
theorem paper_prefix_bounds (P m : ℝ) (hP : 0 < P) (hm : 0 < m) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) (hsmall : lam ≤ 1 / 120),
      let c := paperParameters P m lam hP hm hlam (by linarith)
      pulseAmplitude c ≤ C * lam ^ 30 ∧
        ∀ (amp : ℝ → ℝ) (eta : ℝ), |eta| ≤ 1 →
          |massMoment c amp eta c.pulseStart /
            (Real.exp c.pulseStart * angular c.P c.dropLength c.lam (c.pulseStart, eta))| ≤ C * lam ^ 29 ∧
          |deriv (fun t => massMoment c amp t c.pulseStart /
            (Real.exp c.pulseStart * angular c.P c.dropLength c.lam (c.pulseStart, t))) eta| ≤ C * lam ^ 29

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.prefixJ_bounds
statement:
theorem prefixJ_bounds (c : Parameters) :
    0 ≤ prefixJ c ∧
      prefixJ c ≤ (5 / 2) * Real.sqrt 2 * c.P +
        4 * Real.sqrt 2 * c.P * Real.exp c.m * Real.exp (3 * Real.exp c.m)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.prefixJ_fixed_interval
statement:
theorem prefixJ_fixed_interval (c : Parameters) :
    prefixJ c = (5 / 2) * Real.sqrt 2 * c.P +
      ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..Real.exp c.m,
        Real.sqrt 2 * Real.exp (3 * y / 2) *
          radialAmplitude c.P c.dropLength c.lam y * dropCoefficient c.m y

statement:

    |LocalizedMomentRepair.coefficients c.exponents c.lower c.upper (debt c amp eta) j| ≤
      (2 * coefficientBound c.P c.m) * Real.exp (-(1 / (4 * c.lam))) * (1 + |amp eta|)

statement:

    HasDerivAt (fun t => LocalizedMomentRepair.coefficients c.exponents c.lower c.upper
      (debt c amp t) j) (affineCoefficients c (1 + 3 * eta ^ 2) amp' j) eta

statement:
theorem two_row_solution_bound {k lam A0 A1 r0 r1 x0 x1 d0 d1 : ℝ}
    (hk : 0 < k) (hlam : 0 < lam) (hlam' : lam ≤ 1)
    (hA0 : k ≤ A0) (hA1 : k ≤ A1)
    (hr0 : 0 ≤ r0) (hr0' : r0 ≤ Real.exp 1)
    (hgap : lam ≤ r0 - r1)
    (h0 : A0 * (x0 + r0 * x1) = d0) (h1 : A1 * (x0 + r1 * x1) = d1) :
    lam * |x0| ≤ ((1 + Real.exp 1) / k) * (|d0| + |d1|) ∧
      lam * |x1| ≤ ((1 + Real.exp 1) / k) * (|d0| + |d1|)

statement:
theorem ideal_lag_equation (h η : ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.RadialSchedule.ideal_lag_ge_one
NavierStokes.RadialSchedule.ideal_source_displayed
statement:
theorem ideal_source_displayed (h η : ℝ) :
    idealSource h η =
      (3 / 5) * (4 * coordinateFactor h η - 1) - h * (1 - 8 * η ^ 2) +
        (axialExponent h + 4 * axialShape η) * η * (2 * η / (1 + η ^ 2))

name: NavierStokes.RadialSchedule.ideal_source_positive_decomposition
statement:
theorem ideal_source_positive_decomposition (h η : ℝ) :
    idealSource h η = 9 / 5 - h + (16 / 5) * h * η ^ 2 +
      2 * (axialExponent h + 4 * axialShape η) * η ^ 2 / (1 + η ^ 2)

    (herror₀ : |error₀| ≤ 1 / 100) (herror₁ : |error₁| ≤ 1 / 100) :
    K * (9 / 10 : ℝ) ^ 2 - pulseEnergyDebt + error₀ < 0 ∧

    ∃ A ∈ Set.Icc (9 / 10 : ℝ) (6 / 5),
      K * A ^ 2 - pulseEnergyDebt + error A = 0

    let b := (debt₁ - debt₂) / (r₂ - r₁)
    let a := -debt₁ - r₁ * b
    debt₁ + a + r₁ * b = 0 ∧ debt₂ + a + r₂ * b = 0

name: NavierStokes.TailEnergyBounds.abs_deriv_normalizedPostPulseEnergy_le
statement:

      (2 * flattenLength + 4 * tailConstant) * d.core.lam *

statement:
theorem energyDensity_release_bound (d : TailData) (eta : ℝ) {y : ℝ}
    (hy : d.releaseStart ≤ y) :
    energyDensity d eta y ≤ 4 * energyDensity d eta d.releaseStart *
      (Real.exp 2 * Real.exp (-2 * (y - d.releaseStart)) +
        d.h ^ 8 * Real.exp 8 * Real.exp (-(2 * d.h) * (y - d.releaseStart)))

    energyDensity d eta y = energyDensity d eta d.releaseStart *
      Real.exp (2 * releasePrimitive d (y - d.releaseStart)) *
      (tailShape d (y - tailStart d) / (1 - d.rho)) ^ 2

    (2 * quadraticCoefficient d.core * amplitude d eta + linearTerm d.core eta) *

name: NavierStokes.PulseAmplitude.amplitude_spec
statement:
theorem amplitude_spec (d : OutgoingTail.TailData)
    (hsmall : d.core.lam ≤ 1 / 120) (hwait : d.core.wait = 60 * Real.log (1 / d.core.lam))
    (hscale : errorScale d.core ≤ 1 / 1000) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (amplitude d) ∧ ∀ eta : ℝ, eta ^ 2 ≤ 1 →
      9 / 10 < amplitude d eta ∧ amplitude d eta < 6 / 5 ∧
      (∫ y, Real.exp y * (axial d.core (amplitude d) (y, eta) ^ 2 -
        OutgoingTail.finalAngular d (y, eta) ^ 2 / 2)) = 0 ∧
      |deriv (amplitude d) eta| ≤ 128 * errorScale d.core ∧
      (∀ A ∈ Icc (9 / 10 : ℝ) (6 / 5), totalEnergy d A eta = 0 → A = amplitude d eta)

    9 / 10 < amplitude d eta ∧ amplitude d eta < 6 / 5 ∧

theorem energyIntegrand_integral_pulse (d : OutgoingTail.TailData) (A eta : ℝ) :

      normalization d.core * shape eta ^ 2 / d.core.lam * scaledPulseEnergy d.core A eta

name: NavierStokes.PulseAmplitude.energyIntegrand_late
NavierStokes.PulseAmplitude.energyIntegrand_prefix
statement:
theorem energyIntegrand_prefix (d : OutgoingTail.TailData) (A eta : ℝ) {y : ℝ}
    (hy : y ≤ d.core.pulseStart) :
    energyIntegrand d A eta y =
      eta ^ 2 * (Real.exp y * dropCoefficient d.core.m y ^ 2) -
        shape eta ^ 2 * (coreEnergyWeight d.core y / 2)

name: NavierStokes.PulseAmplitude.energyIntegrand_pulse
statement:
theorem energyIntegrand_pulse (d : OutgoingTail.TailData) (A eta : ℝ) {y : ℝ}
    (hy : d.core.pulseStart ≤ y) (hy' : y ≤ d.core.endpoint) :
    energyIntegrand d A eta y = normalization d.core * shape eta ^ 2 *
      (pulseWeight d.core (y - d.core.pulseStart) *
        (pulseRatio d.core (fun _ => A) (y - d.core.pulseStart, eta) ^ 2 - 1 / 2))

name: NavierStokes.PulseAmplitude.exists_uniform_amplitude_threshold
statement:
theorem exists_uniform_amplitude_threshold (P m : ℝ) (hP : 0 < P) :
    ∃ lam₀ C : ℝ, 0 < lam₀ ∧ 0 < C ∧ ∀ d : OutgoingTail.TailData,
      d.core.P = P → d.core.m = m → d.core.wait = 60 * Real.log (1 / d.core.lam) →
      d.core.lam < lam₀ →
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (amplitude d) ∧ ∀ eta : ℝ, eta ^ 2 ≤ 1 →
        9 / 10 < amplitude d eta ∧ amplitude d eta < 6 / 5 ∧
        (∫ y, Real.exp y * (axial d.core (amplitude d) (y, eta) ^ 2 -
          OutgoingTail.finalAngular d (y, eta) ^ 2 / 2)) = 0 ∧
        |deriv (amplitude d) eta| ≤ C * d.core.lam * (1 + Real.log (1 / d.core.lam)) ∧
        (∀ A ∈ Icc (9 / 10 : ℝ) (6 / 5), totalEnergy d A eta = 0 → A = amplitude d eta)

        ∀ eta : ℝ, eta ^ 2 ≤ 1 →

statement:
theorem normalizedResetEnergy_eq (d : TailData) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta : ℝ) :
    normalizedResetEnergy d c eta = (d.core.lam / pulseNormalization d) *
      resetEnergy d c eta * (1 + eta ^ 2) ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.ResetEnergyBounds.normalizedResetEnergy_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem normalizedResetEnergy_hasDerivAt (d : TailData) {c : ℝ → Coeff}
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (eta : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (normalizedResetEnergy d c)
      (d.core.lam * deriv (resetEnergy d c) eta / (pulseNormalization d * shape eta ^ 2) +
        (4 * eta / (1 + eta ^ 2)) * normalizedResetEnergy d c eta) eta

name: NavierStokes.ResetEnergyBounds.normalized_resetEnergy_deriv_abs_le
statement:
theorem normalized_resetEnergy_deriv_abs_le (eta : ℝ) (heta : eta ^ 2 ≤ 1) :

statement:
theorem resetDensity_eq (d : TailData) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta y : ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.ResetEnergyBounds.resetDensity_hasDerivAt
NavierStokes.ResetEnergyBounds.resetDensity_integrable

name: NavierStokes.CorrectedPulseAmplitude.amplitude_clamped_equation
statement:
theorem amplitude_clamped_equation (d : TailData) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta : ℝ) :
    PulseAmplitude.quadraticCoefficient d.core * amplitude d c eta ^ 2 +
      PulseAmplitude.linearTerm d.core eta * amplitude d c eta +
      PulseAmplitude.negativeClamp (constantTerm d c eta) = 0

name: NavierStokes.CorrectedPulseAmplitude.amplitude_contDiff
statement:
theorem amplitude_contDiff (d : TailData) {c : ℝ → Coeff} (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) :

name: NavierStokes.CorrectedPulseAmplitude.amplitude_derivative_bound
statement:
theorem amplitude_derivative_bound (d : TailData) {c : ℝ → Coeff}
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (eta e : ℝ) (heta : eta ^ 2 ≤ 1)
    (h : PulseAmplitude.EnergyErrorBounds d eta e) (hshift : |energyShift d c eta| ≤ e)
    (he : e ≤ 1 / 1000) (hT : |deriv (PulseAmplitude.normalizedTail d) eta| ≤ e)
    (hs : |deriv (energyShift d c) eta| ≤ e) : |deriv (amplitude d c) eta| ≤ 128 * e

name: NavierStokes.CorrectedPulseAmplitude.amplitude_derivative_identity
statement:
theorem amplitude_derivative_identity (d : TailData) {c : ℝ → Coeff}
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (eta : ℝ) (hneg : constantTerm d c eta < -(1 / 5)) :
    (2 * PulseAmplitude.quadraticCoefficient d.core * amplitude d c eta +
        PulseAmplitude.linearTerm d.core eta) * deriv (amplitude d c) eta +
      deriv (PulseAmplitude.linearTerm d.core) eta * amplitude d c eta +
        deriv (constantTerm d c) eta = 0

name: NavierStokes.CorrectedPulseAmplitude.amplitude_energy_equation
statement:
theorem amplitude_energy_equation (d : TailData) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta : ℝ)
    (hc : constantTerm d c eta ≤ -(1 / 5)) : energyPolynomial d c (amplitude d c eta) eta = 0

name: NavierStokes.CorrectedPulseAmplitude.amplitude_pos
statement: theorem amplitude_pos (d : TailData) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta : ℝ) : 0 < amplitude d c eta

name: NavierStokes.CorrectedPulseAmplitude.amplitude_spec
statement:
theorem amplitude_spec {d : TailData} {K : ℝ} (w : ResetWitness d K) (hK : 0 < K)
    (hsmall : d.core.lam ≤ 1 / 120) (hwait : d.core.wait = 60 * Real.log (1 / d.core.lam))
    (hscale : combinedScale d K ≤ 1 / 1000) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (amplitude d w.coefficients) ∧ ∀ eta : ℝ, eta ^ 2 ≤ 1 →
      9 / 10 < amplitude d w.coefficients eta ∧ amplitude d w.coefficients eta < 6 / 5 ∧
      totalEnergy d w.coefficients (amplitude d w.coefficients eta) eta = 0 ∧
      |deriv (amplitude d w.coefficients) eta| ≤ 128 * combinedScale d K ∧
      (∀ A ∈ Icc (9 / 10 : ℝ) (6 / 5), totalEnergy d w.coefficients A eta = 0 →
        A = amplitude d w.coefficients eta)

name: NavierStokes.CorrectedPulseAmplitude.amplitude_spec_of_bounds
statement:
theorem amplitude_spec_of_bounds (d : TailData) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta e : ℝ)
    (heta : eta ^ 2 ≤ 1) (h : PulseAmplitude.EnergyErrorBounds d eta e)
    (hshift : |energyShift d c eta| ≤ e) (he : e ≤ 1 / 1000) :
    9 / 10 < amplitude d c eta ∧ amplitude d c eta < 6 / 5 ∧ totalEnergy d c (amplitude d c eta) eta = 0

theorem amplitude_totalEnergy_zero (d : TailData) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta : ℝ)

name: NavierStokes.CorrectedPulseAmplitude.amplitude_unique
statement:
theorem amplitude_unique (d : TailData) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta e : ℝ)

    (hshift : |energyShift d c eta| ≤ e) (he : e ≤ 1 / 1000)

    A = amplitude d c eta

name: NavierStokes.CorrectedPulseAmplitude.coefficient_derivative_bounds
statement:
theorem coefficient_derivative_bounds (d : TailData) {c : ℝ → Coeff}
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (eta e : ℝ) (heta : eta ^ 2 ≤ 1)
    (h : PulseAmplitude.EnergyErrorBounds d eta e)
    (hT : |deriv (PulseAmplitude.normalizedTail d) eta| ≤ e)
    (hs : |deriv (energyShift d c) eta| ≤ e) :
    |deriv (PulseAmplitude.linearTerm d.core) eta| ≤ 4 * e ∧

name: NavierStokes.CorrectedPulseAmplitude.exists_corrected_amplitude
statement:
theorem exists_corrected_amplitude (P m : ℝ) (hP : 0 < P) :
    ∃ lam₀ K C : ℝ, 0 < lam₀ ∧ 0 < K ∧ 0 < C ∧ ∀ d : TailData,
      d.core.P = P → d.core.m = m → d.core.wait = 60 * Real.log (1 / d.core.lam) →
      d.core.lam < lam₀ → ∃ w : ResetWitness d K,
        ContDiff ℝ ∞ (amplitude d w.coefficients) ∧ ∀ eta : ℝ, eta ^ 2 ≤ 1 →
          9 / 10 < amplitude d w.coefficients eta ∧ amplitude d w.coefficients eta < 6 / 5 ∧
          totalEnergy d w.coefficients (amplitude d w.coefficients eta) eta = 0 ∧
          |deriv (amplitude d w.coefficients) eta| ≤ C * d.core.lam * (1 + Real.log (1 / d.core.lam)) ∧
          (∀ XR : ℝ, 0 < XR →
            IntegrableOn (radialEnergyIntegrand d w.coefficients (amplitude d w.coefficients) eta XR) (Ioi 0) ∧
            (∫ X in Ioi 0, radialEnergyIntegrand d w.coefficients (amplitude d w.coefficients) eta XR X) = 0) ∧
          (∀ A ∈ Icc (9 / 10 : ℝ) (6 / 5), totalEnergy d w.coefficients A eta = 0 →
            A = amplitude d w.coefficients eta)

name: NavierStokes.CorrectedPulseAmplitude.numerical_coefficient_bounds
statement:
theorem numerical_coefficient_bounds (d : TailData) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta e : ℝ)
    (heta : eta ^ 2 ≤ 1) (h : PulseAmplitude.EnergyErrorBounds d eta e)
    (hshift : |energyShift d c eta| ≤ e) (he : e ≤ 1 / 1000) :
    1 / 5 ≤ PulseAmplitude.quadraticCoefficient d.core ∧
      PulseAmplitude.quadraticCoefficient d.core ≤ 13 / 50 ∧
      |PulseAmplitude.linearTerm d.core eta| ≤ 1 / 100 ∧
      -(13 / 50) ≤ constantTerm d c eta ∧ constantTerm d c eta ≤ -(23 / 100)

theorem realized_energy_eq (d : TailData) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta : ℝ) :

      correctedAngular d c (y, eta) ^ 2 / 2)) = totalEnergy d c (amplitude d c eta) eta

name: NavierStokes.CorrectedPulseAmplitude.totalEnergy_normalized

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.ResetWitness.history_eq_candidate
statement:
theorem history_eq_candidate (eta : ℝ) (q : ℝ → ℝ) {a y : ℝ}
    (ha : d.releaseStart ≤ a) (hay : a ≤ y)

      HasDerivAt q (-profileSlope d t - d.h - (1 + profileSlope d t) * q t) t)

theorem radial_history_eta_independent (eta eta' : ℝ) {X : ℝ} (hX : 0 < X)

    (∫ u in Ioc 0 X, radialH d w.coefficients eta u) =
      ∫ u in Ioc 0 X, radialH d w.coefficients eta' u

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.ResetWitness.radial_history_eventual
statement:
theorem radial_history_eventual (eta : ℝ) {X : ℝ} (hX : 0 < X)
    (hfar : tailEnd d ≤ Real.log X) :
    (∫ u in Ioc 0 X, radialH d w.coefficients eta u) = X * radialH d w.coefficients eta X / (1 - d.h)

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.ResetWitness.radial_history_integrable
statement:
theorem radial_history_integrable (eta : ℝ) {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    IntegrableOn (radialH d w.coefficients eta) (Ioc 0 (Real.exp y))

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.ResetWitness.renormalized_angular_moment
statement:
theorem renormalized_angular_moment (eta : ℝ) :
    (∫ X in Ioi 0, radialH d w.coefficients eta X - radialPowerH d X) = 0

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.ResetWitness.renormalized_log_integrable
statement:
theorem renormalized_log_integrable (eta : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun y => correctedWeight d w.coefficients eta y - powerWeight d y)

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.ResetWitness.renormalized_log_integral
statement:
theorem renormalized_log_integral (eta : ℝ) :
    (∫ y, correctedWeight d w.coefficients eta y - powerWeight d y) = 0

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.ResetWitness.renormalized_radial_integrable
statement:
theorem renormalized_radial_integrable (eta : ℝ) :
    IntegrableOn (fun X => radialH d w.coefficients eta X - radialPowerH d X) (Ioi 0)

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.complete_release_moments
statement:
theorem complete_release_moments :
    ∃ lam0 : ℝ, 0 < lam0 ∧ ∀ d : TailData, d.core.lam < lam0 →
      ∃ c : ℝ → Coeff, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (correctedAngular d c) ∧
        ∀ eta : ℝ,
          IntegrableOn (fun X => radialH d c eta X - radialPowerH d X) (Ioi 0) ∧
          (∫ X in Ioi 0, radialH d c eta X - radialPowerH d X) = 0 ∧
          ∀ X : ℝ, 0 < X → tailEnd d ≤ Real.log X →
            (∫ u in Ioc 0 X, radialH d c eta u) = X * radialH d c eta X / (1 - d.h)

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.correctedWeight_contDiff
statement:
theorem correctedWeight_contDiff (d : TailData) (c : ℝ → Coeff)
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (eta : ℝ) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (correctedWeight d c eta)

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.correctedWeight_eq_power
statement:
theorem correctedWeight_eq_power (d : TailData) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta : ℝ)
    {y : ℝ} (hy : tailEnd d ≤ y) : correctedWeight d c eta y = powerWeight d y

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.correctedWeight_eq_release
statement:
theorem correctedWeight_eq_release (d : TailData) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta : ℝ) {y : ℝ}
    (hy : d.releaseStart ≤ y) : correctedWeight d c eta y = releaseWeight d y

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.correctedWeight_ideal
NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.corrected_eq_release
statement:
theorem corrected_eq_release (d : TailData) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta : ℝ) {y : ℝ}

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.exponential_radial_weight
statement:
theorem exponential_radial_weight (y : ℝ) :
    Real.exp y * Real.sqrt (2 * Real.exp y) = Real.sqrt 2 * Real.exp (3 * y / 2)

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.image_exp_Iic
statement: theorem image_exp_Iic (y : ℝ) : Real.exp '' Iic y = Ioc 0 (Real.exp y)

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.momentCandidate_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem momentCandidate_hasDerivAt (d : TailData) (q : ℝ → ℝ) {y : ℝ}
    (hy : d.releaseStart ≤ y)
    (hq : HasDerivAt q (-profileSlope d y - d.h - (1 + profileSlope d y) * q y) y) :
    HasDerivAt (momentCandidate d q) (releaseWeight d y) y

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.powerWeight_integrable
statement: theorem powerWeight_integrable (d : TailData) (y : ℝ) : IntegrableOn (powerWeight d) (Iic y)

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.powerWeight_integral
statement:
theorem powerWeight_integral (d : TailData) (y : ℝ) :
    (∫ t in Iic y, powerWeight d t) = powerWeight d y / (1 - d.h)

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.profileSlope_before_tail
statement:
theorem profileSlope_before_tail (d : TailData) {y : ℝ} (hy : y ≤ tailStart d) :
    profileSlope d y = releaseSlope d (y - d.releaseStart)

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.radialH_comp_exp
statement:
theorem radialH_comp_exp (d : TailData) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta y : ℝ) :
    |Real.exp y| • radialH d c eta (Real.exp y) = Real.sqrt 2 * correctedWeight d c eta y

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.radialPowerH_comp_exp
statement:
theorem radialPowerH_comp_exp (d : TailData) (y : ℝ) :
    |Real.exp y| • radialPowerH d (Real.exp y) = Real.sqrt 2 * powerWeight d y

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.radial_difference_comp_exp
statement:
theorem radial_difference_comp_exp (d : TailData) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta y : ℝ) :
    |Real.exp y| • (radialH d c eta (Real.exp y) - radialPowerH d (Real.exp y)) =
      Real.sqrt 2 * (correctedWeight d c eta y - powerWeight d y)

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.releaseLag_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem releaseLag_hasDerivAt (d : TailData) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (releaseLag d)
      (-releaseSlope d t - d.h - (1 + releaseSlope d t) * releaseLag d t) t

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.releaseWeight_contDiff
statement: theorem releaseWeight_contDiff (d : TailData) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (releaseWeight d)

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.releaseWeight_eq_power
statement:
theorem releaseWeight_eq_power (d : TailData) {y : ℝ} (hy : tailEnd d ≤ y) :
    releaseWeight d y = powerWeight d y

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.releaseWeight_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem releaseWeight_hasDerivAt (d : TailData) {y : ℝ} (hy : d.releaseStart ≤ y) :
    HasDerivAt (releaseWeight d) (releaseWeight d y * (1 + profileSlope d y)) y

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.releaseWeight_pos
statement: theorem releaseWeight_pos (d : TailData) (y : ℝ) : 0 < releaseWeight d y

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.shifted_releaseLag_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem shifted_releaseLag_hasDerivAt (d : TailData) {y : ℝ} (hy : y ≤ tailStart d) :

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.tailEnd_pos
statement: theorem tailEnd_pos (d : TailData) : 0 < tailEnd d

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.tailLag_zero_late

name: NavierStokes.ReleaseMoments.tailShapeDeriv_zero_late
statement:
theorem tailShapeDeriv_zero_late (d : TailData) {t : ℝ} (ht : 3 ≤ t) :

statement:
theorem weighted_power (d : TailData) (y : ℝ) :

theorem admissible (d : TailData) :

statement:
theorem angular_factorization (d : TailData) (y η : ℝ) :

statement:

statement:
theorem axisPressure_deriv_pos (d : TailData) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) :

name: NavierStokes.SchedulePressure.axisPressure_deriv_zero

statement:

statement: theorem axisPressure_neg (d : TailData) (η : ℝ) : axisPressure d η < 0

statement:
theorem Pi_tendsto_axis (F : Profile) (eta : ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingProfile.Profile.U_after

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingProfile.Profile.angular_integrable
statement:

theorem angular_integral_zero (F : Profile) (eta : ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingProfile.exists_fixed_lambda
statement:
theorem exists_fixed_lambda (P m : ℝ) (hP : 0 < P) (hm : 0 < m) :
    ∃ lam C : ℝ, 0 < lam ∧ 0 < C ∧ ∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → 2 * h < lam →
      ∃ F : Profile, F.data.core.P = P ∧ F.data.core.m = m ∧
        F.data.core.lam = lam ∧ F.data.h = h ∧ Specification F C

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingProfile.exists_outgoing_profile
statement:
theorem exists_outgoing_profile (P m : ℝ) (hP : 0 < P) (hm : 0 < m) :
    ∃ lam₀ C : ℝ, 0 < lam₀ ∧ 0 < C ∧ ∀ lam : ℝ,
      0 < lam → lam < lam₀ → ∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → 2 * h < lam →
      ∃ F : Profile, F.data.core.P = P ∧ F.data.core.m = m ∧
        F.data.core.lam = lam ∧ F.data.h = h ∧
        F.data.core.wait = 60 * Real.log (1 / lam) ∧ Specification F C

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingProfile.exists_profile_for_data
statement:
theorem exists_profile_for_data (P m : ℝ) (hP : 0 < P) :
    ∃ lam₀ C : ℝ, 0 < lam₀ ∧ 0 < C ∧ ∀ d : TailData,
      d.core.P = P → d.core.m = m → d.core.wait = 60 * Real.log (1 / d.core.lam) →
      d.core.lam < lam₀ → ∃ F : Profile, F.data = d ∧ Specification F C

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingProfile.exponential_prefix_integral

    {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    IntegrableOn f (Iic y) ∧ (∫ t in Iic y, f t) = a / b + ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..y, f t

name: NavierStokes.HeatTailEdit.outgoingEdit_before
NavierStokes.HeatTailEdit.outgoingEdit_eventual_heat
statement:
theorem outgoingEdit_eventual_heat (d : TailData) (ν eta : ℝ) {K X : ℝ}
    (hK : 0 < K) (hX : 0 < X) (htail : 3 ≤ Real.log (X / K) + 1 / 5) :
    outgoingEdit d ν K eta X =
      (outgoingAmplitude d * K ^ exponent d.h) *
        RadialHeatProfile.spatialProfile (1 + d.h) ν X

name: NavierStokes.HeatTailEdit.outgoingEdit_full
statement:
theorem outgoingEdit_full (d : TailData) (ν eta : ℝ) {K X : ℝ}
    (hK : 0 < K) (hX : 0 < X) (hfull : 1 / 2 ≤ Real.log (X / K) + 1 / 5) :
    outgoingEdit d ν K eta X =
      outgoingAmplitude d * (X / K) ^ (-exponent d.h) *
        tailShape d (Real.log (X / K) + 1 / 5) *
          RadialHeatProfile.profile (1 + d.h) (2 * ν / X)

name: NavierStokes.HeatTailEdit.outgoingEdit_heat_factorization
statement:
theorem outgoingEdit_heat_factorization (d : TailData) (ν eta : ℝ) {K X : ℝ}

    outgoingEdit d ν K eta X =
      (outgoingAmplitude d * K ^ exponent d.h) *
        RadialHeatProfile.spatialProfile (1 + d.h) ν X *
          tailShape d (Real.log (X / K) + 1 / 5)

name: NavierStokes.HeatTailEdit.outgoing_angular
statement:
theorem outgoing_angular (d : TailData) {ν K : ℝ} (hν : 0 < ν) (hK : 0 < K) (eta : ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.HeatTailEdit.outgoing_pressure

theorem outgoing_pressure (d : TailData) {ν K : ℝ} (hν : 0 < ν) (hK : 0 < K) (eta : ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.HeatTailEdit.powerTail_angular
statement:
theorem powerTail_angular {h ν K e M : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hν : 0 < ν)
    (hK : 0 < K) (he : 0 ≤ e) {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hbound : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → |f t| ≤ M) :
    IntegrableOn (fun X => Real.sqrt (2 * X) * change (powerTail h e K f) h ν K X) (Ioi K) ∧
      |angularDebt (powerTail h e K f) h ν K| ≤
        Real.sqrt 2 * heatConstant h ν * e * M * Real.sqrt K / h

name: NavierStokes.HeatTailEdit.powerTail_bound
statement:
theorem powerTail_bound {K e M X : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (he : 0 ≤ e) (hX : K ≤ X)

    |powerTail h e K f X| ≤ e * M * (X / K) ^ (-exponent h)

statement:

    (hbound : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → |f t| ≤ M) :
    IntegrableOn (squareChange (powerTail h e K f) h ν K) (Ioi K) ∧
      |energyDebt (powerTail h e K f) h ν K| ≤
        2 * heatConstant h ν * e ^ 2 * M ^ 2 / (2 * exponent h)

statement:
theorem powerTail_pressure {h ν K e M : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hν : 0 < ν)
    (hK : 0 < K) (he : 0 ≤ e) (hM : 0 ≤ M) {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hbound : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → |f t| ≤ M) :
    IntegrableOn (fun X => squareChange (powerTail h e K f) h ν K X / X) (Ioi K) ∧

theorem powerTail_square_bound {K e M X : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (he : 0 ≤ e)

    (hf : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → |f t| ≤ M) :

name: NavierStokes.HeatTailEdit.powerTail_weighted_change
statement:
theorem powerTail_weighted_change {h ν K e M q : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hν : 0 < ν)
    (hK : 0 < K) (he : 0 ≤ e) {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hbound : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → |f t| ≤ M) (hq : q < exponent h) :
    IntegrableOn (fun X => X ^ q * change (powerTail h e K f) h ν K X) (Ioi K) ∧
      |∫ X in Ioi K, X ^ q * change (powerTail h e K f) h ν K X| ≤
        heatConstant h ν * e * M * K ^ q / (exponent h - q)

name: NavierStokes.HeatTailEdit.powerTail_weighted_squareChange
statement:
theorem powerTail_weighted_squareChange {h ν K e M q : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hν : 0 < ν)
    (hK : 0 < K) (he : 0 ≤ e) (hM : 0 ≤ M) {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hbound : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → |f t| ≤ M) (hq : q < 2 * exponent h) :
    IntegrableOn (fun X => X ^ q * squareChange (powerTail h e K f) h ν K X) (Ioi K) ∧
      |∫ X in Ioi K, X ^ q * squareChange (powerTail h e K f) h ν K X| ≤
        2 * heatConstant h ν * e ^ 2 * M ^ 2 * K ^ q / (2 * exponent h - q)

name: NavierStokes.HeatTailEdit.pressureDebt_eq
statement:
theorem pressureDebt_eq (E : ℝ → ℝ) (h ν K : ℝ) :
    pressureDebt E h ν K = ∫ X in Ioi K, X ^ (-1 : ℝ) * squareChange E h ν K X

name: NavierStokes.HeatTailEdit.squareChange_bound

theorem squareChange_bound {E : ℝ → ℝ} {h ν K X : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hν : 0 ≤ ν)

      2 * heatConstant h ν * E X ^ 2 / X

name: NavierStokes.HeatTailEdit.switch_contDiffOn

theorem weightedKernel_eq {K X : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (hX : 0 < X) (p q : ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.HeatTailEdit.weighted_integral_bound
statement:
theorem weighted_integral_bound {K p q B : ℝ} {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hK : 0 < K)

    (hb : ∀ X ∈ Ioi K, |g X| ≤ B * (X / K) ^ p / X) :
    IntegrableOn (fun X => X ^ q * g X) (Ioi K) ∧
      |∫ X in Ioi K, X ^ q * g X| ≤ B * K ^ q / (-p - q)

theorem FirstJetBound.mono {P : Patch} {a : ℝ → ℝ} {c : ℝ → Coeff} {η L M : ℝ}

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.amplitudeDebt_bounds
statement:
theorem amplitudeDebt_bounds {U S : Set ℝ} (hU : IsOpen U) (hSU : S ⊆ U)
    {a : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a U) (hpos : ∀ η ∈ U, 0 < a η)

      ‖deriv (fun θ => amplitudeFactors (a θ)) η‖ ≤ D)

    ‖amplitudeDebt (a η) v‖ ≤ D * ‖v‖ ∧

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.amplitudeDebt_contDiffOn
NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.amplitudeFactors_contDiffOn
NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.angular_density_rescale
statement:
theorem angular_density_rescale (P : Patch) (lam R a : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R)

    Real.sqrt (2 * (R * x)) *
      (physicalProfile P lam R a c (R * x) - cleanProfile lam R a (R * x)) =
      (Real.sqrt (2 * R) * a) * (x ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * correction P c x)

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.angular_scale_eq
statement:
theorem angular_scale_eq (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) :

theorem baseProfile_lower_bound (P : Patch) (lam : ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.baseProfile_positive
statement:
theorem baseProfile_positive (lam : ℝ) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :

statement:
theorem bumps_disjoint (P : Patch) (i j : Fin 3) (hij : i ≠ j) (x : ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.compact_amplitude_bounds
statement:
theorem compact_amplitude_bounds {U S : Set ℝ} (hU : IsOpen U) (hS : IsCompact S)

    ∃ D : ℝ, 0 < D ∧ ∀ η ∈ S,
      ‖amplitudeFactors (a η)‖ ≤ D ∧
      ‖deriv (fun θ => amplitudeFactors (a θ)) η‖ ≤ D ∧
      |a η| ≤ D ∧ |deriv a η| ≤ D

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.composed_solver_deriv_bound
statement:
theorem composed_solver_deriv_bound {g : Coeff → Coeff} {ε C : ℝ}

    (hbound : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Coeff) ε, ‖fderiv ℝ g v‖ ≤ C)

    (hmem : d η ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Coeff) ε) :
    ‖deriv (g ∘ d) η‖ ≤ C * ‖deriv d η‖

statement:
theorem correctionCLM_apply (P : Patch) (x : ℝ) (c : Coeff) :

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.correction_contDiff
statement:
theorem correction_contDiff (P : Patch) (c : Coeff) :

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.correction_derivative_bound
statement:
theorem correction_derivative_bound (P : Patch) (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (c : Coeff) (x : ℝ),

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.correction_family_contDiffOn
NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.correction_first_jet_bound
statement:
theorem correction_first_jet_bound (P : Patch) :

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.correction_hasCompactSupport
statement:
theorem correction_hasCompactSupport (P : Patch) (c : Coeff) :

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.correction_iteratedDeriv
statement:
theorem correction_iteratedDeriv (P : Patch) (c : Coeff) (k : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    iteratedDeriv k (correction P c) x = ∑ j, c j * iteratedDeriv k (bump P j) x

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.correction_moment
statement:
theorem correction_moment (P : Patch) (s : ℝ) (c : Coeff) :
    (∫ x, x ^ s * correction P c x) = ∑ j, c j * bumpMoment P s j

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.correction_parameter_deriv
NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.correction_square
statement:
theorem correction_square (P : Patch) (c : Coeff) (x : ℝ) :
    (correction P c x) ^ 2 = ∑ j, (c j) ^ 2 * (bump P j x) ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.correction_square_moment
statement:
theorem correction_square_moment (P : Patch) (s : ℝ) (c : Coeff) :
    (∫ x, x ^ s * (correction P c x) ^ 2) = ∑ j, (c j) ^ 2 * squareMoment P s j

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.correction_support
statement:
theorem correction_support (P : Patch) (c : Coeff) :

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.correction_tsupport
statement:
theorem correction_tsupport (P : Patch) (c : Coeff) :
