name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.energy_density_rescale
statement:
theorem energy_density_rescale (P : Patch) (lam R a : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R)
    (c : Coeff) (x : ℝ) :
    (physicalProfile P lam R a c (R * x)) ^ 2 - (cleanProfile lam R a (R * x)) ^ 2 =
      (2 * a ^ 2) * weightedChange P lam c 0 x

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.exists_heat_compensation
statement:
theorem exists_heat_compensation (P : Patch) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 ≤ lam)
    (T : OutgoingTail.TailData) (ν q : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (hq : 0 < q)
    {U S : Set ℝ} (hU : IsOpen U) (hS : IsCompact S) (hSU : S ⊆ U)
    (a : ℝ → ℝ) (ha : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a U) (hpos : ∀ η ∈ U, 0 < a η) :
    ∃ K₀ C : ℝ, 0 < K₀ ∧ 0 < C ∧ ∀ K : ℝ, K₀ ≤ K →
      ∃ (c : ℝ → Coeff) (V : Set ℝ),
        IsOpen V ∧ S ⊆ V ∧ V ⊆ U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c V ∧
        ∀ η ∈ S,
          physicalMoments P lam (q * K) (a η) (c η) + heatDebt T ν K η = 0 ∧
          ‖c η‖ ≤ C / K ∧ ‖deriv c η‖ ≤ C / K ∧
          FirstJetBound P a c η (C / K) ∧
          ∀ X : ℝ, 0 < X → 0 < physicalProfile P lam (q * K) (a η) (c η) X

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.exists_normalized_compensation
statement:
theorem exists_normalized_compensation (P : Patch) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 ≤ lam) :
    ∃ (g : Coeff → Coeff) (ε C : ℝ), 0 < ε ∧ 0 < C ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g (Metric.ball 0 ε) ∧ g 0 = 0 ∧
      ∀ d ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Coeff) ε,
        momentMap P lam (g d) = d ∧ ‖g d‖ ≤ C * ‖d‖ ∧ ‖fderiv ℝ g d‖ ≤ C ∧
        ∀ x : ℝ,
          (|correction P (g d) x| ≤ C * ‖d‖ ∧
            |deriv (correction P (g d)) x| ≤ C * ‖d‖) ∧
          (0 < x → 0 < baseProfile lam x + correction P (g d) x)

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.exists_uniform_parameter_compensation
statement:
theorem exists_uniform_parameter_compensation (P : Patch) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 ≤ lam)
    {U S : Set ℝ} (hU : IsOpen U) (hS : IsCompact S) (hSU : S ⊆ U)
    (a : ℝ → ℝ) (ha : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a U) (hpos : ∀ η ∈ U, 0 < a η) :
    ∃ ε C : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ 0 < C ∧ ∀ v : Coeff, ‖v‖ < ε →
      ∃ (c : ℝ → Coeff) (V : Set ℝ),
        IsOpen V ∧ S ⊆ V ∧ V ⊆ U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c V ∧
        ∀ η ∈ S, momentMap P lam (c η) = amplitudeDebt (a η) v ∧
          ‖c η‖ ≤ C * ‖v‖ ∧ ‖deriv c η‖ ≤ C * ‖v‖ ∧
          FirstJetBound P a c η (C * ‖v‖) ∧
          ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < a η * (baseProfile lam x + correction P (c η) x)

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.heatDebt_independent
statement:
theorem heatDebt_independent (T : OutgoingTail.TailData) (ν : ℝ) {K : ℝ}
    (hK : 0 < K) (η : ℝ) : heatDebt T ν K η = heatDebt T ν K 0

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.integral_rescale
statement:
theorem integral_rescale (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (F : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (∫ X, F X) = R * ∫ x, F (R * x)

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.intervals_separated
statement:
theorem intervals_separated (P : Patch) (i j : Fin 3) (hij : i < j) :
    upper P i ≤ lower P j

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.linearEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem linearEquiv_apply (P : Patch) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 ≤ lam) (c : Coeff) :
    linearEquiv P lam hlam c = (linearMatrix P lam).mulVec c

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.linearMatrix_det_ne_zero
statement:
theorem linearMatrix_det_ne_zero (P : Patch) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 ≤ lam) :
    (linearMatrix P lam).det ≠ 0

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.linearMatrix_entry
statement:
theorem linearMatrix_entry (P : Patch) (lam : ℝ) (i j : Fin 3) :
    linearMatrix P lam i j = bumpMoment P (powers lam i) j

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.lower_gt_left
statement: theorem lower_gt_left (P : Patch) (j : Fin 3) : P.left < lower P j

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.lower_lt_upper
statement: theorem lower_lt_upper (P : Patch) (j : Fin 3) : lower P j < upper P j

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.mixed_moment_unchanged
statement:
theorem mixed_moment_unchanged (P : Patch) (lam R a : ℝ) (c : Coeff) (U : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hU : ∀ X, X / R ∈ Ioo P.left P.right → U X = 0) :
    (∫ X, U X * physicalProfile P lam R a c X) = ∫ X, U X * cleanProfile lam R a X

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.momentMap_identity
statement:
theorem momentMap_identity (P : Patch) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 ≤ lam) (c : Coeff) :
    linearEquiv P lam hlam c + quadraticCLM P c c = momentMap P lam c

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.normalizedDebt_eq
statement:
theorem normalizedDebt_eq (R a : ℝ) (d : Coeff) :
    normalizedDebt R a d = amplitudeDebt a (scaledDebt R d)

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.patch_heat_disjoint
statement:
theorem patch_heat_disjoint (P : Patch) (lam q K a h ν : ℝ)
    (hq : 0 < q) (hK : 0 < K) (hpatch : q * P.right ≤ 1)
    (c : Coeff) (E : ℝ → ℝ) {X : ℝ} (hX : 0 < X) :
    (physicalProfile P lam (q * K) a c X - cleanProfile lam (q * K) a X) *
      HeatTailEdit.change E h ν K X = 0

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.physicalDifference_hasCompactSupport
statement:
theorem physicalDifference_hasCompactSupport (P : Patch) (lam R a : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R)
    (c : Coeff) :
    HasCompactSupport (fun X => physicalProfile P lam R a c X - cleanProfile lam R a X)

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.physicalMoments_cancel
statement:
theorem physicalMoments_cancel (P : Patch) (lam R a : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (ha : 0 < a)
    (c d : Coeff) (heq : momentMap P lam c = normalizedDebt R a d) :
    physicalMoments P lam R a c + d = 0

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.physicalMoments_eq
statement:
theorem physicalMoments_eq (P : Patch) (lam R a : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (c : Coeff) :
    physicalMoments P lam R a c =
      ![2 * a ^ 2 * momentMap P lam c 0,
        2 * R * a ^ 2 * momentMap P lam c 1,
        R * Real.sqrt (2 * R) * a * momentMap P lam c 2]

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.physicalMoments_integrable
statement:
theorem physicalMoments_integrable (P : Patch) (lam R a : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (c : Coeff) :
    Integrable (fun X => ((physicalProfile P lam R a c X) ^ 2 -
      (cleanProfile lam R a X) ^ 2) / X) ∧
    Integrable (fun X => (physicalProfile P lam R a c X) ^ 2 -
      (cleanProfile lam R a X) ^ 2) ∧
    Integrable (fun X => Real.sqrt (2 * X) *
      (physicalProfile P lam R a c X - cleanProfile lam R a X))

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.physicalMoments_positive_radius
statement:
theorem physicalMoments_positive_radius (P : Patch) (lam R a : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (c : Coeff) :
    physicalMoments P lam R a c =
      ![∫ X in Ioi 0, ((physicalProfile P lam R a c X) ^ 2 - (cleanProfile lam R a X) ^ 2) / X,
        ∫ X in Ioi 0, (physicalProfile P lam R a c X) ^ 2 - (cleanProfile lam R a X) ^ 2,
        ∫ X in Ioi 0, Real.sqrt (2 * X) *
          (physicalProfile P lam R a c X - cleanProfile lam R a X)]

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.physicalProfile_eq_clean_of_nonpos
statement:
theorem physicalProfile_eq_clean_of_nonpos (P : Patch) (lam R a : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R)
    (c : Coeff) {X : ℝ} (hX : X ≤ 0) :
    physicalProfile P lam R a c X = cleanProfile lam R a X

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.physicalProfile_eq_clean_outside
statement:
theorem physicalProfile_eq_clean_outside (P : Patch) (lam R a : ℝ) (c : Coeff) (X : ℝ)
    (hX : X / R ∉ Ioo P.left P.right) :
    physicalProfile P lam R a c X = cleanProfile lam R a X

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.physicalProfile_family_contDiffOn
statement:
theorem physicalProfile_family_contDiffOn (P : Patch) (lam R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R)
    {U : Set ℝ} {a : ℝ → ℝ} {c : ℝ → Coeff}
    (ha : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a U) (hc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c U) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => physicalProfile P lam R (a z.1) (c z.1) z.2) (U ×ˢ Ioi 0)

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.powers_injective
statement: theorem powers_injective (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 ≤ lam) : Injective (powers lam)

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.pressure_density_rescale
statement:
theorem pressure_density_rescale (P : Patch) (lam R a : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R)
    (c : Coeff) (x : ℝ) :
    ((physicalProfile P lam R a c (R * x)) ^ 2 - (cleanProfile lam R a (R * x)) ^ 2) /
        (R * x) = (2 * a ^ 2 / R) * weightedChange P lam c (-1) x

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.quadraticCLM_apply
statement:
theorem quadraticCLM_apply (P : Patch) (c d : Coeff) :
    quadraticCLM P c d =
      ![(1 / 2) * ∑ j, squareMoment P (-1) j * c j * d j,
        (1 / 2) * ∑ j, squareMoment P 0 j * c j * d j, 0]

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.scaled_heatDebt_bound
statement:
theorem scaled_heatDebt_bound (T : OutgoingTail.TailData) (ν q : ℝ)
    (hν : 0 < ν) (hq : 0 < q) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ K : ℝ, 0 < K →
      ‖scaledDebt (q * K) (heatDebt T ν K 0)‖ ≤ C / K

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.square_change_add_of_disjoint
statement:
theorem square_change_add_of_disjoint (b p t : ℝ) (hpt : p * t = 0) :
    (b + p + t) ^ 2 - b ^ 2 = ((b + p) ^ 2 - b ^ 2) + ((b + t) ^ 2 - b ^ 2)

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.upper_lt_right
statement: theorem upper_lt_right (P : Patch) (j : Fin 3) : upper P j < P.right

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.weightedChange_identity
statement:
theorem weightedChange_identity (P : Patch) (lam : ℝ) (c : Coeff) (w x : ℝ) :
    weightedChange P lam c w x =
      x ^ (w + slope lam) * correction P c x + x ^ w * (correction P c x) ^ 2 / 2

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.weightedChange_integrable
statement:
theorem weightedChange_integrable (P : Patch) (lam : ℝ) (c : Coeff) (w : ℝ) :
    Integrable (weightedChange P lam c w)

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.weightedChange_integral
statement:
theorem weightedChange_integral (P : Patch) (lam : ℝ) (c : Coeff) (w : ℝ) :
    (∫ x, weightedChange P lam c w x) =
      (∑ j, c j * bumpMoment P (w + slope lam) j) +
        (∑ j, (c j) ^ 2 * squareMoment P w j) / 2

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.weighted_bump_integrable
statement:
theorem weighted_bump_integrable (P : Patch) (s : ℝ) (j : Fin 3) :
    Integrable (fun x => x ^ s * bump P j x)

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.weighted_bump_sq_integrable
statement:
theorem weighted_bump_sq_integrable (P : Patch) (s : ℝ) (j : Fin 3) :

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.weighted_correction_integrable
statement:
theorem weighted_correction_integrable (P : Patch) (s : ℝ) (c : Coeff) :

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.weighted_correction_sq_integrable
statement:
theorem weighted_correction_sq_integrable (P : Patch) (s : ℝ) (c : Coeff) :

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.weighted_integrable
statement:
theorem weighted_integrable (P : Patch) (s : ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hg : Continuous g) (hs : support g ⊆ Icc P.left P.right) :
    Integrable (fun x => x ^ s * g x)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingDilation.E_at_switch
statement:
theorem E_at_switch (F : Profile) (XR eta : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR) :
    E F XR (switchRadius F XR, eta) = carrierAmplitude F * (1 - F.data.rho)

statement:
theorem E_eq_clean_switch_profile (F : Profile) (XR eta X : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR)
    (hX : switchRadius F XR ≤ X) :
    E F XR (X, eta) = HeatTailEdit.outgoingProfile F.data (switchRadius F XR) eta X

theorem eventual_power (F : Profile) (XR eta X : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR) (hX : 0 < X)
    (hfar : tailRadius F XR ≤ X) :
    U F XR (X, eta) = 0 ∧ E F XR (X, eta) = powerE F XR X ∧
      I F XR eta X = X * H F XR (X, eta) / (1 - F.data.h)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingDilation.exists_dilated_outgoing_profiles
statement:
theorem exists_dilated_outgoing_profiles (P m : ℝ) (hP : 0 < P) (hm : 0 < m) :
    ∃ lam₀ C : ℝ, 0 < lam₀ ∧ 0 < C ∧ ∀ lam : ℝ,
      0 < lam → lam < lam₀ → ∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → 2 * h < lam →
      ∃ F : Profile, F.data.core.P = P ∧ F.data.core.m = m ∧
        F.data.core.lam = lam ∧ F.data.h = h ∧ Specification F C ∧
        ∀ XR : ℝ, 0 < XR → DilatedSpecification F XR

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingDilation.exists_fixed_schedule
statement:
theorem exists_fixed_schedule (P m : ℝ) (hP : 0 < P) (hm : 0 < m) :
    ∃ lam C : ℝ, 0 < lam ∧ 0 < C ∧ ∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → 2 * h < lam →
      ∃ F : Profile, F.data.core.P = P ∧ F.data.core.m = m ∧
        F.data.core.lam = lam ∧ F.data.h = h ∧ Specification F C ∧
        ∀ XR : ℝ, 0 < XR → DilatedSpecification F XR

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingDilation.ideal_prefix
statement:
theorem ideal_prefix (F : Profile) (XR eta X : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR) (hX : 0 < X) (hX' : X ≤ XR) :
    E F XR (X, eta) = F.data.core.P * OutgoingSchedule.shape eta * (X / XR) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) ∧
    U F XR (X, eta) = 4 * eta ∧
    Pi F XR (X, eta) = axisDatum F XR eta +
      (5 / 2) * F.data.core.P ^ 2 * OutgoingSchedule.shape eta ^ 2 * (X / XR) ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ)

theorem editBound_nonneg {h L : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (square : Bool) (n : ℕ) :

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.editJet_bound
statement:
theorem editJet_bound {h K L ν X : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hX : 1 ≤ X)
    (hν : ν ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) L) (square : Bool) (n : ℕ) :
    |editJet square h K n ν X| ≤ editBound square h L n / X

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.editJet_continuousOn_X
statement:
theorem editJet_continuousOn_X {h K ν : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h)

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.editJet_hasDerivWithinAt

theorem editJet_hasDerivWithinAt {h K ν X : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hX : 0 < X) (hν : 0 ≤ ν) (square : Bool) (n : ℕ) :
    HasDerivWithinAt (fun u => editJet square h K n u X)
      (editJet square h K (n + 1) ν X) (Ici 0) ν

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.energy_decay
statement: theorem energy_decay (d : TailData) : tailDecay d true + 0 < 0

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.etaConstant_nonneg
statement:
theorem etaConstant_nonneg (d : TailData) (square : Bool) {q : ℝ}

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.etaDebt_contDiffOn
statement:
theorem etaDebt_contDiffOn (d : TailData) {K : ℝ} (hK : 1 ≤ K) (square : Bool)
    {q : ℝ} (hq : tailDecay d square + q < 0) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (etaDebt d K square q) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.etaDebt_hasDerivWithinAt
statement:
theorem etaDebt_hasDerivWithinAt (d : TailData) {K : ℝ} (hK : 1 ≤ K) (square : Bool)
    {q : ℝ} (hq : tailDecay d square + q < 0) {eta : ℝ} (hη : eta ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    HasDerivWithinAt (etaDebt d K square q)
      (nuDebtJet d K square q 1 (diffusion eta) * (-2 * eta)) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) eta

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.etaDebt_jet_bound
statement:
theorem etaDebt_jet_bound (d : TailData) {K : ℝ} (hK : 1 ≤ K) (square : Bool)
    {q : ℝ} (hq : tailDecay d square + q < 0) (n : ℕ) {eta : ℝ}
    (hη : eta ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    |iteratedDerivWithin n (etaDebt d K square q) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) eta| ≤
      etaConstant d square q n * K ^ q

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.exists_physical_debt_C1_bounds
statement:
theorem exists_physical_debt_C1_bounds (d : TailData) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ K : ℝ, 1 ≤ K → ∀ eta ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
      |physicalPressure d K eta| ≤ C / K ∧
      |derivWithin (physicalPressure d K) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) eta| ≤ C / K ∧
      |physicalEnergy d K eta| ≤ C ∧
      |derivWithin (physicalEnergy d K) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) eta| ≤ C ∧
      |physicalAngular d K eta| ≤ C * Real.sqrt K ∧
      |derivWithin (physicalAngular d K) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) eta| ≤ C * Real.sqrt K

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.exists_physical_debt_jet_bounds
statement:
theorem exists_physical_debt_jet_bounds (d : TailData) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ K : ℝ, 1 ≤ K → ∀ eta ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
      |iteratedDerivWithin n (physicalPressure d K) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) eta| ≤ C / K ∧
      |iteratedDerivWithin n (physicalEnergy d K) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) eta| ≤ C ∧
      |iteratedDerivWithin n (physicalAngular d K) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) eta| ≤ C * Real.sqrt K

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.heatJetBound_nonneg
statement:
theorem heatJetBound_nonneg {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (n : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ heatJetBound h n

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.heat_ratio_physical
statement:
theorem heat_ratio_physical {q s τ : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (hs : 0 < s) :
    2 * (τ / q) / (s / q) = 2 * τ / s

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.integral_chain_continuousOn
statement:
theorem integral_chain_continuousOn (n : ℕ) :
    ContinuousOn (fun ν => ∫ t, J n ν t ∂μ) (Ici 0)

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.integral_chain_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem integral_chain_hasDerivAt (n : ℕ) {ν : ℝ} (hν : 0 < ν) :

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.integral_chain_hasDerivWithinAt
statement:
theorem integral_chain_hasDerivWithinAt (n : ℕ) {ν : ℝ} (hν : 0 ≤ ν) :

      (Ici 0) ν

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.iteratedDerivWithin_integral_chain
statement:
theorem iteratedDerivWithin_integral_chain (n : ℕ) {ν : ℝ} (hν : 0 ≤ ν) :
    iteratedDerivWithin n (fun u => ∫ t, J 0 u t ∂μ) (Ici 0) ν =
      ∫ t, J n ν t ∂μ

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.jetProduct_bound
statement:
theorem jetProduct_bound {a b A B : ℕ → ℝ} {X : ℝ} (hX : 1 ≤ X)
    (hA : ∀ i, 0 ≤ A i) (hB : ∀ i, 0 ≤ B i)
    (ha : ∀ i, |a i| ≤ A i / X) (hb : ∀ i, |b i| ≤ B i / X) (n : ℕ) :
    |jetProduct a b n| ≤ jetProduct A B n / X

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.jetProduct_continuousOn
NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.jetProduct_hasDerivWithinAt
statement:
theorem jetProduct_hasDerivWithinAt {a b : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ} {s : Set ℝ} {ν : ℝ}
    (ha : ∀ i, HasDerivWithinAt (a i) (a (i + 1) ν) s ν)
    (hb : ∀ i, HasDerivWithinAt (b i) (b (i + 1) ν) s ν) (n : ℕ) :
    HasDerivWithinAt (fun u => jetProduct (fun i => a i u) (fun i => b i u) n)
      (jetProduct (fun i => a i ν) (fun i => b i ν) (n + 1)) s ν

theorem multiplier_nu_contDiffOn {h K X : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hX : 0 < X) :

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.multiplier_nu_jet
statement:
theorem multiplier_nu_jet {h K X ν : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hX : 0 < X)
    (hν : 0 ≤ ν) (n : ℕ) :
    iteratedDerivWithin (n + 1) (fun u => multiplier h u K X) (Ici 0) ν =
      correctionJet h K (n + 1) ν X

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.multiplier_nu_jet_bound
statement:
theorem multiplier_nu_jet_bound {h K X ν : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hX : 1 ≤ X)
    (hν : ν ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (n : ℕ) :
    |iteratedDerivWithin (n + 1) (fun u => multiplier h u K X) (Ici 0) ν| ≤
      correctionBound h 1 (n + 1) / X

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.multiplier_zero
statement: theorem multiplier_zero {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (K X : ℝ) : multiplier h 0 K X = 1

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.nuConstant_nonneg
statement:
theorem nuConstant_nonneg (d : TailData) (square : Bool) {q : ℝ}

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.nuDebtJet_bound
statement:
theorem nuDebtJet_bound (d : TailData) {K : ℝ} (hK : 1 ≤ K) (square : Bool)
    {q : ℝ} (hq : tailDecay d square + q < 0) (n : ℕ) {ν : ℝ}
    (hν : ν ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    |nuDebtJet d K square q n ν| ≤ nuConstant d square q n * K ^ q

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.nuDebtJet_derivative
statement:
theorem nuDebtJet_derivative (d : TailData) {K : ℝ} (hK : 1 ≤ K) (square : Bool)
    {q : ℝ} (hq : tailDecay d square + q < 0) (n : ℕ) {ν : ℝ} (hν : 0 ≤ ν) :
    HasDerivWithinAt (nuDebtJet d K square q n) (nuDebtJet d K square q (n + 1) ν)
      (Ici 0) ν

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.nuDebtJet_eq_iteratedDerivWithin
statement:
theorem nuDebtJet_eq_iteratedDerivWithin (d : TailData) {K : ℝ} (hK : 1 ≤ K)
    (square : Bool) {q : ℝ} (hq : tailDecay d square + q < 0) (n : ℕ)
    {ν : ℝ} (hν : 0 ≤ ν) :
    iteratedDerivWithin n (nuDebtJet d K square q 0) (Ici 0) ν =
      nuDebtJet d K square q n ν

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.nuDebt_contDiffOn
statement:
theorem nuDebt_contDiffOn (d : TailData) {K : ℝ} (hK : 1 ≤ K) (square : Bool)
    {q : ℝ} (hq : tailDecay d square + q < 0) :

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.nuDebt_linear_first_neg
statement:
theorem nuDebt_linear_first_neg (d : TailData) {K : ℝ} (hK : 1 ≤ K)
    {q : ℝ} (hq : tailDecay d false + q < 0) {ν : ℝ} (hν : 0 ≤ ν) :
    nuDebtJet d K false q 1 ν < 0

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.outgoing_debts_integrable
statement:
theorem outgoing_debts_integrable (d : TailData) {K ν : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (hν : 0 ≤ ν)
    (eta : ℝ) :
    IntegrableOn (fun X => squareChange (outgoingProfile d K eta) d.h ν K X / X) (Ioi K) ∧
    IntegrableOn (squareChange (outgoingProfile d K eta) d.h ν K) (Ioi K) ∧
    IntegrableOn (fun X => Real.sqrt (2 * X) * change (outgoingProfile d K eta) d.h ν K X)
      (Ioi K)

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.physicalAngular_contDiffOn
statement:
theorem physicalAngular_contDiffOn (d : TailData) {K : ℝ} (hK : 1 ≤ K) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (physicalAngular d K) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.physicalAngular_endpoint_derivative_pos
statement:
theorem physicalAngular_endpoint_derivative_pos (d : TailData) {K : ℝ} (hK : 1 ≤ K) :
    0 < derivWithin (physicalAngular d K) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) 1

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.physicalAngular_eq
statement:
theorem physicalAngular_eq (d : TailData) {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (eta : ℝ) :
    physicalAngular d K eta = Real.sqrt 2 * nuDebtJet d K false (1 / 2) 0 (diffusion eta)

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.physicalAngular_hasDerivWithinAt
statement:
theorem physicalAngular_hasDerivWithinAt (d : TailData) {K : ℝ} (hK : 1 ≤ K)
    {eta : ℝ} (hη : eta ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    HasDerivWithinAt (physicalAngular d K)
      (Real.sqrt 2 * (nuDebtJet d K false (1 / 2) 1 (diffusion eta) * (-2 * eta)))
      (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) eta

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.physicalAngular_jet_bound
statement:
theorem physicalAngular_jet_bound (d : TailData) {K : ℝ} (hK : 1 ≤ K)
    (n : ℕ) {eta : ℝ} (hη : eta ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    |iteratedDerivWithin n (physicalAngular d K) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) eta| ≤
      (Real.sqrt 2 * etaConstant d false (1 / 2) n) * Real.sqrt K

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.physicalEdit_before
statement:
theorem physicalEdit_before (d : TailData) {K X : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (hX : 0 < X)
    (hXK : X ≤ K) (eta : ℝ) : physicalEdit d K eta X = outgoingProfile d K eta X

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.physicalEdit_eventual_heat_carrier
statement:
theorem physicalEdit_eventual_heat_carrier (d : TailData) {K q s τ eta : ℝ}
    (hK : 0 < K) (hq : 0 < q) (hs : 0 < s) (hν : diffusion eta = τ / q)
    (hlate : 3 ≤ Real.log ((s / q) / K) + 1 / 5) :
    q ^ (-exponent d.h) * physicalEdit d K eta (s / q) =
      (outgoingAmplitude d * K ^ exponent d.h) *
        RadialHeatProfile.spatialProfile (1 + d.h) τ s

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.physicalEdit_heat_carrier
statement:
theorem physicalEdit_heat_carrier (d : TailData) {K q s τ eta : ℝ}
    (hK : 0 < K) (hq : 0 < q) (hs : 0 < s) (hν : diffusion eta = τ / q)
    (hfull : 1 / 2 ≤ Real.log ((s / q) / K) + 1 / 5) :
    q ^ (-exponent d.h) * physicalEdit d K eta (s / q) =
      (outgoingAmplitude d * K ^ exponent d.h) *
        RadialHeatProfile.spatialProfile (1 + d.h) τ s *
          tailShape d (Real.log ((s / q) / K) + 1 / 5)

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.physicalEdit_joint_contDiffOn
statement:
theorem physicalEdit_joint_contDiffOn (d : TailData) {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => physicalEdit d K p.2 p.1)
      (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.physicalEdit_pos
statement:
theorem physicalEdit_pos (d : TailData) (K : ℝ) {eta X : ℝ}
    (hη : eta ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) (hX : 0 < X) : 0 < physicalEdit d K eta X

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.physicalEnergy_contDiffOn
statement:
theorem physicalEnergy_contDiffOn (d : TailData) {K : ℝ} (hK : 1 ≤ K) :

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.physicalEnergy_eq
statement:
theorem physicalEnergy_eq (d : TailData) {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (eta : ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.physicalEnergy_hasDerivWithinAt

theorem physicalEnergy_hasDerivWithinAt (d : TailData) {K : ℝ} (hK : 1 ≤ K)

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.physicalEnergy_jet_bound
statement:
theorem physicalEnergy_jet_bound (d : TailData) {K : ℝ} (hK : 1 ≤ K)

      etaConstant d true 0 n

statement:
theorem physicalPressure_contDiffOn (d : TailData) {K : ℝ} (hK : 1 ≤ K) :

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.physicalPressure_eq
statement:
theorem physicalPressure_eq (d : TailData) {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (eta : ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.physicalPressure_hasDerivWithinAt
statement:
theorem physicalPressure_hasDerivWithinAt (d : TailData) {K : ℝ} (hK : 1 ≤ K)
    {eta : ℝ} (hη : eta ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    HasDerivWithinAt (physicalPressure d K)
      (nuDebtJet d K true (-1) 1 (diffusion eta) * (-2 * eta)) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) eta

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.physicalPressure_jet_bound
statement:
theorem physicalPressure_jet_bound (d : TailData) {K : ℝ} (hK : 1 ≤ K)
    (n : ℕ) {eta : ℝ} (hη : eta ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    |iteratedDerivWithin n (physicalPressure d K) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) eta| ≤
      etaConstant d true (-1) n / K

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.physical_debts_integrable
statement:
theorem physical_debts_integrable (d : TailData) {K eta : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K)
    (hη : eta ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    IntegrableOn (fun X => squareChange (outgoingProfile d K eta) d.h (diffusion eta) K X / X)
      (Ioi K) ∧
    IntegrableOn (squareChange (outgoingProfile d K eta) d.h (diffusion eta) K) (Ioi K) ∧
    IntegrableOn (fun X => Real.sqrt (2 * X) *
      change (outgoingProfile d K eta) d.h (diffusion eta) K X) (Ioi K)

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.physical_debts_zero
statement:
theorem physical_debts_zero (d : TailData) (K : ℝ) {eta : ℝ} (hη : diffusion eta = 0) :

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.squareCorrectionJet_continuousOn_X

theorem squareCorrectionJet_continuousOn_X {h K ν : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h)

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.squareCorrectionJet_hasDerivWithinAt

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.weightedDebtJet_bound
statement:

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.weightedDebtJet_derivative

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.weightedDebtJet_eq_iteratedDerivWithin

theorem weightedDebtJet_eq_iteratedDerivWithin (square : Bool) (n : ℕ) {ν : ℝ} (hν : 0 ≤ ν) :
    iteratedDerivWithin n (weightedDebtJet W square h K q 0) (Ici 0) ν =

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.weightedDebt_contDiffOn
statement:
theorem weightedDebt_contDiffOn (square : Bool) :

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.weightedJet_bound
statement:

      (B * editBound square h L n) * weightedKernel K p q X

statement:

      HasDerivWithinAt (fun u => weightedJet W square h K q n u X)
        (weightedJet W square h K q (n + 1) ν X) (Ici 0) ν

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.weightedJet_dominated
statement:
theorem weightedJet_dominated (square : Bool) :
    ChainDominated (weightedJet W square h K q) (volume.restrict (Ioi K))

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.weightedJet_integrable
statement:
theorem weightedJet_integrable (square : Bool) (n : ℕ) {ν : ℝ} (hν : 0 ≤ ν) :

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.weightedJet_measurable

statement:
theorem amplitudeDebt_variable_bounds {S : Set ℝ} (huniq : UniqueDiffOn ℝ S)
    {a : ℝ → ℝ} {v : ℝ → Coeff} (ha : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a S)
    (hpos : ∀ η ∈ S, 0 < a η) (hv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v S)
    {D : ℝ} (hD : ∀ η ∈ S, ‖amplitudeFactors (a η)‖ ≤ D ∧
      ‖derivWithin (fun θ => amplitudeFactors (a θ)) S η‖ ≤ D)
    {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ S) :
    ‖amplitudeDebt (a η) (v η)‖ ≤ D * ‖v η‖ ∧
      ‖derivWithin (fun θ => amplitudeDebt (a θ) (v θ)) S η‖ ≤
        D * (‖v η‖ + ‖derivWithin v S η‖)

name: NavierStokes.ParametricTerminalCompensation.amplitudeDebt_variable_contDiffOn
NavierStokes.ParametricTerminalCompensation.amplitudeDebt_variable_derivWithin
statement:
theorem amplitudeDebt_variable_derivWithin {S : Set ℝ} {a : ℝ → ℝ} {v : ℝ → Coeff}
    {η : ℝ} (huniq : UniqueDiffWithinAt ℝ S η)
    (ha : DifferentiableWithinAt ℝ (fun θ => amplitudeFactors (a θ)) S η)
    (hv : DifferentiableWithinAt ℝ v S η) :
    derivWithin (fun θ => amplitudeDebt (a θ) (v θ)) S η =
      -(derivWithin (fun θ => amplitudeFactors (a θ)) S η * v η +
        amplitudeFactors (a η) * derivWithin v S η)

statement:
theorem exists_compensation_for_scaled_family (P : Patch) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 ≤ lam)
    (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q) {S : Set ℝ} (hS : IsCompact S) (huniq : UniqueDiffOn ℝ S)
    (a : ℝ → ℝ) (ha : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a S) (hpos : ∀ η ∈ S, 0 < a η)
    (d : ℝ → ℝ → Coeff) (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 < B)
    (hreg : ∀ K : ℝ, 1 ≤ K → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => scaledDebt (q * K) (d K η)) S)
    (hbound : ∀ K : ℝ, 1 ≤ K → ∀ η ∈ S,
      ‖scaledDebt (q * K) (d K η)‖ ≤ B / K ∧
      ‖derivWithin (fun θ => scaledDebt (q * K) (d K θ)) S η‖ ≤ B / K) :
    ∃ K₀ C : ℝ, 0 < K₀ ∧ 0 < C ∧ ∀ K : ℝ, K₀ ≤ K →
      ∃ c : ℝ → Coeff, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c S ∧ ∀ η ∈ S,
        physicalMoments P lam (q * K) (a η) (c η) + d K η = 0 ∧
        ‖c η‖ ≤ C / K ∧ ‖derivWithin c S η‖ ≤ C / K ∧
        FirstJetWithinBound P a c S η (C / K) ∧
        ∀ X : ℝ, 0 < X → 0 < physicalProfile P lam (q * K) (a η) (c η) X

statement:

    (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q) {S : Set ℝ} (hS : IsCompact S) (huniq : UniqueDiffOn ℝ S)
    (a : ℝ → ℝ) (ha : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a S) (hpos : ∀ η ∈ S, 0 < a η)
    (d : ℝ → ℝ → Coeff) (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 < B)
    (hreg : ∀ K : ℝ, 1 ≤ K → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => scaledDebt K (d K η)) S)
    (hbound : ∀ K : ℝ, 1 ≤ K → ∀ η ∈ S,
      ‖scaledDebt K (d K η)‖ ≤ B / K ∧
      ‖derivWithin (fun θ => scaledDebt K (d K θ)) S η‖ ≤ B / K) :
    ∃ K₀ C : ℝ, 0 < K₀ ∧ 0 < C ∧ ∀ K : ℝ, K₀ ≤ K →
      ∃ c : ℝ → Coeff, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c S ∧ ∀ η ∈ S,
        physicalMoments P lam (q * K) (a η) (c η) + d K η = 0 ∧
        ‖c η‖ ≤ C / K ∧ ‖derivWithin c S η‖ ≤ C / K ∧
        FirstJetWithinBound P a c S η (C / K) ∧
        ∀ X : ℝ, 0 < X → 0 < physicalProfile P lam (q * K) (a η) (c η) X

name: NavierStokes.ParametricTerminalCompensation.exists_physical_heat_compensation
statement:
theorem exists_physical_heat_compensation (P : Patch) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 ≤ lam)
    (T : OutgoingTail.TailData) (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (a : ℝ → ℝ) (ha : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1))
    (hpos : ∀ η ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, 0 < a η) :
    ∃ K₀ C : ℝ, 0 < K₀ ∧ 0 < C ∧ ∀ K : ℝ, K₀ ≤ K →
      ∃ c : ℝ → Coeff, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) ∧
        ∀ η ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
          physicalMoments P lam (q * K) (a η) (c η) + physicalDebt T K η = 0 ∧
          ‖c η‖ ≤ C / K ∧ ‖derivWithin c (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) η‖ ≤ C / K ∧
          FirstJetWithinBound P a c (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) η (C / K) ∧
          ∀ X : ℝ, 0 < X → 0 < physicalProfile P lam (q * K) (a η) (c η) X

name: NavierStokes.ParametricTerminalCompensation.exists_variable_compensation
statement:
theorem exists_variable_compensation (P : Patch) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 ≤ lam)
    {S : Set ℝ} (hS : IsCompact S) (huniq : UniqueDiffOn ℝ S)
    (a : ℝ → ℝ) (ha : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a S) (hpos : ∀ η ∈ S, 0 < a η) :
    ∃ ε C : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ 0 < C ∧ ∀ v : ℝ → Coeff,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v S → (∀ η ∈ S, ‖v η‖ < ε) →
      ∃ c : ℝ → Coeff, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c S ∧ ∀ η ∈ S,
        momentMap P lam (c η) = amplitudeDebt (a η) (v η) ∧
        ‖c η‖ ≤ C * ‖v η‖ ∧
        ‖derivWithin c S η‖ ≤ C * (‖v η‖ + ‖derivWithin v S η‖) ∧
        FirstJetWithinBound P a c S η (C * (‖v η‖ + ‖derivWithin v S η‖)) ∧
        ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < a η * (baseProfile lam x + correction P (c η) x)

        RadialHeatProfile.spatialProfile (1 + F.data.h) (ParametricHeatTail.diffusion eta) X *

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.E_on_patch
statement:
theorem E_on_patch (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta X : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR)
    (hX : 0 < X) (hpatch : X / patchRadius F XR ∈ Icc compensationPatch.left compensationPatch.right) :
    E F XR c (X, eta) = TerminalCompensation.physicalProfile compensationPatch F.data.core.lam
      (patchRadius F XR) (shapedPatchAmplitude F eta) (c eta) X

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.E_times_U
statement:
theorem E_times_U (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta X : ℝ)
    (hXR : 0 < XR) (hX : 0 < X) :
    E F XR c (X, eta) * U F XR (X, eta) = OutgoingDilation.E F XR (X, eta) * U F XR (X, eta)

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.H_contDiffOn
statement:
theorem H_contDiffOn (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR) {c : ℝ → Coeff}
    (hc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c parameterDomain) : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (H F XR c) domain

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.J_integrand_eq
statement:
theorem J_integrand_eq (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta X : ℝ)
    (hXR : 0 < XR) (hX : 0 < X) :
    H F XR c (X, eta) * U F XR (X, eta) = OutgoingDilation.H F XR (X, eta) * OutgoingDilation.U F XR (X, eta)

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.J_unchanged
statement:
theorem J_unchanged (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta X : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR) :
    J F XR c eta X = OutgoingDilation.J F XR eta X

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.M_unchanged
statement: theorem M_unchanged (F : Profile) (XR eta X : ℝ) : M F XR eta X = OutgoingDilation.M F XR eta X

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.Pi_after_switch
statement:
theorem Pi_after_switch (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta X : ℝ)
    (hXR : 0 < XR) (hX : switchRadius F XR ≤ X) :
    Pi F XR c (X, eta) = -(1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∫ u in Ioi X,
      ParametricHeatTail.physicalEdit F.data (switchRadius F XR) eta u ^ 2 / u

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.Pi_exp
statement:
theorem Pi_exp (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta y : ℝ) :
    Pi F XR c (Real.exp y, eta) = -(1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∫ t in Ioi y, E F XR c (Real.exp t, eta) ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.U_after_switch
statement:
theorem U_after_switch (F : Profile) (XR eta X : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR)
    (hK : switchRadius F XR ≤ X) : U F XR (X, eta) = 0

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.U_contDiffOn
statement: theorem U_contDiffOn (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR) : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (U F XR) domain

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.anchoredPrimitive_contDiff
statement:
theorem anchoredPrimitive_contDiff {P : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup P] [NormedSpace ℝ P]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ P] (f : P × ℝ → ℝ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (a : ℝ) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × ℝ => ∫ t in a..z.2, f (z.1, t))

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.canonicalKernel_comp_exp
statement:
theorem canonicalKernel_comp_exp (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta y : ℝ) :
    |Real.exp y| • canonicalKernel F XR c eta (Real.exp y) = E F XR c (Real.exp y, eta) ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.changeRow_decomposition
statement:
theorem changeRow_decomposition (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta : ℝ)
    (i : Fin 3) (X : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR) (hX : 0 < X) :
    changeRow F XR c eta i X = heatRow F XR eta i X + patchRow F XR c eta i X

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.correction_zero_outside
NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.energy_decomposition
statement:
theorem energy_decomposition (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta X : ℝ) :
    energyDensity F XR c eta X = OutgoingDilation.energyDensity F XR eta X - changeRow F XR c eta 1 X / 2

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.entrance_before_patch
statement: theorem entrance_before_patch (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR) : XR < patchRadius F XR

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.exists_compensation
statement:
theorem exists_compensation (F : Profile) :
    ∃ XR₀ C : ℝ, 0 < XR₀ ∧ 0 < C ∧ ∀ XR : ℝ, XR₀ ≤ XR → Nonempty (CompensationWitness F XR C)

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.exists_fixed_schedule
statement:
theorem exists_fixed_schedule (P m : ℝ) (hP : 0 < P) (hm : 0 < m) :
    ∃ lam B : ℝ, 0 < lam ∧ 0 < B ∧ ∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → 2 * h < lam →
      ∃ F : Profile, F.data.core.P = P ∧ F.data.core.m = m ∧
        F.data.core.lam = lam ∧ F.data.h = h ∧ OutgoingProfile.Specification F B ∧
        ∃ XR₀ C : ℝ, 0 < XR₀ ∧ 0 < C ∧ ∀ XR : ℝ, XR₀ ≤ XR →
          ∃ w : CompensationWitness F XR C, Specification F XR w.coefficients

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.exists_heated_profile
statement:
theorem exists_heated_profile {F : Profile} {B : ℝ} (hF : OutgoingProfile.Specification F B) :
    ∃ XR₀ C : ℝ, 0 < XR₀ ∧ 0 < C ∧ ∀ XR : ℝ, XR₀ ≤ XR →
      ∃ w : CompensationWitness F XR C, Specification F XR w.coefficients

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.extendedHeatE_contDiffOn
statement:
theorem extendedHeatE_contDiffOn (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR) :

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.freeLogE_contDiff
statement:
theorem freeLogE_contDiff (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR) :

statement:
theorem freeLogE_eq (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta y : ℝ)

    freeLogE F XR ((c eta, eta), y) = E F XR c (Real.exp y, eta)

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.full_switch_above_radius
statement:
theorem full_switch_above_radius {K X : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (hX : 0 < X)
    (hfull : 1 / 2 ≤ Real.log (X / K) + 1 / 5) : K ≤ X

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.heatE_after
statement:
theorem heatE_after (F : Profile) (XR eta X : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR)
    (hXK : switchRadius F XR ≤ X) :
    heatE F XR (X, eta) = ParametricHeatTail.physicalEdit F.data (switchRadius F XR) eta X

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.heatE_before
statement:
theorem heatE_before (F : Profile) (XR eta X : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR) (hX : 0 < X)

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.heatE_contDiffOn
statement:
theorem heatE_contDiffOn (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (heatE F XR) domain

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.heatE_eq_extended
statement:
theorem heatE_eq_extended (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : p ∈ domain) :
    heatE F XR p = extendedHeatE F XR p

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.heatE_pos
statement:
theorem heatE_pos (F : Profile) (XR eta X : ℝ) (hX : 0 < X) (heta : eta ∈ parameterDomain) :
    0 < heatE F XR (X, eta)

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.heatE_times_U
statement:
theorem heatE_times_U (F : Profile) (XR eta X : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR) (hX : 0 < X) :
    heatE F XR (X, eta) * U F XR (X, eta) = OutgoingDilation.E F XR (X, eta) * U F XR (X, eta)

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.heatRow_integrable
statement:
theorem heatRow_integrable (F : Profile) (XR eta : ℝ) (i : Fin 3) (hXR : 0 < XR)
    (heta : eta ∈ parameterDomain) : IntegrableOn (heatRow F XR eta i) (Ioi 0)

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.heatRow_integral
statement:
theorem heatRow_integral (F : Profile) (XR eta : ℝ) (i : Fin 3) (hXR : 0 < XR) :
    (∫ X in Ioi 0, heatRow F XR eta i X) =
      ParametricTerminalCompensation.physicalDebt F.data (switchRadius F XR) eta i

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.heatRow_zero_before
statement:
theorem heatRow_zero_before (F : Profile) (XR eta : ℝ) (i : Fin 3) (X : ℝ)
    (hXR : 0 < XR) (hX : 0 < X) (hXK : X ≤ switchRadius F XR) : heatRow F XR eta i X = 0

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.heat_differences
statement:
theorem heat_differences (F : Profile) (XR eta X : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR) (hX : 0 < X) :
    heatE F XR (X, eta) - OutgoingDilation.E F XR (X, eta) =
      HeatTailEdit.change (HeatTailEdit.outgoingProfile F.data (switchRadius F XR) eta)
        F.data.h (ParametricHeatTail.diffusion eta) (switchRadius F XR) X ∧
    heatE F XR (X, eta) ^ 2 - OutgoingDilation.E F XR (X, eta) ^ 2 =
      HeatTailEdit.squareChange (HeatTailEdit.outgoingProfile F.data (switchRadius F XR) eta)
        F.data.h (ParametricHeatTail.diffusion eta) (switchRadius F XR) X

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.integrable_positive_tail
statement:
theorem integrable_positive_tail (f : ℝ → ℝ) (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 < K)
    (hz : ∀ X : ℝ, 0 < X → X ≤ K → f X = 0) (hi : IntegrableOn f (Ioi K)) :
    IntegrableOn f (Ioi 0)

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.integral_positive_tail
statement:
theorem integral_positive_tail (f : ℝ → ℝ) (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 < K)
    (hz : ∀ X : ℝ, 0 < X → X ≤ K → f X = 0) :
    (∫ X in Ioi 0, f X) = ∫ X in Ioi K, f X

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.kernel_decomposition
statement:
theorem kernel_decomposition (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta X : ℝ) :
    canonicalKernel F XR c eta X = OutgoingDilation.canonicalKernel F XR eta X + changeRow F XR c eta 0 X

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.parameter_sq_le_one
statement: theorem parameter_sq_le_one {eta : ℝ} (heta : eta ∈ parameterDomain) : eta ^ 2 ≤ 1

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.patchIncrement_contDiffOn
NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.patchIncrement_eq_difference
statement:
theorem patchIncrement_eq_difference (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta X : ℝ) :
    patchIncrement F XR c (X, eta) =
      TerminalCompensation.physicalProfile compensationPatch F.data.core.lam
        (patchRadius F XR) (shapedPatchAmplitude F eta) (c eta) X -
      TerminalCompensation.cleanProfile F.data.core.lam (patchRadius F XR) (shapedPatchAmplitude F eta) X

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.patchRow_integrable
statement:
theorem patchRow_integrable (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta : ℝ)
    (i : Fin 3) (hXR : 0 < XR) : IntegrableOn (patchRow F XR c eta i) (Ioi 0)

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.patchRow_integral
statement:
theorem patchRow_integral (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta : ℝ)
    (i : Fin 3) (hXR : 0 < XR) :
    (∫ X in Ioi 0, patchRow F XR c eta i X) =
      TerminalCompensation.physicalMoments compensationPatch F.data.core.lam
        (patchRadius F XR) (shapedPatchAmplitude F eta) (c eta) i

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.patch_below_switch
statement:
theorem patch_below_switch (F : Profile) (XR X : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR)
    (hpatch : X / patchRadius F XR ∈ Icc compensationPatch.left compensationPatch.right) :
    X < switchRadius F XR

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.patch_square_difference
statement:
theorem patch_square_difference (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta X : ℝ)
    (hXR : 0 < XR) (hX : 0 < X) :
    E F XR c (X, eta) ^ 2 - heatE F XR (X, eta) ^ 2 = patchRow F XR c eta 1 X

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.positive_tail_indicator
statement:
theorem positive_tail_indicator (f : ℝ → ℝ) (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 < K)
    (hz : ∀ X : ℝ, 0 < X → X ≤ K → f X = 0) :
    (Ioi (0 : ℝ)).indicator f = (Ioi K).indicator f

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.primitive_contDiff
statement:
theorem primitive_contDiff {P : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup P] [NormedSpace ℝ P]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ P] (f : P × ℝ → ℝ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × ℝ => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..z.2, f (z.1, t))

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.pulseEnd_le_switch
statement:
theorem pulseEnd_le_switch (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR) :

statement:
theorem renormalized_decomposition (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta X : ℝ) :
    H F XR c (X, eta) - OutgoingDilation.powerH F XR X =
      (OutgoingDilation.H F XR (X, eta) - OutgoingDilation.powerH F XR X) + changeRow F XR c eta 2 X

name: NavierStokes.ReservedPatches.canonical_margins
statement:
theorem canonical_margins (F : Profile)
    (hw : F.data.core.wait = 60 * Real.log (1 / F.data.core.lam)) (s : Slot) :
    F.data.core.holdStart + 29 < leftClock F s ∧
      rightClock F s ≤ F.data.core.pulseStart - 3

name: NavierStokes.ReservedPatches.canonical_wait_gt_54
statement:
theorem canonical_wait_gt_54 {lam : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam) (hlam' : lam < 1 / 10) :
    54 < 60 * Real.log (1 / lam)

name: NavierStokes.ReservedPatches.clean_E_shaped
statement:
theorem clean_E_shaped (F : Profile) (XR eta X : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR) (hX : 0 < X)
    (hlo : F.data.core.holdStart ≤ OutgoingDilation.clock XR X)
    (hhi : OutgoingDilation.clock XR X ≤ F.data.core.pulseStart) :
    OutgoingDilation.E F XR (X, eta) =
      xAmplitude F XR eta * X ^ (-(1 / 2 + F.data.core.lam))

name: NavierStokes.ReservedPatches.clean_fields
statement:
theorem clean_fields (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR) (s : Slot)
    (eta : ℝ) {X : ℝ} (hX : X ∈ window F XR s) :
    OutgoingDilation.U F XR (X, eta) = 0 ∧
      OutgoingDilation.E F XR (X, eta) =
        xAmplitude F XR eta * X ^ (-(1 / 2 + F.data.core.lam))

name: NavierStokes.ReservedPatches.clock_bounds
statement:
theorem clock_bounds (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR) (s : Slot)
    {X : ℝ} (hX : X ∈ window F XR s) :
    leftClock F s < OutgoingDilation.clock XR X ∧
      OutgoingDilation.clock XR X < rightClock F s

name: NavierStokes.ReservedPatches.clock_inside_wait
statement:
theorem clock_inside_wait (F : Profile) (s : Slot) :
    F.data.core.holdStart < leftClock F s ∧ rightClock F s < F.data.core.pulseStart

statement:
theorem closedPatch_nonempty (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR) (s : Slot) :

statement:
theorem closedPatch_subset (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR) (s : Slot) :

statement:
theorem closedPatches_disjoint (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR)

    Disjoint (closedPatch F XR s) (closedPatch F XR t)

name: NavierStokes.ReservedPatches.finite_updates_eqOn
statement:
theorem finite_updates_eqOn {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR) (t : Slot)
    (s : ι → Slot) (v : ι → ℝ × ℝ → ℝ)
    (hs : ∀ i, s i ≠ t) (hv : ∀ i, Supported F XR (s i) (v i))
    (g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) :
    EqOn (fun p => g p + ∑ i, v i p) g (window F XR t ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ))

statement:
theorem five_row_updates_supported (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR) (s : Slot)

    Supported F XR s (fun p => A p.2 * FiveProfileMoments.u (momentPatch F XR hXR s) (c p.2) p.1) ∧
      Supported F XR s (fun p => A p.2 * FiveProfileMoments.e (momentPatch F XR hXR s) (c p.2) p.1)

name: NavierStokes.ReservedPatches.heat_increment_supported
statement:
theorem heat_increment_supported (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR)

statement:
theorem heat_left (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) :

statement:
theorem heat_right (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.ReservedPatches.heat_slot_actual_formula
statement:
theorem heat_slot_actual_formula (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR)

statement:
theorem heated_E_eq_clean (F : Profile) (XR : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR)

statement:

    (hp : 0 < power) (hlo : 0 < lo) (horder : lo < hi) (hqlo : 0 < qlo)
    (hleft : lo ≤ Real.sqrt qlo * a) (hright : Real.sqrt qhi * b ≤ hi)
    (v : PressureStream.Plane) (d : PressureStream.Plane → Debt) {p : ChartPoint}
    (hq : chartQ coord p ∈ Icc qlo qhi)
    (hΨ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (actualChartPotential coord A B lam a b power lo hi M v d) p) :

    (hp : 0 < power) (hlo : 0 < lo) (horder : lo < hi) (hqlo : 0 < qlo)

    (hq : chartQ coord p ∈ Icc qlo qhi) :

name: NavierStokes.MeanRankUpdate.actual_rank_stream_identities
statement:
theorem actual_rank_stream_identities (s : WeightedClasses.StripData ChartPoint)
    {coord A B lam a b power lo hi qlo qhi α : ℝ}
    (hc : 0 < coord) (hc1 : coord < 1) (hlam : 0 < lam) (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b)
    (hB : B ≠ 0) (hp : 0 < power) (hlo : 0 < lo) (horder : lo < hi) (hqlo : 0 < qlo)
    (hleft : lo ≤ Real.sqrt qlo * a) (hright : Real.sqrt qhi * b ≤ hi)
    (hT : ∀ p ∈ s.domain, chartInput p ∈ PhysicalCoordinateBounds.positiveTime)
    (hq : ∀ p ∈ s.domain, chartQ coord p ∈ Icc qlo qhi)
    (hR : ∀ p ∈ s.domain, p.1 ∈ Icc lo hi)
    (hz : ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ p ∈ s.domain, p ∈ supportBand a b qlo qhi → δ ≤ s.zeta p)
    (M : ℕ → ℝ) (v : ℕ → PressureStream.Plane) (w : PressureStream.Plane × PressureStream.Plane)
    {d : ℕ → PressureStream.Plane → Debt}
    (hd : WeightedClasses.UnweightedClass s α (fun n p => d n p.2.1)) :
    ∀ n p, p ∈ s.domain →
      actualChartAxial coord A B lam a b power lo hi (M n) (v n) (d n) p =
        slowChartDesired coord A B lam a b (d n) (p.1, p.2.1) ∧
      PressureStream.graphDivergence (PressureStream.physicalSpeed power (M n)) ((0 : PressureStream.Plane), v n) w

    (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (hq : 0 < q) (A η : ℝ) (d : Debt) (V G : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hV : ∀ r ∈ Ioo (Real.sqrt q * a) (Real.sqrt q * b),
      V r = q ^ (-A) * shapedAmplitude B η * (r ^ 2 / (2 * q)) ^ (-(1 / 2 + lam)))
    (hG : ∀ r ∈ Ioo (Real.sqrt q * a) (Real.sqrt q * b), G r = 0) :

      (angularIncrement lam (shapedAmplitude B η * (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 / 2 + lam)) a b
        (Real.sqrt q) (q ^ (-A)) d)

        (Real.sqrt q) (q ^ (-A)) d)

statement:
theorem reserved_five_rows (F : OutgoingProfile.Profile) {XR q : ℝ}
    (hXR : 0 < XR) (hq : 0 < q) (c : ℝ → HeatedOutgoing.Coeff) (A η : ℝ) (d : Debt) :
    FiveRowRank.FiveRows (reservedAngularBase F XR c q (q ^ (-A)) η)
      (reservedAxialBase F XR q (q ^ (-A)) η) d
      (angularIncrement F.data.core.lam (shapedAmplitude (ReservedPatches.radialAmplitude F XR 0) η)
        (ReservedPatches.radialSupportLeft F XR .mean) (ReservedPatches.radialSupportRight F XR .mean)
        (Real.sqrt q) (q ^ (-A)) d)
      (desiredAxialIncrement F.data.core.lam (shapedAmplitude (ReservedPatches.radialAmplitude F XR 0) η)
        (ReservedPatches.radialSupportLeft F XR .mean) (ReservedPatches.radialSupportRight F XR .mean)
        (Real.sqrt q) (q ^ (-A)) d)

statement:
theorem scaled_angular_mass {ell : ℝ} (hell : 0 < ell) (U : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (∫ r, r ^ (2 : ℕ) * scaleField ell U f r) =
      ell ^ 3 * U * ∫ x, x ^ (2 : ℕ) * f x

name: NavierStokes.MeanRankUpdate.scaled_angular_row
statement:
theorem scaled_angular_row {ell : ℝ} (hell : 0 < ell) (U : ℝ) (V G f g : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (∫ r, r ^ (2 : ℕ) *
      (scaleField ell U G r * scaleField ell U f r + scaleField ell U V r * scaleField ell U g r)) =
        ell ^ 3 * U ^ 2 * ∫ x, x ^ (2 : ℕ) * (G x * f x + V x * g x)

name: NavierStokes.MeanRankUpdate.scaled_axial_mass
statement:
theorem scaled_axial_mass {ell : ℝ} (hell : 0 < ell) (U : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (∫ r, r * scaleField ell U f r) = ell ^ 2 * U * ∫ x, x * f x

name: NavierStokes.MeanRankUpdate.scaled_axial_row
statement:
theorem scaled_axial_row {ell : ℝ} (hell : 0 < ell) (U : ℝ) (V G f g : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (∫ r, 2 * r * scaleField ell U G r * scaleField ell U g r -
      r * scaleField ell U V r * scaleField ell U f r) =
        ell ^ 2 * U ^ 2 * ∫ x, 2 * x * G x * g x - x * V x * f x

name: NavierStokes.MeanRankUpdate.scaled_pressure_row
statement:
theorem scaled_pressure_row {ell : ℝ} (hell : 0 < ell) (U : ℝ) (V f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (∫ r, (2 * scaleField ell U V r / r) * scaleField ell U f r) =
      U ^ 2 * ∫ x, (2 * V x / x) * f x

      scaledPrimitive (fun r => f (r, p.2.1)) p.1

    (v : PressureStream.Plane) (w : E × PressureStream.Plane) {f : ℝ × E → ℝ}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hs : RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b f)
    (p : PressureStream.Lift E) :

      (PressureStream.streamBeta w
        (PressureStream.streamPotential d a b M ((0 : E), v) (slowLift f)))

name: NavierStokes.SmoothFamilyTorusInverse.fderiv_applyMultiplier
statement:
theorem fderiv_applyMultiplier {m : Frequency → ℂ} (hm : PolynomialGrowth m)
    {f : Source P} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hp : Periodic f) (z : Point P) :
    fderiv ℝ (applyMultiplier m f) z =
      (∑ i : BasisIndex P, parameterLift i
        (applyMultiplier m (parameterPartial (parameterBasis i) f) z)) +
      torusLiftX (applyMultiplier (multiplierX m) f z) +
      torusLiftY (applyMultiplier (multiplierY m) f z)

name: NavierStokes.SmoothFamilyTorusInverse.mixedJet_inverse_bound
statement:
theorem mixedJet_inverse_bound (d : Direction) {f : Source P}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hp : Periodic f) (q : ℕ) (w : List Bool)
    (S : Set P) {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hzero : ∀ p ∈ S, ∀ x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ‖parameterJet q f (p, (x, y))‖ ≤ C)
    (hfirst : ∀ p ∈ S, ∀ x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ‖tensorTorusWord (List.replicate (w.length + 5) false)
        (fun Y => parameterJet q f (p, Y)) (x, y)‖ ≤ C)
    (hsecond : ∀ p ∈ S, ∀ x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ‖tensorTorusWord (List.replicate (w.length + 5) false)
        (fun Y => parameterJet q f (p, (Y.2, Y.1))) (x, y)‖ ≤ C)
    (p : P) (hps : p ∈ S) (Y : Plane) :
    ‖mixedJet q w (inverse d f) (p, Y)‖ ≤
      ParametricTorusInverse.mixedLossConstant w.length * C

statement:
theorem norm_derivativeWord_inverse_le (d : Direction) {f : Source P}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hp : Periodic f) (w : List Bool) (p : P) (Y : Plane) {C : ℝ}
    (hzero : ∀ x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖f (p, (x, y))‖ ≤ C)
    (hfirst : ∀ x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ‖SmoothFourierData.xJet (w.length + 5) (slice f p) (x, y)‖ ≤ C)
    (hsecond : ∀ x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ‖SmoothFourierData.xJet (w.length + 5)
        (SmoothFourierData.swapFunction (slice f p)) (x, y)‖ ≤ C) :
    ‖derivativeWord w (slice (inverse d f) p) Y‖ ≤
      ParametricTorusInverse.mixedLossConstant w.length * C

theorem norm_jet_applyMultiplier_le (n l : ℕ) {m : Frequency → ℂ}

    {f : Source P} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hp : Periodic f)
    {S : Set P} {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (h : JetBound f S (n + l + 4) C)
    (p : P) (hps : p ∈ S) (Y : Plane) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (applyMultiplier m f) (p, Y)‖ ≤
      multiplierJetConstant (P := P) n l * B * C

name: NavierStokes.SmoothFamilyTorusInverse.norm_multiplierTermDerivative_le

theorem norm_multiplierTermDerivative_le (m : Frequency → ℂ) (f : Source P)

      (∑ i : BasisIndex P, ‖parameterLift i‖ *
        ‖m k * coefficient (parameterPartial (parameterBasis i) f) z.1 k‖) +
      ‖torusLiftX (P := P)‖ * ‖multiplierX m k * coefficient f z.1 k‖ +
      ‖torusLiftY (P := P)‖ * ‖multiplierY m k * coefficient f z.1 k‖

    (hab : a ≤ b) (hχ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ)
    (hleft : ∀ u ≤ a, χ u = 0) (hright : ∀ u, b ≤ u → χ u = 1) (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ (M : ℝ) (v : E) (J : (ℝ × E → F) → ℝ × E → F)
      (f : ℝ × E → F) (p : ℕ) (C : ℝ), M ≠ 0 → 0 ≤ C →
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ f → RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b f →
      (∀ n < p, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (J (RadialAlias.sourceJet J f n))) →
      (∀ n < p, RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b (J (RadialAlias.sourceJet J f n))) →
      (∀ n < p, RadialAlias.directionalDeriv v (J (RadialAlias.sourceJet J f n)) =
        RadialAlias.sourceJet J f n) →
      FiniteJetBound m (RadialAlias.sourceJet J f p) (Prod.fst ⁻¹' Icc a b) C →
      ∀ j ≤ m, ∀ z : ℝ × E,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (exactAlias χ M v f) z‖ ≤ K * C * (|M|⁻¹) ^ p

NavierStokes.UniformFourierAlias.exactAlias_uniform_of_inverse
statement:
theorem exactAlias_uniform_of_inverse {a b : ℝ} {v : E} {χ : ℝ → ℝ}
    (G : (ℝ × E → F) → Prop) (J : (ℝ × E → F) → ℝ × E → F) (loss : ℕ)
    (hab : a ≤ b) (hχ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ)
    (hleft : ∀ u ≤ a, χ u = 0) (hright : ∀ u, b ≤ u → χ u = 1)
    (hregular : ∀ f, G f → ContDiff ℝ ∞ f ∧ RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b f)
    (hsmooth : ∀ f, G f → ContDiff ℝ ∞ (J f))
    (hsupport : ∀ f, G f → RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b (J f))
    (hsolve : ∀ f, G f → RadialAlias.directionalDeriv v (J f) = f)
    (hclosed : ∀ f, G f → G (RadialAlias.slowDeriv (J f)))
    (htame : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ f, G f → ∀ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C →
      FiniteJetBound (m + loss) f (Prod.fst ⁻¹' Icc a b) C →
        FiniteJetBound m (J f) (Prod.fst ⁻¹' Icc a b) (K * C)) (m p : ℕ) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ f, G f → ∀ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C →
      FiniteJetBound (m + (loss + 1) * p) f (Prod.fst ⁻¹' Icc a b) C →
      ∀ M : ℝ, M ≠ 0 → ∀ j ≤ m, ∀ z : ℝ × E,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (exactAlias χ M v f) z‖ ≤ K * C * (|M|⁻¹) ^ p

name: NavierStokes.UniformFourierAlias.fiberOperator_preserves_meanClass
statement:
theorem fiberOperator_preserves_meanClass
    (T : (((ℝ × S) × Plane) → F) → ((ℝ × S) × Plane) → H) (loss : ℕ)
    (hTsmooth : ∀ f, ContDiff ℝ ∞ f → ParameterPeriodic f → ContDiff ℝ ∞ (T f))
    (hTbound : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ (f : ((ℝ × S) × Plane) → F)
      (A : Set (ℝ × S)) (C : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ f → ParameterPeriodic f → 0 ≤ C →
      (∀ j ≤ m + loss, ∀ p ∈ A, ∀ Y, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f (p, Y)‖ ≤ C) →
      ∀ j ≤ m, ∀ p ∈ A, ∀ Y, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (T f) (p, Y)‖ ≤ K * C)
    {a b cL cR : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hcL : 0 < cL) (hcR : 0 < cR)
    (ε R : ℕ → ℝ) (hε : ∀ n, 0 < ε n) (hεone : ∀ n, ε n ≤ 1) (hR : ∀ n, 1 ≤ R n)
    {α : ℝ} {f : ℕ → ℝ × (S × Plane) → F}
    (hf : MeanClass (logStripData a b cL cR ha hcL hcR ε R hε hεone hR) α f)
    (hfc : ∀ n, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (f n)) (hp : ∀ n, SourcePeriodic (f n)) :
    MeanClass (logStripData a b cL cR ha hcL hcR ε R hε hεone hR) α
      (fun n => fromProduct (T (toProduct (f n))))

statement:
theorem dividedAlias_eq_pullback {d a b M : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (hd : 0 < d)
    (v : E) (g : ℝ × E → ℝ) :
    PressureStream.divideRadius (RadialPullback.physicalAlias d a b M v g) =
      fun z => aliasFactor d a z.1 * UniformFourierAlias.exactAlias
        (TransportPrimitive.interiorCutoff (a ^ d) (b ^ d)) M v (RadialPullback.normalizeSource d a g)
          (RadialPullback.liftChart (RadialPullback.powerChart d a) z)

name: NavierStokes.TemporalMeanUpdate.dividedAlias_finiteJets_transfer
statement:
theorem dividedAlias_finiteJets_transfer {d a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (hd : 0 < d)
    (m : ℕ) : ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ (M : ℝ) (v : E) (g : ℝ × E → ℝ),
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ g → RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b g →
      ∀ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C →
      (∀ j ≤ m, ∀ z : ℝ × E, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (UniformFourierAlias.exactAlias
        (TransportPrimitive.interiorCutoff (a ^ d) (b ^ d)) M v
          (RadialPullback.normalizeSource d a g)) z‖ ≤ C) →
      ∀ j ≤ m, ∀ z : ℝ × E,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (PressureStream.divideRadius (RadialPullback.physicalAlias d a b M v g)) z‖ ≤
          K * C

    (ε R : ℕ → ℝ) (hε : ∀ n, 0 < ε n) (hεone : ∀ n, ε n ≤ 1) (hR : ∀ n, 1 ≤ R n)
    (M : ℕ → ℝ) (hM : ∀ n, M n ≠ 0) {g : ℕ → PressureStream.Lift S → ℝ}
    (hg : WeightedClasses.MeanClass
      (WeightedRadialPrimitive.logStripData a b cL cR ha hcL hcR ε R hε hεone hR) α g)
    (hgc : ∀ n, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (g n)) (hgp : ∀ n, PressureStream.TorusPeriodicLift (g n))
    (hgm : ∀ n p, PressureStream.torusAverage (g n) p = 0)
    (hgs : ∀ n, RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b (g n)) (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∃ p : ℕ, ∀ n j, j ≤ m → ∀ z : PressureStream.Lift S,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (PressureStream.divideRadius
        (RadialPullback.physicalAlias d a b (M n) ((0 : S), vector .radial) (g n))) z‖ ≤
          C * ε n ^ α * R n ^ p

name: NavierStokes.TemporalMeanUpdate.temporal_mean_update
statement:
theorem temporal_mean_update {d a b M : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (hd : 0 < d)
    (v : Plane) (w : S × Plane) (h : ℝ) (n : ℕ) {fθ fz : PressureStream.Lift S → ℝ}
    (hθ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ fθ) (hz : ContDiff ℝ ∞ fz)
    (hpθ : PressureStream.TorusPeriodicLift fθ) (hpz : PressureStream.TorusPeriodicLift fz)
    (hsz : RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b fz) (z : PressureStream.Lift S) :
    fastDerivative h n (desiredIncrement h n fθ) z + centered fθ z = 0 ∧
    fastDerivative h n (axialUpdate d a b M v h n fz) z + centered fz z =
      -fastDerivative h n (axialAlias d a b M v h n fz) z ∧
    PressureStream.graphDivergence (PressureStream.physicalSpeed d M) (0, v) w
      (radialUpdate d a b M v w h n fz) (axialUpdate d a b M v h n fz) z = 0 ∧
    PressureStream.torusAverage (desiredIncrement h n fθ) (z.1, z.2.1) = 0 ∧
    PressureStream.torusAverage (axialUpdate d a b M v h n fz) (z.1, z.2.1) = 0

name: NavierStokes.CorrectionState.rank_rows_on_patch
statement:
theorem rank_rows_on_patch (r : RankData S) (c : Context (Lift S)) (u : State (Lift S))
    (n : ℕ) (x : S) (Y : PressureStream.Plane)
    (hlam : 0 < r.lambda) (hC : r.coefficient n x ≠ 0)
    (ha : 0 < r.inner) (hab : r.inner < r.outer) (hell : 0 < r.length n x)
    (hU : r.velocity n x ≠ 0)
    (hV : ∀ R ∈ Ioo (r.length n x * r.inner) (r.length n x * r.outer),
      c.base.angular n (R, (x, Y)) =
        MeanRankUpdate.background r.lambda (r.coefficient n x) (r.length n x) (r.velocity n x) R)
    (hG : ∀ R ∈ Ioo (r.length n x * r.inner) (r.length n x * r.outer),
      c.base.axial n (R, (x, Y)) = 0) :
    FiveRowRank.FiveRows (fun R => c.base.angular n (R, (x, Y)))
      (fun R => c.base.axial n (R, (x, Y))) (debt c u n x)
      (fun R => rankAngular r c u n (R, x))
      (fun R => rankDesiredAxial r c u n (R, x))

name: NavierStokes.CorrectionState.reconstructed_radial_residual
statement:
theorem reconstructed_radial_residual (r : ReconstructionData)
    (ha : 0 < r.inner) (hd : 0 < r.exponent) (c : Context (Lift S))
    (u : State (Lift S))
    (hoperator : ∀ f : ScalarField (Lift S), ∀ n x, c.operators.dr f n x =
      PressureStream.graphDr (PressureStream.physicalSpeed r.exponent (r.frequency n))
        (0, r.radialDirection) (f n) x)
    (hsmooth : ∀ n, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (u.gr c n))
    (hsupport : ∀ n, RadialAlias.RadiallySupported r.inner r.outer (u.gr c n))
    (n : ℕ) (x : Lift S) :
    (reconstructPressure r c u).radialResidual c n x =
      -PressureStream.rho r.inner r.outer r.inner_lt_outer x.1 * pressureDefect c u n x.2.1 +
        pressureAlias r c u n (x, 0) 0

name: NavierStokes.CorrectionState.temporal_fast_cancellation
statement:
theorem temporal_fast_cancellation (r : ReconstructionData) (h : ℝ)
    (axial : S × PressureStream.Plane) (c : Context (Lift S)) (u : State (Lift S))
    (ha : 0 < r.inner) (hd : 0 < r.exponent)
    (hθ : ∀ n, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (u.thetaResidual c n))
    (hz : ∀ n, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (u.axialResidual c n))
    (hpθ : ∀ n, PressureStream.TorusPeriodicLift (u.thetaResidual c n))
    (hpz : ∀ n, PressureStream.TorusPeriodicLift (u.axialResidual c n))
    (hsz : ∀ n, RadialAlias.RadiallySupported r.inner r.outer (u.axialResidual c n))
    (n : ℕ) (x : Lift S) :
    TemporalMeanUpdate.fastDerivative h n ((temporalIncrement r h axial c u).angular n) x +
        TemporalMeanUpdate.centered (u.thetaResidual c n) x = 0 ∧
    TemporalMeanUpdate.fastDerivative h n ((temporalIncrement r h axial c u).axial n) x +
        TemporalMeanUpdate.centered (u.axialResidual c n) x = temporalAlias r h c u n (x, 0) 2

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicResidual.Actual.angularGenerator_add

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicResidual.Actual.cylindricalLaplacian_add
statement:
theorem cylindricalLaplacian_add {U : Set D} (hU : IsOpen U) (R : D → ℝ)
    {Vr Vθ Vz : D → D} (hr : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vr U)
    (hθ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vθ U) (hz : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vz U)
    {f g : D → ℂ} (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U) (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U)
    {x : D} (hx : x ∈ U) :
    cylindricalLaplacian R Vr Vθ Vz (f + g) x =
      cylindricalLaplacian R Vr Vθ Vz f x + cylindricalLaplacian R Vr Vθ Vz g x

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicResidual.Actual.cylindricalVectorLaplacian_add
statement:
theorem cylindricalVectorLaplacian_add {U : Set D} (hU : IsOpen U) (R : D → ℝ)
    {Vr Vθ Vz : D → D} (hr : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vr U)
    (hθ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vθ U) (hz : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vz U)
    {a b : D → ComplexVector}
    (ha : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => a y i) U)
    (hb : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => b y i) U)
    {x : D} (hx : x ∈ U) :
    cylindricalVectorLaplacian R Vr Vθ Vz (a + b) x =
      cylindricalVectorLaplacian R Vr Vθ Vz a x +
        cylindricalVectorLaplacian R Vr Vθ Vz b x

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicResidual.Actual.gradient_add
statement:
theorem gradient_add (R : D → ℝ) (Vr Vθ Vz : D → D)
    {p q : D → ℂ} {x : D} (hp : DifferentiableAt ℝ p x)
    (hq : DifferentiableAt ℝ q x) :
      LinearWaveResidual.gradient R Vr Vθ Vz (p + q) x = LinearWaveResidual.gradient R Vr Vθ Vz p x + LinearWaveResidual.gradient R Vr Vθ Vz q x

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicResidual.Actual.linearResidual_add
statement:
theorem linearResidual_add {U : Set D} (hU : IsOpen U) (ε : ℝ) (R : D → ℝ)
    {Vr Vθ Vz : D → D} (Vt : D → D) (hr : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vr U)
    (hθ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vθ U) (hz : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vz U)
    (B a b : D → ComplexVector) (p q : D → ℂ)
    (ha : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => a y i) U)
    (hb : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => b y i) U)
    (hp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ p U) (hq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ q U)
    {x : D} (hx : x ∈ U) :
    LinearWaveResidual.linearResidual ε R Vr Vθ Vz Vt B (a + b) (p + q) x =
      LinearWaveResidual.linearResidual ε R Vr Vθ Vz Vt B a p x + LinearWaveResidual.linearResidual ε R Vr Vθ Vz Vt B b q x

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicResidual.Actual.linearResidual_base_add
statement:
theorem linearResidual_base_add (ε : ℝ) (R : D → ℝ) (Vr Vθ Vz Vt : D → D)
    (B M a : D → ComplexVector) (p : D → ℂ) {x : D}
    (hB : ∀ i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => B y i) x)
    (hM : ∀ i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => M y i) x) :
    LinearWaveResidual.linearResidual ε R Vr Vθ Vz Vt (B + M) a p x =
      LinearWaveResidual.linearResidual ε R Vr Vθ Vz Vt B a p x +
      LinearWaveResidual.transport R Vr Vθ Vz M a x +
      LinearWaveResidual.transport R Vr Vθ Vz a M x

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicResidual.Actual.linearResidual_sum
statement:
theorem linearResidual_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) {U : Set D} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (ε : ℝ) (R : D → ℝ) {Vr Vθ Vz : D → D} (Vt : D → D)
    (hr : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vr U) (hθ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vθ U) (hz : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vz U)
    (B : D → ComplexVector) (u : ι → D → ComplexVector) (p : ι → D → ℂ)
    (hu : ∀ l ∈ s, ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => u l y i) U)
    (hp : ∀ l ∈ s, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (p l) U) {x : D} (hx : x ∈ U) :
    LinearWaveResidual.linearResidual ε R Vr Vθ Vz Vt B (∑ l ∈ s, u l) (∑ l ∈ s, p l) x =
      ∑ l ∈ s, LinearWaveResidual.linearResidual ε R Vr Vθ Vz Vt B (u l) (p l) x

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicResidual.Actual.nonlinearResidual_add_sub
statement:
theorem nonlinearResidual_add_sub {U : Set D} (hU : IsOpen U) (ε : ℝ) (R : D → ℝ)
    {Vr Vθ Vz : D → D} (Vt : D → D) (hr : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vr U)
    (hθ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vθ U) (hz : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vz U)
    (B a b : D → ComplexVector) (p q : D → ℂ)
    (ha : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => a y i) U)
    (hb : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => b y i) U)
    (hp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ p U) (hq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ q U)
    {x : D} (hx : x ∈ U) :
    nonlinearResidual ε R Vr Vθ Vz Vt B (a + b) (p + q) x -
        nonlinearResidual ε R Vr Vθ Vz Vt B a p x =
      LinearWaveResidual.linearResidual ε R Vr Vθ Vz Vt B b q x + LinearWaveResidual.transport R Vr Vθ Vz a b x +
        LinearWaveResidual.transport R Vr Vθ Vz b a x + LinearWaveResidual.transport R Vr Vθ Vz b b x

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicResidual.Actual.nonlinearResidual_mean_add
statement:
theorem nonlinearResidual_mean_add {U : Set D} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (ε : ℝ) (R : D → ℝ) {Vr Vθ Vz : D → D} (Vt : D → D)
    (hr : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vr U) (hθ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vθ U) (hz : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vz U)
    (B M a : D → ComplexVector) (p q : D → ℂ)
    (hB : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => B y i) U)
    (hM : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => M y i) U)
    (ha : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => a y i) U)
    (hp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ p U) (hq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ q U)
    {x : D} (hx : x ∈ U) :
    nonlinearResidual ε R Vr Vθ Vz Vt B (M + a) (p + q) x =
      nonlinearResidual ε R Vr Vθ Vz Vt B M p x +
      nonlinearResidual ε R Vr Vθ Vz Vt (B + M) a q x

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicResidual.Actual.nonlinearResidual_sum
statement:
theorem nonlinearResidual_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) {U : Set D} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (ε : ℝ) (R : D → ℝ) {Vr Vθ Vz : D → D} (Vt : D → D)
    (hr : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vr U) (hθ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vθ U) (hz : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vz U)
    (B : D → ComplexVector) (u : ι → D → ComplexVector) (p : ι → D → ℂ)
    (hu : ∀ l ∈ s, ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => u l y i) U)
    (hp : ∀ l ∈ s, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (p l) U)
    (hdisj : ∀ l ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ s, l ≠ j → Disjoint (tsupport (u l)) (tsupport (u j)))
    {x : D} (hx : x ∈ U) :
    nonlinearResidual ε R Vr Vθ Vz Vt B (∑ l ∈ s, u l) (∑ l ∈ s, p l) x =
      ∑ l ∈ s, nonlinearResidual ε R Vr Vθ Vz Vt B (u l) (p l) x

theorem conjugate_opposite_mean_bound {s : StripData D} {P : ℕ → D → ℝ} {α β κ : ℝ}
    (G : Geometry s κ) (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) {Φ : ℕ → D → ℝ} {ν : ℕ → ℝ} {a b : Family D}
    (ha : WaveVector s P α a) (hb : WaveVector s P β b)
    (hΦ : ∀ n, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Φ n) s.domain) (hν : ∀ n, ν n ≠ 0)
    (haθ : AngularIndependent G a)
    (hdiv : ∀ n x, x ∈ s.domain → cylindricalDivergence
      (G.radius n) (G.radial n) (G.angular n) (G.axial n) (vectorMode (ν n) (Φ n) (a n)) x = 0)
    (hP0 : ∀ n x, x ∈ s.domain → 0 ≤ P n x)
    (hP1 : ∀ n x, x ∈ s.domain → P n x ≤ 1) (i : Fin 3) :
    MeanClass s (α + β - κ) (fun n x =>
      (sameCoefficient G Φ (fun n => -(ν n)) a (conjugateFamily b) n x i).re)

name: NavierStokes.WaveInteractionBounds.real_equal_modes_identity
statement:
theorem real_equal_modes_identity {s : StripData D} {P : ℕ → D → ℝ} {β κ : ℝ}
    (G : Geometry s κ) (Φ : ℕ → D → ℝ) (ν : ℕ → ℝ) (a b : Family D)
    (hb : WaveVector s P β b) (hbθ : AngularIndependent G b)
    (hΦ : ∀ n, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Φ n) s.domain)
    (n : ℕ) {x : D} (hx : x ∈ s.domain) (i : Fin 3) :
    LinearWaveResidual.realTransport (G.radius n) (G.radial n) (G.angular n) (G.axial n)
      (fun y j => (vectorMode (ν n) (Φ n) (a n) y j).re)
      (fun y j => (vectorMode (ν n) (Φ n) (b n) y j).re) x i =
      (sameCoefficient G Φ ν a b n x i * carrier (2 * ν n) (Φ n) x).re / 2 +
        (sameCoefficient G Φ (fun n => -(ν n)) a (conjugateFamily b) n x i).re / 2

name: NavierStokes.WaveInteractionBounds.real_mean_coefficient_bound
statement:
theorem real_mean_coefficient_bound {s : StripData D} {P : ℕ → D → ℝ} {α β κ : ℝ}
    (G : Geometry s κ) (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) {Φ : ℕ → D → ℝ} {ν : ℕ → ℝ} {a b : Family D}
    (ha : WaveVector s P α a) (hb : WaveVector s P β b)
    (hΦ : ∀ n, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Φ n) s.domain) (hν : ∀ n, ν n ≠ 0)
    (haθ : AngularIndependent G a)
    (hdiv : ∀ n x, x ∈ s.domain → cylindricalDivergence
      (G.radius n) (G.radial n) (G.angular n) (G.axial n) (vectorMode (ν n) (Φ n) (a n)) x = 0)
    (hP0 : ∀ n x, x ∈ s.domain → 0 ≤ P n x)
    (hP1 : ∀ n x, x ∈ s.domain → P n x ≤ 1) (i : Fin 3) :
    MeanClass s (α + β - κ) (fun n x =>
      (sameCoefficient G Φ (fun n => -(ν n)) a (conjugateFamily b) n x i).re / 2)

name: NavierStokes.WaveInteractionBounds.real_modes_identity
statement:
theorem real_modes_identity {s : StripData D} {P : ℕ → D → ℝ} {β κ : ℝ}
    (G : Geometry s κ) (Φ : ℕ → D → ℝ) (ν ξ : ℕ → ℝ) (a b : Family D)
    (hb : WaveVector s P β b) (hbθ : AngularIndependent G b)
    (hΦ : ∀ n, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Φ n) s.domain)
    (n : ℕ) {x : D} (hx : x ∈ s.domain) (i : Fin 3) :
    LinearWaveResidual.realTransport (G.radius n) (G.radial n) (G.angular n) (G.axial n)
      (fun y j => (vectorMode (ν n) (Φ n) (a n) y j).re)
      (fun y j => (vectorMode (ξ n) (Φ n) (b n) y j).re) x i =
      ((sameCoefficient G Φ ξ a b n x i * carrier (ν n + ξ n) (Φ n) x).re +
        (sameCoefficient G Φ (fun n => -(ξ n)) a (conjugateFamily b) n x i *
          carrier (ν n - ξ n) (Φ n) x).re) / 2

name: NavierStokes.WaveInteractionBounds.realized_seed_pair_bound
statement:
theorem realized_seed_pair_bound {s : StripData D} {P : ℕ → D → ℝ} {α β κ δ M : ℝ}
    (R : D → ℝ) (Vr Vθ Vz : ℕ → D → D)
    (hR : ∀ x ∈ s.domain, 0 < R x)
    (hr : UnweightedClass s (-κ) Vr) (hθ : UnweightedClass s 0 Vθ)
    (hz : UnweightedClass s 1 Vz) (hinv : UnweightedClass s 0 (fun _ x => (R x)⁻¹))
    {Φ : ℕ → D → ℝ} {ν ξ : ℕ → ℝ} {a₀ b₀ : Family D}
    (hN : PhaseJetBounds.PolynomialJets (CurlClassBounds.phaseDomain s)
      (fun n => phaseNormal R (Vr n) (Vθ n) (Vz n) (Φ n)))
    (ha₀ : WaveClass s P α a₀) (hb₀ : WaveClass s P β b₀) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hlower : ∀ n x, x ∈ s.domain → δ ≤ ‖phaseNormal R (Vr n) (Vθ n) (Vz n) (Φ n) x‖)
    (hupper : ∀ n x, x ∈ s.domain → ‖phaseNormal R (Vr n) (Vθ n) (Vz n) (Φ n) x‖ ≤ M)
    (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) (hκhalf : κ ≤ 1 / 2)
    (hνinv : BandBound s (1 / 2) (fun n => 1 / ν n))
    (hξinv : BandBound s (1 / 2) (fun n => 1 / ξ n))
    (hν : ∀ n, ν n ≠ 0) (hratio : BandBound s 0 (fun n => ξ n / ν n))
    (hΦ : ∀ n, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Φ n) s.domain)
    (hG : ∀ n, CurlClassBounds.CylindricalGeometry s.domain R (Vr n) (Vθ n) (Vz n))
    (ht : ∀ n x, x ∈ s.domain → normalDot (phaseNormal R (Vr n) (Vθ n) (Vz n) (Φ n) x) (a₀ n x) = 0)
    (haθ : ∀ n i x, x ∈ s.domain → along (Vθ n)
      (fun y => CurlClassBounds.realizedCoefficient (ν n) R (Vr n) (Vθ n) (Vz n) (Φ n) (a₀ n) y i) x = 0)
    (hζ : ∀ x ∈ s.domain, s.zeta x ≤ 1)
    (hP0 : ∀ n x, x ∈ s.domain → 0 ≤ P n x)
    (hP1 : ∀ n x, x ∈ s.domain → P n x ≤ 1) :
    WaveVector s P (α + β - κ)
      (sameCoefficient (fixedGeometry R Vr Vθ Vz hR hr hz hinv) Φ ξ
        (fun n => CurlClassBounds.realizedCoefficient (ν n) R (Vr n) (Vθ n) (Vz n) (Φ n) (a₀ n))
        (fun n => CurlClassBounds.realizedCoefficient (ξ n) R (Vr n) (Vθ n) (Vz n) (Φ n) (b₀ n)))

name: NavierStokes.WaveInteractionBounds.same_label_curl_interaction
statement:
theorem same_label_curl_interaction {s : StripData D} {P : ℕ → D → ℝ} {α β κ : ℝ}
    (G : Geometry s κ) (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) {Φ : ℕ → D → ℝ} {ν ξ : ℕ → ℝ}
    {a b B : Family D} (ha : WaveVector s P α a) (hb : WaveVector s P β b)
    (hΦ : ∀ n, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Φ n) s.domain) (hν : ∀ n, ν n ≠ 0)
    (hratio : BandBound s 0 (fun n => ξ n / ν n))
    (haθ : AngularIndependent G a) (hbθ : AngularIndependent G b)
    (hG : ∀ n, CurlClassBounds.CylindricalGeometry s.domain
      (G.radius n) (G.radial n) (G.angular n) (G.axial n))
    (hB : ∀ n, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (B n) s.domain)
    (hcurl : ∀ n, EqOn (vectorMode (ν n) (Φ n) (a n))
      (CurlClassBounds.cylindricalCurl (G.radius n) (G.radial n) (G.angular n) (G.axial n) (B n))
      s.domain)
    (hζ : ∀ x ∈ s.domain, s.zeta x ≤ 1)
    (hP0 : ∀ n x, x ∈ s.domain → 0 ≤ P n x)
    (hP1 : ∀ n x, x ∈ s.domain → P n x ≤ 1) :
    ∃ c : Family D, WaveVector s P (α + β - κ) c ∧
      ∀ n x, x ∈ s.domain → LinearWaveResidual.transport
        (G.radius n) (G.radial n) (G.angular n) (G.axial n)
        (vectorMode (ν n) (Φ n) (a n)) (vectorMode (ξ n) (Φ n) (b n)) x =
          fun i => c n x i * carrier (ν n + ξ n) (Φ n) x

    (G : Geometry s κ) (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) {Φ : ℕ → D → ℝ} {ν ξ : ℕ → ℝ}

    (hΦ : ∀ n, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Φ n) s.domain) (hν : ∀ n, ν n ≠ 0)
    (hratio : BandBound s 0 (fun n => ξ n / ν n)) (haθ : AngularIndependent G a)
    (hdiv : ∀ n x, x ∈ s.domain → cylindricalDivergence
      (G.radius n) (G.radial n) (G.angular n) (G.axial n) (vectorMode (ν n) (Φ n) (a n)) x = 0)
    (hζ : ∀ x ∈ s.domain, s.zeta x ≤ 1)
    (hP0 : ∀ n x, x ∈ s.domain → 0 ≤ P n x)
    (hP1 : ∀ n x, x ∈ s.domain → P n x ≤ 1) :
    WaveVector s P (α + β - κ) (sameCoefficient G Φ ξ a b)

name: NavierStokes.WaveInteractionBounds.slot_complex_product_zero
statement:
theorem slot_complex_product_zero {d h : ℝ} {vr vt : PartitionedCovariance.Plane}
    (sys : PartitionedCovariance.SlotSystem d h vr vt)
    {L M : SlotColoring.Label} (hL : 1 ≤ L.1) (hM : 1 ≤ M.1) (hne : L ≠ M)
    {f g : PartitionedCovariance.Plane → ℝ}
    (hf : Function.support f ⊆ PartitionedCovariance.slotSet h sys.radius vr vt L)
    (hg : Function.support g ⊆ PartitionedCovariance.slotSet h sys.radius vr vt M)
    {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (x : SlotColoring.Position) (Y : PartitionedCovariance.Plane)
    (a b : ℂ) :
    (((PartitionedCovariance.physicalMask d L q x *
        PartitionedCovariance.covered (SlotColoring.nativeIndex h L.1) f Y : ℝ) : ℂ) * a) *
      (((PartitionedCovariance.physicalMask d M q x *
        PartitionedCovariance.covered (SlotColoring.nativeIndex h M.1) g Y : ℝ) : ℂ) * b) = 0

theorem switched_longitudinal (R : D → ℝ) (Vr Vθ Vz : D → D) (ν ξ : ℝ)
    (hν : ν ≠ 0) {Φ : D → ℝ} {a : D → ComplexVector} {x : D}
    (hΦ : DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ x) (ha : ∀ i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => a y i) x)
    (haθ : along Vθ (fun y => a y 1) x = 0)
    (hdiv : cylindricalDivergence R Vr Vθ Vz (vectorMode ν Φ a) x = 0) :

name: NavierStokes.WaveInteractionBounds.transport_mode_left
statement:
theorem transport_mode_left (R : D → ℝ) (Vr Vθ Vz : D → D) (κ : ℝ)
    (Φ : D → ℝ) (a b : D → ComplexVector) (x : D) (i : Fin 3) :
    LinearWaveResidual.transport R Vr Vθ Vz (vectorMode κ Φ a) b x i =
      LinearWaveResidual.transport R Vr Vθ Vz a b x i * carrier κ Φ x

name: NavierStokes.WaveInteractionBounds.transport_mode_right
statement:
theorem transport_mode_right (R : D → ℝ) (Vr Vθ Vz : D → D) (κ : ℝ)
    {Φ : D → ℝ} (a : D → ComplexVector) {b : D → ComplexVector} {x : D}
    (hΦ : DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ x) (hb : ∀ i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => b y i) x)
    (i : Fin 3) :
    LinearWaveResidual.transport R Vr Vθ Vz a (vectorMode κ Φ b) x i =
      (LinearWaveResidual.transport R Vr Vθ Vz a b x i +
        phaseFactor κ * normalDot (phaseNormal R Vr Vθ Vz Φ x) (a x) * b x i) * carrier κ Φ x

name: NavierStokes.WaveInteractionBounds.transport_modes
statement:
theorem transport_modes (R : D → ℝ) (Vr Vθ Vz : D → D) (κ κ' : ℝ)
    {Φ : D → ℝ} (a : D → ComplexVector) {b : D → ComplexVector} {x : D}
    (hΦ : DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ x) (hb : ∀ i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => b y i) x)
    (i : Fin 3) :
    LinearWaveResidual.transport R Vr Vθ Vz (vectorMode κ Φ a) (vectorMode κ' Φ b) x i =
      (LinearWaveResidual.transport R Vr Vθ Vz a b x i +
        phaseFactor κ' * normalDot (phaseNormal R Vr Vθ Vz Φ x) (a x) * b x i) *
          carrier (κ + κ') Φ x

name: NavierStokes.WaveInteractionBounds.transport_realLift
statement:
theorem transport_realLift (R : D → ℝ) (Vr Vθ Vz : D → D)
    (u : D → Fin 3 → ℝ) {v : D → Fin 3 → ℝ} {x : D}
    (hv : ∀ i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => v y i) x) (i : Fin 3) :
    LinearWaveResidual.transport R Vr Vθ Vz
      (LinearWaveResidual.realLift u) (LinearWaveResidual.realLift v) x i =
        (LinearWaveResidual.realTransport R Vr Vθ Vz u v x i : ℂ)

name: NavierStokes.WaveInteractionBounds.transport_real_parts
statement:
theorem transport_real_parts (R : D → ℝ) (Vr Vθ Vz : D → D)
    (u : D → ComplexVector) {v : D → ComplexVector} {x : D}
    (hv : ∀ i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => v y i) x) (i : Fin 3) :
    LinearWaveResidual.realTransport R Vr Vθ Vz
      (fun y j => (u y j).re) (fun y j => (v y j).re) x i =
        ((LinearWaveResidual.transport R Vr Vθ Vz u v x i).re +
          (LinearWaveResidual.transport R Vr Vθ Vz u (fun y j => star (v y j)) x i).re) / 2

name: NavierStokes.WaveInteractionBounds.wave_mean_identity
statement:
theorem wave_mean_identity {s : StripData D} {κ : ℝ} (G : Geometry s κ)
    (Φ : ℕ → D → ℝ) (ν : ℕ → ℝ) (m a : Family D)
    (hmθ : AngularIndependent G m) (haθ : AngularIndependent G a)
    (n : ℕ) {x : D} (hx : x ∈ s.domain) (hΦ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (Φ n) x)
    (ha : ∀ i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => a n y i) x) (i : Fin 3) :
    LinearWaveResidual.transport (G.radius n) (G.radial n) (G.angular n) (G.axial n)
      (m n) (vectorMode (ν n) (Φ n) (a n)) x i +
    LinearWaveResidual.transport (G.radius n) (G.radial n) (G.angular n) (G.axial n)
      (vectorMode (ν n) (Φ n) (a n)) (m n) x i =
        waveMeanCoefficient G Φ ν m a n x i * carrier (ν n) (Φ n) x

name: NavierStokes.HarmonicCovariance.angularProduct_add_error

theorem angularProduct_add_error (A B C E : OscillatoryScalar D)
    (hA : ∀ n x, Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => A n (x, θ)))
    (hB : ∀ n x, Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => B n (x, θ)))
    (hC : ∀ n x, Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => C n (x, θ)))
    (hE : ∀ n x, Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => E n (x, θ))) :
    angularAverage ((A + C) * (B + E)) - angularAverage (A * B) =
      angularAverage (A * E) + angularAverage (C * B) + angularAverage (C * E)

    (hb : ∀ j ∈ F, WaveClass s P β (fun n x => b n (-j) x))

    (i k : PolarCharts.Index)

theorem common_carrier_physical_bound {h a b Z r0 P B eBase : ℝ}

    (hZ : 0 ≤ Z) (hr0 : 0 ≤ r0) (hP : 1 ≤ P) (hB : 1 ≤ B) (heBase : 0 ≤ eBase)
    (Δ m : ℕ) (g eAmp A H : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hH : 0 ≤ H) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, 4 ≤ n → ∀ d : ℕ, d ≤ Δ →
      ∀ w : SpaceTime, PhysicalGraphBounds.scaledRadial n w ∈ PhysicalGraphBounds.annulus a b →
      |w.1| ≤ 1 → ‖PhysicalGraphBounds.liftZT (PhysicalGraphBounds.physicalLift h n w)‖ ≤ Z →
      ∀ q : ℝ, 0 < q → q / 2 ≤ ChartScales.Q n → ChartScales.Q n ≤ 2 * q →
      ∀ (c : CarrierData) (amp : LiftPoint → ℂ) (j : ℤ),
      |c.angular| ≤ P → |c.axial| ≤ P → |c.radial| ≤ P →
      |PhysicalGraphBounds.etaCoordinate (PhysicalGraphBounds.nativeGraph h n w - c.center)| ≤ r0 →
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ amp → ContDiff ℝ ∞ c.F → ContDiff ℝ ∞ c.G → |(j : ℝ)| ≤ H →
      (∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i amp (commonLift h n d w)‖ ≤
        A * ChartScales.Q n ^ g * ChartScales.S n ^ eAmp) →
      (∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i c.F
        (PhysicalGraphBounds.slotMap (PolarCharts.chart a c.chart)
          (ChartScales.timeCoefficient h n) c.center r0 (PhysicalGraphBounds.physicalLift h n w)).1‖ ≤
            B * ChartScales.S n ^ eBase) →
      (∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i c.G
        (PhysicalGraphBounds.slotMap (PolarCharts.chart a c.chart)
          (ChartScales.timeCoefficient h n) c.center r0 (PhysicalGraphBounds.physicalLift h n w)).1‖ ≤
            B * ChartScales.S n ^ eBase) →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (commonWave a h n d r0 c amp j) w‖ ≤
        C * q ^ (g - PhysicalGraphBounds.waveLoss h m)

    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, 4 ≤ n → ∀ d : ℕ, d ≤ Δ →
      ∀ w : SpaceTime, PhysicalGraphBounds.scaledRadial n w ∈ PhysicalGraphBounds.annulus a b → |w.1| ≤ 1 →
